article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser slår alarm over hurtig spredning af ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders sound the alarm over the rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompt an alarm from Doctors Without Borders (MSF). MSF says the extent and severity of the outbreak are unknown, with uncertainty surrounding transmission and case numbers. There have never before been so many Ebola cases so soon after an outbreak was declared. Alan Gonzales, MSF’s operational deputy director, notes the rapid spread and the difficulty in assessing the situation. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission within DR Congo and highlights concerns about the pace of spread after the outbreak declaration. The article attributes the warning to MSF and underscores the need for continued assessment and response, though it does not provide detailed figures or laboratory confirmation in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がエボラの急速な蔓延について警告を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは最高危険度の感染症であり、DRC での急速な蔓延は直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは最高危険度病原体であり、DRCにおける「これまでにない急速な蔓延」という警告は著名なNGOから発出されている。症例数・確認数の詳細は不明だが、MSFの懸念表明と急速な伝播の報告から深刻な状況と判断される。国際的な公衆衛生上の関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola em SP é diagnosticado com meningite; caso não é descartado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo is diagnosed with meningitis; the case has not been ruled out.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, previously from the Democratic Republic of Congo and recently visiting there, is suspected of Ebola but diagnosed with meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis; Ebola testing remains ongoing with results expected within 48 hours. He is in grave condition, isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas after initial care at a UPA for fever and inconclusive malaria tests, then deteriorated with diarrhea and disorientation requiring intubation. Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirmed meningococcal meningitis; Ebola tests continue to rule out infection. Contacts from the flight and early care are being monitored. Globally, WHO reports 18 deaths among 134 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda (13% mortality), with 223 deaths and 906 cases under investigation. No autochthonous transmission of Ebola in South America."

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ疑いの患者が髄膜炎と診断される、症例は除外されていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的に拡大するリスク、異常・予想外な症例）。ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者検出は南米では通常想定されないイベントであり、DRCからの渡航者からの症例は国際的監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCから最近訪問したブラジル患者がエボラ疑いで髄膜炎と診断された。エボラ検査は継続中。DRC・ウガンダ併せて134確定例18死亡、223死亡・906調査中の現在のアウトブレイク背景。南米での自動伝播なし。患者は隔離中で接触者追跡実施中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says community ownership key to ending Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marks the 17th Ebola epidemic in the country and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, one of six Ebola species. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain; survival is possible with early medical care, and some patients in Ituri have recovered. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Ghebreyesus emphasized community ownership and local participation, stating he aims to listen and support community-led solutions rather than impose orders. In Bunia, response priorities include hand hygiene, dissemination of accurate information, and safe, dignified burials. DRC Prime Minister Judith Tuluka pledged that response investments will strengthen the national health system long after the crisis. He urged reconsideration of travel bans that hinder transparency; WHO remains committed after the outbreak is declared over.

triage.headline_ja: WHOチーフが、エボラ出血熱の流行を終わらせるための鍵は地域社会の関与だと述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる新規流行が確認された。DRCのイトゥリ州での発生で、ワクチンや治療法がない株であり、国際的な関心と支援が必要とされている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（6種のエボラウイルスの一つ）による第17番目の流行。ワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOおよびDRC首相が国際社会に対応支援を呼びかけている。渡航禁止措置についても言及されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser slår alarm over hurtig spredning af ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders sound the alarm over the rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with MSF warning that the true scope and severity are unknown. More than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 223 deaths have occurred in DR Congo since the outbreak was declared a little over two weeks ago; neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. Transmission remains via direct contact with bodily fluids; the current variant has no approved treatments or vaccines. The World Health Organization estimates a 30–50% case fatality rate. The epicenter lies in eastern Ituri Province, including Bunia, where ongoing conflict and difficult terrain hinder response. MSF cites shortages of basic supplies and testing backlogs, and border and airport closures hamper control efforts. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia; critics argue WHO was slow to declare the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がエボラウイルスの急速な拡大に警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多国間流行（DRC＆ウガンダ）、高い死亡率（30-50%）、国際的拡大リスク、急速な症例増加、医療体制の崩壊兆候。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（対象国外）が含まれているが、記事サマリーで実際の患者発生はDRCが主（確認患者>1,000、死亡223名以上）。ウガンダは隣接国で9確認患者・1死亡報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ検証済み。エボラウイルス疾患の国際的拡大懸念、高い死亡率、医療体制の脆弱性、国家検査能力の不足などが複合的に存在。WHO事務局長の現地訪問実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا.. البرازيل تشتبه في مسافر قادم من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Brazil suspects a traveler coming from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola virus concerns in Brazil as São Paulo state health authorities investigate a suspected case in São Paulo, the capital, linked to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a regional outbreak. The patient has fever and is isolated in a hospital specialized in caring for suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. Globally, health authorities are racing to contain a rare Bundibugyo strain spreading from the DRC into Uganda. The World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC, with 223 deaths under investigation. Confirmed infections number 125 in the DRC and 7 in Uganda, including 3 imported from the Congo and 1 death. Ongoing transmission continues in both the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：ブラジルがコンゴからの旅行者の感染を疑う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染症、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認症例125例・死亡23例が報告されており、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ・ブラジル）への拡大が発生中。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIではウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。DRC由来の感染がブラジルに渡航者経由で持ち込まれた疑い。WHO報告の906疑似症例・125確認症例・23死亡（DRC=223死亡調査中、Uganda=1死亡）。2026年5月31日時点での多国間拡大事象であり、国際公衆衛生上の重大懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ketua WHO lawat pusat wabak Ebola di DR Congo; seru bantuan antarabangsa ditingkatkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits Ebola outbreak center in DR Congo; calls for increased international aid.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the Ebola outbreak center in Bunia, Ituri, DR Congo, urging greater international aid to combat Bundibugyo Ebola spreading across three eastern provinces and into Uganda. DR Congo reports at least 1,077 suspected cases since May 15, with 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed infections, including one death. WHO warns the true toll is likely higher due to limited laboratory capacity and insecurity hindering reporting. Uganda has closed its border with DRC and imposed a 21-day quarantine for arrivals. A patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests—the first confirmed recovery in the outbreak. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; CDC Africa says a vaccine could be ready by year-end, and WHO is evaluating several promising candidates for trials. North and South Kivu, along with Ituri, face persistent violence and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、DR Congo のエボラ出血熱感染拡大中心地を視察；国際支援強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。1,077疑似患者、246死亡、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）への拡大、ウガンダの国境閉鎖・検疫措置導入により、PICKUP判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域に Uganda が含まれるが、記事サマリーでは Uganda は 9 例の確定患者（1 死亡）が述べられており、主要な流行中心は DR Congo である。対象国リストに Uganda は含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo Ebola（稀な株）による前例なき大規模流行、複数州での同時流行、国境を越えた拡大、ワクチン・治療法不在といった要因が重大なリスク。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola internado em SP testa positivo para meningite; investigação continua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola hospitalized in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis; investigation continues.
article.articleSummary: In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man admitted to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas on May 30 has been diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) confirmed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. Ebola suspicion remains after recent travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where active transmission exists; Ebola-specific tests were sent to Adolfo Lutz and will undergo sequencing, with results expected within 48 hours. The patient remains in isolation, treated with antibiotics and hydration, after presenting with fever, diarrhea, disorientation and rapid deterioration requiring intubation. It is unclear whether he passed through affected provinces due to sedation. Contacts on the plane and at the UPA are being monitored. Public health authorities consider the risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil/South America very low, noting no autochthonous transmission, no direct flights, and transmission requiring direct contact with bodily fluids; exposed asymptomatic individuals are monitored for 21 days. Investigation ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の疑いで入院した患者がサンパウロで髄膜炎で陽性；調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラとメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の両方を検出し、DRC渡航歴がある患者の確認はシグナルとして重要。
triage.notes: 患者はサンパウロで確認されたが、DRCへの最近の渡航により、エボラ感染の可能性が排除されていない。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の確定診断に加え、エボラ検査は進行中。ブラジルでのエボラ導入リスクは公式には低いとされているが、DRC渡航歴と症状（発熱、下痢、意識混濁、急速な悪化）の組み合わせにより、確認検査が重要。飛行機上および医療施設での接触者監視が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉應對不佳！前CDC主任：全球未做好準備迎接下一場大流行病 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response was inadequate; former CDC director says the world is not prepared to face the next pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, former U.S. CDC Director Thomas R. Frieden warns that the world is not prepared for the next pandemic, citing a weak Ebola response as evidence. Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases as the outbreak accelerates, with border closures among the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Rwanda complicating relief and humanitarian coordination. Funding commitments to epidemic preparedness are only slightly above half of the US$500 million needed. Frieden notes a retreat of U.S. public health engagement, including loss of airlift support for responses and policy shifts under the Trump administration, such as stopping WHO dues and cutting more than 3,000 CDC staff, with leadership resignations in several agencies. He argues the WHO must be strengthened and the CDC must remain robust to avert future crises.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応が不十分！前CDC主任：世界は次の大流行に対する準備ができていない
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラ関連ウイルス）の1,077例の疑い例が報告され、DRC・ウガンダ・ルワンダ間の国境閉鎖が実施されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）の複数が該当。公衆衛生当局からの警告あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダとルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれていますが、記事サマリーでは実際の発生はDRCのBundibugyo ebolavirus感染症が主題。ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境閉鎖により対応地域として言及されているため、検証済み発生地としてはDRCのみを列挙。資金不足（500百万ドル必要に対し半分以下の確保）と国際調整の困難が指摘されており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: الدفن الآمن "حلقة مفقودة" في بؤرة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Safe Burial: "Missing Link" in the Ebola Outbreak Epicenter
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) marks the seventeenth outbreak there and the third-largest since 1976. The surge centers on Ituri's Bunia region, where first cases were confirmed earlier this month. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia and Kinshasa to urge early care—isolation, rehydration, and pain relief—and emphasized safe burials as a critical control point; burials carry high transmission risk. Health facilities faced attacks by crowds seeking to reclaim bodies for traditional rites; PPE shortages were reported. As of May 29, WHO reported 906 suspected cases with 223 deaths under investigation; later, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kampa cited 1,028 suspected cases and 225 confirmed. The rare Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or treatments; international funding has lagged. Infections have been confirmed across three provinces, with Uganda closing its border last week. Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo linked to Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 安全埋葬は「欠落の環」エボラ流行の震源地で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは高い致死率と国際的拡大の懸念を示し、ウガンダの国境閉鎖、ブラジルでの疑い例検出など既に複数国に影響を及ぼしている。
triage.notes: DRCではBundibugyo株のエボラが17番目の流行を引き起こし、223～225死亡が報告されている。WHOおよび各国保健当局の関心が高く、ウガンダの国境閉鎖およびブラジルでの疑い例検出により国際的な懸念が高まっている。ワクチン・治療法の不足が指摘されており、国際支援の必要性は明白。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉傳染性強、致死率高！　感染症專家：專業醫護也常遭感染 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is highly contagious and has a high mortality rate! Infectious disease experts: even professional healthcare workers are often infected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks continue in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda highlighted. Taiwan will ban entry from these countries for 90 days starting June 2, with exemptions for spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals. Dr. Li Bingying, chief of pediatrics at National Taiwan University Hospital, warns Ebola is highly contagious with high mortality; even trained healthcare workers are frequently infected. Global pandemic risk remains low, but border controls are prudent. Transmission is mainly person-to-person, and can occur from contact with patients' clothing; strict PPE and infection-control are essential, avoiding skin-to-skin contact. When a suspected case or outbreak arises, stringent screening and quarantine are required. Travel between Taiwan and DRC/Uganda is infrequent, so the public need not overreact; suspected travelers with fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding are escorted to contracted hospitals and coordinated with local health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは伝染性が強く、致死率が高い！感染症専門家：専門的な医療従事者もしばしば感染する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、中央アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ出血熱の継続的な流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施など国際的懸念の高い事象である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（民主共和国）とウガンダにおけるエボラウイルス病の継続的流行を報告。台湾が6月2日より90日間の渡航禁止を実施するなど、実際の国際的対応が取られている。対象国リストはDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。エボラはIHR Annex2基準を完全に満たし、WPRO基準においても全項目該当する高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: لستم وحدكم.. مدير الصحة العالمية يزور بؤرة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: You're not alone... WHO Director-General visits the Ebola epicenter in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak. Declared on May 15, the outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where two new cases were confirmed on Friday, lifting Uganda’s total to nine. In DRC, Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, with the majority of confirmed cases in Ituri. Rural areas face weak public services and violence by armed groups, hindering access and fueling trust deficits and misinformation that complicate response efforts. DRC Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamamba said warehouses hold PPE, medicines, and tests, with focus on distribution logistics. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain circulating has no licensed vaccine or treatment, though a promising therapy is in late-stage trials. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: あなたは一人ではありません...WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ流行中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当、WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。WHO事務局長の訪問を伴う国際的エボラ出血熱流行で、複数国への拡大、国際懸念事態の宣言、高い社会的・政治的関心を有する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例（9例）が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での発生が主要イベント。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチン未承認、治療法なし。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（国際懸念事態）既に宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kepala WHO Kunjungi Pusat Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Visits Ebola Outbreak Center
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak is underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province in the northeastern part of the country, about two weeks ago. The World Health Organization estimates roughly 223 deaths and 906 suspected cases to date. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa, expressing confidence that the country can fully address the outbreak. He urged other nations not to close borders or ban travel, arguing such measures hinder transparency. The DRC has faced Ebola outbreaks 16 times before, and this is the 17th; past experiences give some confidence in eventual containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な影響をもたらす疾病であり、死亡例223件、疑い患者906件という重症度が高い。IHR基準で少なくとも3基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行易感染性が確認され、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRC内の地理的位置は主にイトゥリ州の northeastern 地域で、キンシャサに WHO 事務局長が訪問。16回の過去のエボラ流行履歴があり、これが17回目。国際的関心が極めて高く、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Fast lane, green lane, air travel pass: What you need to know about Singapore's COVID-19 travel measures
article.articleSummary: Singapore’s COVID-19 travel measures use fast lanes and green lanes to revive aviation. Fast lane with China (launched June 8) covers six provinces (Shanghai, Tianjin, Chongqing, Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang); travellers must be sponsored, obtain a visa/SafeTravel Pass, and undergo pre-departure and arrival tests, with 1–2 days of isolation pending results. They must follow a controlled itinerary and use TraceTogether (Singapore) or Health QR. Fast lane with South Korea (opened Sept 4) requires sponsorship, a SafeTravel Pass or quarantine-exemption certificate, a 14-day controlled itinerary, and the Self Health Check and TraceTogether apps. Green lane with Indonesia (reciprocal, announced Oct 12) enables essential travel; entry points Batam Centre and Jakarta; Singapore entry Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal and Changi; pre- and post-arrival swabs; TraceTogether/SafeEntry and e-HAC/Peduli Lindungi. Green lanes with Brunei, Japan, and Malaysia require stayed 14 days in Brunei or Singapore prior to departure, a 72-hour pre-departure swab, travel passes, and post-arrival testing with a 14-day itinerary.

triage.headline_ja: ファストレーン、グリーンレーン、航空旅行パス：シンガポールのCOVID-19渡航対策について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、本記事はシンガポールの渡航対策に関する情報提供型の内容です。新規の感染症イベント、異常な症例増加、または公衆衛生上の新たな危機を示す情報はなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を満たしていません。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のパンデミック疾患（COVID-19）に関する過去の渡航対策の説明であり、新規の感染症シグナルではありません。フルRRA対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm Wabah Ebola, Renggut 246 Nyawa, Penyebaran Sangat Mengkhawatirkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak Alarm: 246 Lives Lost, The Spread Is Highly Concerning.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, has claimed 246 lives. The eastern DR Congo outbreak has escalated rapidly, with two weeks since declaration and authorities reporting daily suspected cases while hundreds of samples await testing. Neighboring Uganda has confirmed 9 cases and 1 death, signaling cross-border transmission risk. International response is strained by border and airport closures, complicating aid delivery and containment. MSF has issued an emergency warning, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is in Ituri to coordinate efforts. Ongoing conflict within DR Congo further hinders response. Tedros urged community engagement and warned that funeral practices, including touching the bodies of Ebola victims, can propagate transmission. True scale and severity of the outbreak remain uncertain given testing backlogs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行警報：246人の死亡者、拡大が極めて懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。ウガンダへの越境感染確認、複数死亡者、WHO事務局長による現地対応で社会政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は記事中で確認されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていません。DRCのイトゥリ州での246人の死亡、検査待ちのサンプル多数、MSFの緊急警告、WHO事務局長の現地対応、国境・空港閉鎖、武力紛争による対応阻害など複合的リスク要因が存在します。

article.articleHeadline: У ВООЗ назвали ситуацію зі спалахом Еболи в Африці вкрай тривожною
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO described the Ebola outbreak in Africa as extremely worrying.
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after the outbreak declaration, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths, with neighboring Uganda recording nine confirmed cases and one death. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no proven vaccine; mortality approaches one third. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus personally traveled to Ituri Province in eastern Congo to assess the situation and help remove barriers; officials warn traditional funeral rites involving body contact risk further spread. MSF says the response is not keeping pace with transmission, hindered by border and airport closures, armed conflict, and testing delays; Bunia lab now returns results within 24 hours, accelerating detection. A suspected Ebola case has emerged in São Paulo state, Brazil, involving a 37-year-old man recently returned from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行を極めて懸念すべき状況と述べた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1000件超の疑い例、246死亡）、異常性（希少な株による大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認、ブラジルで疑い例）、渡航制限のリスクあり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、DRCおよびウガンダでエボラが確認されており、ブラジル（サンパウロ州）で疑い例が発生している。対象国はDRCとBrazilのみ。希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による大規模流行で、ワクチン未整備。WHOトップの現地訪問、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Activan protocolo sanitario en Brasil por sospecha de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health protocol activated in Brazil due to suspected Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case triggers Brazil health protocol in São Paulo after a man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever following a visit to the country. The patient is isolated in a hospital specialized for suspected/confirmed Ebola cases; no laboratory confirmation reported yet. Ituri Province in the Congo is the outbreak epicenter, with 246 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases cited by the African Union health agency. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality rate estimated around 30–50%, and the WHO notes no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO classifies the outbreak risk as high in sub-Saharan Africa but low globally. The virus likely circulated in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared an international health emergency. MSF’s Alán González points to rapid case growth after declaration. This represents an imported case under investigation in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラ疑い症例により保健プロトコルが発動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い症例のブラジルへの越境移入であり、異常性が高く、国際的拡大リスクがある。IHR基準で複数該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な潜在的影響と国際的懸念が存在するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者は中央アフリカからの訪問後ブラジルで症状発症。DRC（イトゥリ州）が流行地であり、ブラジル・サンパウロで疑い症例が検出された越境イベント。検査室確認待ちの状態であるが、医療機関隔離の対応がとられている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、致命率30-50%で懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ назвали ситуацию со вспышкой Эболы в Африке крайне тревожной
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO described the situation with the Ebola outbreak in Africa as extremely worrying.
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after the Ebola outbreak was declared, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri region reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF warns response lags behind transmission, with border restrictions, conflict complicating field work, and testing delays. The WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Ituri to assess the situation and help remove obstacles; he cautioned that traditional funeral rites involving contact with the deceased pose a serious transmission risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no proven vaccine, and case fatality is about a third. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects. Lab capacity has improved: a Bunia lab now returns results in 24 hours, after samples previously traveled up to 1,500 km to Kinshasa. Brazil reports a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man who recently returned from DRC and is under observation.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはアフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱の発生状況を極めて憂慮すべき状況と述べた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大のリスク、国境制限の可能性が認められる。エボラウイルス病は最高危険度のNPBI病原体であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri地域、Kinshasa）、ウガンダ、ブラジル（サンパウロ）を言及しているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。ブラジルは疑い例の報告地点だが発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、致命率約1/3、ワクチン未確認、MSFが対応の遅れを警告、国境制限と紛争が現地活動を複雑化。WHO事務局長による現地視察が行われた。極めて高リスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: DDC warns public in Thailand over rainy-season diseases and hazards
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control (DDC) warns of rainy-season health risks in the country. Aedes-borne diseases—dengue fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus infection—increase as stagnant water boosts mosquito breeding; affected individuals present with high fever, headaches, body aches, rash, or joint pain. Prevention centers on the '3 Keeps to Prevent 3 Diseases': keep homes clean, prevent stagnant rubbish water, and keep water containers tightly covered; use mosquito nets, repellents, and protective clothing. Additional rainy-season hazards include venomous snake bites, lightning injuries, and poisonous mushrooms. People should avoid exposed areas during thunderstorms, refrain from sheltering under large trees, unplug electrical devices to reduce surge risk, and not collect unknown wild mushrooms. For suspected bites or mushroom-related symptoms, seek medical care promptly. DDC has alerted all 12 Offices of Disease Prevention and Control and the Institute for Urban Disease Control and Prevention to prepare for surveillance, prevention and SRRT response; hotline 1422 for questions.

triage.headline_ja: タイの疾病管理局（DDC）が雨季の疾病と危険について国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: Zika とChikungunya の両者が言及されており、スクリーニング基準を複数満たす可能性があるが、記事は雨季の一般的な公衆衛生警告であり、具体的な流行や異常な増加の報告はなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な公衆衛生警告であり、現在の流行や新規の異常な発生ではなく、季節的な定常現象への対応を述べている。具体的な患者数、入院数、死亡数などの重症度に関する情報が記載されていない。タイのDDCが全国のサーベイランス強化を指示していることから政府の関心は高いが、国際的な懸念や国際支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Belga vindo de Uganda, país que registra casos de ebola, é internado no Rio e testa positivo para malária; paciente segue isolado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belgian coming from Uganda, a country reporting Ebola cases, is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro and tests positive for malaria; the patient remains isolated.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, a Belgian man arriving from Uganda is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, under a safety protocol to assess potential Ebola virus disease. He presented with viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) and tested positive for malaria; however, Ebola diagnostics are ongoing and the patient remains in isolation at Fiocruz’s Evandro Chagas Institute (INI), the reference unit for suspected Ebola cases. Uganda’s Ebola outbreaks prompted immediate precautionary measures and CIEVS activation. Biological samples were collected for diagnostic testing, with Ebola results pending. Epidemiological surveillance by SES-RJ and Rio de Janeiro city health authorities is tracing contacts, who have been instructed to report symptoms such as sudden high fever, severe headaches, and muscle and joint pains. The case is treated as an imported potential Ebola scenario while malaria has been confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダからベルギー人男性がリオデジャネイロに入院、エボラが報告されている国から来院し、マラリア検査陽性；患者は隔離継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ウガンダでのエボラ流行地からの患者がブラジルで疑い例として報告され、マラリア陽性も確認された。国際的な越境感染リスクと対応体制の動員が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのエボラ発生地からの入国者がブラジルで疑い例として報告。マラリア既確認、エボラ診断結果は待機中。CIEVS（ブラジル感染症対応センター）が活動化し、接触者追跡が進行中。公式な隔離・診断体制が展開されており、国家的対応が確認される。ベルギーも関連地域として挙げられているが、記事の主題イベント発生地はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: "Врачи без границ" заявили о тревожной ситуации со вспышкой Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of an alarming Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, an alarming Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) Deputy Director of Operations Alan Gonzalez described an unprecedentedly rapid spread and ongoing threat to residents and healthcare workers. Two weeks after a sharp rise in infections, new suspected cases are reported daily, but laboratory confirmation is slow, hindering timely responses. Gonzalez called for expanding laboratory testing to contain transmission and improve case diagnosis. The report highlights strain on local health systems and responders amid continued transmission and challenges in swift testing and confirmation. No detailed case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の重大な脅威であり、進行中の流行による深刻な影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR付属書2に明記される重大感染症。記事では「unprecedented rapid spread」と述べられ、毎日新たな疑似症例が報告されている。検査確認の遅延が対応を困難にしており、保健システムの負担が強調されている。国際的な支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Lääkärit ilman rajoja: Ebolatilanne Kongossa erittäin hälyttävä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is extremely alarming.
article.articleSummary: MSF says the Ebola situation in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is extremely alarming. The statement notes that the number of reported Ebola cases so soon after the outbreak was declared is higher than at any prior moment. The outbreak was reported in mid-May. According to Africa CDC, there have been about 1,100 suspected cases and around 250 suspected Ebola deaths since the outbreak began. The World Health Organization cautions that the virus has likely spread far more broadly than the official counts indicate. The report underscores severe ongoing transmission and the challenge of containing the outbreak in a region with repeated health emergencies. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ状況は極めて深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスによる活発なアウトブレイク（1,100疑い例、250死亡）、異常な高い発症速度、国際的な懸念と拡大リスク、医療危機地域での制御困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクは公開情報として高い関心対象。MSF、WHO、Africa CDCからの警告が記載されている。Ituri Province での地理的位置確認。感染源や国間の移動状況は記事に記載なし。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يزور بؤرة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو صحراء ميديا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Congo's Media Desert.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak, urging early healthcare access and safe burial practices as authorities race to contain spread. The outbreak is the 17th in DRC and the third-largest by size, with WHO saying transmission outpaces international response. Tedros met in Kinshasa with Prime Minister Judith Somenwa Toluka before traveling to Bunia, where first confirmed cases were recorded earlier this month. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccines or treatments; emphasis remains on early supportive care—isolation, fluid replacement, pain relief—and safe funerary practices, while respecting traditions. Attacks on health facilities seeking bodies for traditional rites further heighten transmission risk. WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation; the DRC health minister, Samuel Roger Kamba, cites 1,028 suspected cases, including 225 infections.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則(IHR)基準の4項目全て（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、また WPRO スクリーニング基準の全5項目に該当する。WHO事務局長の現地訪問という国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は DRC で 17 番目の流行であり、3 番目に大きい規模とのこと。Bundibugyo 株でワクチンと治療法がない。WHO 事務局長の公式訪問により国際的な関心が極めて高い。感染者数や死亡者数について WHO と DRC 当局の報告に齟齬が見られる（WHO: 906 疑い例・223 死亡 vs DRC: 1,028 疑い例・225 感染）。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉傳染性強、致死率高！　感染症專家：專業醫護也常遭感染 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is highly contagious and has a high mortality rate! Infectious disease experts: Even professional healthcare workers are often infected - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda continue to intensify; Taiwan will suspend entry for residents of the two countries for 90 days from June 2, 2026, with exceptions for four categories, including spouses and minor children. Infectious disease expert Li Bingying, a pediatric attending at National Taiwan University Hospital, warns Ebola is highly transmissible and deadly; even trained healthcare workers can be infected. While a global pandemic is unlikely, border controls are warranted. Ebola spreads mainly through close person-to-person contact, and contact with contaminated clothing can transmit the virus, so full personal protective equipment is essential and skin-to-skin contact must be avoided. If cases or outbreaks are detected, strict screening and quarantine are advised. Taiwan's CDC says suspected cases with fever, headache, muscle aches, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding will be transported to contracted hospitals, with local health authorities coordinating prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは感染力が強く、致死率が高い！感染症専門家：訓練を受けた医療従事者でも感染することが多い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。複数国での同時流行と国境措置実施により即座の監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはTaiwan（1668284）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であり、台湾での症例報告や流行はない。台湾は渡航制限の実施国として言及されているため、verified_locationsから除外した。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみだが、ウガンダでの流行も記事の中心主題であり、国際的な懸念事項として両国を列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fears spark probe into infected monkey bite at research lab
article.articleSummary: Montana’s Rocky Mountain Laboratory, a government infectious-disease research facility, is under urgent scrutiny after a November 2025 incident in which a lab worker was bitten through PPE by a monkey infected with Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, described as a strain of Ebola. The worker was treated and returned to work without illness. A February 2026 PPE hole raised potential exposure to the same virus while handling lab mice. Senator Tim Sheehy has asked Montana’s Inspector General to launch an urgent probe into the bite, the February exposure, and the lab’s safety procedures, citing concerns about Vincent Munster, Chief of the Virus Ecology Unit, who traveled to Africa in January 2026 and was detained at Detroit airport with vials in his personal luggage; he has not been charged. Laura Loomer and other Republican Senators amplified calls for investigations and funding pauses to prevent another Wuhan-like incident. No confirmed cases or outbreaks reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の懸念が研究所での感染サル咬傷調査を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: クリミア・コンゴ出血熱とエボラ熱を扱う高度な危険病原体の研究施設での複数の安全事故が報告されているが、実際の症例や流行は確認されていない。情報不足の中での政治的関心が高い案件のため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は米国モンタナ州の研究所での事故を主題としているが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていない。China は記事中で『Wuhan-like incident』との比較言及があるが、実際の発生地はUSA。対象国内では実際の病例発生は報告されていない。リスク評価の対象外だが、国際的なバイオセキュリティ関心事として記録。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-CDC director warns Ebola outbreak could rank second largest in history
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has 134 lab-confirmed cases (predominantly in Congo; 9 in Uganda) and 18 deaths; Congo reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. Historically, West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak had 28,600 cases and 11,308 deaths, while the DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak had 3,470 cases and 2,287 deaths. Former CDC director Robert Redfield warned the current outbreak could become the second-largest ever and may persist for some time. WHO Director-General Tedros said the response is hampered by conflict in the DRC, including attacks on health facilities, and urged an immediate ceasefire. The CDC has restricted entry for foreign nationals and U.S. green-card holders who were in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, with enhanced screening for Americans at selected airports.

triage.headline_ja: 元CDC局長がエボラアウトブレイクが過去2番目の規模になる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの複数国にまたがる流行で、確認症例134例・死亡18例、疑い症例906例・疑い死亡223例を報告。国際的拡大リスク（複数国での発生）と旅行制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。Uganda と Sudan は記事内容に含まれるが、対象国リストに未含含。疾患は Bundibugyo エボラウイルス（稀な型）で、元 CDC 局長による警告があり、既に CDC による渡航制限措置が実施されている。DRC での紛争による対応阻害も報告されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: النفط وهرمز وإيبولا على أجندة وزيرة خارجية بريطانيا خلال زيارتها للصين والهند
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oil, the Strait of Hormuz, and Ebola on the British Foreign Secretary's agenda during her visit to China and India.
article.articleSummary: British Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper heads to China on June 2 and to India later in the week, in a trip focused on global issues including the Strait of Hormuz, the Russia-Ukraine war, and the latest Ebola outbreak. In China she will meet Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Vice President Han Zheng, before traveling to Shenzhen for a science-and-technology program on June 3. She then travels to India on June 4 to meet External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and engage with business leaders, academics, and partners working on the UK-India Vision 2035. The visit comes amid geopolitical tension and higher oil prices tied to spillover from the US-Israel confrontation with Iran, and as Britain and India push ahead with a trade pact whose implementation has faced steel-import restrictions raised by New Delhi. Cooper’s talks are expected to address key global challenges.

triage.headline_ja: イギリス外相の中国・インド訪問の議題に石油、ホルムズ海峡、エボラ出血熱が含まれる
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ出血熱を言及しているが、サマリーでは具体的な発生状況や患者情報が記載されておらず、外相の訪問議題の一部として取り上げられているのみである。イベント情報として不十分であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーはエボラ出血熱の具体的な発生や患者報告を述べておらず、イギリス外相の訪問時の議題項目として言及されているに過ぎない。実際のエボラ出血熱イベント情報が不明確であるため、WATCH判定とした。続報で具体的な発生状況が報告される場合はPICKUPに変更する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lääkärit ilman rajoja: Ebolatilanne Kongossa erittäin hälyttävä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The Ebola situation in Congo is extremely alarming.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is described as extremely alarming by Doctors Without Borders. MSF leader Alan Gonzalez says reported cases shortly after the outbreak declaration are higher than ever. Since mid-May, Africa CDC counts roughly 1,100 suspected cases and about 250 suspected Ebola deaths, with hundreds of samples still untested, suggesting the true scale is larger. The WHO also says the virus has most likely spread beyond confirmed cases. Early treatment markedly improves survival, but containment is impeded by border and airport closures that delay essential medical supplies and humanitarian staff. Uganda has closed its border with the DRC and imposed a 21-day quarantine for entrants. There is currently no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, though officials say a vaccine could be ready by year-end. Ebola is present in three eastern DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda; WHO chief Tedros visited Bunia and pledged international support.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴのエボラ情勢は極めて深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、および渡航制限が確認される。大規模な患者発生と高い死亡率を特徴とする。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）も発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは境界閉鎖と検疫措置を実施している国として扱われており、実際の患者発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州に限定されている。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ワクチン未供給状況、サンプル未検査が多数ある（真の規模がさらに大きい可能性）、国際的な医療支援の必要性が記事で明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲網紅遭蟲咬病逝！疾管署急警「死亡率飆60％」台灣已56例確診 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old influencer dies after insect bite! Taiwan CDC issues urgent warning that the mortality rate has surged to 60%; Taiwan has 56 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-31, a 39-year-old Chinese influencer in Yunnan died after a suspected scrub typhus infection from a chigger mite bite, prompting renewed attention to this disease. Taiwan’s CDC notes scrub typhus is endemic in Taiwan, with 56 locally confirmed cases—including 1 death—as of May 24 (previously 53 with 1 death). The eastern counties are most affected: Taitung 16 cases, Hualien 10, and Kinmen 7, indicating higher risk in eastern Taiwan and offshore islands. The disease is transmitted by rickettsia-carrying chigger larvae; incubation is about 9–12 days. Early symptoms mimic flu, with a rash typically appearing about a week after onset, and the bite site may form a dark crust. Untreated mortality can reach 60%; early diagnosis and antibiotics reduce it below 5%. Preventive guidance includes long sleeves, pants, socks, protective footwear, and repellents; wash and change clothing after outdoor activities, especially in grasslands, fields, or campsites, with peak activity in spring and summer.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳ネットインフルエンサーが虫刺され病で死亡！台湾CDC緊急警告「致死率60%に急上昇」台湾で既に56例確診
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病で死亡者が発生し、台湾で56例の確認例があり、致死率が高い（未治療時60%）という重症性が示されている。社会的関心も高く（著名人の死亡）、スクリーニング基準で複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事主題は台湾での恙虫病の流行と著名人の死亡事例だが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にTaiwanが含まれているものの、対象国リストにTaiwan（台湾）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはChinaのみに限定。ただしサマリーの大部分は台湾のデータ（56例、地域分布）に関するもので、中国での死亡事例は引き金となった背景事象と考えられる。恙虫病は対象地域（台湾含む東南アジア）で地域流行性疾患として知られており、致死率の高さ（未治療時60%）と社会的影響の大きさが認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — A patient in São Paulo, Brazil, under investigation for suspected Ebola was diagnosed with meningitis after laboratory tests ruled out Ebola. Initial symptoms prompted high-lethality disease precautions, including isolation and enhanced surveillance. While Ebola infection was excluded, health authorities continue to monitor the patient and outbreak-related protocols remain in place. The meningitis diagnosis, which can be caused by viruses, bacteria, or other agents, shifts focus to treatment of meningitis and investigation of its circumstances. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in relation to this event. Experts emphasize rapid investigation and adherence to safety procedures to protect healthcare workers, patients, and the public.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラを疑われた患者が髄膜炎で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラは除外され、髄膜炎と診断された。確認されたエボラ症例はなく、IHR/WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラが検査で除外され、髄膜炎と診断された個別患者のケースであることが明確。感染症危機の兆候ではなく、確認されたエボラ症例がないため、トリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente sob suspeita de ébola é internado no Brasil - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient suspected of having Ebola is admitted to hospital in Brazil - Renascença
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized in isolation in São Paulo, Brazil. The patient, treated at an infectious-disease institute, presented with fever, disorientation, and diarrhea and is reported to have meningitis. The case is under investigation by local authorities and Brazil's Ministry of Health; it is not yet confirmed whether he passed through provinces affected by the Congo outbreak. After testing, laboratory confirmation results are expected within 48 hours. The incident involves an imported potential case linked to the Congo-origin Ebola outbreak; no confirmed cases or deaths are reported in Brazil at this time. Health authorities are monitoring for transmission and enforcing infection-control measures pending confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラ疑い患者が入院 - ルナシェンサ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際移入例であり、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（致死性疾患）、異常性（ブラジルでの発生は予想外）、国際的拡大リスク（DRCからの輸入例）の3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行中にブラジルで疑い例が発生した輸入症例。患者はDRC出身の37歳移民で、発熱・意識混濁・下痢・髄膜炎症状を呈し、現在隔離入院中。48時間以内に検査結果判明予定。ブラジルでの確定例・死亡例はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西現疑似伊波拉病例 患者曾到剛果（金） - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports suspected Ebola case; patient had been to Congo (Kinshasa) - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s São Paulo state health authorities are investigating a suspected Ebola virus disease case in a male patient who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa). The patient has fever and is in hospital isolation. The Congolese outbreak centers in Ituri province, with Bunia as the capital, where WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited and warned there is no approved vaccine or therapy for the Bundibugyo virus strain; early isolation and treatment are critical, and safe burial of Ebola victims is essential. Doctors Without Borders said Congo’s response is strained, with hundreds of samples awaiting testing and resources lagging. Congolese health authorities claim adequate resources and experience, and that the outbreak is not out of control; more than 1,000 suspected cases and over 200 deaths have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで疑似エボラ病例を報告；患者はコンゴ（キンシャサ）を訪問していた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（ブラジルへの輸入例）、DRCでの進行中の大規模流行（1000件超の疑似症例、200超の死亡）、WHO幹部による警告、および対応能力の不足に関する報告が、IHR基準2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）とWPRO基準複数個（異常性、重症度、管理可能性）に該当するため、フルRRA実施を要する。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州での継続的なエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）とブラジル（サンパウロ州）への輸入例の報告。サマリーではDRCの流行規模（1000超の疑似症例、200超の死亡）、対応能力の課題（検査待ち数百サンプル、資源不足）、およびWHO事務局長による警告が記述されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges safe burials in visit to heart of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Congo's Ituri province, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged residents amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak—the 17th in Congo and the third-largest since the disease was discovered. He urged people to seek treatment and practice safe burials as authorities scramble to contain the virus. The outbreak outpaces the global response, according to Tedros before he traveled to Kinshasa. A Brazilian health official said Sao Paulo state is investigating a suspected Ebola case in a man who recently visited Congo; the patient is in isolation at a specialist hospital. Tedros, after meeting Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, noted the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments, making early palliative care—isolation, rehydration, and pain management—critical.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱流行の中心地訪問で安全な埋葬を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の新規outbreak報告として国際的な懸念が極めて高い。DRCでの17番目のoutbreak且つ3番目の大規模流行であり、ブラジルへの一次症例報告も確認されている。
triage.notes: DRCではIturi州Buniaでの第17番目のエボラoutbreak。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法未承認。ブラジル・サンパウロ州では最近DRC訪問者に疑似症例が報告され隔離中。WHO事務局長Tedrosが現地を訪問。国際拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट: डब्‍ल्‍यूएचओ प्रमुख ने देशों से सीमा बंदी और ट्रैवल बैन हटाने की अपील की - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Crisis: WHO Chief Appeals to Countries to Lift Border Closures and Travel Bans - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompt WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to urge countries to lift border closures and travel bans, saying restrictions hinder response and erode trust. Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, remains the outbreak’s main epicenter. In the DRC, the three affected provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—account for over 1,000 suspected cases. Uganda has nine confirmed cases, with two new infections reported in Kampala on Friday. DRC Health Minister Roger Kamba targets containment within four to six months, prioritizing three provinces and preventing further spread; laboratory capacity has improved, with about 900 samples tested and roughly 260 positives, enabling testing of all incoming samples at 200–300 per day. No approved vaccine or specific therapy exists yet, though timely quality medical care improves patient survival.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：WHO事務局長が国々に国境閉鎖と渡航禁止の解除を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の多国間での流行拡大を示す。公開衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性、複数国での確認例がWHOの対外的呼びかけを招いている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国でエボラ症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙。DRC国内3州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ）での1,000件以上の疑い例、ウガンダでの9件の確定例、WHO事務局長による各国への公開的な呼びかけなど、多くの公開衛生上の指標が存在し、国際的懸念が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西首现疑似伊波拉病例 患者曾到刚果民主共和国 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports its first suspected Ebola case; patient had been to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, Brazil's health authorities said they are investigating a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo state. The patient, a 37-year-old man, recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing. After returning to Brazil, he developed fever and is hospitalized in a facility dedicated to Ebola confirmed or suspected cases and is in isolation. The case in Brazil marks the first suspected Ebola case reported by the country. Meanwhile, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in the DRC, to discuss the outbreak with local health authorities and WHO teams. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; there is currently no effective vaccine. The estimated case fatality rate is about one-third, though with prompt, quality medical care survival is possible, and some Ituri patients have recovered.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初の疑似エボラ病例を報告 患者はコンゴ民主共和国を訪問していた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCで発生中のエボラ流行から患者がブラジルへ入国し、新規国での発症疑い例という極めて重大なシグナル。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: DRCでの進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）から患者がブラジルへ移動し発症した可能性。ブラジルでの初の疑似エボラ症例報告であり、国際的な感染伝播リスクが極めて高い。WHOも対応中。対象国リストに含まれるDRC及びBrazilの両国で実際のイベント発生が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Os diagnósticos dos primeiros pacientes com suspeita de Ebola em Rio e SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The diagnoses of the first patients with suspected Ebola in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo confirms that a 37-year-old man arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, initially suspected of Ebola, tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcal meningitis); diagnosis was made by Instituto Adolfo Lutz, while Ebola investigations continue. He is hospitalized in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas with fever, cough, chills, and diarrhea. In Rio de Janeiro, a patient from Uganda presented viral symptoms triggering Ebola concerns; he tested positive for malaria but remains in isolation at INI/Fiocruz while analyses to exclude Ebola are pending. Regiane de Paula noted laboratory confirmation of meningococcal meningitis by Instituto Adolfo Lutz as part of the differential diagnosis, with Ebola testing ongoing. In both cities, teams maintain isolation, clinical monitoring, and biosafety protocols; health authorities monitor contacts and implement preventive measures to minimize transmission while awaiting definitive Ebola results.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロとサンパウロにおけるエボラウイルス病の疑い患者の診断
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）およびコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者に関連した複数の重篤な感染症（メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎、エボラウイルス病の疑い、マラリア）の検出。IHR基準の重症度および国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニングの異常性・重症度・流行リスクが該当し、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 複数の重篤疾患の関与と国際的な渡航リンク（コンゴ民主共和国→ブラジル、ウガンダ→ブラジル）により、リスク評価は高い。エボラウイルス病の検査継続中であり、確定診断待機中。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎確定例とマラリア確定例も含まれている。隔離・監視体制は適切に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai ghi nhận sốt xuất huyết Dengue tăng sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai Province records an early rise in dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dong Nai Province records an early rise in dengue fever in the first four months of 2026, reporting 2,461 cases and 3 deaths across 870 outbreak clusters, with children under 15 making up 45.1% of cases. Despite not yet entering the rainy season, Dong Nai has the highest dengue fatalities in the country for this period, at 55 cases per 100,000 population, above the national rate of about 43. Nationally, from Dec 14, 2025 to Apr 18, 2026, dengue reached 44,965 cases with 5 deaths, up 1.8-fold versus the same period in 2025 (24,924 cases, 3 deaths). Dong Nai borders Ho Chi Minh City, with dense transport networks and industrial zones facilitating spread; the affected age group now includes workers aged 22–44. The vector is Aedes aegypti, breeding in clean water in household containers rather than dirty water. Prevention emphasizes year-round mosquito control, 5–10 minutes weekly checks, protective measures, timely medical care, and that a dengue vaccine is licensed in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ドン・ナイ省でデング熱の患者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節外れのデング熱患者急増（2,461例、死亡3例）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、国家レベルの管理体制が機能している形跡があるため、情報の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節外れの患者増（雨季前の発生）、死亡率が全国平均を上回る（55/10万 vs 43/10万）、子ども（45.1%）と成人労働者両方に影響。ホーチミン市との地理的近接性により広域拡大の可能性あり。ただしベトナムではワクチン利用可能で管理体制が存在するため、国際支援の必要性は現段階では低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads as concerns grow over Trump's Kenya quarantine plan
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — Ebola spreads as concerns grow over Trump's Kenya quarantine plan. The head of the World Health Organization has arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to visit communities at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak. At least 1,200 cases have been confirmed, and the virus has spread to Uganda. With no approved vaccine or treatment, containment remains challenging for health authorities. Separately, the Trump administration has proposed quarantining all Americans exposed to Ebola in Kenya, a plan that the Nairobi High Court has already ruled against.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大、トランプのケニア隔離計画への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、複数国への国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクをすべて満たし、フルRRA進行を正当化する。
triage.notes: ケニアとウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは感染症イベントの主要な発生地はDRCおよび拡大先のウガンダと述べられている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。本事例はIHR通知要件を完全に満たし、かつ米国の政策的対応も含まれており、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo traveller tests negative for Ebola in 2nd test
article.articleSummary: DR Congo national, 37, admitted to Ahmedabad Civil Hospital, Gujarat, after arriving in India (May 18–22 in Mumbai; then Silvassa and Daman; reached Vadodara May 25; admitted May 26). The initial test at NIV-ICMR was Ebola-negative but malaria-positive. A second confirmatory Ebola test was also negative, allowing transfer from the Ebola isolation ward to a malaria-treatment room; fever had abated and he was improving. Three foreign colleagues identified as close contacts were quarantined at SVP Hospital in Ahmedabad on May 27 and are likely to be released. Ebola is a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern; major outbreaks occur in DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Incubation for Ebola ranges 2–21 days, with symptoms typically appearing 8–10 days after exposure. No Ebola case is confirmed in this traveller.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ旅行者がエボラ検査で2回目の陰性反応
triage.triage_reason: Ebola疑い患者が検出され、WHO PAHEICとして国際的に高い懸念があるが、患者は確定診断が陰性で既に隔離解除見込み。マラリア確定診断であり、直接的なEbola脅威は低減している。情報は充分だが、感染症警戒として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDR Congoからインドへの旅行者でEbola疑い患者についてだが、確定診断は陰性でマラリア陽性。インド国内での実際の発生地域はAhmedabad, Gujarat, Mumbai, Silvassa, Vadodaraなど複数。Ebola PAHEICであり異常・予想外の事象として検出されたが、患者の確定診断が陰性であり、直接的な脅威は低い。3名の接触者が隔離されており、管理体制は機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Tổng giám đốc WHO thăm Congo giữa lúc dịch Ebola bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits Congo amid Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, in the northeast. The outbreak began about two weeks ago; WHO estimates 223 deaths and 906 suspected cases, while Africa CDC places the figures at 1,077 suspected and 246 deaths as of May 28. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare, highly lethal form with a 25–50% fatality rate; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ghebreyesus met health authorities and urged against border closures, arguing they hinder case finding; he encouraged safe burial practices and seeking medical care early. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading faster than typical and cautions against underestimating its scale, urging urgent response. Minister Roger Kamba attended the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行の最中にコンゴを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準を4つ全て満たす：深刻な公衆衛生影響（223～246死亡、906～1,077疑い例）、希少で致死率25～50%のBundibugyo株の異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク（国境対策の懸念）、医療体制や渡航制限のリスク。また、WHO事務局長訪問、MSFの警告、アフリカCDCも関与する社会的・政治的関心の高さから、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に民主共和国コンゴのIturi州での発生が主題。Bundibugyo株は稀で致死率が高く、ワクチンと特異的治療法がない。MSFが感染速度が典型的な流行より速いと警告。WHO事務局長の訪問とアフリカCDCの関与は国際的関心と対応能力の評価を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros aterriza en el corazón del ébola y lanza un mensaje de urgencia a la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros lands at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak and issues an urgent message to the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, a new Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15 has spread to three provinces and reached Uganda, where two more cases were confirmed, bringing Uganda’s total to nine. In the DRC, authorities report 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases, with Ituri’s Bunia—the region’s capital—home to most confirmed infections. Security challenges in Ituri, including armed groups and attacks on civilians, plus incidents at treatment centers and widespread rumors, hinder containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus travelled to Bunia to hear communities, assess the response, and pinpoint gaps for intensified international support. He said communities are not alone and urged continued backing. Congolese Health Minister Samuel Kamba said stockpiles of protection, medicines, and tests exist, but distribution logistics remain the primary hurdle; Bunia airport remains closed to commercial traffic.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長がエボラの震源地に到着し、コンゴ民主共和国に緊急メッセージを発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。死亡者246名、疑い例1000名超の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例確認されたが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイク。Bluedot APIが検出したウガンダは二次的な影響。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。セキュリティ課題、医療施設での事件、根拠のない情報など対応上の重大な障害が複数存在。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的な関心が著しく高い。

article.articleHeadline: مشاهد قاتمة من بؤرة تفشي إيبولا بالكونغو: نقص إمكانيات وإحراق جناح عزل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bleak scenes from the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Congo: shortages of resources and the burning of an isolation ward.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has surged into a severe outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, a gold-mining town in northeastern DRC. Africa CDC data show more than 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths, with over 400 suspected cases in Mongbwalu. The crisis has overwhelmed hospital care, with patients crowded into wards lacking PPE and supplies; relatives provide meals and water. Seven hospital workers have died, and several others are infected. Attacks on health facilities, including the burning of an MSF isolation ward, have driven some patients to flee. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is the third-largest Ebola wave in DRC history, requiring scaled international support to avert the deadliest outcome. Diagnostics are delayed, as samples travel to Bonia for testing, enabling nosocomial transmission. Fruit bats are the natural reservoir; no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists. A 5-year-old boy with severe bleeding is recovering.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の震源地からの暗い光景：資源の不足と隔離病棟の焼却
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つすべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,077例以上の疑い例、246例以上の死亡）、異常な大規模流行、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて存在。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: DRCの北東部Mongbwalu（金鉱町）を震源地とするエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の大規模流行。5月15日に宣言され、DRC史上3番目の規模。医療施設への攻撃（MSF隔離病棟の焼却など）、医療従事者7名の死亡、検査遅延による院内感染のリスク増加が報告されている。国際的支援の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to eating wild animals
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, remains active as of May 31, 2026, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since the May 15 start. The World Health Organization suspects the outbreak is larger than reported. Transmission is linked to handling, slaughtering, and consumption of wild meat from the Congo Basin, despite authorities’ bans on hunting endangered wildlife; Kinshasa’s Masina Market illustrates how wild meat—antelope, large rodents, caterpillars—continues to be sold. Experts warn that spillovers from animals such as bats drive human infections, underscoring a One Health need in a region plagued by violence and displacement. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved medicines or vaccines. The Congo Basin remains a major carbon sink despite biodiversity losses, and public health campaigns stress avoiding meat from unknown sources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、野生動物の食肉摂取との関連を専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの活動的な流行が確認された。1,000件以上の疑い患者と220件以上の死亡が報告されており、国際的な拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による活動的な流行。2026年5月15日開始、5月31日現在も継続。1,000件以上の疑い患者、220件以上の死亡。WHO推定では実際の症例はさらに多い可能性。野生肉の摂取、処理、屠殺に関連した人動物間の感染リンク。WHO公認ワクチンおよび医療品がないBundibugyo株。暴力と避難民が蔓延する地域での対応の困難性。これはWPRO地域の評価対象国ではないが、グローバルな公衆衛生脅威としてのシグナル価値は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'deeply alarming', MSF warns
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after the Ebola outbreak declaration in Ituri Province, eastern DR Congo, the situation is 'deeply alarming' with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths in DR Congo; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF notes cases are rising faster than the response can keep up, with hundreds of samples still untested. Containment and aid deliveries are hampered by border and airport closures amid ongoing conflict. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to assess the response, urging greater community involvement and warning that funeral body-contact can fuel transmission. In Bunia daily life appears largely unchanged for now. As of 31 May 2026, the outbreak’s true scale remains uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大は『非常に懸念される』とMSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000件以上の疑似患者と246人以上の死亡、異常性、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダで9件の確認例、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、国際機関の高度な関与と支援ニーズが明白。
triage.notes: Bunia はイトゥリ州（東部DRC）内の都市で、DRC内の主要な発生地点。ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHOトップの現地視察が行われており、国際的な高度な関与の明確な証拠。現地の紛争と国境閉鎖による制御困難性も注記。

article.articleHeadline: Posible Caso De ébola En Brasil: Hombre Que Viajó A África Bajo Investigación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Ebola Case in Brazil: Man Who Traveled to Africa Under Investigation
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case in Brazil: A man who recently traveled to Africa is hospitalized in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emilio Ribas in São Paulo while tests are conducted to confirm or rule out infection. Health authorities report symptoms compatible with Ebola, a viral disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids and capable of causing fever, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhaging. A strict infection control protocol has been implemented at the hospital, and extensive epidemiological investigations are underway to identify the infection source and trace contacts since the patient’s return from Africa. A public alert has been issued advising vigilance for symptom onset and encouraging those who had contact with the patient to seek medical care if fever or other Ebola signs appear. Authorities urge calm and strict adherence to guidance while containment measures proceed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新たなエボラ出血熱の可能症例：アフリカ渡航歴のある男性が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例がブラジルで報告され、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。確認検査中の段階だが、高病原性感染症として速やかなフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（São Paulo州）での疑い症例を主題としている。患者がアフリカから帰国後の症状発現であり、接触者追跡が進行中。現時点で確認検査の結果待機中だが、エボラの可能症例は自動的に高優先度シグナルとなる。WPRO基準外の地域だがグローバルな関心事項として重要。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe sobre o caso suspeito de Ebola investigado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the suspected Ebola case under investigation in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, with recent travel there, is hospitalized in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo as a suspected Ebola case. If confirmed, this would be Brazil’s first Ebola case and the first outside Africa since the Congo outbreak. A late-Saturday test indicated the virus causing meningitis, but Ebola remains under investigation. The São Paulo Health Secretariat deems the importation risk very low due to no autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights to the outbreak region, and Ebola’s transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids. Authorities urge vigilance for febrile travelers with recent travel to endemic areas within 21 days and assessment of contacts. Brazil activated the National Contingency Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers to strengthen surveillance; suspected cases may require a second blood sample 48 hours after the first. In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, the epicenter, ~1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved, with vaccines for Zaire lacking proven efficacy against this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで調査中のエボラ疑い患者について知られていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの疑い患者がブラジルで初めて報告され、アフリカ外での感染確認となる可能性があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの疑い患者がブラジルに検出されたもので、確認事例となればアフリカ外での初例となる極めて重要なシグナル。DRC（Ituri州）が現在の流行の中心地であり、ウガンダでも確認例がある。患者の近接接触者への対応と国内監視体制の強化が急務。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株という情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: ജി​ല്ല വി​ക​സ​ന സ​മി​തി യോ​ഗം; സ്കൂ​ളു​ക​ൾ തു​റ​ക്കാ​ൻ സ​ജ്ജം, മ​ഴ​ക്കാ​ല രോ​ഗം ത​ട​യും | District Development Committee meeting; Schools ready to open, monsoon diseases to be prevented
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: District Development Committee meeting; Schools ready to open, monsoon diseases to be prevented.
article.articleSummary: Malappuram: In the first post-election District Development Committee meeting, chaired by A.D.M.C.S. Rajesh, the Education Department said schools are ready for the new academic year, with fitness checks completed. Minor glitches were identified and to be fixed by Sunday. Uniforms and books distribution is 90% complete; workbooks and IT books will be supplied in the first week, as raised by MLAs T. P. Ibrahim and T. P. Ashrafali. Heavy rains damaged National Highway 66 service road; drainage works have begun in Puthanathani, Unniyal, and Chungam. A drainage project of 12.87 crore rupees has been allotted to the district collector. The district will meet to discuss monsoon-relief measures and address highway drainage issues, urged by MLAs. Health: DMO said steps to prevent monsoon diseases are in place, with intensified plague-control measures. For 2025-26, district expenditure was 96.07% of allocations; state schemes 95.95% (349 schemes); central schemes around 99%.

triage.headline_ja: 地区開発委員会会議; 学校開校準備完了、季節性疾患の予防対策実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事は季節性疾患予防の一般的な行政報告であり、ペスト発生を示す具体的な症例・患者数・死亡事例がない。Bluedotの自動地域抽出エラーにより北朝鮮が含まれているが、記事サマリーはインド・ケーララ州の行政会議のみを主題としている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが北朝鮮（Sirubau, Hamnam）を不正に付与。記事サマリーはマラップラム地区（ケーララ州、インド）の行政会議について述べており、ペスト発生事例は報告されていない。『monsoon diseases to be prevented』は予防対策の計画に関する記述であり、実在する流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 谭德塞视察刚果（金）伊波拉疫区　呼吁国际社会支援 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus Visits Ebola-Affected Region in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Urges the International Community to Provide Support
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the Ituri Province capital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to assess the Ebola outbreak and urge more support to contain it. The outbreak continues in eastern DRC, with cases across at least three provinces and spillovers into Uganda. There is no vaccine or therapy for the Bundibugyo virus strain; early isolation and treatment are crucial. Authorities call for unified, science-based information and discourage traditional burial practices to curb transmission. Doctors Without Borders says Congo lacks supplies and hundreds of samples await testing; Health Minister Kanba says the country has capacity to meet testing needs and denies the outbreak is out of control. Brazil reports a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo state, a man who recently traveled to DRC and is in isolation. Africa CDC notes over 1,000 suspected cases and over 200 deaths since May 15.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行地域を視察し、国際社会への支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外のバンディブギョウ株、国際的拡大（ウガンダへのスピルオーバー、ブラジル疑い症例），貿易/渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。200以上の死亡、1,000以上の疑い症例、複数国への拡大、予防接種なしという極めて高いリスクプロファイル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題とし、バンディブギョウ株（ワクチン・治療法なし）による200以上の死亡を報告。ウガンダへのスピルオーバーとブラジルでの疑い症例があり、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。WHO事務局長による現地視察と国際支援の呼びかけは高度の政治的・社会的関心を示す。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Tổng Giám đốc WHO kêu gọi chôn cất an toàn đối với những người chết vì virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General urges safe burial for those who died from the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, amid a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak—the 17th outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery. He urged safe burial practices to prevent transmission, warning that touching the deceased can spread the virus. The Bundibugyo virus currently has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; early care—consisting of isolation, rehydration, and pain management—remains crucial and has helped some patients in Ituri recover. The outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with more than 200 fatalities in Congo during just over half a month. A related case in Brazil’s São Paulo is under investigation and linked to a recent Congo visit, with the patient isolated in a specialty hospital.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラウイルスで亡くなった人の安全な埋葬を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当。DRCでの17番目のエボラ発生で大規模死亡者数、及びブラジルへの国際拡大確認。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでのブンディブギョエボラ発生は、わずか2週間超で200人以上の死亡者を記録。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と安全埋葬への呼びかけは高い国際的関心を示唆。ブラジル・サンパウロでの関連症例は国際拡大の実証。ワクチン・治療薬なしの現状は管理困難性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tetapkan Darurat Ebola, Kemenkes Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan di Pintu Masuk RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Emergency, Health Ministry Steps Up Vigilance at Indonesia's Entry Points
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the WHO declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) arising from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), Sudan Virus Disease (SVD), and Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD) strains are circulating. Travel-related cases have been reported in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa, DR Congo. Indonesia tightened entry-point vigilance at airports and seaports, with 24/7 monitoring by the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR) and Public Health Emergency Operation Center (PHEOC). National labs are on standby for rapid detection. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected humans or animals; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms: fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. The fatality rate averages about 50%; travelers from DRC or Uganda should seek care within 21 days if fever or bleeding develops. Vaccines remain limited for outbreak management in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO エボラ感染症の国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、インドネシア保健省が出入国地点での警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言により国際的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数国への拡大、渡航制限リスクが確認された。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言は国際的に最高レベルの警告。DRCでの3種類のエボラウイルス株同時循環、複数国への渡航関連症例報告、高い致死率（約50%）が確認された。インドネシアは対象国であり、記事の主要な報道主題として取り上げられている。ウガンダも被影響国だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：及时医治有助应对埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Timely treatment helps combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Timely treatment is crucial in the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. With no approved vaccine or specific antiviral therapy yet, high-quality medical care—including isolation, rehydration, and pain control—has enabled some patients in Ituri Province (capital Bunia) to recover. The World Health Organization and partners are advancing clinical trials for vaccines and treatments. DR Congo's Health Minister Kanba said control measures will be continually refined, with the outbreak expected to last 4–6 months and adjusted as needed. The outbreak was declared on May 15. By May 26, DR Congo had 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 238 deaths; Uganda reported 9 confirmed cases by May 29. The guidance emphasizes rapid treatment and public health interventions to limit spread while vaccines and therapies are evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 適切な治療がエボラ出血熱の対策に役立つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された多国間流行（DRC 1,077疑似例・238死亡、ウガンダ9確認例）であり、高い致死性、国際的な拡大リスク、及び深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の重大事象に該当する。発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーでの主題はDRCのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外した。ワクチンおよび抗ウイルス療法の臨床試験が進行中との記述があり、国際的な支援・対応が進行中と判断される。2026年5月31日の最新情報。

article.articleHeadline: Ini Tanda Anda Perlu Memeriksakan Diri ke Dokter Saat Mengalami Gejala Infeksi Sinus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These are signs you should see a doctor when you have sinusitis symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Nasal congestion and facial pressure may signal sinusitis requiring medical care when symptoms persist. ENT specialist Dr. Omar G. Ahmed notes that distinguishing a viral cold from a bacterial sinus infection hinges on duration: seek evaluation if symptoms last more than a week or worsen after an improvement. Most acute sinusitis begins with a viral infection and typically resolves in 7–10 days; ongoing inflammation can trap bacteria in the sinuses, causing a bacterial infection. Acute sinusitis that recurs four or more times a year is termed recurrent; if symptoms persist beyond 12 weeks, it is chronic sinusitis, which may require endoscopy to detect issues such as nasal polyps or a deviated septum. Complications can include bronchitis and pneumonia. Not all sinus infections require antibiotics; treatment focuses on reducing inflammation and supporting the immune system. Delaying care can prolong recovery—consult a doctor if flu symptoms worsen or disrupt sleep and function.

triage.headline_ja: 副鼻腔炎の症状がある場合に医師の診察を受ける必要がある兆候
triage.triage_reason: 記事は副鼻腔炎の一般的な症状と医学的ガイダンスに関する教育的コンテンツであり、特定の感染症発生事象、集団発生、または異常な疾病パターンを報告していない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが『Influenza』を疾患として抽出しているが、記事の実際の内容は副鼻腔炎（sinusitis）に関する医学的アドバイスであり、インフルエンザの流行や発生事象ではない。これは医療教育コンテンツであり、感染症危機管理シグナルとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: tudo o que se sabe do homem internado em estado grave com suspeita da infecção, em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: everything we know about the man hospitalized in serious condition with suspected infection in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case identified in São Paulo, Brazil, involving a 37-year-old man who had traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo about 10 days earlier. He presented with fever and was hospitalized at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas under biosafety precautions for suspected high-risk pathogens. On May 30, 2026, he tested positive for meningococcal meningitis. Before transfer, he was treated at a Unidade de Pronto Atendimento (UPA) with high fever and inconclusive malaria tests; on arrival he was gravely ill, with diarrhea and disorientation, requiring intubation. The case triggered the National Contingency Plan: isolation and epidemiological and laboratory investigations. Samples will undergo analysis; the patient is being tested for other diseases, including malaria. The Instituto Adolfo Lutz will conduct the laboratory investigation, with sequencing-based testing employed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：サンパウロで疑い例として入院している重篤患者について知られていることすべて
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク病原体（エボラ、髄膜炎菌髄膜炎）の疑い例、DRC渡航歴、国家的対応の発動、国際的な懸念事項があるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の疑い例はPICSN（東南アジア・太平洋感染症早期警戒システム）対象国（ブラジル）での初期報告。DRC滞在歴および複数の高リスク病原体による多重感染の可能性が懸念される。国家レベルの生物安全対策と検査体制の発動が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中國網紅染恙蟲病猝逝 疾管署：若經適當治療死亡率低於5%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese online influencer dies suddenly after contracting scrub typhus; Taiwan CDC says mortality rate under 5% with proper treatment.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) remains a risk in Taiwan, with 57 cases reported as of May 24, including 56 locally acquired and 1 death. Mortality with proper treatment falls below 5%, far lower than the up-to-60% rate without treatment. Cases typically rise from April–May, peak in June–July, with a second wave in September–October. Distribution includes Taitung (16), Hualien (10), and Kinmen (7), with 11 other counties reporting 1–4 cases. Transmission is via infected chigger mite larvae, which bite passing hosts; human-to-human transmission is not typical. Symptoms include abrupt high fever, headache, back pain, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, and a painless eschar at the bite site, sometimes with pneumonia or liver abnormalities. Early diagnosis and treatment reduce death risk; prevention focuses on protective clothing, repellents, bathing after outdoor activity, and prompt care if fever and rash develop after outdoor exposure. A 39-year-old Chinese influencer in Yunnan recently died after scrub typhus.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のネット有名人が恙虫病で急死、台湾CDC：適切な治療により死亡率は5%未満
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での恙虫病症例が57例報告され、死亡事例も含まれている。また中国（雲南省）での死亡例も報道され、異常・予想外の状況と判断される。IHR基準を複数該当し、シグナルとしてフル評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが台湾も発生地域として抽出しているが、記事サマリーの主題は台湾での恙虫病流行と中国（雲南省）での死亡事例である。対象国リスト（GeoNames ID）に台湾は含まれておらず、記事から実際に該当する対象国は中国（1814991）のみ。台湾での症例報告は重要な文脈情報だが、対象国による検証では中国のみを計上する。

article.articleHeadline: Snelle verspreiding ebola in Congo is 'zeer alarmerend', waarschuwt Artsen Zonder Grenzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is 'highly alarming,' warns Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, is highly alarming, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF).
