The outbreak involves more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri as the epicenter. A key concern is the inability to gauge the true scale or severity of transmission, with hundreds of test samples awaiting analysis and frontline teams struggling to keep pace. MSF is calling for a drastic increase in specialized medical organizations on the ground and an immediate expansion of testing capacity to hasten laboratory confirmation and containment efforts. The article emphasizes urgent diagnostic and outbreak-response needs without details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラの急速な拡大は「非常に懸念される」とことと、国境なき医師団が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラで1,000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡者、ワクチン・治療法なし。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。国際的な医療支援の直接的な呼び出しがある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはまれな変異体であり、ワクチン・承認治療法がない点が特に懸念される。WHO事務局長が現地視察した高い政治的関心がある。検査待機中のサンプルが数百件あり、真の流行規模の把握が困難な状況が強調されている。MSFによる直接的な国際医療支援拡大要求。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस: विदेश से आने वालों की होगी जांच, बिलासपुर सिम्स में होगा आरटीपीसीआर टेस्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Screening for people arriving from abroad; RT-PCR test to be conducted at Bilaspur SIMS.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus precautions are being tightened in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. Suspected cases will undergo RT-PCR testing at Bilaspur SIMS (Chhattisgarh Institute of Medical Sciences). Hospitals across the district—government and private—have made mask-wearing mandatory. The state government has ordered mandatory thermal screening and testing for travelers arriving from abroad. A tri-tier protection framework is in place to prevent entry through international travel, with daily sharing of data on international arrivals from Raipur and other nearby airports to the district pandemic control cell. Major railway stations have been instructed to watch for passengers returning from foreign travel with symptoms. Specifically, any citizen returning from African countries must remain in home quarantine under health department supervision for 21 days upon reaching Bilaspur.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：海外から到着した人々のスクリーニング；ビラスプルSIMSでRT-PCR検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: インド（対象国）におけるエボラウイルス対策の強化であるが、現在のところ確定症例や実際の患者発生の報告がなく、予防的措置（スクリーニング・検査態勢整備）が主体。情報が限定的であり、フルRRA前段階として継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記された実患者または確定症例がない。これはエボラウイルス発症の報告ではなく、インド（Chhattisgarh州）での予防的対応・監視体制の確立についての報道。アフリカからの帰国者に対する21日間の隔離要件が設定されており、政府の対応は進行中だが、現在の段階では『PICKUP』（フルRRA）には至らない。ただし、今後の患者発生報告、または対策強化の背景にある他の情報が出現した場合は速やかに再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen Zonder Grenzen noemt snelle verspreiding ebola in Congo "zeer alarmerend
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders calls the rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo "very alarming."
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) calls the rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo 'very alarming' during WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus's visit to Ituri, the outbreak's epicenter. At least 246 deaths have been reported from the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, the lineage at the source of infections. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. MSF warns that the first days after outbreak declaration have seen an unprecedented surge in cases, signaling accelerated transmission. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission in Ituri and the lack of targeted medical countermeasures for Bundibugyo Ebola, raising concerns about containment, clinical management, and the broader public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴにおけるエボラの急速な拡大を「極めて警戒すべき」と評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による確認された死亡246件と急速な感染伝播が報告されており、ワクチンおよび承認された治療法が存在しない。WHO事務局長訪問中の報告で国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクを主題としている。246件の死亡報告、ワクチン・治療薬の不在、急速な感染拡大、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など、複数の重大な懸念要因が確認される。フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：及时医治有助应对埃博拉疫情_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Timely treatment helps combat the Ebola outbreak - Beijing News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo lineage) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, centered in Bunia. No approved vaccine or specific antiviral therapy exists; timely, high-quality medical care—especially isolation, rehydration, and pain relief—can enable recovery, and some patients in Ituri have recovered. WHO and partners are pursuing vaccine and therapeutic clinical trials. DR Congo Health Minister expects the response to last about 4–6 months with dynamic adjustments as needed. The outbreak began around May 15; as of May 26, 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 238 deaths have been reported; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases as of May 29. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia on May 30 to oversee the response and emphasize timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：適切な治療がエボラ出血熱の流行対応に役立つ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定・疑い例が多数報告され、死亡例が238件に及ぶ。DRC（アイトゥリ州）とウガンダでの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に除外。DRCでのエボラ発生（ブンジブギョ系統）は確認され、1,077例の疑い例と238死亡が報告されている。WHOチーフが現地視察を実施しており、国際的対応が進行中。4-6ヶ月の対応期間が見込まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen Zonder Grenzen: snelle verspreiding ebola in Congo is 'zeer alarmerend'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: rapid spread of Ebola in Congo is 'highly alarming'.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province an Ebola outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. Officials report more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, identified as the outbreak’s origin. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for this variant. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that the true scale and severity of transmission cannot yet be assessed: daily new suspected cases are reported, but hundreds of test samples await laboratory analysis, delaying confirmation and response. Field teams say they cannot keep pace with the outbreak’s spread. MSF has urged a dramatic increase in the number of specialized medical organizations on the ground and an immediate expansion of testing capacity. The concerns were raised during a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴでのエボラの急速な拡大は「非常に懸念される」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による1,000以上の疑い例と246死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予防接種やワクチンの不在、WHO事務局長の現地視察など国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模エボラ出血熱の発生。1,000以上の疑い例、246確認死亡。ワクチン・治療薬未開発。検査・対応能力の不足が懸念される。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: FG screens inbound passengers, Hajj returnees
article.articleSummary: Nigeria activated emergency surveillance at airports and entry points after Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo virus strain), with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Inbound passengers and returning Hajj pilgrims face mandatory Ebola screening via a dedicated portal and an Ebola health questionnaire, coordinated by the NCDC with aviation and health authorities. Pilgrims returning from Saudi Arabia from June 4 will be screened at Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Enugu, and Kano; Ugandan Airlines flights to Lagos will undergo special screening through the Hajj terminal at Murtala Muhammed International Airport. Airlines have been urged to ensure online health declaration forms, with paper forms on arrival if needed. Screening is underway at MMIA Lagos, including temperature checks, vaccination document verification, and contact-tracing data collection. NCDC warns Nigeria remains vulnerable due to international travel and symptom overlap with malaria and Lassa fever; hospitals are alerted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：FGが到着乗客とハッジ帰国者をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク（ウガンダ、DRC）に対するナイジェリアの対応状況を報告。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事は既に発生中のウガンダおよびDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（WHO PHEIC宣言済み、2026年5月17日）に対するナイジェリアの初期対応（空港スクリーニング活性化）を報道。ナイジェリア自体の患者報告はないが、高いリスク地域からの旅行者スクリーニングを実施中。マラリアおよびラッサ熱との症状重複の指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة يدعو لدفن آمن خلال زيارة لبؤرة تفشي إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of the World Health Organization calls for safe burial during a visit to the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Bunia, Ituri Province, Congo, epicenter of Ebola outbreak, urging early care, isolation, rehydration, and pain relief, and emphasizing safe burials as authorities combat the seventh Congo outbreak and its third largest on record. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccines or treatments, making prompt care essential. Congo totals shown by WHO: 906 suspected cases with 223 suspected deaths under investigation; later reports list 1,028 suspected cases and 225 confirmed. The outbreak spans three Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda, which has closed its border with Congo. Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo in a man who recently traveled from Congo; he is isolated in a specialized hospital. MSF warns of unprecedented spread, while funding shortfalls and donor hesitancy threaten the response. Africa CDC and Congolese officials say resources exist and call for sustained international support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の流行中心地を訪問し、安全な埋葬を呼びかける - ショロウク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、複数国での確認、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者を伴う多国間流行であり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際的な対応が進行中のため、フルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はワクチン・治療法がなく、クリティカルな脅威。ウガンダも感染者が発生しているが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ブラジルは輸入症例が報告されているため対象国として含める。記事配信日が2026年5月となっており、日付の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Opini: Mengenal Orthoebolavirus, Sebentuk Ancaman Kesehatan Masyarakat Global yang Nyata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opinion: Getting to Know Orthoebolavirus, a Real, Tangible Global Public Health Threat.
article.articleSummary: May 2026 outbreak of orthoebolavirus (Ebolavirus) in the Congo region and Uganda has prompted WHO to declare an international public health emergency (PHEIC). The CDC reports 264 deaths linked to the outbreak. Ebola, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo, is named after the Ebola River. Since 2014, Ebola outbreaks have occurred across Africa, the Americas, and Europe, including the United States, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom; Indonesia has not reported cases. Four human-pathogenic species exist: Zaire ebolavirus, Sudan ebolavirus, Taï Forest ebolavirus, and Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The 2026 outbreaks are attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Researchers are examining cross-protective antibody responses among species in survivors. A 2019 FDA-approved vaccine targets Zaire ebolavirus but does not protect against Sudan ebolavirus (outbreak 2022). Zoonotic spillover from fruit bats and primates drives initial infections; human-to-human transmission occurs via body fluids of the infected or deceased.

triage.headline_ja: オピニオン：オルトエボラウイルス（Orthoebolavirus）の理解 - 真の世界的公衆衛生上の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月のコンゴ・ウガンダでのエボラ発生により、WHOがPHEIC宣言、264人の死亡報告がある。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC・ウガンダでの2026年5月のエボラ発生が主題。インドネシアは「cases reported」とあり、対象国リストに含まれるため検証済みロケーションに含める。米国・イタリア・スペイン・英国・スーダンは過去の流行例として言及されているが、2026年5月の現在の発生地ではないため除外。PHEIC宣言、264死亡、Bundibugyo ebolavirus特定、ヒト-ヒト感染確認など、極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre de 37 años...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola in a 37-year-old man....
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil, is evaluating a 37-year-old man of Congolese origin with symptoms compatible with Ebola who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He is hospitalized, initially in ICU, and transferred to Hospital Emilio Ribas, where he remains in quarantine while results are awaited. Authorities emphasize that the case is under investigation but unlikely to trigger a broader outbreak, citing no autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the affected region to the region, and Ebola transmission only via direct contact with blood, secretions, body fluids, or tissues of symptomatic patients. In the DRC, the WHO reports 49 new infections and eight deaths in the past week, with 160 suspected cases and 47 probable deaths under analysis. The WHO also notes an imported confirmed case in the United States and treatment in Germany. Diagnostic challenges for the Bundibugyo strain hinder early detection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがコンゴ民主共和国から渡航してきた37歳男性のエボラ感染の可能性を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ヒト-ヒト感染の高リスク病原体（エボラ出血熱）の疑い症例が対象国（ブラジル、DRC）で報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も重篤な感染症の一つ。DRCでの継続的な感染者発生が背景にあり、症例がブラジルを含む複数国に波及している。Bundibugyo株の診断困難性が早期検出を阻害している点も懸念。米国およびドイツへの輸入症例も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil.- Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil - Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola in a man of....
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man of Congolese origin in São Paulo, Brazil, with Ebola-compatible symptoms, is hospitalized awaiting lab results after traveling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He was treated in an ICU, moved to Hospital Emilio Ribas, placed in quarantine, and is under investigation with isolation, reporting, laboratory testing, and follow-up. Officials say the risk of regional spread is unlikely, noting no endemic transmission in South America, no direct flights from the affected region, and transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic patients. In DR Congo, the outbreak has intensified with 49 new infections and 8 more deaths in the past week, plus 160 suspected cases and 47 probable deaths under analysis. The WHO also reports a confirmed case outside Africa in a U.S. citizen treated in Germany after Congo exposure. Diagnostic capacity is hampered by the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル - ブラジルがコンゴ民主共和国から渡航した男性のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。対象国DRCでのエボラ流行激化と南米への輸入例報告により、シグナル閾値を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの流行激化（新規感染49件、死亡8件/週）と南米への輸入例（ブラジル）が主題。米国市民のドイツでの確認例も言及されているが、米国・ドイツは対象国外。DRCは深刻な流行状況、ブラジルは南米初の疑い輸入例として両国を検証済み場所とした。Bundibugyo株の診断困難性も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Anggap Sepele! Flu Singapura pada Anak Bisa Picu Radang Otak dan Kelumpuhan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Underestimate It! Singapore Flu in Children Can Cause Encephalitis and Paralysis.
article.articleSummary: Singapore Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in children remains relatively high in Jakarta, Indonesia. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) is identified as the most dangerous variant, capable of causing encephalitis, seizures, and flaccid paralysis by invading the nervous system. Dr. Handayani, a pediatric specialist, warns that not all HFMD viruses carry the same risk; EV71 is more virulent. Symptoms in affected children include high fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers that hinder eating and drinking, and a rash on the hands and feet. The warning came during Health Talk World Immunization Week 2026 at Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri, Jakarta, on May 29, 2026, organized with Kalventis. The article notes ongoing, relatively high HFMD case counts among children but provides no specific figures or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 軽視しないで！子どもの手足口病（ヘルパンギーナ）は脳炎と麻痺を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による脳炎・麻痺のリスクが指摘され、ジャカルタで手足口病が継続的に多数発生している状況。異常性・重症度・流行しやすさの複数基準に該当し、社会的関心（保健啓発イベント）も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはシンガポール由来の手足口病（HFMD）がジャカルタで流行していることを主題としており、インドネシアが確認された発生地。Singapore は感染症イベントの命名由来であり、実際の発生地はインドネシア（ジャカルタ）であるため verified_locations に含めない。EV71による神経症状（脳炎、麻痺）のリスク警告と、継続的かつ相対的に高い症例数が報告されている点が懸念される。ただし具体的な患者数・死亡数は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, le directeur de l'OMS dit au pays qu'il n'est pas seul face à l'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the WHO director tells the country that it is not alone in facing Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri’s Bunia has been ongoing for two weeks, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths recorded as of May 31, 2026. Mongbwalu, a 150,000‑strong mining town about three hours from Bunia, is described as an epicenter where health workers are overwhelmed and testing capacity is strained. The World Health Organization’s Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited to reassure communities, call for coordinated action under the Congolese government’s leadership, and stress the critical role of community engagement to stop transmission. A local lab can now test samples within 24 hours, a improvement over sending them to Kinshasa. Funeral-handling restrictions evoke local resistance and attacks on care centers. MSF officials say international support remains far below needs, and misinformation on social media fuels fear. Uganda border closure disrupts trade and access to care, with some patients seeking treatment across the border in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでは、WHO事務局長がエボラウイルスとの戦いで国が一人ではないと述べている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの大規模流行（906例の疑い例、223人の死亡）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの患者流出）、国際的支援要請など、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO事務局長の訪問など高い社会的・政治的関心あり。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダへの患者流出と国境閉鎖言及があるが、ウガンダでの確認事例は明記されておらず、DRCでの発生が主題のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO事務局長の訪問、社会的動乱（医療施設への攻撃、葬儀慣行への抵抗）、国際的支援の不足などが指摘されており、高いリスクと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Бразилия разследва предполагаем случай на ебола в Сао Пауло | Новини.бг
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a suspected case of Ebola in São Paulo | Novini.bg
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health authorities in São Paulo are investigating a suspected Ebola case. A man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently visited the DRC, where an Ebola epidemic is ongoing, developed fever and has been isolated in a hospital equipped for suspected and confirmed cases. The incident follows a May 15 declaration of a new Ebola outbreak in the Central African Republic, with the WHO issuing an international alert. Ebola cases have been reported in three provinces of DR Congo and in neighboring Uganda, indicating ongoing regional transmission. The Brazilian case represents a potential imported infection, with authorities conducting monitoring, isolation, and contact-tracing as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロでのエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの国際的な流行危機であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC、CAR、ウガンダで継続的なエボラ流行中。ブラジルの疑い症例は輸入感染で、DRCから帰国した患者が発症。WHOが国際アラートを発出。高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Perketat Kewaspadaan soal Wabah Ebola, Virus Bisa Sebabkan Demam hingga Pendarahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Tightens Vigilance Over Ebola Outbreak, Ebola Virus Can Cause Fever and Bleeding
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health tightens vigilance at all entry points, with border screening and readiness enhanced due to border spread. Travel-associated cases have been reported in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa, linked to population mobility and limited local health facilities. The ministry has mobilized field health workers, expanded traveler screening, and prepared referral pathways to standard hospitals for suspected cases. National labs are on standby to support rapid detection, with 24-hour monitoring via SKDR and the PHEOC. Ebola’s average fatality rate is about 50%. Strains mentioned: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), Sudan Virus Disease (SVD), Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD). Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects from infected humans or animals. Officials urge calm and counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ流行について警戒を強化、エボラウイルスは発熱から出血を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが2026年5月17日にエボラをPHEICとして宣言し、複数国での確認報告あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、ウガンダ（Kampala）とキンシャサでの旅行関連患者が報告されている。インドネシアは記事の主体（Ministry of Health Tightens Vigilance）として含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が確認され、平均致死率50%、複数の出血熱ウイルス株が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, le directeur de l'OMS dit au pays qu'il n'est pas seul face à l'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the WHO Director-General tells the country that it is not alone in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two weeks into a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri's Bunia, the most affected province, authorities report at least 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths. A local laboratory now can test samples within 24 hours, replacing prior delays that sent specimens to Kinshasa. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the area, stating that people in Ituri, the Kivu regions, and across the DRC are not alone and highlighting the nation’s history with Ebola—16 previous outbreaks contained; this is the 17th. He called for strengthened coordination among health and humanitarian actors under government leadership and stressed that community engagement is critical to stopping transmission. He also acknowledged tensions around strict funeral-care rules that, while necessary, clash with local burial practices and have fueled attacks on care centers.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでは、WHO事務局長が同国がエボラウイルスに直面して一人ではないと述べています
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる確認された複数死亡（223例）を伴う新規アウトブレイク、DRC内複数地域での拡大、国際機関（WHO）の高レベル関与が確認されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの17回目のアウトブレイク（DRC）。発症からわずか2週間で906疑似症例、223死亡が報告されている。Ituri州Bunia市が最初の震源地だが、Kinshasa市への拡大も確認。WHO事務局長の現地訪問による国際的関心の高さ、地域検査体制の迅速化、葬儀ルール周辺の社会的緊張など、多角的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果爆千例伊波拉 谭德塞赴前线：与你们同在
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo reports 1,000 Ebola cases; Tedros heads to the front lines: we stand with you
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains critical, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as a focal point, where WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to urge intensified international aid and community-driven response. He stressed overcoming distrust and misinformation and working with authorities to reinforce response efforts. The highly contagious hemorrhagic fever has spread to three eastern DRC provinces and spilled over into neighboring Uganda. Africa CDC reports that since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has recorded at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, including 246 deaths, while Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The visit underscores the need for sustained funding, risk communication, and health-system strengthening to curb transmission and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果爆千例伊波拉 谭德塞赴前线：与你们同在
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による高い政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病(EVD)は記事サマリーで明確にDRCのイツリ州ブニアを中心とした東部で発生し、ウガンダへも波及していることが述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsに含めない。2026年5月31日時点で1,077疑い症例・246死亡が記録され、WHO事務局長の現地派遣は最高レベルの国際的関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Ostkongo: "In den Gemeinden hieß es: Ihr bereichert euch an unserem Blut!"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Eastern Congo: "You are profiting from our blood!"
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo for the second time in a few years, with eastern DRC near Beni the epicenter. A new Ebola virus variant is spreading, resulting in more than 1,000 people classified as suspected or confirmed cases, and around 250 deaths likely attributed to Ebola to date. The 2018 outbreak in DRC was the second-largest globally. Doctor Maurice Kakule Mutsunga, based at a hospital near Beni in eastern Congo, was among the first Ebola infections in 2018. The Die Zeit report highlights the hospital situation amid the current outbreak in eastern DRC. The article notes ongoing transmission and the re-emergence of Ebola in the region, prompting renewed public health concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部のエボラ出血熱：「あなたたちは私たちの血で金儲けしている！」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。新型エボラウイルス亜型による1,000人以上の疑似症・確定患者、約250人の死亡が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行性・管理可能性も満たしている。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 新規エボラウイルス亜型の出現、数千人規模の患者数、複数回の流行パターンが指摘されており、国際的関心も極めて高い。医療体制の脆弱性と社会的不信も報告されている。西アフリカのエボラ流行（2014-2016）を彷彿させるリスクレベル。DRC対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا وائرس تیزی سے پھیلنے لگا،صورتحال انتہائی تشویشناک ہوگئی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ebola virus is spreading rapidly; the situation has become extremely alarming.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths, centered in Ituri province in eastern DRC. Neighboring Uganda has nine confirmed Ebola cases and one death. Doctors Without Borders deputy director Dr. Allen Gonzalez warned that two weeks after the outbreak was declared, the situation is extremely alarming, with case numbers rising far faster than in previous outbreaks. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess containment efforts amid the flare-up. MSF reports ground teams are confronting conditions that hinder effective response to rapid transmission. The article highlights escalating transmission and cross-border risk, underscoring the need for intensified public health measures and international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが急速に拡大、状況は極めて懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの病原体であり、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（1,000以上の疑似症例、246人死亡）と隣国ウガンダへの越境感染を示す。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはウガンダを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは「隣国ウガンダで9確定症例」と記述されており、主要アウトブレイクはDRCのIturi州が中心。ウガンダは越境感染例としての言及であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則に基づく強制通報対象で、この規模のアウトブレイクはWHO事務局長による直接対応（Tedros訪問）が確認されており、最優先事項。

article.articleHeadline: Brazilia investighează un caz suspect de Ebola, la Sao Paolo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a suspected case of Ebola in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazilian health authorities in São Paulo are investigating a suspected Ebola case. A man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who had recently visited the country presented with fever and is in isolation at a hospital specialized in suspected or confirmed Ebola cases, according to a press release. The investigation underscores the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The report notes that no laboratory confirmation is provided in the article, and authorities are pursuing standard infection-control precautions and monitoring close contacts while the case is evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロでエボラウイルス感染の疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRCからの渡航者による疑い例で、エボラウイルスは高い重症度を有し国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは検査室確認前の疑い例だが、DRCでの進行中の流行地からの渡航者による発熱例であり、高い懸念レベルを指す。隔離・接触者監視等の対策が実施されている。国際的な公衆衛生関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the town at the frontline of the Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: Outbreak centers on Mongbwalu where Bundibugyo Ebola virus circulates, linked to fruit bats believed to be its reservoir, and amplified by gold mining and conflict that draw migrants through the town. Lokudu, a hospital clinician, recalls operating on a young woman who died after a cesarean on April 6; in the weeks after, staff fell ill, including an anaesthesiologist (May 9) and a surgical assistant (May 10). Sylvestre Atama, a Catholic preacher who died of Ebola, triggered a violent backlash as followers demanded his body for a traditional funeral; a crowd of more than 100 attacked the hospital, and a line of soldiers escorted the burial after a five-hour standoff. Patients fled wards during the chaos. Ailing five-year-old Emmanuel Cyrille showed improvements, sitting up and stopping his bleeding. WHO says a vaccine for this strain could take six to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の最前線にある町の内側
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の活動的な流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。死亡例、医療従事者への拡大、社会的混乱、国際的懸念が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはMongobaluを中心としたコンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo Ebolaウイルス流行を記述。複数の死亡例、医療従事者の感染、医療施設への暴力的な対立による患者の逃亡など、医療体制への深刻な影響が報告されている。ワクチン開発も進行中（6〜9ヶ月）との記載あり。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として最高レベルのリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre de 37 años procedente de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola in a 37-year-old man from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, São Paulo's Health Secretariat reported a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized with Ebola-like symptoms and awaiting laboratory confirmation. He reportedly traveled from the DRC, was treated in an intensive care unit, then moved to Hospital Emilio Ribas and placed in quarantine, with tests per protocol (isolation, notification, lab analysis, follow-up). Authorities say the case is under investigation but with a low risk of regional spread, noting no autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the affected region, and that Ebola transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues of symptomatic individuals. In the DRC, last week: 49 new infections and eight deaths; 160 suspected cases and 47 probable deaths under analysis. The WHO confirmed one exported case—a U.S. citizen treated in Germany after caring for patients in Congo. Bundibugyo strain has limited diagnostic capacity, hindering early detection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがコンゴ民主共和国からの37歳男性におけるエボラの可能性のある症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重篤度が極めて高く、国際的な拡大リスク（既に米国・ドイツへの輸出症例確認）があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。DRC現地での活動的な流行に加え、ブラジルでの初の輸入症例報告候補であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、南米初のエボラ輸入症例の可能性が示唆されており、DRC現地での流行継続（直前週に49新規感染・8死亡、160疑い症例）と既知の国際輸出症例（米国市民がドイツで治療）が背景にある。Bundibugyo株の診断困難性も懸念材料。ブラジル当局は低リスク評価を示しているが、確定診断待機中であり、続報追跡が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Rakušanka izolovaná na vídeňské klinice ebolou podle testů infikovaná není
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Austrian woman isolated at a Vienna clinic is not infected with Ebola according to tests.
article.articleSummary: An Austrian woman in Vienna remains under medical surveillance after two negative Ebola tests, ruling out infection of the 19-year-old who had been isolated at a Vienna clinic for possible exposure. The patient had returned from Uganda, where she volunteered at a Kampala orphanage since August 2025 through Caritas; symptoms prompted isolation two days after arrival in Austria. She was treated in Linz before transfer to Vienna; her mother was also isolated. Two tests, the second conducted after an interval following the first, were negative for Ebola. Ebola spreads by contact and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding; vaccines exist for some strains, but in Congo and Uganda the Bundibugyo variant is circulating with no vaccine or effective treatment. The current epidemic is the 17th since 1976; fatality ranges 25–90%; the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths, and Congo’s 2018–2020 deaths approached 2,300.

triage.headline_ja: オーストリア人女性がウィーンの診療所で隔離されているが、検査によればエボラウイルスに感染していない
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例が2回の陰性検査により感染を否定されたため、実際の感染症事例ではない。公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威は解消されており、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去のコンゴ・ウガンダでのエボラ流行背景情報を言及しているが、本記事の主題は陰性判定された疑い例の解消であり、実際の感染症イベントではない。対象国内での実際の感染症の発生・拡大は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report #2
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO on 17 May 2026 under the International Health Regulations (2005) after confirmed cross-border transmission, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. WHO External Situation Report provides latest epidemiological updates; travel and trade restrictions are advised, with border closures at some crossings while humanitarian, cargo and other authorized movements continue. WHO prioritized readiness and response: Priority 1 countries—DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Burundi, Rwanda; Priority 2—Angola, Central African Republic, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of Congo, United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia. IOM response focuses on border health screening, surveillance, risk communication and community engagement; deployment of emergency health personnel; accelerated logistics and field coordination; Mobility Tracking (DTM) supports mobility analysis and weekly outbreak reporting. Ongoing insecurity and displacement in eastern DRC raise regional spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: 多国間ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク - 状況報告#2
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限実施）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、多国間の確認済み感染例と高い国際的関心がある。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。DRCとウガンダ間での確認済み越境感染、東DRCの不安定性と変位による地域的スピルオーバーリスク増加。優先対応国リストに複数国が含まれ、IOMを含む国際的対応が実施中。対象国リスト内で検証された発生地はDRC、Uganda、Zambiaの3か国。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges countries to avoid travel bans as Ebola outbreak spreads in Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighbouring Uganda, centered on Bunia in eastern DRC. The Bundibugyo strain, a less common variant with no approved vaccine or targeted therapy, drives current transmission. As of May 31, 2026, DRC authorities report more than 900 suspected Ebola infections and over 220 suspected deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases, including infections detected in Kampala, with one death linked to the outbreak. Early diagnosis and supportive care can improve survival. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged governments to avoid travel bans and border closures, arguing they hinder transparency and cooperation. Tedros visited Bunia to assess the situation and bolster international support. Ongoing containment relies on prompt medical care, resource provision, and trusted communication among governments, health agencies, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱アウトブレイクがコンゴとウガンダに拡大する中、WHO事務局長は各国に渡航禁止令を回避するよう促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認例と高い死亡率、国際協力の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）も記載されているが、サマリーではウガンダでの症例数が限定的（9確認例、1死亡）かつ東部DRCのBunia中心のアウトブレイクが主題であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。ただし、ウガンダでの感染が報告されている点は重要な二次発生の兆候である。

article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser slår alarm over hurtig spredning af ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns of rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The humanitarian organization says there have never been so many Ebola cases so soon after an outbreak was declared, signaling accelerated transmission in the DR Congo outbreak. Alan Gonzales, MSF's operational vice director, comments on the current situation and its concerning trajectory. The article notes the unusually high number of Ebola cases within a short interval since the declaration, underscoring the seriousness of the ongoing outbreak. It confirms MSF's continued involvement in the DR Congo response. Specific case counts and fatalities are not provided in the excerpt, but the message is clear: the outbreak in DR Congo is evolving rapidly and drawing international attention.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がエボラの急速な感染拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生への影響、DRC内での異常な急速拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は対象国リストに含まれないDRCでの発生であるが、IHR基準の全4項目に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生への重大な脅威を示しており、フルRRA実施対象として適切。MSFによる正式な警告が発出されており、信頼性の高いソースからの情報。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات اشتباه الإصابة بفيروس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in cases of suspected viral infection.
article.articleSummary: 1,028 suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of Friday, up from 906 the previous day, per Kinshasa Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The eastern DRC outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with additional suspected cases reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization noted in early May that the outbreak likely began about two months before detection and emphasized the rarity of Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine exists. The rise in suspected cases raises concerns about spread in densely populated areas and the associated challenges of contact tracing and isolation. WHO also reported gradually improving laboratory testing capacity, with most accumulated samples of suspected cases expected to be processed in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: 疑い患者数の増加、ウイルス感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の流行で1,028疑い症例が報告され、DRCとウガンダで確認。予防接種がない希少な株による国際的拡大リスクと人口密集地での感染懸念により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と渡航・貿易制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCでの1,028疑い症例とウガンダでの追加疑い症例が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチンがない希少株で、人口密集地での接触追跡課題が強調されている。WHO による検査能力向上の報告も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Amisi raises alarm over US Ebola facility as Duale defends Laikipia project
article.articleSummary: Kenya plans an Ebola preparedness and isolation facility in Laikipia, defended by Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale as a dual-use military installation serving Kenyan and American nationals and part of broader outbreak preparedness, not to host Ebola patients. Saboti MP Caleb Amisi criticized the plan on May 30, 2026, urging leaders to prioritise Kenya’s safety and postpone other activities, warning of potentially devastating consequences if action falters. The move follows heightened regional vigilance amid Ebola outbreaks in neighbouring countries, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) cited as the epicentre; Duale notes many Kenyans work in DRC and cites over 350 KDF soldiers deployed there. As of May 31, 2026, Kenya has not recorded any confirmed Ebola cases. The facility is framed as strengthening public-health security, not importing Ebola patients, and will serve both Kenyan and American personnel operating in high-risk regions.

triage.headline_ja: アミシ氏が米国エボラ施設について警告 デュアレ氏がライキピア・プロジェクトを擁護
triage.triage_reason: ケニアのエボラ対策施設計画に関する政治的議論であり、実際のエボラ発生ではなく予防的施設建設の記事である。DRCでの実際のアウトブレイク情報は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアのエボラ対策施設建設計画に関する政治的議論である。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているが、本記事の焦点ではない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。実際の発生情報がなく、準備施設計画の政治議論であることからWATCHとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ketua WHO gesa negara pertimbang semula sekatan perjalanan akibat Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief urges countries to reconsider travel restrictions due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Canada and the United States have imposed travel bans and visa suspensions on residents from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. Rwanda and Uganda have also restricted Congo-origin travel, and Rwanda bars entry to foreigners who have travelled through Congo in the past 30 days. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking in Bunia, Ituri, urged unity and cautioned that travel restrictions could hinder transparent reporting, emphasizing local communities’ role in response to the outbreak. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain currently has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. As of the WHO update on Friday, at least 134 confirmed cases have been reported in DRC and Uganda, with 18 deaths. Congolese authorities report ongoing suspected cases, taking the cumulative total to over 1,000 since the outbreak was declared on May 15, concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ感染症の旅行制限の再考を各国に促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中4項目すべてが該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（複数国での確認）、死亡例を伴う深刻な影響、多国間での渡航制限の実施により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラの国際的発生。DRCで1,000以上の累積症例、複数国での旅行制限、WHO事務局長による緊急声明が報じられている。ワクチンと承認された治療法がない状況。南スーダンはAPIの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは旅行制限の対象国として言及されており、実際の感染症イベント発生地は不明であるため対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Aldrig förr har Ebola spridits så här snabbt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Ebola has never spread this quickly.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that the Ebola outbreak in Kongo-Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is having severe consequences. Deputy MSF chief Alan Gonzalez says the virus is spreading faster than aid workers can respond. 'Never before have so many cases been reported so soon after an Ebola outbreak was confirmed,' he notes. The article reports hundreds of deaths and cautions that the toll is likely undercounted. It highlights the unprecedented pace of transmission and the strain on frontline responders. The report provides no specific case counts or transmission details beyond the rapid spread and high mortality, underscoring the seriousness of the outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: MSF: エボラはかつてないほど迅速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、高い死亡率、医療対応の限界が報告されており、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。国際的な支援が必要な深刻な感染症危機。
triage.notes: MSF（国境なき医師団）による公式警告。「かつてないほど迅速な拡大」「数百人の死亡」と報告。DRCはエボラ流行地域であり、今回の異例の拡大速度は国際的な懸念事項。継続的な監視と詳細情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief heads to Ebola epicentre - as Brazil investigates suspected case
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the Ebola epicentre in the DRC’s Ituri province (Bunia), urging treatment seeking and safe burials as the Bundibugyo strain spreads with no approved treatments or vaccines; early palliative care (isolation, rehydration, pain management) is vital. Brazil reports a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo state involving a man who recently traveled to the DRC, isolated at a specialist hospital. In the DRC, 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths are under investigation, with later authorities identifying 1,028 suspected cases and 225 confirmed. Ebola has been confirmed in three DRC provinces and in Uganda, which this week shut its border with the DRC; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. WHO warns the outbreak is spreading faster than the response, with funding about a third of needs and appeals for international support. Attacks on health facilities and basic supply shortages hinder response; this marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC after prior experience.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の中心地へ向かう - ブラジルが疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。国際的に拡大するリスク（ブラジルでの疑い例、ウガンダでの確認例）と、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,028疑い例、225確定例、高い死亡率）が明確。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ州）でのBundibugyo株エボラ流行は確定的。ブラジル（サンパウロ州）での疑い例は、DRC渡航者からの輸入例として報告されており、国際的な懸念が高い。ウガンダも地理的に近接し、既に確定例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、国境閉鎖、資金不足、医療施設への攻撃といった要素から、管理可能性に重大な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Rakúšanka, ktorú vo viedenskej nemocnici uzavreli do izolácie pre možnú nákazu ebolou, nie je infikovaná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Austrian woman placed in isolation in a Viennese hospital due to a possible Ebola infection is not infected.
article.articleSummary: An Austrian 19-year-old woman in Vienna’s hospital was placed in isolation over a possible Ebola infection after returning from Uganda, but two tests showed she is not infected and she remains under medical supervision. The patient had been in Kampala since August 2025, volunteering at an orphanage through the Catholic humanitarian organization Caritas. Officials described her condition as stable but with signs compatible with Ebola before test results. The Ebola outbreak has spread from neighboring Congo; in Congo and Uganda, the Bundibugyo variant is circulating, for which there is no vaccine or effective treatment. Vaccines and treatments exist for some Ebola strains, but not for Bundibugyo. The case is imported to Austria; authorities will continue monitoring. The report cites Kurier and CTK as sources.

triage.headline_ja: ウィーンの病院で隔離されたオーストリア人女性（19歳）はエボラウイルスに感染していない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス陽性ケースではなく陰性確定ケースであるが、ウガンダからの帰国者で初期症状を呈していた点、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行地域での曝露歴がある点から、エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスクに関連する情報として注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者は陰性確定したため、即座の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないが、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行地域（DRCおよびウガンダ）からの輸入例として、国際的な疾病監視の観点から情報価値がある。オーストリアは対象国リストに含まれないが、感染症イベントの発生地はウガンダとDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Podejrzenie pierwszego przypadku eboli w Brazylii. Pacjent w izolacji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected first case of Ebola in Brazil. Patient in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a suspected first case of Ebola, with the patient in isolation at a hospital dedicated to suspected or confirmed viral or infectious disease during an outbreak. WHO data show the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 906 probable Ebola cases, with 223 deaths where infection is suspected to have caused death. Africa CDC data for the DRC indicate 246 deaths and over 1,000 probable cases. The Associated Press notes that Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades. The deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC occurred from 2018 to 2020, claiming nearly 2,300 fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初のエボラ疑い患者が報告。患者は隔離状態
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大可能性、ブラジルでの初疑い患者報告による異常性、および潜在的な渡航・貿易制限リスクが認められる。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者報告は極めて異例であり、国際的な懸念を招く可能性が高い。DRCでは継続的な流行が確認されており、ウイルスの国際拡散リスクが顕在化している。患者の隔離状況、渡航歴、感染源の特定など、追加情報の入手が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Швидкість поширення лихоманки Ебола викликає глибоку тривогу - "Лікарі без кордонів"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapid spread of Ebola fever raises deep concern - Doctors Without Borders
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, rapid spread of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo Ituri province has prompted MSF to call the outbreak deeply troubling after two weeks since declaration. The DRC has logged over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF's deputy director Dr. Alan Gonzalez notes record numbers of cases appearing so soon after outbreak declaration, with many more suspected cases yet to be verified. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to oversee response, while the conflict in the DRC hampers containment and complicates aid delivery, including border and airport closures. Canada has begun revoking visas for nationals of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan amid Ebola concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の急速な拡大が深刻な懸念を引き起こす - 国境なき医師団
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ一類感染症であり、DRC東部での急速な拡大（1,000件以上の疑似患者、246人以上の死亡）、ウガンダへの越境拡大、複数国の対応（カナダのビザ取り消し、WHO総長の現地訪問）により、国際的影響と公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC Ituri州での発生が主題。ウガンダ（隣国、9確認患者）とスーダン（カナダのビザ取り消し対象）も言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。カナダはListに含まれないため除外。発行日が2026年5月で将来日時だが、シグナルとしての情報は有効。MSFとWHOの高い関与レベルが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Canada impose de nouvelles mesures aux frontières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Canada imposes new border controls.
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes border controls to curb Ebola spread. Travelers who stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days will be screened on arrival and must comply with health measures. Eligible entrants must have a 21-day quarantine plan with a safe place and essentials; asymptomatic travelers proceed to quarantine. If no plan exists, they will be placed in a quarantine site, such as a hotel, with regular follow-up. During quarantine, individuals must stay at the site, monitor symptoms daily, and report health status to the Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC). If symptoms appear, PHAC will evaluate and manage. Measures run May 30, 2026 23:59 ET to Aug 29, 2026 under the Quarantine Act. DR Congo declared Ebola on May 15; by May 2026, 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected cases, with three Congolese provinces affected and Uganda reporting confirmed cases, totaling nine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：カナダが国境で新たな措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで確認、カナダが国境措置を実施）が明らかであり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な関心と対応措置が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は対象国外（カナダの対応）であるが、実際の感染症イベントはDRC（対象国）で発生している。2026年5月15日にDRCでエボラが宣言され、1,000件以上の疑似症例のうち246人が死亡、ウガンダで確認症例9件。国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限の実施が確認されており、WPRO基準全5項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường kỹ năng phòng chống dịch bệnh chăn nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening skills in preventing and controlling livestock diseases
article.articleSummary: On 31 May 2026 in Phước Thành Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, the local People’s Committee and the district Veterinary Station Region 6 under the City’s Department of Agriculture and Rural Development conducted a training conference on preventing and controlling livestock and poultry diseases and rabies in dogs and cats for area farms. The locality houses over 84,000 pigs and about 1.2 million poultry, with authorities noting persistent disease risks and neighboring African swine fever outbreaks that affect farming activities and product sales. Measures urged include stricter coordination to control transport, slaughter, and disease surveillance; enhanced vaccination, sanitation, and biosecurity; and expanded public outreach. Rabies education emphasizes responsible dog/cat management, vaccination, and avoiding free-roaming. Trainees will learn to recognize disease signs, outbreak response, and safe, biosecure farming practices to limit wide-spread transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜疾病の予防・制御スキル向上の推進
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの口蹄疫と狂犬病に関する予防啓発・訓練イベント。既知のリスク地域での対応強化だが、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、周辺地域での既存の流行への対応であるため、情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の周辺地域での口蹄疫流行に対する予防啓発・訓練であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。8万4千頭の豚と120万羽の家禽が関連する地域での継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と、流行易感染性地域（epidemic_prone）により、WPRO基準2項目該当。政府関連機関による訓練実施は政府関心を示唆するが、急性リスク評価対象ではなく、経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉應對不佳！前CDC主任：全球未做好準備迎接下一場大流行病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poor Ebola response! Former CDC director: The world is not prepared to face the next pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Former CDC director Thomas R. Frieden warns the world remains unprepared for the next pandemic, criticizing Ebola response and U.S. public health reductions. Frieden, now CEO of Resolve to Save Lives, says this Ebola outbreak will not trigger a global pandemic or pose major risk to many Americans, but serves as a stress test in which the world has performed poorly. Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases as the outbreak spreads, with border closures among the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Rwanda complicating relief coordination. International funding commitments are only slightly more than half of the $500 million outbreak financing required. In the past, the U.S. provided airlift support; since Donald Trump’s presidency, U.S. involvement has waned. Frieden urges stronger WHO support and maintains CDC capacity, criticizing recent U.S. policy shifts, including WHO dues suspension and staff cuts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応が不十分！前CDC主任：世界は次のパンデミックへの準備ができていない
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with 1,077 suspected cases spreading across DRC, Uganda, Rwanda meets IHR criteria (unusual/unexpected, international spread risk, serious public health impact). Warrants full RRA despite current expert assessment of low global pandemic risk.
triage.notes: Rwanda mentioned in article context but not explicitly stated as confirmed case location; included DRC and Uganda based on explicit mention of border closures and outbreak spread. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (not Zaire strain) with 1,077 suspected cases. Funding gap ($250M+ shortfall) and weakened U.S. public health capacity are risk factors. Rwanda omitted from verified_locations as it appears in context of border closure coordination rather than confirmed outbreak location in the summary.

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉應對不佳！前CDC主任：全球未做好準備迎接下一場大流行病 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response has been inadequate! Former CDC director: The world is not prepared to face the next pandemic | Wishing you good health | SETN News HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleSummary: Former CDC director Thomas R. Frieden warns that the world remains unprepared for the next pandemic, citing the Ebola response as a stress test that has failed. Africa CDC reports as of May 28, 2026, 1,077 suspected Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases as the outbreak spreads across Africa, with border closures among the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Rwanda hindering relief efforts. Funding commitments for epidemic prevention are only slightly above half of the $500 million needed. Frieden criticizes U.S. policy changes under the Trump administration, including stopping WHO contributions, cutting more than 3,000 CDC staff, and forcing leadership departures, arguing that public health defenses are weakened and WHO and CDC must be stronger. The situation underlines ongoing Ebola challenges in Africa, though Frieden says this outbreak is unlikely to trigger a global pandemic, it signals a concerning trend for future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応が不十分！前CDC所長：世界は次のパンデミックに対する準備ができていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも4つ以上該当。1,077件の疑い例、複数国での発生、国境閉鎖、国際的な資金不足が報告されており、シグナルとして評価される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による1,077件の疑い例がアフリカで報告。DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ間の国境閉鎖により浮流支援が阻害。前CDC所長による世界的パンデミック準備不足に関する強い警告により高い社会政治的関心。ウガンダとルワンダも関連国として報告されているが、記事本文の主題は主にDRCでの発生に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: ＷＨＯトップ、エボラ拡大地域を訪問　国際社会の追加支援要請 -- コンゴ：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief visits Ebola outbreak areas; appeals for additional international support.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province prompted a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on May 30, 2026. With infections rapidly expanding in the region, he appealed for additional international support to bolster the response. He stressed solidarity—“you are not alone”—and reiterated that transmission can be halted with strong government leadership and active community engagement. The visit aimed to mobilize resources and international backing to complement national and regional efforts, underscoring the ongoing need for surveillance, patient care, and containment measures in the outbreak zone.

triage.headline_ja: ＷＨＯトップ、エボラ拡大地域を訪問　国際社会の追加支援要請 -- コンゴ：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生をIturi州で確認。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際支援要請という高レベルの対応が行われている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致命率が高く、Ituri州での「急速な感染拡大」が記述されている。WHO事務局長による直接訪問と国際支援要請は、事象の深刻性と管理困難性を示唆している。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Järjestö: Ebolatilanne erittäin hälyttävä Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Organization: The Ebola situation is extremely alarming in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is described as extremely alarming by Doctors Without Borders. The World Health Organization says the virus has likely spread far beyond what is officially reported. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, the number of reported Ebola cases in the region is higher than in any previous outbreak. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention reports around 1,100 suspected cases and about 250 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC since the outbreak began. WHO cautions that the true scale may be much larger than these figures indicate. As of May 31, 2026, the situation remains dire, with ongoing transmission and substantial uncertainty about the full extent of spread.

triage.headline_ja: 組織：エボラの状況はコンゴで非常に深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、高い国際的感染リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明白。
triage.notes: 2026年5月のエボラ集団発生。患者数1,100例以上、死亡250例以上（推定）と過去の流行より深刻。WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を示唆。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে প্রাণঘাতী ইবোলা ভাইরাসের প্রকোপ আশঙ্কাজনকভাবে বাড়ছে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in the deadly Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, has surged with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 and at least 246 deaths. The rare Bundibugyo strain is driving transmission and has crossed into neighboring Uganda, where border-area deaths have been reported. The outbreak was officially declared about two weeks ago, and MSF warns the situation is rapidly spiraling out of control. There is currently no approved vaccine, antiviral, or specific treatment for Bundibugyo EBOV. The World Health Organization has urged intensified international funding and support to expand urgent medical care and cross-border containment, as millions in affected frontier regions face extreme risk from this highly contagious virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの致命的なエボラウイルス感染拡大が懸念される形で増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（246死亡、1,000+疑似症例）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明らかである。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は記事で「越境して死亡が報告された」と言及されているが、主たる発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo EBOV株は珍しく、治療法なし。WHOが国際支援を強く要請している点から社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Тедрос ги повика локалните заедници од ДР Конго активно да учествуваат во борбата против епидемијата на ебола - MakPress
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros urged local communities in the DRC to actively participate in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly in the central region, with Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, among the epicenters. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged local communities to actively participate in the response, stressing community engagement and coordination with the international effort. He arrived in Kinshasa to bolster support and called for greater international backing, noting WHO has provided only about one third of the needed funds. The ministry reported 225 confirmed Ebola infections and 906 suspected cases in the country as of Thursday. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, WHO records 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths. MSF warns the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 is spreading extremely quickly and that the on-ground capacity remains below what is needed.

triage.headline_ja: テドロスWHO事務局長、エボラ流行対策でDRコンゴの地域コミュニティの積極的参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当。WHO事務局長が現地入りし国際支援強化を要請するなど高い政治的関心を示す。
triage.notes: DRコンゴでのエボラ流行は2026年5月15日に宣言され、確認症例225件、疑い症例906件、死亡数233件（確認10件、疑い223件）。キンシャサとイトゥリ州ブニアが主要なエピセンター。MSFによると1976年以来17番目の流行で急速に拡大中。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し国際的支援要請を強化している点が社会的・政治的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA E RISCHIO ITALIA | "Viaggi, isolamento e tracciamento: così si evita l'allarme Covid"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and the Risk to Italy | "Travel, Isolation and Contact Tracing: How to Avoid Covid Panic"
article.articleSummary: Ebola, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, is at the center of concern linking outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda (Ruwenzori region). The article emphasizes Italy’s risk hinges on travel, isolation, and contact tracing rather than panic, noting Ebola’s high clinical lethality but lower transmissibility than respiratory viruses like COVID-19. Transmission requires direct contact with infected body fluids (blood, vomit, diarrhea, secretions, or cadavers). There is no magical cure; treatment is supportive—intravenous fluids, oxygen, symptom control, and protecting staff with appropriate PPE. Key measures for Italy include thorough travel history, rapid isolation, and meticulous contact tracing, plus prevention by avoiding high-risk exposures such as caves with fruit bats and risky funeral rites, where body handling can drive spread. Historical Uganda–2000 experiences at Lacor Hospital underscore healthcare worker and patient risk, reinforcing the need for preparedness and robust public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラと伊イタリアへのリスク | 「渡航、隔離、接触者追跡：新型コロナのパニックを回避する方法」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスのDRC・ウガンダ発生が欧州（イタリア）への輸入リスクを提示しており、高い関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラはDRCおよびウガンダ（Ruwenzori地域）で発生しており、イタリアへの輸入リスク記事。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度（臨床的致命率が高い）、感染しやすい性質（直接接触で感染）、管理可能性（適切な隔離・接触者追跡で制御可能）が該当。ただし、verified_locationsについて：記事サマリーはDRC（203312）とウガンダでの発生を述べているが、ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074であり対象国リスト外のため除外。Myanmar（1327865）も記事に出現していないため、実際には対象国内でのエボラ発生は DRC のみ。修正して DRC のみを列挙するべき。

article.articleHeadline: Singapore has 'done well' in handling Wuhan coronavirus situation, but must remain vigilant: PM Lee
article.articleSummary: Singapore reports 13 confirmed Wuhan coronavirus cases, with several patients isolated at the National Centre for Infectious Diseases. Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong credited rapid case finding, isolation and treatment, but urged continued vigilance as the outbreak may be accelerating in China. The World Health Organization declared a global emergency, with over 9,800 cases and more than 200 deaths in China. In response, Singapore announced four masks per household to address shortages amid public concern. PM Lee urged non-discrimination against Chinese nationals, noting the virus can affect anyone, and urged cooperation with China. Authorities are countering misinformation via the Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA). Healthcare workers at NCID were commended, highlighting ongoing preparedness to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールは武漢コロナウイルス対応で「よく対応できた」が警戒を続ける必要がある：リー首相
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。COVID-19パンデミック初期段階で、WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国での患者発生、社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはシンガポールも含まれるが、記事の主題はシンガポールの対応状況であり、実際の流行の中心はChinaであることが明確。シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に除外。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、2026年5月時点の記事だが、内容はCOVID-19初期段階（2020年初頭）の状況を反映。

article.articleHeadline: Tổng lực phòng chống dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All-out effort to prevent and control the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks are accelerating in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no vaccine or approved specific treatment. The WHO has declared a PHEIC over this strain, noting high regional risk from urban transmission, cross-border movement, and strained health systems, while global risk remains low. Ebola is zoonotic, with fruit bats, porcupines, and primates as reservoirs; human spread occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, or contaminated objects. Six Ebola species exist; Bundibugyo is among the top three in outbreaks. Incubation can reach 24 days, allowing travel before symptoms. Early detection, isolation, and infection control are key. Vietnam is assessed at low importation risk, but authorities are strengthening border surveillance, hospital readiness, and testing capacity. Ho Chi Minh City's health authorities have 24/7 entry screening for travelers from affected regions, with Tan Son Nhat Airport issuing advisories.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行防止・対策に総力を挙げて取り組む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで加速度的に拡大し、WHOがPHEIC を宣言。地域的リスク（都市部感染、国境越境、保健システム脆弱化）が高く、ベトナムを含む複数国が監視・対応を強化している。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: Ho Chi Minh City（ベトナム）の当局が24時間体制の入国スクリーニングと検査体制強化を実施中。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は潜伏期間が24日に及ぶため、症状発症前の国際的な人の移動による二次感染リスクが存在。ウガンダはサマリーに記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh Ebola tại CHDC Congo diễn biến phức tạp, WHO cảnh báo nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is evolving in a complex way, WHO warns of danger.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the situation accelerating. As of May 30, 225 laboratory-confirmed cases, 1,028 suspected cases, and more than 220 suspected deaths have been reported, and the virus has crossed into Uganda (9 cases, 1 death). The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare, highly dangerous strain for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. While confirmed case fatality appears lower, the overall scale and severity remain uncertain; MSF calls it one of the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreaks. Security crises in Ituri and eastern provinces, including armed groups ADF and M23, hinder response. EU supplies and US funding (>$112 million) are mobilizing; WHO is coordinating trials of experimental drugs and a potential vaccine. Africa CDC warns of funding cuts; IGAD reallocates about $7 million. Uganda and Rwanda closed borders; the US imposes entry restrictions for recent travelers to the region. Kenya faces a court challenge to a US Ebola quarantine center.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が複雑に展開、WHOが危険を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した確定的なシグナル。複数国への国際的拡大、高い重症度、国境閉鎖などの国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUganda、Rwanda、Kenyaも含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の確定例は主としてDRC（Ituri）での発生であり、Ugandaへの越境例（9例、1死亡）が記載されている。ただし対象国リストにはUgandaやRwandaが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）は極めて高リスク疾患であり、ワクチンが利用不可、セキュリティ危機により対応が妨害されている点も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief appeals against travel bans as Ebola cases surge in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda persists, with the epicentre in Ituri Province's Bunia and more than 1,000 suspected cases. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments yet; however, early diagnosis and timely, quality medical care can improve survival. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries to reconsider travel bans and border closures, warning such restrictions hinder outbreak containment by eroding transparency and trust. DRC Health Minister Roger Kamba said authorities aim to contain the outbreak within four to six months. The decision to visit affected communities underscores the emphasis on community engagement alongside public health measures to control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ熱症例の急増に伴う渡航禁止令に対して異議を唱える（DRC、ウガンダ）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された多国間流行（DRC・ウガンダ）で1,000件以上の疑い例があり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの双方に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダは対象外のため除外。WHOトップによるステートメント、1,000件以上の疑い例、治療法未確立、複数省庁の関与など複合的な警告指標。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Xanuun halis ah oo ka dilaacay dal ay Soomaalidu ka ganacsato
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri region) has intensified, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths reported. Health authorities warn the rise is occurring at an unprecedented pace. Across the border in Uganda, nine laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and one death have been recorded. MSF deputy director Dr Alan Gonzales termed the situation exceptionally severe for its rapid spread, observed two weeks after the outbreak announcement. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to oversee containment efforts amid the flare-up. Response measures focus on surveillance, laboratory confirmation, isolation, contact tracing, and community engagement to halt transmission, with heightened concern for cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリア人が取引している国で起きた危機的な危険な状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準全て該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問など高度な社会・政治的関心。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ地域でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境の言及もあるがDRC発生が中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。1,000件以上の疑い例と246死亡、WHOトップの現地訪問による政治的重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الحالات المشتبه بإصابتها بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1028 شخصاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in suspected Ebola cases in the Congo to 1,028 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with suspected cases rising to 1,028 as of May 29, 2026 (from 906 the previous day). Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba reported that the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain remains active, with cases also reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization had noted in early May that the outbreak likely began about two months earlier and involves a rare Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine. Experts warn that the extended undetected transmission in a densely populated region has hindered tracing and isolation of contacts. The report underscores ongoing cross-border concerns and the need for strengthened surveillance and public health measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疑い症例が1,028人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて満たす。稀なブンディブギョ種での継続的なアウトブレイク、国境越えでのウガンダでの症例報告、ワクチン未開発、接触者追跡困難など複数の深刻なリスク要因がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでの記述は「cases also reported in Uganda」であり、主たる発生地はDRCである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。稀なブンディブギョ株でのアウトブレイク、ワクチン未開発、密集地域での長期未検出伝播など、多数の重大リスク要因が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Flu Singapura Bisa Sebabkan Anak Lumpuh hingga Radang Otak, Ini Kata Dokter : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore Flu Can Cause Paralysis in Children and Even Encephalitis, Doctors Say: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), known as Singapore Flu, remains a common pediatric infection in Jakarta, Indonesia. While most cases are mild, some involve Enterovirus 71 (EV71), linked to more severe disease, including encephalitis and paralysis. Dr. Handayani, a Pediatric Specialist at Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri, notes she can manage up to eight HFMD cases in a single clinic session. EV71 can cause high fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers that hinder eating and drinking, and rash on hands and feet. The remarks came during Health Talk World Immunization Week 2026. The article emphasizes ongoing circulation of HFMD and the importance of recognizing EV71-associated severity.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール風邪は小児の麻痺と脳炎を引き起こす可能性があり、医師が警告：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病がジャカルタで継続的に流行しており、脳炎や麻痺などの重度合併症が報告されている。スクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理性）し、社会的・政治的関心も確認。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのジャカルタで流行中のHFMD（手足口病）とEV71に関する医学的警告。シンガポール（Singapore）は「シンガポール風邪」という病名の由来を示すのみで、記事の主題イベント発生地はインドネシア（ジャカルタ）。タイ発生地域（1605651）は含めない。World Immunization Week 2026での医療専門家による発言であり、政府・医療関心の高さを反映。

article.articleHeadline: WHO kêu gọi hỗ trợ khẩn cấp ngăn dịch Ebola lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO appeals for urgent support to prevent the Ebola outbreak from spreading.
article.articleSummary: WHO appeals for urgent support as Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo widens. On May 15, the DRC declared an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus; by May 30–31, at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths have been reported across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda records 9 cases, including 1 death. WHO cautions the true scale may be larger due to silent transmission and limited testing capacity. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; several candidate vaccines are under consideration for clinical trials, with vaccine trials hoped by year’s end. Immediate priorities: prevent spread beyond affected provinces; maintain surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection control, and safe burials. Displacement and insecurity in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu heighten spread risk; international funding and local trust are essential, and travel bans should be reconsidered to avoid hindering response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行拡大を防ぐための緊急支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による重大な公衆衛生危機で、DRCおよびウガンダで確認され、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限のリスクも存在。スクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当し、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCでのエボラ outbreak と、ウガンダでの9例確認が述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙した。Bundibugyo Ebola は稀で致命率が高い（CFR 246/1077≈23%）。ワクチン未承認、治療法なしという状況で、国際的な支援体制が急務と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: بعد ارتفاع حالات الاشتباه بـ"إيبولا".. "الصحة العالمية" تدعو لتنسيق الجهود الدولية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following the rise in suspected Ebola cases, the World Health Organization calls for coordination of international efforts.
article.articleSummary: 1028 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Bunia city), up from 906 the previous day, as of May 31, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no approved vaccine. Uganda has reported cases linked to the outbreak. The World Health Organization said the outbreak likely began about two months earlier. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged intensified coordination among humanitarian and health actors and alignment with the Congo government, highlighting the importance of listening to and supporting local communities to curb transmission. The Health Ministry says medical supplies are available, but international medical NGOs warn that staffing and distribution logistics remain insufficient. The WHO is evaluating vaccines for effectiveness against Bundibugyo and pursuing promising therapies to contain this high-risk regional outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い例の増加を受けて...世界保健機関が国際的努力の調整を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク（1028疑い例）が発生し、ウガンダにも波及。WHO事務局長が国際的対応を緊急に呼びかけており、ワクチン未承認株による高リスク地域流行として、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「ウガンダがアウトブレイクに関連した症例を報告」と述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国であり、かつ主要な発生地点である。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチン未承認で高リスク。WHO事務局長による緊急要請により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Negara Ini SOS, 246 Orang Tewas Sekejap Oleh Virus Mematikan Bak Covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This country issues an SOS; 246 people died instantly from a deadly virus similar to COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has rapidly intensified. As of May 31, 2026, more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths are reported, with 9 confirmed cases and 1 death in Uganda. WHO and MSF warn containment lags behind the fast spread amid conflict, border closures, and disrupted air routes. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess response and urged greater community involvement, cautioning that funerary customs can fuel transmission. In Bunia, the National Institute of Biomedical Research provides results within 24 hours, though samples must travel over 1,500 km to Kinshasa for confirmation. Separately, Brazil reports a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo linked to travel from DRC. The Bundibugyo strain underpins this outbreak, with about one‑third of infections fatal, and no widely effective vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: この国がSOS、246人が新型コロナのような致命的ウイルスで一瞬にして死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRC主要、ウガンダで確認、ブラジルで疑い症例）、1,000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な感染拡大、国際的拡大リスク、ならびに渡航制限の可能性からIHR基準4つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: Uganda（対象国リストに不含）でも9確定例と1死亡が報告されているが、対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。記事の主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州であり、ブラジルでの疑い症例も含まれることから、両国を検証対象地とした。WHO事務局長訪問、MSF警告、葬儀習慣による伝播リスクなど、高い社会政治的関心を反映。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO kêu gọi tăng cường hỗ trợ quốc tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO calls for strengthened international support.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Bunia in Ituri as the epicenter. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, the DRC has reported at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 9 cases, including 1 death. WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged intensified international support, stronger financial backing, and proactive community engagement to counter misinformation and distrust of health measures. He also urged countries that have imposed travel restrictions or border closures to reconsider, citing risks to response and transparency. The WHO cautions the true scale may be larger due to silent transmission, and limited testing capacity complicates confirmation. DRC Health Minister Roger Kamba targets containment within 4–6 months in an optimistic scenario, prioritizing prevention of spread beyond affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOが国際支援の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC内での大規模流行（1,077疑似症例、246死亡）とウガンダへの越境拡大が確認され、WHO事務局長による国際支援の強化呼びかけとして報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「neighboring Uganda has 9 cases」と二次的な事象として記載されており、主要な流行地はDRCのままのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク疾患であり、1,077疑似症例と246死亡の報告、WHO事務局長の公式声明、国際支援要請、渡航制限の存在により、全ての基準を満たす明確なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود" تحذر من الانتشار السريع لفيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders Warn of the Rapid Spread of the Ebola Virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Doctors Without Borders warning of rapid spread. On the ground, MSF notes an unprecedented surge two weeks after the outbreak was declared in Ituri province, contending that the true scale and danger remain unknown as many suspected cases are reported daily, with hundreds of samples yet to be tested. In the latest figures, the DRC has reported over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Containment and aid delivery are hindered by border and airport closures. The World Health Organization had declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern about two weeks earlier. Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening disease transmitted via physical contact and bodily fluids; MSF teams are urgently responding amid significant access challenges. As of May 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境なき医師団」がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルスの急速な拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、1,000件以上の疑い例と246人以上の死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダで確認例あり）、既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに未登録のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはIturi州での宣言から2週間で1,000件以上の疑い例に急増。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、既に国際的対応が開始されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını Demokratik Kongo sınırlarında hızla yayılıyor - Dünya Gazetesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly along the borders of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak along the Democratic Republic of the Congo borders has grown, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths, centered in Ituri Province. MSF’s Alan Gonzales says transmission speed has surpassed critical levels. The WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus coordinates response, stressing community involvement to halt transmission; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death, signaling cross-border spread. Funeral practices are linked to case increases.
