Logistics are strained by conflict and border closures; Bunia airport implements hygiene measures, and on-site testing at Bunia’s National Biomedical Research Institute delivers results within 24 hours, replacing 1,500-km sample shipments to Kinshasa. A related Sao Paulo case involves a 37-year-old man recently returned from Africa; Bundibugyo is the circulating strain, with no vaccine, and roughly one-third of cases fatal. Transmission occurs via body fluids and contaminated objects, with fruit bats as reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の国境沿いで急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡、異常性：伝播速度が臨界レベルを超過、国際的拡大：ウガンダへの越境感染、渡航制限リスク：ブラジルでの関連症例）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。高い社会的・政治的関心。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ州を中心）であることが明確。ウガンダでの越境感染の報告もあるが、記事の主題はDRC中心。ブラジルのサンパウロでの症例は渡航関連（帰還者）であり、現地での流行ではないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo型、ヒト-ヒト感染、葬儀慣習による感染拡大、紛争とロジスティックス困難による管理困難など複数の高リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στην "πρώτη γραμμή" ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ για την έξαρση του Έμπολα - Φόβοι για διεθνή διασπορά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: On the "front line," the WHO Director-General on the Ebola outbreak — Fears of international spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached a critical phase with the Bundibugyo strain, which has no licensed vaccines or therapies, driving rising caseloads across three provinces. Uganda has closed its border amid concerns of cross-border transmission. The episode is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since discovery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to the Ituri region, including Bunia, after meeting Prime Minister Judith Suminuwa Tuluka, urging residents to seek rapid care and follow safe burial practices. Brazil reported a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo involving a man who recently visited Congo; he is isolated in a specialized hospital. Early figures show 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths) under investigation, later 1,028 suspected cases with 225 confirmed. MSF warns the response is under-resourced and not keeping pace with the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ発生対策の「最前線」にいるWHO事務局長 - 国際的拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、ワクチン・治療法のない株による異常な状況、国際的拡大の明白なリスク、国境閉鎖による渡航制限）。また、WHO事務局長の現地視察、複数国での確認、MSFの警告による社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生が主題。ウガンダの国境閉鎖は記載されているが、ウガンダでの実際の症例確認は記事サマリーに明記されていないため、verified_locationsには含めず。Brazilの疑い例（DRC訪問者の隔離）は確認されており含める。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、MSFの資源不足警告、3州での拡大、ワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyo株という重篤な要因が複数存在。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns against travel bans as DR Congo battles deadly Ebola outbreak without vaccine
article.articleSummary: WHO warns against travel bans amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province’s eastern region, including Bunia and surrounding communities, in contexts of insecurity and fragile health systems. Although no vaccine exists, some infected individuals have recovered through early medical care and supportive treatment. WHO is accelerating clinical trials for vaccines and treatments and supporting the government-led response. It urges countries to reconsider travel restrictions that could impede emergency operations and reduce transparency. Community engagement is prioritized, including women’s groups, religious and business leaders, and youth to foster trust and local ownership. Burial practices remain a transmission risk, and WHO will sustain essential health services while strengthening hospitals, laboratories, and health workers in DRC beyond the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行とワクチン不在の中でコンゴ民主共和国が旅行禁止に警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規流行でIHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株による致命的アウトブレイク、ワクチン未開発、国際的な旅行制限リスク、脆弱な保健システム下での管理課題により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株による流行。Ituri州東部（Bunia含む）での発生。医療体制の脆弱性、埋葬慣行による感染リスク、不安定な治安環境が懸念される。ワクチン・治療法未開発が深刻。WHO主導の対応加速中。DRC対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Maamulka Caafimaadka Congo iyo WHO oo Beeniyey Digniintii MSF, Sheegayna in Xaaladda Ebola La Xakameeyey
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia region) with 134 laboratory-confirmed cases and 18 deaths reported as of 2026-05-31. Authorities, supported by WHO, say the situation is under control; early case increases reflect heightened vigilance rather than containment failure. Testing capacity has been deployed to major facilities and samples are processed rapidly. No alarming situation or bottlenecks; health supplies and trained staff are arriving at airports, and response timelines remain intact. The Ministry notes that regional health facilities can deliver routine care alongside Ebola response using pre-planned emergency measures. Robust community engagement with traditional leaders promotes care-seeking. The government clarifies that about 1,000 reported cases is unverified routine data and that most people are healthy. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to commend coordination.

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تدق ناقوس الخطر: إيبولا ينتشر بسرعة غير مسبوقة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders Sound the Alarm: Ebola Is Spreading at an Unprecedented Speed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading at unprecedented speed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Doctors Without Borders warning of a rapid rise in cases in the eastern Ituri province and potential cross-border spread into Uganda. Official counts show more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 related deaths in the DRC. Neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death, heightening concerns about regional transmission. Health authorities say hundreds of samples have not yet been tested, leaving the true scale of the outbreak uncertain. Border and airport closures are delaying the delivery of humanitarian aid and medical supplies, complicating containment efforts. The World Health Organization declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern about two weeks earlier. Ebola virus transmits primarily through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person, and via contaminated surfaces or objects.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団が警告を発出：エボラが前例のない速度で拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限あり）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。WHO既に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも9例の確認症例が報告されているが、発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCのみを記載。既にWHO PHEIC宣言済みで、1000症例超・246死亡、境界越えリスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: 谭德塞抵刚果伊波拉疫区 吁国际社会支援遏病毒 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros Arrives in the Congo Ebola Zone, Urges the International Community to Help Contain the Virus.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Ituri Province’s capital Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to address the Ebola outbreak described as the most severe in the eastern region. He urged the international community to boost funding and support to contain the deadly Ebola virus spread. While acknowledging existing assistance to the Congolese government, he stressed the need for community ownership to overcome mistrust and misinformation and called on other nations to increase financial aid. During the visit, Tedros said officials are engaging with local communities to review progress and provide assistance when challenges arise. The remarks underscore ongoing international efforts to quell a serious Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, with emphasis on community engagement and greater funding.)

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長がコンゴのエボラ疫区に到着、国際社会にウイルス封じ込め支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生はIHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的な関心が高く、国際支援が明示的に求められている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つCritical communicable diseaseであり、東部DRCにおける「最も深刻な」流行とされている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際的支援の明示的な呼びかけは、この事象の国際保健上の重要性を示す。スクリーニング基準全5項目が該当しており、フルRRA実施が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Șeful Organizației Mondiale a Sănătății a vizitat epicentrul epidemiei de Ebola din Congo pentru a încuraja implicarea comunităților în combaterea bolii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The head of the World Health Organization visited the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in Congo to encourage community involvement in the fight against the disease.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the epicenter of a severe, rare Ebola outbreak to boost community involvement. The virus is spreading faster than response capacity, despite better medical unit organization and new aid. He plans to visit a treatment center in Bunia and meet local authorities, healthcare workers, and affected families, stressing international support and crucial community engagement. The outbreak is present in three eastern provinces of the DRC and in neighboring Uganda, with the true scale likely larger than detected due to limited laboratory capacity. Africa CDC reports at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda confirms nine cases and one death. One patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests—the first recovery in the current outbreak. Ebola transmits via close contact and body fluids; displacement and insecurity complicate control, with Uganda and Rwanda closing borders and Uganda imposing a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC. The U.S. has barred entry for recent travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行中心地を訪問し、疾病対策への地域社会の参加を促進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健上最も深刻な病原体であり、複数国への国際的拡大、重篤性、貿易・渡航制限のリスクが顕著。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR附属書2の全基準を満たす。DRC東部Ituri州での流行は複数国への拡大（ウガンダで確認）、高い死亡率（1,077疑い例、246死亡）、ウガンダ・ルワンダの国境閉鎖、米国の入国制限など、深刻な国際的影響を示している。WHOトップの現地訪問が報道されており、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ketua WHO gesa negara pertimbang semula sekatan perjalanan akibat Ebola | Berita Harian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief urges countries to reconsider travel restrictions due to Ebola | Berita Harian
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries to reconsider travel bans after an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Canada and the U.S. have imposed travel restrictions and visa suspensions for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda have limited travel from Congo. Foreign nationals who traveled through Congo in the past 30 days are barred from entering Rwanda. Speaking from Bunia in Ituri Province, Tedros said unity and solidarity are the best tools, and travel bans may hinder transparent case reporting, especially Bundibugyo Ebola, with no approved vaccine or treatment. As of the WHO update on Friday, at least 134 lab-confirmed cases in Congo and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. Congo health authorities report ongoing suspected cases, pushing total above 1,000 since the outbreak was declared on May 15; Bundibugyo is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の影響を受けた渡航制限の再検討を各国に要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威に対して既に国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。対象国DRCで確認された現在進行中のアウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）のアウトブレイク。DRCのItuli州およびNorth Kivu州、South Kivu州で集中。確認症例134例（うち18例死亡）、疑い症例を含めると1,000例以上。複数国による渡航制限が既に実施されており、WHOが渡航制限の再検討を要請している段階。ワクチン・治療法がない状況。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUSA、Canada、Sudan、Rwandaなども含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国は渡航制限を実施している側であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCおよびウガンダである。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Duale: Laikipia Ebola facility will serve all patients, not just Americans
article.articleSummary: Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale announced that the planned Ebola quarantine and treatment facility at Laikipia Airbase, Kenya, will serve all patients and be manned by the Kenya Defence Forces, not reserved for U.S. citizens. It forms part of Kenya's broader public-health preparedness to detect, isolate and manage Ebola outbreaks and will be linked to a national network of 11 specialized centres nationwide. The U.S. government has pledged about Sh1.7 billion to support Kenya's readiness, echoing aid to Africa CDC and WHO. The proposal follows controversy over a separate 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility for exposed American citizens at Laikipia, which a High Court temporarily suspended amid concerns about transparency and public participation. The move comes amid regional concern over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with MSF urging coordinated regional action.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ大臣：ライキピア州エボラ施設は米国民だけでなくすべての患者に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療施設の準備段階の発表であり、現在の実際の患者発生ではなく、DRCでの地域的な懸念に対応した予防的取り組みです。情報不足の中でも施設整備と地域的な流行準備の文脈があるため、経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラ治療施設準備の発表であり、実際の患者発生イベントではなく、DRC での地域的懸念に対応した予防措置です。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めました。実際の流行の有無、患者数、死亡者数に関する具体的情報が不足しているため WATCH と判定しました。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief calls for global support to tackle Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a focal concern with the highly contagious haemorrhagic fever reported in three eastern provinces, and in neighbouring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, the area most affected, to urge intensified international assistance. He said national authorities receive support but stressed the need for stronger community ownership, combatting mistrust and misinformation, and increased financial backing from the international community. At a briefing in Ituri, he affirmed solidarity, saying, 'You're not alone in this. We're here, we're with you, and we will see this through together.' The response continues to rely on community engagement, coordination, and resources to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に対処するための国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は指定感染症で、DRCおよびウガンダでの多発は国際的脅威である。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際支援要請は高い政治的関心を示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラウイルス病は致死率の高い指定感染症であり、WHO事務局長による現地訪問は国際的な懸念の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Amenințarea Ebola. Nu există un vaccin sau un tratament specific pentru tulpina Bundibugyo, iar teoriile conspirației au reapărut. "Distragere a atenției, farsă, schemă financiară, pretext pentru o altă agendă nefastă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola threat. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, and conspiracy theories have resurfaced. "Distraction, a farce, a financial scheme, a pretext for another nefarious agenda."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province: Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu) and neighboring Uganda (Kampala) has been designated a public health emergency of international concern by WHO as of May 17, 2026. DR Congo reports 82 lab-confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. In Ituri, eight confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths have occurred across at least three health zones. Two lab-confirmed cases (one death) were detected in Kampala in travelers from DRC within 24 hours (May 15–16, 2026); a separate case returning from Ituri to Kinshasa tested negative by INRB. Symptoms align with Ebola virus disease; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola currently. WHO risk assessments: very high nationally, high regionally, low globally. Conspiracy theories and substantial health-system and regional insecurity challenges accompany the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの脅威。ブンディブギョ株には特定のワクチンや治療法がなく、陰謀論が再び浮上。「注意散漫、茶番、金銭的スキーム、別の悪い議題の口実」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）指定済みのエボラウイルス集団発生。国境を越えた複数国での症例確認、死亡例あり、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: 記事はルーマニアメディア発信だが、内容はDRC（イトゥーリ州）およびウガンダ（カンパラ）でのブンディブギョエボラ集団発生に関するもの。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC指定。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー本文では具体的な症例報告がないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole hara dijelovima centralne Afrike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic ravages parts of Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo variant is ravaging parts of Central Africa, with no vaccine or treatment for this rare strain that has triggered two epidemics in recent decades. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 482 suspected cases and about 116 deaths have been reported since April, with two cases and one death confirmed in Uganda and potential spread to neighboring South Sudan. Global attention is diminished as the United States dismantles USAID, downsizing health-emergency staff, halting communications, and canceling key scientific research. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) immediately, even before the Emergency Committee convened; officials warn the crisis could last months. Images show burial efforts in Mongbwalu, protective health workers in a Congolese hospital, and checkpoints monitoring temperatures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が中央アフリカの一部地域を荒廃させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した重大な感染症イベント。Bundibugyo型の稀なエボラウイルス株による多数の死亡者と複数国への拡大リスク、および国際的な支援体制の課題が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行をDRC主体で報告。ウガンダおよび南スーダンへの潜在的な拡大に言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの発生。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、ワクチン・治療法がない稀な株系であることが強調されている。米国のUSAID削減による国際的対応能力の低下も注視すべき要素。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak: testing challenges & spread
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 260 confirmed cases, with Uganda reporting 9 cases (1 fatal). The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, spans more than a dozen health zones across three provinces, with Bunia in Ituri province as the epicenter. As of May 30, authorities said initial acceptances for experimental antibody treatment in a phase-2 trial were agreed with US partners; initial doses expected soon. Therapy candidates in evaluation include MBP134, Maftivimab, and remdesivir, while WHO notes no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. Testing has exceeded 900 tests, with capacity 200-300 samples per day, but hundreds remain untested and 84 newly confirmed cases last week included five healthcare workers in Bunia. MSF warns the outbreak could be outpacing response. Tedros urged lifting travel barriers; MSF calls for more field support; early care saves lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：検査上の課題と感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際的拡大、予想外の流行拡大）。WPRO基準全て該当。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行は即座のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのBundibugyo株エボラの260例確認を主題とする。ウガンダでの9例（死亡1例）の記載がありますが、サマリーの焦点はDRCの流行にあり、ウガンダは国境を越えた波及として記述されている。検査能力の不足、医療従事者への感染、治療法不足、国際的支援（米国の実験的抗体治療の導入、WHO、MSF対応）が明記されており、複数の重症度・管理性の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: "ศาลเคนยา" สั่งระงับแผนตั้งศูนย์กัก "โรคอีโบลา" ของสหรัฐฯ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court orders suspension of the U.S. plan to establish Ebola quarantine center.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court on May 30, 2026 suspended the plan to establish a 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at a Kenyan air base for Americans who had close contact with the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, pending a June 2 hearing. The project aimed to prevent Ebola from entering the United States and included more than US$13 million in pledged support to Kenya for outbreak preparedness. Some Kenyans welcomed the ruling to reduce domestic risk, while others viewed it as a lost regional health leadership opportunity. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the Ebola outbreak remains a major concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Beni, DR Congo, urged safe burials to curb transmission, as the DR Congo health minister reports over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. MSF notes the rapid spread and likely underreporting of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国のエボラウイルス隔離センター設置計画の中止を命じる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重篤性の高い公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRC での活発なアウトブレイク（1,000 件以上の疑い例、246 件以上の死亡）が報告されている。国際的な感染拡大リスク（米国への持ち込みリスク対策）および渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR 基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの裁判所判決だが、実際のエボラウイルスアウトブレイクは DRC で発生している。米国は対象国リストに含まれず、ケニアも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locations は DRC のみ。DRC でのアウトブレイク状況（1,000 件以上の疑い例、246 件以上の死亡、MSF による懸念表明、WHO 事務局長による現地視察）により、重篤性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の複数基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola en un hombre de 37 años procedente de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Investigates a Possible Case of Ebola in a 37-Year-Old Man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Brazil investigates a possible Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He was treated in an ICU and transferred to Hospital Emilio Ribas in São Paulo, placed in quarantine while laboratory results are pending. The response follows clinical and epidemiological criteria, including isolation, rapid notification, lab testing, and contact tracing. Health authorities deem the outbreak risk to Brazil low, noting no autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the Congo region, and Ebola transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions or bodily fluids from symptomatic cases. In the DRC, World Health Organization reports 49 infections and eight deaths in the past week, with 160 suspected cases and 47 probable deaths under analysis. The WHO also confirms a case outside Africa: a U.S. citizen treated in Germany after exposure in Congo. The Bundibugyo strain's limited diagnostic capacity hinders early detection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、民主共和国コンゴから来た37歳男性の可能性のあるエボラ症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の輸入症例（DRCから）であり、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。DRCでの活発な流行（49感染、8死亡/週）と複数国への波及（米国、ドイツ）により、シグナル認定に値する。
triage.notes: 記事ではブラジルにおけるDRC由来の輸入症例の調査が主題。DRCでのBundibugyo株による活発な流行（160疑い例、47確定死亡例）が背景にあり、米国市民がドイツで確認された症例も言及されている。ブラジルでの自動伝播リスクは低いと評価されているが、国際検疫体制の動作確認として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Stray dog on biting spree injures nearly 60 in MP's Shivpuri; caught
article.articleSummary: Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, faced a stray-dog rabies risk incident when a black stray dog injured nearly 60 people across multiple localities on Saturday, including a two-year-old girl with severe facial wounds; the most severe attack occurred in Laxmibai Colony. Victims were rushed to district hospital and local health centres and administered anti-rabies vaccines and medical care. An emergency capture operation tracked and detained the dog, prompting intensified surveillance in affected areas. The incident highlights rabies risk from stray dogs; officials urged vigilance and reporting of aggressive animals. The Supreme Court recently allowed euthanasia for rabid, incurably ill, or demonstrably dangerous stray dogs to curb threats to human life, while relocation/sterilisation policies were upheld as not sufficient alone. Locals demand a permanent solution to the stray-dog menace as public-safety measures are reinforced.

triage.headline_ja: MP州シヴプラに野良犬が咬傷60人近くに被害；捕獲
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ウイルス曝露を伴う集団咬傷事件（60人近く）であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準において異常性・重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性が認められ、対象国インドで実際に発生。社会的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: シヴプリ市（マディヤプラデシュ州）での単一の野良犬による集団咬傷事件。狂犬病ウイルス曝露の直接的リスク。被害者のワクチン接種状況は記事では不明だが、医療対応が実施されている。インドの最高裁が危険な野良犬の安楽死を承認した直後の発生であり、政策的な背景がある。動物由来感染症の地域管理問題として重要。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo sangat mengkhawatirkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is very worrying.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, is highly concerning as of May 31, 2026. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) Deputy Director of Operations Alan Gonzalez said on May 30 that the speed of spread is unprecedented, with suspected cases emerging daily and frontline teams struggling to keep up. Slow laboratory testing is delaying timely confirmation, prompting calls to urgently expand testing capacity to at least partially contain transmission. As of May 31, more than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the DRC, including 223 deaths suspected to be due to Ebola. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Ituri. The WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). A previous DRC Ebola outbreak ended in October 2025.

triage.headline_ja: MSF: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病感染症流行は極めて懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大リスク、PHEIC宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。既にWHOによるPHEIC宣言済みの重大事態。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言済み。900例以上の疑い患者、223例の死亡報告。前例のないスピードで拡大中。ウガンダの地域はサマリーでは流行の具体的な影響が明記されておらず、DRC内での集中的な発生地として取扱い。ウガンダはPHEIC指定の一部だが、サマリー上での主要発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Penularan Flu Singapura Tinggi, 1 Anak Bisa Tulari 12 Orang : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High transmission of Singapore flu, one child can infect 12 people: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia—Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), often called Singapore flu, is highly contagious among children. Pediatric specialist dr. Handayani, M.Ked (Ped), Sp.A. of Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri told Health Talk during World Immunization Week 2026 that a single infected child can pass HFMD to as many as 12 other children, especially in schools or playgrounds. The disease’s spread can outpace COVID-19 during the pandemic, which averaged about seven secondary cases per index case. Transmission occurs rapidly through the fecal-oral route: virus from an infected child’s stool can cling to hands, toys, or objects and be transferred to others.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール風邪の感染力が高い、1人の子どもが12人に感染させることができる：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）の高い感染性と小児への広がりが報告され、COVID-19を上回る感染速度が指摘されている。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、インドネシアでの公衆衛生上の関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）は既知の疾患だが、記事では「シンガポール風邪」と呼称。インドネシア（ジャカルタ）での高い感染性が強調されており、特に小児集団施設での流行リスクが指摘されている。COVID-19やインフルエンザとの複合流行の可能性も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Yogyakarta Tetap Waspadai Hantavirus Meski Belum Ada Temuan di Sepanjang 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yogyakarta City Government Remains Vigilant Against Hantavirus Despite No Findings Throughout 2026.
article.articleSummary: Yogyakarta City Government reports no Hantavirus cases from January through May 2026, though 2025 recorded one Yogyakarta case that recovered. Despite vigilance, authorities caution the public to remain alert for rodents-borne Orthohantavirus transmission. Clarification from Dinkes indicates previous alerts referred to Kulon Progo, not Yogyakarta City; subsequent testing was negative for Hantavirus. Hantavirus is a zoonosis transmitted via infected rats through bites, contact with rat saliva, urine, feces, or inhalation of aerosolized particles, e.g., cleaning dusty storage spaces without gloves or masks. Clinical types include Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS); Indonesia most commonly reports HFRS with 1–2 week incubation. Early symptoms: high fever, conjunctival hemorrhage and facial flushing, headache, reduced appetite, eye pain; later hypotension, altered consciousness, edema, and oliguria. City health department is enhancing capacities for management of Leptospirosis and Hantavirus.

triage.headline_ja: ヨグヤカルタ市政府、2026年を通じて検出例がないにもかかわらずハンタウイルスに警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのハンタウイルス関連疾患の警戒継続を報じているが、2026年の検出例がなく、2025年の1症例も回復済みで、現時点での公衆衛生への深刻な影響が限定的。スクリーニング基準で「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」の要素がありWATCH判定だが、具体的な流行の兆候や深刻度、国際拡大のリスク評価には情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事は主にハンタウイルスの予防啓発と地域保健局の監視体制強化について述べており、急性の流行を示唆していない。2026年の検出例がなく、前年度の1症例も回復済みであるため、現時点での深刻性は限定的。ただしげっ歯類を媒介とする人獣共通感染症であり、継続的な監視と啓発の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Trump coupe l'aide, le virus avance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Trump cuts aid, the virus advances.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) with spillover into Uganda escalates. On May 15, the DRC health ministry confirmed Ebola cases in Ituri; Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or miracle treatment, leaving rapid isolation and rigorous contact tracing as the only defenses. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 19, the first such decision in its history. By May 20, there were 51 confirmed cases in DRC, about 600 suspected cases, and 139 probable deaths, with Bunia, Butembo, and Goma affected and cross-border transmission to Kampala reported. Field response is hampered by funding cuts: US aid plummeted from $881m to $115m; Oxfam lost $13m in 2025; rapid-response teams reduced from 76 to 15. Washington later released $23m for DRC/Uganda and mobile clinics. Ituri’s mining-driven movement complicates tracing; Africa CDC warns $319m is urgently needed; regional ministers seek solidarity May 22–23 in Kampala.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱：トランプが支援を削減、ウイルスが拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダでの確定症例・死亡報告があり、WHO が PHEIC 宣言した。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）への越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。記事は DRC での発生が主題。2026年5月時点での PHEIC 宣言、51確定症例、139死亡予想、資金不足による対応障害が重要な要素。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลา-น่ากลัวมากขึ้นทุกที ถึงแม้องค์การอนามัยโลก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola—getting scarier by the day, even the World Health Organization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is escalating, involving Bundibugyo virus. The World Health Organization has not declared a public health emergency, but about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths have been reported, with transmission spreading to neighboring countries. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 2014-2016. The virus spreads via direct contact with infected body fluids—blood, saliva, feces, urine, semen—through mucous membranes or open skin, placing healthcare workers and family caregivers at high risk. Early symptoms resemble malaria or fever, followed by rapid deterioration with bleeding and organ failure as the virus multiplies in lymph nodes and then the bloodstream. Notably, the virus remains infectious in deceased bodies for up to about a week, making funeral rites a key transmission route in humid climates. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ—日に日に怖くなっている、世界保健機関さえも
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（750疑い例、177死亡）で、隣国への感染拡大報告あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年配信日付のため将来日付。DRCでの第17次エボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo型で、有効なワクチンと治療法が存在しない。死体の感染性が1週間継続するため、葬儀が重要な感染経路。医療従事者と家族ケアラーのリスクが高い。隣国への感染拡大が既に報告されている。WHOがまだ国際的懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言していないことも、対応遅延の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 백신·치료제 없는 에볼라, 음모론·지원 삭감 속 "역대 가장 빠른 속도" 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Without Vaccines or Treatments Spreads at the Fastest Rate in History Amid Conspiracy Theories and Aid Cuts
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with no approved vaccine or treatment, fastest growth on record amid aid cuts and local distrust. Since the May 15 outbreak declaration, suspected cases reached about 1,077 with 246 deaths, in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; MSF cautions the true scale is higher. Transmission appears to have begun with care for a laboring patient at Mongwalu General Hospital, with healthcare workers among the fatalities (at least seven). The Bundibugyo variant has a 30–50% case fatality rate; incubation up to 21 days; early symptoms mimic malaria and typhoid; laboratory confirmation can take four days or longer. Resource shortages—PPE, test kits, and clean water—hamper care; hundreds of samples remain untested. Attacks on facilities and patient escapes accompany social unrest. U.S. funding cuts have weakened surveillance; a $23 million pledge is viewed as insufficient. By May 23, 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases were reported across three eastern provinces. Vaccine development is projected to take 6–9 months.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン・治療薬のないエボラ、陰謀論・支援削減の中で「過去最速」の拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模発生で、死亡者246名、確定症例1,077名超、医療施設への攻撃、社会的混乱、国際的支援削減という深刻な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）でのエボラ発生を主題としている。Bundibugyo株は致命率30-50%で治療薬・承認済みワクチンがない。5月15日の発生宣言以降、確定症例1,077名、死亡246名。医療施設への攻撃、患者逃走、社会的不信が制御を困難にしており、MSFによれば実際の規模はさらに大きいと懸念されている。米国の資金削減も状況を悪化させている。

article.articleHeadline: ابولا در ایران؛ از شایعه تا زنگ خطر!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Iran: From rumor to the alarm bell!
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola remains a health concern after African outbreaks, with WHO warning the outbreak could be larger than known, though not yet a pandemic. No cases have been reported in Iran; authorities urge enhanced border and airport surveillance. Travelers from Africa should seek care for fever, nausea or vomiting and report travel history. The current strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of four Ebola virus species; there is no vaccine or antiviral for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via blood, body fluids, or contaminated tissues; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; case fatality among symptomatic patients ranges 50–90%. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Sudan and near the Congo; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone infected about 28,600 people and killed about 11,300. Controlling measures rely on surveillance and health checks at entry points.

triage.headline_ja: イラン：エボラ - 噂から警報まで！
triage.triage_reason: エボラの異常性・重症度は明らかだが、イラン国内での確認症例はなく、記事は啓発・警告段階。アフリカでの発生は確認されているため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカでの発生が確認され、DRCおよび西アフリカ（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ）での過去の大規模流行が言及されている。イラン国内では報告症例なし。Bluedot APIがイランを発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーから実際の発生国はアフリカのDRCのみ対象国リストに該当。他のアフリカ国（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ）はサマリーに歴史的背景として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Академик Гинцбург оценил угрозу лихорадки Эбола для России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Academician Gintsburg assessed the threat of Ebola fever to Russia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever does not pose a pandemic threat to Russia, according to Academician Alexander Gintsburg, head of the Gamaleya National Research Center for Epidemiology and Microbiology. He says Russia does not require a specialized Ebola drug because the risk to its citizens is low and the outbreak would not be a priority domestically. Treatment remains symptomatic, with the aim of preventing death and allowing the patient’s immune system to generate antibodies over 10–12 days. As of May 31, 2026, an Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 by the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda is driven by Ebola virus Bundibugyo, first identified in Uganda in 2007. The epicenter is Ituri Province in eastern DRC, with transmission in North and South Kivu as well. In the DRC there are over 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 suspected deaths; in Uganda, 9 suspected cases and 1 death have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: ギンツブルク学者、ロシアに対するエボラ熱の脅威を評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱のアウトブレイクが公式に宣言され、DRCで1,000件以上の疑い患者、240人の疑い死亡が報告されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常/予想外」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、流行性、管理可能性に該当し、フルRRA実施の必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月31日のエボラアウトブレイクについて報じているが、これは日付が未来のデータ（現在2024年）であり、記事の信頼性に疑問がある可能性あり。ただし提供データとして処理。DRCでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダは二次的言及のため対象国リスト（1562822）外として除外。ロシアは記事の関心対象地域だが実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الحالات المشتبه في إصابتها بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1028
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in suspected Ebola cases in Congo to 1,028
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said suspected Ebola cases rose to 1,028 by Friday, up from 906 the day before, with the Bundibugyo strain continuing to cause transmission and cases reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization noted in early May that the eastern Congo outbreak likely began about two months earlier and involves the rare Bundibugyo variant for which there is no vaccine. The protracted, undetected spread in a densely populated region has hindered contact tracing and isolation of exposed individuals. The situation raises cross-border concerns with Uganda and underscores the need for vigilant surveillance and public health measures, given the absence of a licensed preventive vaccine for this Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける疑い例エボラ症例数が1,028例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株による大規模発生、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。ワクチン非適応型Bundibugyo株による限定的治療オプション下での急速な症例増加。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はコンゴ東部での発生を主題としており、ウガンダは越境リスクとして言及されているにすぎない。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの稀な株であり、利用可能なワクチンがないことが重大な懸念。2ヶ月間の未検出拡大、人口密集地での急速な症例増加は制御困難性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Kanungu authorities ban public gatherings over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) triggers tight safeguards in Kanungu District, Uganda, a border district with the DRC. Authorities indefinitely suspend weekly markets, bars, discos, and unauthorised gatherings to prevent cross-border transmission. Surveillance at high-risk entry points is intensified; only essential travellers may cross under strict health screening - cargo vehicles and drivers, cargo boda bodas, registered refugees, and security personnel. Border measures require thermo guns and handwashing stations at entrances; burials must follow safe protocols under health-security supervision. Public transport will be monitored, with radio and community sensitisation campaigns on prevention and symptom reporting (fever, bleeding, vomiting). On 2026-05-30/31, Uganda reported two new EVD cases in Kampala, raising the national total to nine confirmed cases, including one death.

triage.headline_ja: カヌング当局、エボラを巡り公開集会を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認例と死亡例、DRCとの国境地域での急速な感染拡大、国家規模の対応措置が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出された地域にはウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCとの国境地域での発生であり、DRCは対象国に含まれるため DRC のみを記載。エボラ出血熱の確認例（計9例、死亡1例）、公開集会禁止などの社会的影響、高いヒト-ヒト感染性、DRC国境での越境リスク等から、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疫情确诊病例增至260起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 260 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 260 confirmed cases, spreading across three provinces and more than 10 health zones. Uganda has reported nine cases, including one death. MSF warns the spread may outpace response as hundreds of samples await testing. The DRC has completed over 900 Ebola tests and expanded labs to process 200–300 samples daily; suspected cases declined from a week’s peak of 1,077 to 349 by May 28, but new confirmed cases continue, including healthcare workers. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or therapy, though early treatment can improve survival. The United States has agreed to support a mid-stage trial of an experimental antibody therapy. WHO Director-General Tedros urged intensified international aid to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情確診病例が260件に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、重症度が高く国際的な拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの9症例（死亡1件）が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国の支援も述べられているが、米国は対象国でないため除外。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）、ワクチン/療法なし、医療従事者への感染、複数州での拡大など多数の重篤要因があり、WHOも国際支援強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: ผอ.อนามัยโลกลงพื้นที่ศูนย์กลางอีโบลาระบาด เรียกร้องให้ฝังศพอย่างปลอดภัย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the Ebola outbreak epicenter, calls for safe burials.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia in Ituri Province, DR Congo, the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak—the 17th in the country and the third-largest since the virus’s discovery 50 years ago. He urged rapid patient treatment and safe burial practices as health authorities work to contain transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy, making early supportive care (isolation, fluid replacement, pain management) critical. The first confirmed case was reported in early May in Ituri. Separately, Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo linked to a traveler who recently visited DR Congo. Tedros also met with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka before visiting Bunia to reinforce public health response and community safeguards.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の流行中心地を訪問、安全な埋葬を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC→ブラジルへの渡航関連症例）が存在し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性が高い。また、DRCでの大規模流行とブラジルでの疑い例により、スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCのIturi Province（Bunia）でのエボラ出血熱大規模流行（第17次流行）と、ブラジル・サンパウロでの渡航関連疑い症例が明記されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus型で治療法・ワクチンが限定的であり、WHOのトップが現地訪問している点から国際的な関心も高い。医療支援の管理可能性についても懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: নতুন করে দুর্ভাবনায় ফেলছে ইবোলা ভাইরাস, আমাদের কী করণীয়
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is causing renewed concern; what should we do?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has renewed global alarm as outbreaks involve Congo and Uganda, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization has designated this event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), underscoring its international public health significance. Ebola remains highly lethal and highly contagious, with laboratory work performed under Biosafety Level 4 containment. The author, a microbiologist, contends this resurgence is a substantial warning for densely populated countries such as Bangladesh. The piece emphasizes the gravity of the situation and the need for heightened vigilance, preparedness, and rapid response to prevent further spread and the potential export or import of cases, even though it does not list case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 新たに不安をもたらしているエボラウイルス、私たちは何をすべきか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC指定済み。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認症例あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているエボラ発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外。バングラデシュの言及は潜在的リスク警告であり、実際の発生地ではない。WHOがPHEIC指定済みであり、Bundibugyo株という稀な変異株の関与が報告されている。高度な感染力と致死率、およびBSL4での取扱いが必要とされることは重症度を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO minta tinjau ulang pembatasan perjalanan akibat Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for a review of travel restrictions due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged a review of travel bans amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, warning restrictions may hinder transparent case reporting. Canada and the United States have imposed travel bans and visa suspensions for residents of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda also restrict travel from Congo, with foreign nationals who traveled through Congo in the last 30 days barred entry to Rwanda. In Bunia, Ituri Province, Ghebreyesus called for solidarity and community-led responses to Bundibugyo Ebola, for which there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. As of May 31, 2026, the WHO reports 134 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths in DRC and Uganda, with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 since the outbreak began on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ熱による渡航制限の見直しを要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者134例、死亡18例、疑い患者1,000例超、複数国への拡大、複数国による渡航制限実施という点で、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイク。2026年5月15日から5月31日時点で、DRCおよびウガンダで134確認患者、18死亡、疑い患者1,000例超。カナダ・米国・ルワンダ・ウガンダが渡航制限を実施。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが確認発生地であるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ・南スーダンは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Συστάσεις ΠΟΥ για θεραπείες και υποψήφια εμβόλια για Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommendations for Ebola treatments and candidate vaccines.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-31, the World Health Organization published its recommendations regarding therapies and candidate vaccines that could address the Ebola epidemic in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The guidance covers treatment options and vaccine candidates under consideration to counter the outbreak in eastern DRC. No specific therapies or vaccine names are listed, and the article provides no epidemiological data such as case counts or fatalities. Details on laboratory confirmation, transmission patterns, or infection sources are not included. The report emphasizes that these recommendations relate to potential medical countermeasures for Ebola in the region, outlining the scope of available and investigational options without identifying products or results.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の治療法と候補ワクチンに関するWHO勧告
triage.triage_reason: 東部DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク発生が示唆されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当の可能性が高いが、症例数や死亡数などの流行規模に関する具体的な疫学データが記事に含まれていない。WHOが治療・ワクチン候補の公式勧告を発出している点は重要だが、情報不足のため WATCH で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの公式勧告を報じており、DRC東部でのエボラアウトブレイクの存在を確認させている。しかし具体的な症例数、死亡数、確定診断数などの疫学的詳細が完全に欠落しており、流行規模の判断ができない。続報で疫学データが追加されることが予想され、PICKUP判定への昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Dieser Ausbruch ist besonders gefährlich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: This outbreak is particularly dangerous.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports its 17th Ebola outbreak since the virus was identified in the 1970s, affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda. By May 31, 2026, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected infections and over 240 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments, and early symptoms can resemble other illnesses, with initial tests often negative. The epicenter lies in a mining region far from Kinshasa, with high population mobility and active armed conflict in adjacent provinces, hampering contact tracing and aid delivery. Some communities doubt the outbreak, and traditional funerals hinder containment. The African Union’s Africa CDC warns of potential spread to about ten African countries and calls for vaccine development. Control currently depends on on-site responders amid faltering international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：この流行は特に危険である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo変異株による大規模流行で、ワクチンや承認治療法がなく、1,000件以上の感染疑い患者と240人以上の死亡、隣国ウガンダへの拡大、および約10のアフリカ諸国への拡大リスクが報告されており、国際的な懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株は既知ワクチンがなく治療法も限定的。武装紛争地域での流行により対応が困難。ウガンダへの拡大報告あり。アフリカCDCが約10カ国への拡大リスクを警告。国際支援体制の減少が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgını kritik seviyeyi aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed the critical level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged into a regional health crisis, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. Doctors Without Borders Deputy Director Alan Gonzales says the outbreak speed has crossed a critical threshold. In the last two weeks, authorities identified over 1,000 suspected cases and confirmed 246 fatalities, while global health authorities warn that transmission is outpacing current medical capacity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is coordinating efforts in Ituri province, the hardest-hit region. Officials stress that local community involvement is essential to breaking transmission chains. Cross-border risk is evident as Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. Experts warn that traditional funeral practices fuel transmission. The response is hampered by logistical barriers affecting aid operations and international agencies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症の流行が危機的水準を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則上の最高リスク疾患であり、1000件以上の疑い例と246名の死亡、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大、公衆衛生上の重大な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州におけるエボラ流行の急速な悪化と地域的健康危機への進展を記述。ウガンダでの9例の確認例と1死亡は国境を越えた伝播の証拠であるが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、ウガンダは二次的言及であるため verified_locations から除外。対象国リストに該当しない国の情報のため。ロジスティック上の障害と国際的対応調整の必要性が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola without vaccines or treatments spreads at the "fastest pace on record" amid conspiracy theories and aid cutbacks
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading with no vaccines or treatments. Since the government declared the outbreak on May 15, there are more than 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths in about two weeks, making it the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola on record. Transmission appears to have begun with medical staff involved in surgery on a woman who miscarried in April, six weeks before declaration. Incubation up to 21 days; early symptoms mimic malaria and typhoid; laboratory results can take more than four days. There are no approved vaccines; development for Bundibugyo is expected to take 6–9 months. The strain differs from Zaire; case fatality rate 30–50%. Health systems face shortages of protective gear, test kits, and drinking water; seven medical workers have died; hundreds of samples are untested. In Mongwalu, Ituri Province, hospital isolation wards were burned, 18 suspected patients escaped, and hospital staff were attacked. U.S. funding cuts and WHO/USAID withdrawal have weakened surveillance; relief groups urge expanded testing and community trust to avert the worst Ebola crisis yet.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンや治療法がないエボラが「記録的な最速ペース」で拡大、陰謀論と援助削減の中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目中5項目すべて該当。国際的関心が極めて高い重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の3番目に大きい流行で、記録的な速度での拡大。宣言から2週間で1,077例の疑似症例、246人の死亡を報告。ワクチン未承認、治療法なし。医療体制の深刻な崩壊（隔離病棟の焼却、患者の逃亡、医療従事者への暴力）。米国資金削減とWHO/USAID撤退による監視低下。国際的な支援枠組みと管理の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला आउटब्रेक से कांगो में मचा कोहराम, 30 से 50 प्रतिशत मरीजों की हो रही है मौत -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak wreaks havoc in Congo; 30 to 50 percent of patients are dying.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain triggers a global health alert. As of May 31, 2026, the DRC reports 906+ suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths, with 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain is highly lethal, with mortality estimates of 30–50%, and no vaccine is currently available. The outbreak has spilled into neighboring Uganda with new cases. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency. Early care and treatment could reduce deaths. The first patient has been discharged after full recovery; backlog samples are being tested, and testing capacity is expected to expand. No confirmed community transmission has been reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ発生が大混乱を引き起こす、患者の30～50％が死亡している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の多国間流行。死亡率30-50%の高病原性株による重篤な国際的脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス疾患の多地域流行。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境例も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。確認症例125例、疑い死亡223例。利用可能なワクチンがない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola causa morte de voluntários brasileiros na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola causes the death of Brazilian volunteers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three Brazilian Red Cross volunteers died after contracting Ebola while assisting on the front lines of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed May 23, 2026. The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak risk to very high due to rapid transmission. Official data report 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 cases under investigation and 177 deaths awaiting laboratory confirmation. The outbreak’s regional risk prompted Africa CDC to place ten neighboring countries under strict surveillance: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Congo, and Burundi. International partners continue supporting medical and logistical responses to mitigate a potential humanitarian crisis, despite significant field risks. The WHO portal remains the primary source for ongoing global monitoring updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国でブラジル人ボランティアの死をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。死亡事例、急速な伝播、地域的リスク上昇、近隣10カ国への監視拡大により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主な発生地はDRC（82確認患者、7死亡）であることが明記されている。Bluedot APIが付与した多数の地域のうち、検証対象リスト内で実際にイベント対象となっているのはDRCとZambiaのみ（Zambia含む10カ国は監視対象であり発生地ではない）。国際的関心が極めて高く、WHOおよびAfrica CDCが積極的対応を継続中。ブラジル人ボランティアの死亡という国際的側面も注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Вопреки надеждам на сдерживание, вспышка Эболы в Конго набирает обороты - Врачи без границ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite hopes for containment, the Ebola outbreak in Congo is gaining momentum - Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province shows 1,100 suspected cases and about 250 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no proven vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Ituri and urged communities to participate in control efforts as traditional funeral rites and contact with the deceased drive transmission. The outbreak has crossed borders: Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death; Brazil is monitoring a 37-year-old man who recently returned from Congo and is in isolation. The true scale may exceed confirmed counts. Transmission is linked to bushmeat exposure and funerary practices; containment hinges on surveillance, safe burials, and effective risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対策強化にもかかわらず、感染拡大が加速 - 国境を越えて広がる懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。1,100疑似症例・250死亡の重大な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株でワクチンなし、ウガンダおよびブラジルへの国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク顕著。複数対象国に確認されたシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルの症例は監視段階で確定症例ではなく、DRCが主要発生地。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発の稀株で、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による高い国際的関心も確認。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라확산에 국제사회 우려 증폭...국경없는의사회 "전례없는 수준"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International concern over the spread of Ebola escalates... Doctors Without Borders says 'an unprecedented level'
article.articleSummary: Death toll and cases: Ituri Province, DR Congo: suspected Ebola cases exceed 1,000; deaths at least 246. Adjacent Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Two weeks since official declaration, laboratory confirmation is progressing slowly with hundreds of samples not yet tested. Border closures and flight restrictions hinder containment and aid delivery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess response and urged intensified community engagement, noting that certain funeral practices involving the deceased could amplify spread. Transmission occurs from wildlife (fruit bats) to humans and via contact with blood, vomit, diarrhea, saliva, urine, semen, or contaminated items. In Brazil, a 37-year-old man who recently returned from DRC in São Paulo is under investigation for suspected Ebola. Former CDC director Tom Frieden warns that global public health capacity is weakened, signaling risk for future pandemics if unaddressed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡散に国際社会の懸念増幅...国境なき医師団「前例のない水準」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。複数国での確認患者・死亡、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ブラジル疑い例）、渡航制限実施、国際機関（WHO）の高レベル対応が認められる。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ州）での疑い例1,000件超、死亡246件以上。ウガンダでも確定例9件、死亡1件。ブラジル（サンパウロ）で帰国者の疑い例1件が調査中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な系統）による確認。WHOトップレベルによる現地対応と国際的懸念の急速な高まりが記事の主眼。渡航制限・国境閉鎖が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Попри сподівання на стримування, спалах Еболи в Конго набирає обертів - Лікарі без кордонів
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite hopes for containment, an Ebola outbreak in Congo is gaining momentum - Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as of May 31, 2026, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Since mid-May, health authorities have logged at least 1,100 suspected cases and about 250 suspected deaths. The World Health Organization’s director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri and warned that traditional burial practices, involving contact with the deceased, remain a major transmission driver, alongside possible spillover from bushmeat. Cases have been reported beyond Congo’s borders: nine confirmed cases and one death in neighboring Uganda, and a 37-year-old Congo-returnee in Brazil under isolation, undergoing laboratory investigation. The outbreak is notable for its rapid early spread and for the lack of a proven vaccine against Bundibugyo, with mortality estimated around one-third of infections. MSF raises alarm; authorities urge communities to participate in control measures to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 抑制への期待にもかかわらず、コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が加速している - 国境なき医師団
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。エボラ出血熱の国際的な広がり（DRC、ウガンダ、ブラジル）、高い致死率（約33%）、1,100例以上の疑い例と250例以上の死亡例、ワクチンなしでの対策困難など、フルRRAを要する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認例（9確認例、1死亡）が述べられているが、ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれていても、現在の対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations に含めていない。DRCはイトゥリ州での主要な発生地、ブラジルは帰還者による継続的な感染リスクを示す。ワクチン不在（Bundibugyo株に対する）、埋葬慣行による継続的な伝播リスク、動物由来感染の可能性など、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo: Cases exceed 1,000, raising global alarm
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 suspected infections and claimed at least 246 lives, with Uganda reporting nine cases and one death across the border. In Ituri, the epidemic has escalated to an 'extremely alarming' level two weeks after the outbreak was announced, with Dr. Alan Gonzalez of Doctors Without Borders noting the unprecedented rapid spread for Ebola. Medical teams are strained, daily new suspected infections continue, and hundreds of laboratory samples await testing for confirmation. Full scale of transmission remains unclear due to testing backlogs and delays in humanitarian operations. Border closures and airport restrictions, alongside ongoing armed conflict in the DRC, severely hinder containment efforts. The World Health Organization has warned that conflict complicates the response and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症流行：感染者が1,000人を超え、世界的警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。1,000件超の感染疑い例、246人以上の死亡、国境を越えたウガンダへの波及、医療体制の逼迫、武装紛争による対応阻害など、極めて高いリスク。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは9例1死亡の報告に留まり、主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。DRCが対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）のため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはBluedot APIが付与したが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。極めて高いリスク評価であり、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Более 1000 случаев за две недели: вирус Эбола бьет рекорды по распространению
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 cases in two weeks: the Ebola virus is breaking records for transmission.
article.articleSummary: By 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is surging at an unprecedented rate: over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths in two weeks. Medical response lags behind transmission, with daily new suspected cases and hundreds of samples still untested, per BBC and MSF. Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death; a 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, is under observation after returning from DRC. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine, and roughly one third of those infected die. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects. The World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency on 17 May due to the risk of cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 1000件以上が2週間で報告：エボラウイルスが感染拡大で記録を更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーに「9件確認例と1件死亡」と記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に加えない。DRC での2週間で1000件以上、246人以上の死亡という記録的な急速拡大。ワクチンなしの Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株による流行。5月31日WHO国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（5月17日）済み。ブラジルへの輸入例あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'deeply alarming', MSF warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province (Bunia) with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven vaccine. MSF calls the situation deeply alarming as cases rise while hundreds of samples remain untested; containment hampered by border/airport closures and ongoing conflict. WHO chief Tedros visited Bunia to oversee response, urging community involvement and caution around funerals to avoid transmission from the deceased. Lab capacity at Bunia's National Institute for Biomedical Research now returns results within 24 hours, cutting the previous 1,500 km to Kinshasa. An exported case is reported in São Paulo state, Brazil, where a 37-year-old man recently returned from the DRC is in isolation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が「極めて深刻」とMSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域かつ国際的な拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・ブラジルへの輸出例）、死亡例多数、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準4つ以上該当。国際的なシグナルとして即座にフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにウガンダの確認例記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに該当なし。DRCとブラジルのみ verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo strain は予防ワクチン未開発であり、管理難度が高い。境界閉鎖と継続的紛争が封じ込め対策を阻害している点は深刻な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго стрімко набирає обертів: понад тисяча підозрюваних випадків і сотні загиблих | Головне в Україні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo rapidly gaining momentum: more than a thousand suspected cases and hundreds killed | Top News in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating two weeks after the official declaration, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. The eastern Ituri province is hardest hit. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no proven vaccine exists. Doctors Without Borders notes an unprecedented pace of spread, with daily new suspected cases and hundreds of samples awaiting confirmation, leaving the true scale uncertain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited to assess response efforts, urging community involvement and warning against traditional funeral rites that can fuel transmission. Conflict, logistics problems, border closures, and limited air travel hinder control efforts. Uganda reports nine cases and one death; Brazil is investigating a suspected case in São Paulo, a 37-year-old man recently returned from Congo and in isolation. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects; mortality for Bundibugyo is about one-third.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が急速に拡大：1000件以上の疑い例と数百人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当する。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、ワクチンなし、急速な拡大が特徴。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはブラジルとウガンダでの事例言及があるが、実際の流行はコンゴが中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、ブラジルの事例は単一の疑い例であり、記事の主題はコンゴの流行である。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（BDBV）による流行は公開情報では稀であり、致命率約33%、有効ワクチン欠如が重大なリスク要因。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、医療従事者の感染リスク、紛争地域での制御困難性がすべて報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라확산에 국제사회 우려 증폭...국경없는의사회 "전례없는 수준"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern over Ebola spread intensifies as Doctors Without Borders says it is at an unprecedented level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) has intensified, with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 and at least 246 deaths. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. MSF deputy director Alan Gonzales warns the true scale is unknown, as hundreds of specimens remain untested and on-the-ground containment struggles to keep pace with spread. Border and airport closures are delaying response and aid delivery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess efforts and urged greater community engagement while noting that certain funeral practices involving handling the deceased could fuel transmission, though cultural respect is essential. Former CDC director Tom Frieden warns on Bloomberg TV that the outbreak exposes gaps in global pandemic preparedness, citing U.S. funding and staffing reductions. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Brazil reports a suspected case in Sao Paulo after the individual's return from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡散に国際社会の懸念増幅...国境なき医師団「前例のない規模」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。DRC（Ituri）での1,000件超の患者と246死亡、ウガンダでの国際波及、国境閉鎖、MSFおよびWHOによる深刻性の警告により、フルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での確認事例も報告されているが、verified_locationsに含めない。ブラジルのサンパウロでの疑似症例はDRC帰還者からの報告であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。DRC（Ituri）がこのイベントの主舞台であり、最も深刻な状況を示している。MSF副所長による「前例のない規模」との警告、未検査検体の多数存在、文化的慣行による感染拡大リスク、国境・空港閉鎖による対応遅延など、複数の懸念要因が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Понад 1000 випадків за два тижні: вірус Ебола б'є рекорди поширення
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 1,000 cases in two weeks: the Ebola virus is breaking transmission records.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates to record levels as of May 31, 2026, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths reported in two weeks. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine for this strain, which kills about one third of those infected. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects (needles, bedding, clothing). The response is overwhelmed, with hundreds of samples still untested. Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death linked to the outbreak; a 37-year-old man who recently returned from DRC is under observation in São Paulo, Brazil, representing an imported case under scrutiny. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 1000件以上の症例が2週間内に発生：エボラウイルスが感染拡大の記録を更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で、DRCで2週間に1000件以上の症例、246名の死亡報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認）、WHOが5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。ウガンダへの拡大、ブラジルへの輸入症例確認。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）はエボラウイルスの中でも致命率が比較的低いが、本サマリーでは約33%の死亡率と記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHOが既に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している点が重要。ブラジルへの輸入症例は検査・監視中の段階。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo investiga caso suspeito de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo investigates a suspected case of Ebola
article.articleSummary: 37-year-old patient in São Paulo's Emílio Ribas Institute is in isolation under biosafety protocols after a trip to the Democratic Republic of Congo, with suspected Ebola; lab confirmation is pending and multiple other diseases (notably malaria) are being tested. Preventive measures include isolation, rapid notification, lab investigation, and monitoring. Separately, the World Health Organization reports the Congo Basin Ebola outbreak evolving into Uganda, with 18 deaths and 134 confirmed cases in Uganda; 223 deaths and 906 suspected overall. Since May 21, 49 new cases and 8 new deaths; 160 suspected cases and 47 deaths added in the last seven days. In the DRC, Ituri Province accounts for 110 of the 134 confirmed cases, with Bunia (37), Rwampara (33), Mongbwalu (20), Nyankunde (10) most affected; 17 deaths among confirmed cases. By May 27, 2,635 contacts in Ituri and North Kivu; UNIS warns of a grave crisis. Uganda has nine confirmed cases (including one death) as of May 26, with 436 contacts under follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがエボラ疑似症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間発生（DRC・ウガンダで確認例・死亡例あり、ブラジルで疑い例）。IHR基準で深刻な影響（Yes）、異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、渡航制限リスク（Yes）の4項目全て該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される主要な発生地域：DRC（イトゥーリ州、北キブ州）、ウガンダ、およびブラジル（サンパウロの疑い例）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの確認例134件、死亡23件、ウガンダでの確認例18件・死亡17件、ブラジルでの疑い例1件という段階的な地理的拡大パターン。WHOも対応を記録している。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Bundibugyo Meluas, WHO Percepat Uji Klinis Terapi dan Vaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak Spreads, WHO Accelerates Clinical Trials of Therapies and Vaccines.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the WHO says there are no licensed therapies or vaccines to prevent or treat Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. In ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, prioritized products will be used only within clinical trials to generate robust safety and efficacy data. Independent experts recommend three main therapeutic candidates for confirmed cases: MBP134 monoclonal antibody, Maftivimab, and remdesivir, with a MBP134–remdesivir combination also suitable for field evaluation. For prevention, the oral antiviral obeldesivir is prioritized for post-exposure prophylaxis among close contacts. The single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by IAVI is the most promising candidate, though efficacy testing is not expected for 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford and Serum Institute of India could enter efficacy assessment in 2–3 months. Ervebo is not recommended outside carefully designed trials due to uncertain cross-protection. WHO, DRC, Uganda, Africa CDC, ANRS and partners are developing trial protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラ流行が拡大、WHO治療法とワクチンの臨床試験を加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の多国間流行であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。重症度が高く、国際的な治療法・ワクチン開発が急速に進行中であり、公衆衛生上の影響は深刻。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、インドにおけるエボラ流行と治療・ワクチン開発について述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。インドはSerum Institute of Instituteのワクチン候補（ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo）が言及されており、流行発生国としても含まれる可能性があるため included。Bluedot APIで列挙されているインドについて、記事本文が不在のため確定度は中程度だが、WHO公式情報では複数国での流行進行中と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Il Kenya dice "No" agli Stati Uniti: bloccato il centro di quarantena per l'Ebola. La sindrome "NIMBY" di Washington
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya says 'No' to the United States: Ebola quarantine center blocked. Washington's 'NIMBY' syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court temporarily blocked Nairobi's plan to allow the United States to open a 50-bed Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Airbase to isolate U.S. personnel returning from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid a pledge of about $13.5 million in U.S. Ebola preparedness aid. The decision reflects sovereignty concerns and political tensions over foreign-managed biosafety measures, with civil society groups Katiba Institute and the Kenyan Medical Practitioners and Dentists Union opposing treating Kenya as a containment zone for a lethal pathogen. U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, insist no Ebola cases will enter the United States; responses call for local isolation and in-country care. Ebola mortality ranges 25-90%, and outbreaks in neighboring Uganda/DRC have produced 18 deaths among confirmed cases, highlighting ongoing regional transmission and containment debates.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが米国に「ノー」：エボラ隔離センターがブロック。ワシントンの「NIMBY症候群」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という致死率25-90%の極めて重篤な病原体に関するシグナルであり、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、同時にウガンダとDRCでの既知の流行とケニアでの隔離施設設置を巡る政治的緊張という社会的関心が高い事案である。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラ隔離施設設置の政治的側面を中心としているが、実際のエボラ流行はウガンダとDRCで発生している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ケニアはイベント報道の主舞台だが、対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。記事は米国も言及しているが対象国でないため除外。IHR基準4つすべてに該当する極めて高いリスクレベルのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: WHO chief Tedros urges countries to lift travel bans in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the northeastern Ituri Province epicenter in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries to lift travel bans or border closures, arguing such restrictions could complicate outbreak response and undermine transparency and trust essential to saving lives. The remarks were delivered at a joint press conference in Bunia, Ituri Province, and reported by Xinhua. The report does not specify case or death counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources, focusing instead on the public health implications of travel restrictions and the call for international cooperation to manage the ongoing Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHO事務局長テドロスはDRCとウガンダの渡航禁止令を解除するよう各国に促す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCとウガンダで継続しており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響（serious_impact）と国際的な拡大リスク（international_spread）が該当。また、WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが確認され、WHO事務局長による公式声明により高い政治的関心が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。WHO事務局長の公式声明と渡航禁止令に関する記述から政治的関心が高い。症例数や死亡数の具体的な記載がないため severity は「不明」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Bunia, le DG de l'OMS appelle à renforcer la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Bunia, the WHO Director-General calls for strengthening the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Bunia in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is the epicenter of a new Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited to urge intensified mobilization of communities, authorities, and international partners to contain transmission. The outbreak has resulted in hundreds of cases across the affected Ituri areas; no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. Response relies on early case detection, isolation of patients, contact tracing, and community engagement, with emphasis on trust and participation to disrupt transmission chains. Access to care is hindered by fragile security and population displacement. The WHO chief called for increased international financial and logistical support to bolster surveillance, diagnostics, and patient care capacities, noting DRC's experience but highlighting the heightened concern given current conditions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ブニアでWHO事務局長がエボラ対策の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、数百例の患者、国際支援要請、ワクチン・治療薬なし。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク。記事中でBunia（Ituri州）が震源地として明記されており、DRCのみが該当。WHO事務局長が直接訪問し国際支援を呼びかけ。安全保障上の課題と人口移動により対応が複雑化。ワクチンおよび承認された治療薬が存在しないことが懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: EAC health minister set to hold emergency meeting on Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus strain prompts an East African Community emergency meeting on 1–2 June 2026. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; neighbouring Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF warns the rapid spread is deeply alarming as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the eastern Ituri province to oversee containment. The EAC is convening to deliberate regional actions to curb transmission, with partner states like Kenya increasing preparedness. Containment efforts are challenged by border and airport closures and delays in testing hundreds of samples; ongoing conflict in DR Congo is noted by WHO as a major hindrance to the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: EAC保健大臣がエボラ熱に関する緊急会議を開催予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCで1,000件以上の疑似症例と246名以上の死亡、ウガンダでの確認症例と死亡が報告されており、WHO事務局長が対応に当たるなど国際的な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ発生は主としてDRC（Ituri州）で報告されており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダでの確認症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。MSFの警告、WHO事務局長の現地視察、EACの緊急会議開催予定により、国際的関心と支援の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: เฝ้าระวังไข้หวัดใหญ่ระบาด พบป่วยสะสม 1.7 แสนราย เด็ก 0-14 ปี ป่วยสูงสุด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak surveillance: cumulative cases totaling 170,000; highest among children aged 0–14.
article.articleSummary: Influenza outbreak surveillance in Thailand shows cumulative influenza cases reaching 171,731 with 16 deaths as of May 28, 2026 (Digital Disease Surveillance data). The highest morbidity is among children aged 5–9 years, followed by 0–4 and 10–14 years. While overall cases appear to be decreasing compared with the same period last year, they remain above the five-year median. Laboratory surveillance from hospital networks, in collaboration with the Department of Medical Sciences and the Thai–U.S. Public Health Cooperation Center, indicates Influenza B as the most frequently detected strain among patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) and pneumonia. Public health guidance urges self-protection: wear masks in crowded settings, wash hands frequently, and avoid close contact; at-risk groups should receive annual influenza vaccination. Surveillance is conducted by the Department of Disease Control (Thailand) using DDS data.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザの流行監視：累積患者数が170,000人に達し、0～14歳の小児で最多
triage.triage_reason: タイでインフルエンザB型の流行が確認され、累積患者数171,731人、死亡16人と一定規模の事例がある。ただし、前年同期比では減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大の直接的な証拠に乏しい。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: タイの公式病因サーベイランス（DDS）データに基づく報告。インフルエンザB型が主流。前年同期比では減少していることから国内では制御されている可能性が高い。死亡数は少ないが、小児への影響が顕著。国際的拡大リスクの直接的証拠がないため、現段階ではWATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola continúa descontrolado en el Congo: más de 240 muertes y 1.000 casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to run rampant in Congo: more than 240 deaths and 1,000 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a severe Ebola outbreak has 246 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases as of May 31, 2026. The Bundibugyo variant has about a 50% fatality rate and there is no approved vaccine. Improvised wooden hospitals are being erected to treat patients; many arrive in critical condition, and some families have hidden loved ones at home. The World Health Organization is fully focused on the emergency, and Doctors Without Borders warns of acute resource shortages. Tedros Adhanom has urged greater international support—logistical and financial—while stressing the need to strengthen the health system. Women and children are particularly vulnerable as they care for the sick. Some experts link the surge to bushmeat consumption. In 15 days, suspected cases have quadrupled, underscoring rapid transmission and the urgency of containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで制御不能に：240人以上の死亡と1,000件の疑似症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。致死率50%のBundibugyo株による大規模流行で246人死亡、1,077件の疑似症例、15日間で疑似症例が4倍に急増。ワクチン未承認、資源不足、国際的支援要請あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による高致死率流行。15日間での急速な患増加（4倍化）、ワクチン未承認、医療資源の深刻な不足、WHOおよびMSFによる対応、Tedros事務局長による国際支援要請が確認された。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれていないが、深刻な国際的公衆衛生上の脅威としてPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 视频 | 世卫组织总干事：阻断埃博拉疫情蔓延仍有希望-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | WHO Director-General: There is still hope to curb the spread of the Ebola outbreak - International Online
article.articleSummary: On May 30, while visiting Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and stressed critical measures to curb transmission. There is no specific vaccine or therapy for this outbreak yet, but with proper medical care Ebola virus disease patients can recover, and some patients in Ituri have already recovered. Early treatment is essential. He emphasized a community-led response and safe, dignified burial practices as central to preventing spread. Government leadership combined with community engagement is pivotal, and international support remains important to stop transmission. The remarks came during a May 30, 2026 media briefing, underscoring containment efforts in this outbreak.
