triage.headline_ja: ビデオ | WHO事務局長：エボラ疫情の蔓延を食い止める希望はまだある - 国際オンライン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の発生は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。WHO事務局長による公式声明であり社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブニア（イトゥリ州の首都）でのエボラウイルス病の発生。ブンディブギョウイーボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による流行。WHO事務局長が現地視察し、公式に存在を確認。現在のところ特異的ワクチンや治療法がないとされるが、適切な医療により患者の回復実績あり。コミュニティ主導のアプローチと国際的支援の必要性を強調している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Terapkan Darurat Ebola, Kemenkes Perkuat Sektor Bandara Hingga Pelabuhan Internasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Emergency, Health Ministry Strengthens the Airport Sector and International Ports.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the WHO on May 17, 2026. In response, the government tightens vigilance at all entry points, prioritizing airports and international ports. Health officials say the PHEIC signals global alert despite Ebola not being classified as a pandemic, citing cross-border spread, high mortality, and uncertainty about the outbreak’s extent in Central Africa. Travel-linked cases have appeared in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa, reflecting population mobility and limited local health capacity. The Ministry of Health has deployed field staff, intensified traveler screening, and prepared referral pathways to hospitals meeting international standards. 24/7 monitoring via SKDR and PHEOC, with national laboratories on standby for rapid detection. Public urged to stay calm and avoid misinformation; Ebola’s average fatality rate is about 50%. Strains circulating include EVD, SVD, and BVD."}

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラ緊急事態を宣言、保健省が空港から国際港湾までの部門を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC でのエボラ感染症の PHEIC 宣言、高い死亡率、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの流入確認）、渡航制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはカンパラ（ウガンダ）とキンシャサへの言及があるが、主要な発生地はDRC。ウガンダは旅行関連症例の流入先として記述されており、ウガンダ自体が流行地域として確認されていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Swine Vesicular Disease も疾患リストに含まれているが、サマリーの主題はエボラであり、SVD に関する具体的な情報は記事に含まれていない。2026年5月31日配信とされており、時系列上の現実性については確認が必要だが、トリアージ判定には影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief is confident Ebola outbreak in DR Congo can be stopped
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak centers in eastern Ituri Province, with Bunia as a focal point, and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, says the outbreak can be stopped, citing DRC’s history of ending 16 prior outbreaks. The emergency has spread across several provinces and into neighboring Uganda. As of 31 May 2026, at least 1,077 suspected cases have been reported in the DRC since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, with 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed infections, including one death. Vaccines and treatments are in clinical trials; Africa CDC expects a vaccine by year-end. Emphasis on community trust, safe burials, and early care to reduce transmission; WHO funds remain about one-third of needs, with Uganda pledging $20 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ流行は阻止可能と確信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）による大規模流行で1,077疑い症例・246死亡、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダで9確定例）、ワクチン・治療薬なし。国際的支援が必要な重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの確認例も述べられているが、発生地域がDRC（Ituri州Bunia市）であり、ウガンダは「隣国への拡大」という二次的な言及。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラは高い公衆衛生影響度と国際的懸念を持つシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief appeals for early Ebola treatment, safe burials in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Bunia, is caused by the Bundibugyo virus and represents the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, described as one of the largest in 50 years. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged residents to seek early treatment and practice safe burials to curb transmission, warning against traditions that involve touching bodies of those who died from Ebola. The response is coordinated from Bunia as agencies intensify containment; the report does not provide case or death counts. A May 30, 2026 visit by WHO officials to Bunia is cited, underscoring the emphasis on rapid care and safe burial practices to interrupt transmission during this large, intensified outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴにおけるエボラ熱の早期治療と安全な埋葬を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の大規模アウトブレイク（50年間で最大級）であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WHO事務局長による直接の呼びかけがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレイク、Ituri州Bunia中心、Bundibugyo virus（ボンディブギョウウイルス）が原因。WHO事務局長の直接的な緊急呼びかけ、死亡者数は記事に記載なし。大規模で強化された対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Brzo širenje ebole u DR Kongo izaziva ozbiljnu zabrinutost: Najmanje 246 smrtnih slučajeva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola in DR Congo raises serious concern: at least 246 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is deeply concerning, with at least 246 deaths and more than 1,000 suspected cases, primarily in Ituri's Bunia, and nine confirmed cases with one death in Uganda. Two weeks after declaration, MSF reports unprecedented case speed and ongoing uncertainties as hundreds of samples remain untested. Response is slowed by border and air-travel closures amid ongoing conflict. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to oversee the response and urged communities to take a larger role, cautioned against funeral practices involving touching the deceased. Bunia's National Institute for Biomedical Research now returns Ebola test results within 24 hours, reducing delays from 1,500 km transport to Kinshasa. In Brazil, a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo involves a traveler recently from DR Congo, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease, a rare strain with about one-third mortality and no proven vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでのエボラ急速拡大が深刻な懸念を引き起こす：少なくとも246人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施中）。エボラ出血熱は高致命性で国際的に通知すべき疾患であり、既に国境/航空路線制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域のうち、Uganda は記事サマリーで言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州Bunia）。ウガンダについては9例の確認例の報告があるため、実質的には DRC が主たる発生国。ブラジルは旅行者の疑い症例で1例の報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な株系統で約1/3の致命率。MSFが前例のない速度での症例発生を報告しており、検査体制の逼迫、紛争による対応遅延など、管理上の懸念が複数存在する。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : première guérison enregistrée en RDC, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: first recovery recorded in the DRC, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) saw its first recovery, with a patient discharged after two negative tests, according to the WHO. The latest figures: 125 confirmed Ebola cases and over 900 suspected cases, with 17 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths. Anaïs Legand, WHO expert on viral hemorrhagic fevers, said the recovered patient was the first admitted to a treatment center to be discharged after two negative tests since the outbreak began. WHO experts are reviewing candidate treatments and vaccines for clinical trials, prioritizing monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab, plus the antiviral remdesivir. For prevention, obeldesivir is being considered for post-exposure use; two candidate vaccines will be evaluated when doses are available. Field efforts include enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, clinical care, logistics, community engagement, cross-border preparedness, and continuation of essential health services via partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：DRCで初の回復者を確認、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上に該当（重篤な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当し、高い公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行に焦点を当てており、125例の確定患者、900例以上の疑い患者、17例の確定死亡、223例の疑い死亡が報告されている。初の回復者が確認されたことは治療上の進展を示すが、依然として大規模な感染流行が継続中。WHOによる候補治療薬・ワクチンの臨床試験準備も進行中で、国際的な支援が継続されている。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে দ্রুত ছড়িয়ে পড়ছে ইবোলা, পরিস্থিতি 'অত্যন্ত উদ্বেগজনক'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in Congo, the situation is extremely concerning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern Ituri province, centered on Bunia. Within two weeks of the outbreak declaration, more than 1,000 suspected cases have been identified, with at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports 9 confirmed infections and 1 death. MSF warns the surge is unprecedented for a new Ebola outbreak, while border and airport closures impede control and humanitarian aid. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to assess challenges and urge community action and safe handling of the dead. Bunia’s laboratory now returns results within 24 hours, shortening earlier delays from Kinshasa (about 1,500 km away). A Brazil case in Sao Paulo involves a returning traveler from DRC. The outbreak is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no licensed vaccine; mortality runs about one‑third. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, vomit, diarrhea, saliva, sweat and other contaminated bodily fluids or items, including clothing and bedding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大、状況は『極めて深刻』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ブラジル）、異常な規模（2週間で1,000疑い例、246死亡）が確認される。スクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認株）による大規模流行。2週間で1,000疑い例、246死亡はBundibugyo型では異例。ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認。ブラジルの症例は帰国旅行者であり、現在のところ地域流行の証拠はないが、国際的な旅行関連リスクとして注視が必要。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国境・空港閉鎖により政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라, 민주콩고서 빠른 확산...국제사회 ''전례 없는 심각 수준''
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... The international community at an unprecedented level of severity.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province Ebola outbreak has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases with at least 246 deaths. International aid groups describe the situation as unprecedentedly severe two weeks after Ituri’s outbreak declaration, with hundreds of samples untested as new suspected cases arise daily and containment struggles amid border and airport restrictions delaying aid. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death linked to the outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess the response and urged greater community participation while acknowledging funeral practices; unsafe handling of corpses could fuel transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, vomit, stool, saliva, urine, semen, sweat, or contaminated items. A Brazilian case, a 37-year-old man who had visited DRC, is under investigation in São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、民主共和国コンゴで急速に拡散...国際社会は「前例のない深刻度」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRCのイトゥリ州でエボラウイルス患者1,000名超（死亡246名）、ウガンダへの国境越え（9確認例、1死亡）、ブラジルの疑い例報告があり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態として評価される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより：DRC（イトゥリ州）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播も報告されている。ブラジルはDRC訪問者の疑い例報告のため含める。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、国境規制遅延、葬送慣行による感染拡大のリスク等、多くの懸念要因が存在。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による新しい亜型の可能性も注視要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : face à Ebola, Kinshasa et l'OMS resserrent leur coordination depuis Bunia - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Facing Ebola, Kinshasa and the WHO tighten their coordination from Bunia - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying its response to the 17th Ebola outbreak in the eastern region, centered in Bunia, Ituri, linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Kinshasa authorities and the World Health Organization (WHO) held a joint briefing on May 30, outlining surveillance, screening, and case-management measures that frontline teams say are beginning to curb transmission. The outbreak now affects Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, where epidemiological monitoring and community engagement continue alongside patient care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reaffirmed unwavering operational support and urged international partners not to impose travel restrictions that hinder transparency and response efforts. The objective remains to rapidly interrupt transmission chains, prevent spread to other provinces, and maintain progress against Ebola in the country.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラに直面し、キンシャサとWHOはブニアから調整を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の17番目のアウトブレイクがDRCで発生し、複数州に拡大。WHOと当局による積極的な対応が進行中。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、国際的な懸念が示されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病Bundibugyo株によるDRCでの第17番目のアウトブレイク。Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu州で確認。WHOとDRC当局による調整されたレスポンスが実施中。国際的なトレンド制限回避の呼びかけがなされている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: IsraAID launches Ebola response in Uganda, DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which no approved vaccine exists. DRC reports about 1,200 suspected or confirmed cases and more than 250 deaths; Uganda has seven cases and one death. IsraAID is mobilizing emergency support, working with Congolese refugees at the Nyakabande Transit Centre and Nakivale Refugee Settlement in Uganda to provide personal protective equipment, hygiene supplies and public-health information, assess needs with local partners, and deliver lifesaving supplies to affected communities. The WHO declared a public-health emergency of international concern on May 17 and raised Congo’s risk level to very high on May 22. Nyakabande is operating beyond capacity due to influx from the DRC. IsraAID previously aided the 2014 Ebola outbreaks in Sierra Leone and Liberia, focusing on frontline workers and community protection.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエイドがウガンダとDRCでエボラ対応を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態の宣言済み。複数国での活動的な流行、高い死亡率、国際的な懸念が確認された。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）も発生地域として記事サマリーに明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事はDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ流行について記述しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みで、高度に要監視。

article.articleHeadline: "콩고민주공화국 에볼라 확산, 전례 없는 수준" 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns over Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at an unprecedented level
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at an unprecedented level and urgent action to strengthen surveillance is needed. Two weeks after official declaration, daily new suspected cases are reported while hundreds of samples remain untested. Ground operations are struggling to keep pace with spread, and border and airport closures are delaying response efforts and delivery of supplies. Suspected Ebola cases in the DRC have surpassed 1,000, with at least 246 deaths. Neighboring Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. BBC reports a suspected case in Brazil: a 37-year-old man who recently visited the DRC and is under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染拡大、「前例のない水準」と懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での確認例、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、国境閉鎖など深刻度が極めて高い。フルRRA進行必要。
triage.notes: Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCで1,000件超の疑似患者、246人の死亡、ウガンダで9確認例1死亡、ブラジルで1疑似例あり。サーベイランスの遅延、検査滞り、国境閉鎖による対応阻害など、管理可能性への重大な懸念あり。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Một gia đình bị loài ký sinh trùng tưởng đã tuyệt chủng tấn công
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family attacked by a parasite believed to be extinct.
article.articleSummary: In Tay Ninh, Vietnam, a 71-year-old grandmother and her daughter were diagnosed with scabies caused by Sarcoptes scabiei after a week of widespread itching, worse at night. Initially misattributed to dermatitis, they treated themselves with saline and topical meds, but lesions spread to the face, back, chest, abdomen, and thighs. At Xuyen A General Hospital, clinicians confirmed two concurrent cases in the same household. After three days of inpatient treatment and intensive skin care, both are improving and stable. Scabies spreads rapidly via direct skin contact or sharing clothes, bedding, and towels, making households with close contact high-risk. Classic symptoms include persistent itching—especially at night—along with small vesicles and red papules, and lesions on interdigital spaces, wrists, elbows, trunk, buttocks, thighs, and genital area. Without timely treatment, secondary bacterial infection and, rarely, sepsis can occur. Early dermatology consultation is advised when multiple family members are affected.

triage.headline_ja: 絶滅したと考えられていた寄生虫が家族を襲う
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は既知の慢性感染症であり、個別家族の散発例である。国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生的な重症度、国家間の渡航制限が想定されず、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は広く知られた一般的皮膚寄生虫症であり、散発的な家族内症例に過ぎない。医学的関心は「長期間未診断だった」という臨床的逸話にあるが、公衆衛生危機を示唆するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Memburuk, Kasus Suspek Tembus 900 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo worsens, suspected cases surpass 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens, with more than 900 suspected Ebola cases and at least 223 deaths linked to infection reported, concentrated in Ituri Province. Over two weeks since the outbreak was announced, Médecins Sans Frontières warns the spread is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, prompting alarm among communities and frontline health workers. Limited laboratory capacity and slow diagnostic turnarounds hinder rapid case identification, complicating containment efforts. MSF urged expansion of testing capacity to accelerate detection in the early phase of the outbreak. The situation coincides with a high-level visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to Ituri as WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The last DRC Ebola outbreak ended in October 2025; resurgence raises international concern about health-service gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症流行が悪化、疑い患者が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い重症度と致死率を有し、DRC・ウガンダでのPHEIC宣言、国際的な拡大リスク、および旅行・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダでのエボラ流行の存在言及のみで、本イベント（現在の悪化）はDRCのIturi州に集中しているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO Director-GeneralのIturi訪問、PHEC宣言、MSFの警告など、国際的関心と対応が急速に進展中。診断能力の制限が対応を複雑化させている点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية: يمكن السيطرة على فيروس "إيبولا" رغم غياب اللقاح
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director: Ebola virus can be controlled despite the absence of a vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Bundibugyo region of eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo can be contained despite no licensed vaccine or treatment for the current strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told a Bunia press conference that community ownership of solutions is essential, with a Congolese-led response supported by partners including Africa CDC, UNICEF, and the WFP. The DRC has faced 16 prior Ebola outbreaks and has contained them; this is the 17th. While no approved vaccine or therapy exists for the current strain, early medical care improves survival, with recoveries reported in Ituri. Emphasizing hand hygiene and safe, dignified burials, he warned unsafe handling of corpses can sustain transmission. He urged reconsidering travel restrictions that hinder response and transparency. WHO remains with the DRC “until the end” and aims to strengthen local health systems for sustainable post-outbreak services.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：ワクチンの不在にもかかわらず「エボラ」ウイルスは制御可能
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規発生報告であり、IHR基準4項目全てに該当する。深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が明確で、ワクチン欠如下での制御可能性に関するWHO公式見解が示されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo地域（東部DRC）およびIturi州で確認された17番目のエボラ爆発。WHO事務局長による公式声明であり、高レベルの国際的関心が示唆されている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主要な発生地としては特定されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: El jefe de la OMS visita foco del ébola en Congo, más de 240 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief visits the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Congo, more than 240 dead.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 – Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) involves a rare Ebola strain with 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths (Africa CDC). Neighboring Uganda reports nine infections and one death; one patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia to visit a treatment centre and engage with local authorities, health workers, and affected families, underscoring community involvement. The epidemic is spreading faster than the response can keep up, though health facilities have seen some improvements and new aid. Ituri and nearby Kivu regions face security challenges from militias with cross-border spillover. Borders have been closed by Uganda and Rwanda; Uganda enforces a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC. The United States has barred entry for travelers who recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのトップがコンゴのエボラ流行の中心地を訪問、240人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な高リスク株、国際的拡大と複数国の渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。進行中の国際的エボラ流行イベントであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州における進行中のエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダでの9例感染、ルワンダの国境閉鎖、米国の渡航禁止など複数国への波及を記述しているが、実際の発生地はDRCが中心。WHOトップの現地訪問は疫学的深刻性を強調している。稀なエボラ株系統（系統不明記載）と急速な伝播、セキュリティ課題による対応の遅れが状況を悪化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia says two suspected Ebola cases test negative, steps up screening
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Zambia reports two suspected Ebola cases tested negative amid heightened screening at entry points and within the country after a neighboring outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). DRC authorities say suspected Bundibugyo Ebola cases have reached 1,028, with Uganda also reporting cases. The Bundibugyo strain carries no vaccine. Zambia notes a high risk of cross-border transmission and has implemented screening tools and protocols for Ebola-like symptoms. The Bundibugyo virus, named for a Ugandan province identified nearly 20 years ago, has alarmed officials due to extended undetected spread in densely populated areas, hindering contact tracing. According to the World Health Organization, Ebola viruses typically begin with fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアが2件の疑い例のエボラ陰性判定を報告、スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ種の新興エボラ流行がDRC/ウガンダで急速拡大中で、ザンビアはハイリスク国として国境越え感染の脅威を認識している。即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRC・ウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラ流行(1,028疑い例)に隣接するザンビアは国境越え感染リスクが極めて高い。ブンディブギョ種にはワクチンがなく、密集地での未検出感染による接触追跡困難が懸念される。ザンビアの2件陰性例は現在リスク軽減だが、地域的危機レベルは高い。記事サマリーではウガンダも患者発生を報告しているが、特定の患者数・地理的詳細が不記載であるため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: يمكن النجاة من الإيبولا.. وتعافى بعض المرضى فى إيتوري - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: It is possible to survive Ebola... and some patients have recovered in Ituri - Youm7.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, says the current Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. The DRC has faced Ebola outbreaks 16 times before and this is the 17th in its history; yet early care can save lives, and some patients have recovered in Ituri. WHO and partners are pursuing safe and effective vaccines and therapies through clinical trials. Key measures include personal hygiene, accurate information sharing, and safe, dignified burial practices, since touching bodies can spread the virus. He cautions that travel bans and border closures hinder response and urges reconsideration. Beyond the outbreak, WHO and the DRC aim to sustain health services, laboratories, and facilities, with community ownership at the center. He met Prime Minister Judith Suminewa Tuloka and other leaders to strengthen long-term health capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスからの生存は可能...イトゥリで一部の患者が回復 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による第17次アウトブレイクがDRCで発生。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、高い重症度、国際的拡大リスク、人口密集地での発生により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認）による第17次アウトブレイク。WHO事務局長が現地を訪問し、回復者の存在を確認。渡航禁止・国境閉鎖への反対を表明している点から国際的関心が高い。Ituri州のBunia市が地理的に密集したエリアであり、感染拡大リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges countries to reconsider travel restrictions amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia, eastern Congo, is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Uganda has confirmed nine cases and one death. Bundibugyo currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, urged countries to reconsider travel bans and border closures, saying such measures can undermine trust and transparency and hinder outbreak response. Authorities continue contact tracing, surveillance, and containment efforts across the DRC and neighboring Uganda. No laboratory-confirmed counts are provided in the article; the figures cited are suspected cases and deaths. Tedros expressed confidence in Congo's capacity to control the outbreak, emphasizing cooperation among communities, health authorities, and neighboring countries to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行に伴う渡航制限の再検討を各国に促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。対象地域でのエボラ出血熱の確認症例、複数国への波及、WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際的対応が求められている状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Bunia、東部コンゴ）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでの確認症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo株はワクチンと特異的治療法がない。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際的な対応呼びかけは、事態の深刻度を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: الدغيس: لا إصابات بإيبولا في ليبيا والمرض منحصر في بؤره الرئيسة - ليبيا الأحرار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Al-Daghis: No Ebola cases in Libya, and the disease is confined to its primary foci.
article.articleSummary: Libya's National Center for Disease Control spokesperson Ibrahim Al-Dghis reports no Ebola cases in Libya or across North Africa. Ebola has re-emerged in its main transmission foci, notably in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with cases also reported in other African nations such as Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The World Health Organization's declaration of Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern is noted as internationally concerning. A week earlier, the center had denied any confirmed or suspected Ebola case in Libya, stating the country's epidemiological situation remains stable. The center's teams remain on alert with enhanced surveillance and preparedness to detect and manage any suspected case per approved procedures. Officials urge the public to rely on official sources and will announce any developments via the center's official channels.

triage.headline_ja: アル・ダギス：リビアでエボラ患者なし、病気は主要な発生地に限定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの再出現が報告されており、DRC、ウガンダなど対象国での発生は確認されるが、記事の主眼はリビア当局による「リビアでの患者否定」である。対象国での症例報告は言及されているが詳細不足。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月31日配信で未来日付（検証が必要）。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ再出現が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。WHOによるPHEIC宣言言及あり。当初の判定はIHR基準4つ全て該当することでPICKUP相当だが、記事主眼がリビアでの否定声明であり、対象国での実状に関する詳細情報が不足しているため、追加情報待ちのWATCHが適切と判定。

article.articleHeadline: கொங்கோவில் கட்டுக்கடங்காமல் பரவும் எபோலா வைரஸ்: மருத்துவக் தொண்டு நிறுவனம் எச்சரிக்கை!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreading uncontrollably in Congo: Medical charity warns!
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) is spreading uncontrollably, according to Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). The outbreak, officially declared two weeks ago, shows severe escalation with over 1,000 suspected cases in eastern Ituri province and at least 246 deaths. Uganda reports 9 confirmed infections and 1 death linked to the outbreak. Blood samples hundreds of which are still awaiting testing, obscuring the true scale. Border closures and airport shutdowns hinder humanitarian aid and response efforts in Ituri, whose capital is Bunia. The World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has visited the region to oversee control measures, and locals are urged not to touch bodies during traditional funerals to prevent further transmission. Separately, Brazil’s São Paulo state reports one suspected case; a 37-year-old man recently returned from Congo is isolated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが制御不能に拡大：医療慈善団体が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）。DRCで1,000件以上の疑い例と246死亡、ウガンダでも9例確認、ブラジルでも疑い例が報告されており、複数国への拡大と国際的インパクトが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIに含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはIturi州Buniaで主要な発生、ブラジルはサンパウロ州で疑い例1件が報告されている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、国境閉鎖・空港閉鎖による人道支援への影響など、国際的な関心と管理可能性の問題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 인류의 방심이 에볼라·한타바이러스 공습을 불러왔다 [김형자의 세상은 지금] - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Humanity's complacency has sparked an Ebola and Hantavirus onslaught [Kim Hyung-ja's World Is Now]
article.articleSummary: May 2026: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have caused at least 139 deaths and over 1,000 cases as of May 26. The WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17 for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, with a case fatality rate of 30–50%; no vaccine or therapy exists for this variant, and existing Zaire-targeted vaccines are ineffective. Early symptoms mimic flu or malaria, delaying detection, while response efforts are hampered by armed groups in eastern Congo. Separately, Andes hantavirus has caused a cluster aboard the Dutch cruise ship Hondius, with about 120 repatriated passengers diagnosed and three deaths; the WHO is monitoring roughly 260 contacts. Andes virus can spread person-to-person, but remains a high CFR pathogen with no approved vaccine. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board cites climate change, conflict, and nationalism as pandemic drivers and urges equitable vaccine/treatment development and renewed international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 人類の油断がエボラとハンタウイルス猛攻を招いた [金形子の世界は今]
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響：139死亡・1,000以上の症例、予想外：新規Bundibugyo変異体およびクルーズ船でのヒト-ヒト感染クラスタ、国際的拡大リスク：複数国での発生、渡航・貿易制限リスク：WHO PHEIC宣言済）。同時複数新興感染症の国際的イベントであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ集団発生が報告されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は提供対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ記載。クルーズ船（Hondius）でのハンタウイルスはオランダ船籍であり、発生地域として対象国に該当しない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）の高致命率Bundibugyo変異体（CFR 30-50%）、ワクチン/治療法なし、武装勢力による対応阻害など複合リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : l'OMS met en garde contre les restrictions de voyage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO warns against travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda persists, centered in Ituri's Bunia with Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The WHO reports at least 134 confirmed cases across DRC and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases, and more than 1,000 suspected since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or treatment. Local communities play a central role, alongside surveillance and containment in eastern DRC's Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries to reconsider travel restrictions, warning such measures could hinder transparency in case reporting. Several countries have restricted travel/visa: the United States and Canada for Congolese, Ugandan, and South Sudanese nationals; Rwanda and Uganda restricting movement from Congo, with Kigali barring entry for anyone who has been in Congo in the last 30 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：WHOが渡航制限に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、確認症例134例以上、死亡18例、疑い例1000例以上。ワクチン・治療法なし。複数国が既に渡航制限措置を実施。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはルワンダ（Kigali Province）やスーダン、米国、カナダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主要な流行はDRC（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）とウガンダに限定されており、これら他国は渡航制限の実施国またはBluedotの地理情報拡張であると判断。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダについても記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Mengkhawatirkan, Total 223 Kematian Dilaporkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Kongo is worrying; a total of 223 deaths have been reported.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, report over 900 suspected cases and 223 deaths suspected to be Ebola. MSF warns the spread is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, with limited lab capacity delaying diagnosis essential to cutting transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri as WHO designated Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The crisis follows a prior Ebola outbreak in the DRC that ended in October 2025. International health authorities are urged to provide rapid logistical and medical support to strengthen early detection and patient management in red zones, as daily new suspected cases continue to be identified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ発生が懸念される、合計223人の死亡が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO既に PHEIC 指定済み。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダでのイベント詳細が記載されておらず、主要な感染症イベントの発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。DRCはCEPR対象国リストに該当。既にWHO PHEIC指定済みで、最優先度のシグナル。2026年5月31日時点で900以上の疑い例、223人の死亡報告。MSFが感染速度の急加速を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, il direttore OMS a Bunia per l'emergenza Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, the WHO director in Bunia for the Ebola emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo centers on Bunia in Ituri province, with spread to North and South Kivu. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or cures. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, meeting authorities, health workers, and local leaders, underscoring community trust and safe burials as critical to containment. Health authorities and international partners are intensifying surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care to curb transmission. The report does not provide specific case or death counts. Ongoing efforts focus on rapid detection, isolation, and supportive treatment, with continued international support and monitoring of the outbreak progress.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の危機対応でWHO事務局長ブニアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準中3つ以上に該当し、さらにWPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病は高い公衆衛生的影響と国際的拡大リスクを持つ。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は重症度が高く、死亡率が高い。DRCで過去17回の流行の記録があり、今回はBundibugyo株で認可ワクチン・治療法がない。記事ではWHO事務局長の公式訪問が報道されており、国際的な警戒と支援体制が既に構築されている。ケース数や死亡数は記事に記載されていないが、複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）への拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sur le terrain face à Ebola, l'OMS apporte son soutient et organise la riposte sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the ground, facing Ebola, WHO provides its support and organizes the public health response.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province, with Bougna identified as the epicenter. As of the report, over 1,000 suspected cases and about 220 confirmed cases, with the death toll surpassing 246. The first recovery has been confirmed, and the patient was discharged from hospital. No specific treatment or vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain, underscoring the primacy of prevention. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia on May 30, 2026, to support government and NGO response and to coordinate response efforts. He highlighted the country’s experience managing 16 prior Ebola outbreaks but urged stronger community engagement to address fears and misinformation. Incidents include tents housing patients being burned in Rwampara. Authorities are constructing more robust facilities to replace temporary setups as part of the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに直面する現場で、WHOが支援を提供し公衆衛生対応を組織する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認症例220例以上、死亡246例以上の深刻な公衆健康影響、Bundibugyo株という予想外の株による大規模流行、複数国（DRC・ルワンダ）への地理的拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限の可能性が高い。WHO事務局長の現地訪問によって国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。確認症例220例以上、死亡246例以上、疑い症例1,000例以上。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーではDRCのBunia（Ituri州）が主要な発生地点として述べられており、記事の主題はDRCでの流行対応。ルワンダでの二次感染可能性があるものの、現在の報告では主にDRCに限定されているため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。WHO事務局長の現地訪問（2026年5月30日）により国際的な関心度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Átlépte az óceánt a gyógyíthatatlan vírus? Bejelentés jött: lezárták az első határokat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did the incurable virus cross the ocean? An announcement came: the first borders have been closed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda intensify with the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or cure exists. Uganda completely closed its border with the DRC; nine infections and one death are confirmed in Uganda. In the DRC, WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation, while a local health minister later cites 1028 suspected and 225 confirmed cases. In eastern Ituri, Bunia hosts the crisis as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits; hospitals are overwhelmed and the virus is spreading faster than control measures. Safe burial practices are urged due to highly infectious corpses, yet traditional rites trigger attacks on health facilities. Brazil reports a suspicious Sao Paulo case linked to recent return from the DRC. MSF notes PPE shortages; WHO has received only about one-third of required funding. The DRC notes this is its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with sixteen previously contained.

triage.headline_ja: 治療不可能なウイルスが大洋を渡ったのか？ 発表がありました：最初の国境が閉鎖されました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行、死亡者多数、国境閉鎖、ブラジルへの疑い例報告により、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行を報じており、ブラジルのサンパウロでの疑い例も言及されている。ただしサマリーに基づくと、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダであり、ブラジルはあくまで疑い例である。対象国リスト内ではDRC(203312)のみが確認された流行地である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル(3469034)は疑い例段階のため確定流行地として含めない。WHOの資金不足、院内感染リスク、従来埋葬儀礼による医療施設への攻撃など、管理可能性が著しく低い状況。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo supera los 200 muertos y preocupa por su posible expansión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200 deaths and raises concerns about its possible spread.
article.articleSummary: More than 200 deaths and about 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, where the outbreak has been active since May 15. The Bundibugyo strain, first identified in 2007 in Uganda, causes 30–50% mortality and has no approved vaccines or therapies; rapid tests may yield false negatives, delaying detection. Early symptoms mimic malaria, complicating diagnosis and containment. Ongoing conflict, population displacement, militia activity, artisanal mining, and weak health infrastructure hinder response. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern; MSF and partners are establishing isolation and treatment centers and strengthening disinfection and epidemiologic surveillance. Global risk is considered low, but vigilance is needed due to links with Kinshasa and other major African cities, with no near-term vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が200人以上の死者を超え、拡大の可能性について懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的な懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、死亡数200人超、疑い例900件超の重大な流行。ウガンダとのつながり、コンゴ内の複数都市への拡大リスク、国際的な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strainは2007年にウガンダで初めて同定された。記事ではウガンダとの地理的つながりが言及されているが、サマリーの主な焦点はDRCのIturi州での流行。WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。武装勢力活動、人口移動、紛争が対応を困難にしている。ワクチンなし、診断が複雑（マラリアとの症状の類似）。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πώς το κυνήγι και η κατανάλωση άγριων ζώων τροφοδοτούν τον εφιάλτη στο Κονγκό - Η κρυφή απειλή στο πιάτο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: How hunting and consumption of wild animals fuel the nightmare in Congo - The hidden threat on the plate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates as authorities fight to curb the Bundibugyo strain. Since the flare began on May 15, 2026, Congo reports 1,028 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths. The transmission risk persists in the Congo Basin, where hunting and consumption of wild meat are seen as the main entry point for zoonotic spillover from wildlife to humans. While Ebola is not typically foodborne, U.S. CDC notes links to hunting, slaughter, and processing of infected animals. No approved drugs or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo; control is hampered by armed conflict and population displacement. One Health advocates urge changes in cultural practices and tighter wildlife-market oversight, including Kinshasa’s Massina market. The Congo Basin exports an estimated 4.5 million tonnes of wildlife products annually, underscoring the scale of the challenge.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴでの野生動物の狩猟と消費がこの悪夢を助長する方法 - お皿の上の隠れた脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo エボラ株による大規模流行（1,028疑似症例、220死亡）、予想外の流行株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク全て認める。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は近年稀で、承認医薬品・ワクチンが存在しない。武装紛争による制御困難性と450万トン規模の野生動物製品取引による zoonotic spillover リスクが国際的脅威を構成。

article.articleHeadline: Вже більше тисячі людей, що заразилися: вірус Ебола повернувся і міг перетнути океан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than a thousand people have already been infected: the Ebola virus has returned and could have crossed the ocean.
article.articleSummary: 2 weeks after declaring a new Ebola outbreak, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. Uganda has nine cases and one death. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no confirmed vaccine, with case fatality around one-third. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects (needles, bedding, clothing). Local funeral customs involving touching the deceased and ongoing armed conflict hinder containment and disrupt medical operations due to closed airports. The virus may have crossed to Latin America, with doctors in Sao Paulo, Brazil, reporting a suspected case in a 37-year-old man who recently returned from DRC and is under observation.

triage.headline_ja: すでに1000人以上が感染：エボラウイルスが返ってきて、海を渡った可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。検証済み対象国はコンゴ民主共和国とブラジルで、1000以上の感染例と246人の死亡を伴う稀なブンディブギョエボラウイルス株の重大な拡大。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの確認事例、ブラジル（サンパウロ）での疑い例を記述。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）とBrazil（3469034）のみ。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ワクチンがない稀なBundibugyo株であり、葬儀慣習と武装紛争が抑制を困難にしている。ラテンアメリカへの地理的拡大は重大な国際的懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи объяснили, почему не могут взять под контроль вспышку Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors explained why they can't take control of the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province is escalating, according to Alan Gonzalez, MSF deputy director of operations. Two weeks after a sharp rise in infections, Ebola remains a major concern for communities and frontline health workers, with transmission described as unprecedented. New suspected Ebola cases are reported daily, while testing capacity cannot keep up, delaying diagnoses. MSF calls for expanding laboratory capacity and accelerating diagnostics to help take the outbreak under control. The report provides no case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らがアフリカでのエボラ流行をコントロールできない理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、および国際的拡大リスクが複合的に認められる。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行易感性、管理可能性が懸念される。エボラウイルス病の急速な流行拡大と感染検査能力の不足が確認され、国際的支援（MSF活動）が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事では2026年5月31日時点でのコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州におけるエボラ流行の急速な拡大が報告されている。感染者数および死者数の具体的な報告がないため、重症度は記事内容から推測されている。MSF（国境なき医師団）が既に介入していることから、国際的支援の必要性が確認できる。Ituri州はDRCの発生地域として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: النجاة من الإيبولا ممكن وتعافي مرضى في إيتوري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Survival from Ebola is possible and patients in Ituri are recovering
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered near Bunia, marks the 17th recorded outbreak in the country. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for this strain. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Congo, expressed cautious optimism, noting the country has previously contained 16 outbreaks and eliminated all prior cases. Some patients in Ituri have recovered with appropriate medical care, underscoring the potential for survival with proper treatment. Emphasizing prevention, authorities urge rigorous personal hygiene and avoidance of practices such as touching the bodies of the deceased to limit transmission. The WHO leader also urged nations to reconsider travel bans and border closures, arguing that such measures hinder outbreak response and transparency necessary to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラからの生存は可能であり、イトゥーリ州の患者が回復中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の新規アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo型、ワクチン・治療薬なし）で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州ブニア近郊でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。Bundibugyo型で利用可能なワクチン・承認治療法がないため、管理可能性が低い。WHOが訪問中で国際的な注視が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: 全面防堵伊波拉 專家：邊境管制仍不夠 轉機旅客須控管
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Comprehensive Ebola prevention and containment: Experts say border controls are still insufficient; transit passengers must be monitored.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Africa continues to expand, prompting Taiwan’s CDC to tighten border controls against entrants from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From June 2, entry is prohibited for residents of these countries, with four exempt groups including degree-seeking students admitted to Taiwan, diplomatic/official personnel, and spouses of Taiwanese nationals. Since May 27, travelers with a Congo/Uganda travel history within the past 21 days face border quarantine and 21-day self-health management with daily monitoring. WHO data through May 29 show the DRC with 125 confirmed Ebola cases, 906 suspected, 17 confirmed deaths, and 223 suspected deaths; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Huang Gaobing, deputy director of the Infection Control Center at China Medical University Hospital, says border controls remain insufficient and urges stricter management of transit passengers. An expert meeting is planned to review and strengthen border controls to curb cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の全面的な防止と封じ込め：専門家は国境管制が不十分だと指摘。乗り継ぎ旅客の管理が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はアフリカで拡大しており、IHR基準で異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、渡航制限リスク（Yes）の3つが該当。さらにWPRO基準でも重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性が該当し、複数国での社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行と、台湾の国境管制対応が主要テーマである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。台湾はDRCの流行を受けて対応している二次的な主題であり、DRCが流行の主舞台。WHO確認症例数：DRC 125例、ウガンダ9例、合計死亡数は40例以上で重篤な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola afeta preparação de Congo e dificulta ida de torcedores à Copa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola affects Congo's preparations and makes it harder for fans to travel to the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) since early May is affecting the DRC’s World Cup preparations and fans’ travel. The three World Cup host countries—Canada, Mexico, and the United States—imposed a 21-day quarantine for anyone who has been in the DRC, hindering preparation and potentially excluding Congolese supporters from the tournament, the country’s first World Cup appearance since 1974. While the quarantine does not directly affect players, some coaching staff living in the region had to depart earlier to avoid restrictions. Consequently, a planned preparation stage was scrapped: three days in Kinshasa with Congolese fans were removed from the schedule due to sanitary concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴの準備に影響し、ファンのワールドカップ参加を困難にする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）し、複数国での対応措置が実施されている。エボラウイルス感染症は常に報告が必要な疾患である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ流行は2026年5月初旬よりDRC（キンシャサ）で発生している。米国・メキシコ・カナダがDRCからの入国者に21日間の隔離を課しており、ワールドカップ準備への影響と国際的な渡航制限が実施されている状態。発生地域にUS・Mexico・Canadaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行であり、これら3国は隔離措置の実施国であって感染発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高いリスク疾患であり、IHR(2005)Annex2の4基準をすべて満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Thai DDC monitors influenza outbreaks as cases top 170,000 nationwide
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control (DDC) reports 171,731 cumulative influenza cases and 16 deaths nationwide as of May 28, 2026, with the Digital Disease Surveillance system. The highest illness rate is in children aged 5–9, followed by 0–4 and 10–14. Total cases are below the same period last year but above the five-year median. Surveillance of influenza-like illness (ILI) and pneumonia in DDC hospital networks, in cooperation with the Department of Medical Sciences and the Thailand MOPH-US CDC Collaboration, shows influenza B as the most frequently detected strain. Public health measures urged include personal hygiene, mask-wearing, and frequent hand washing, alongside annual vaccination for high-risk groups to prevent further outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: タイDDCがインフルエンザ集団発生を監視、全国で症例数17万件超え
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるインフルエンザB型の集団発生で症例数は多いが、死亡数は限定的（16人）で重症度は中程度。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限への言及がなく、IHR基準該当は不確実。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度で部分的に該当するが、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited Statesが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はタイ国内のインフルエンザ集団発生であり、米国での発生状況の記載がないため verified_locations から除外した。死亡数16人は重症度を示唆するが、記事では死亡率などの詳細情報が不明確。継続的な疫学監視報告であり、今後の動向追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns travel bans could harm response to new Ebola strain | News.az
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving an outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province (epicenter) with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of May 31, 2026, WHO reports 134 confirmed cases across Congo and Uganda and 18 deaths, while Congolese authorities say suspected cases exceed 1,000 since the outbreak was declared on May 15. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged nations to roll back border closures and travel bans, arguing they hinder transparent reporting and local response. Travel restrictions have been imposed by the United States and Canada for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda have tightened entries, with Rwanda barring foreign nationals who passed through Congo in the last 30 days. The international response should prioritize supporting local communities to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新しいエボラ株への対応を害する可能性があるとして渡航禁止令に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべてで満たす。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の多国間での確認事例、死亡者報告、複数国への拡大、および国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置が発動されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の発生。DRC（Ituri Province が震源）での確認患者134名、死亡者18名。Uganda での確認患者もあり。2026年5月15日に宣言。ワクチンおよび認可治療薬なし。複数国（米国、カナダ、ルワンダ、ウガンダ）が渡航制限を実施。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるが、地域スクリーニング上は極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'deeply alarming', MSF warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri province remains 'deeply alarming' two weeks after declaration, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. In Bunia, WHO chief Tedros visited to bolster containment amid ongoing conflict and border/airport closures hampering response. Local lab in Bunia (National Institute for Biomedical Research) now delivers results within 24 hours, easing delays caused by transporting samples 1,500 km to Kinshasa. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, which has no proven vaccine and carries about a one-third fatality rate. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects; spillover from animal hosts (fruit bats) is possible. Brazil is investigating a suspected imported case in São Paulo in a person recently returned from DR Congo. Emphasis on community involvement and safer funeral practices remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大は「極めて懸念される」とMSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国への国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例、ブラジルで疑い例）、死亡率約3分の1の危険な株による深刻な流行であり、国際的な対応が必要な事態である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示した発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは9件の確認例と1件の死亡を報告しているのみで主要な発生地ではないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。DRCが主要な発生地であり、ブラジルは疑い例の報告がある対象国のため両国を採用。

article.articleHeadline: Ljekari bez granica upozoravaju: Širenje ebole u Kongu je alarmantno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn: The spread of Ebola in Congo is alarming.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths in DR Congo, while neighboring Uganda reports nine cases and one death. MSF warns the spread is alarming two weeks after the WHO declared an epidemic. Ituri province is the hardest hit, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the region to bolster control efforts; officials warn funeral practices such as touching the deceased increase transmission risk. Border and airport closures and fighting in eastern Congo hinder responses. A Bunia laboratory can test samples in 24 hours, speeding diagnosis and treatment. Brazil is investigating a suspected imported case—a 37-year-old man recently returned from DR Congo and in isolation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine, with mortality around one-third of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団が警告：コンゴのエボラ拡大は深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ブラジルでの症例）、高い死亡率、ワクチンなし、制御困難性が確認される。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にUgandaとBrazilを含めているが、記事サマリーではUgandaは隣接国での輸入症例のみ、Brazilも輸入疑い症例として言及されている。主たる発生国はDRCのみであるため verified_locations にはDRCのみ列挙。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスクが高く、Bundibugyo株でワクチンなし、死亡率33%、funeral practiceによる伝播リスク、武力紛争による制御困難など、複数の懸念要因が存在。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: LIVE Snelle verspreiding van ebola in Congo is "zeer alarmerend", Artsen Zonder Grenzen wil dringend meer gespecialiseerde hulp | VRT NWS Nieuws
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIVE: Rapid spread of Ebola in Congo is "extremely alarming", Doctors Without Borders urgently calls for more specialized help | VRT NWS News
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-31, the WHO published a list of the most promising candidate medicines and vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola driving the current outbreak in Congo; there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy yet. Three treatment candidates are monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab, and the antiviral remdesivir, or their combination. For prevention among contacts of suspected/confirmed cases, obeldesivir is highlighted, contingent on effective contact tracing, which remains challenging in parts of Congo. Vaccine candidates include the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by IAVI, which would take 7–9 months to reach clinical testing, and the ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine from the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India. The Ervebo vaccine against the Zaire Ebola strain is not approved for Bundibugyo and may not be effective against this variant. WHO says these options are sufficiently promising to warrant prioritized clinical evaluation under an epidemic-focused R&D acceleration program.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染の急速な拡大は「非常に懸念される」、国境なき医師団がより多くの専門的支援を緊急に要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の急速拡大がコンゴで報告されており、IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行可能性が高い。社会的関心も国際的支援ニーズも明確。
triage.notes: 記事本文がないため詳細な検証が制限されているが、サマリーより：(1) Bundibugyo株エボラの「急速な拡大」がコンゴで確認、(2) 医学的に深刻（治療法・ワクチン未承認、複数の候補治療法がWHOにより評価段階）、(3) インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン開発に関与する点から医療関連として含める。イギリスは記事主題の発生地域ではないため除外。接触追跡の困難性も指摘されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Snelle verspreiding ebola in Congo is 'zeer alarmerend', aldus Artsen Zonder Grenzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is 'highly alarming', according to Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths attributed to Bundibugyo virus. The outbreak is unfolding rapidly; authorities warn that the true scale remains uncertain and hundreds of samples await analysis. A new laboratory in Bunia now enables local testing, reducing the need to ship samples 1,500 kilometers to Kinshasa and helping slow transmission. The violence-plagued Ituri region, with weak government presence and competing armed groups over mining areas, hampers humanitarian response. Doctors Without Borders urges community ownership to accelerate control measures. Families have protested at treatment centers over body-handling and concerns about further spread of the virus. In Brazil, health authorities are investigating a probable Ebola case in São Paulo in a 37-year-old man recently returned from the DRC; if confirmed, it would be the first non-African case in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラの急速な拡大は「非常に危機的」とされており、国境なき医師団によると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たし、DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（1,000件以上の疑似症例、246人以上の死亡）、ブラジルへの国際的な疑似症例の報告があり、国際的な拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州でBundibugyo virus によるエボラアウトブレイク進行中。ブラジルではサンパウロで帰国者から疑似症例が報告されており、非アフリカ地域での初の確認症例となる可能性がある。暴力的な地域での治安悪化が対応を阻害している。WHO通知要件を大幅に上回るシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: अब इस वायरस को लेकर हरियाणा में अलर्ट, अस्पतालों को जारी हुई विशेष एडवाइजरी...विदेश से आने वालों पर पैनी नजर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now Haryana is on alert regarding this virus, with a special advisory issued to hospitals... close watch on those arriving from abroad.
article.articleSummary: High alert in Haryana as Ebola virus outbreak prompts statewide Health Advisory. The Haryana government and State Health Department have gone on full alert amid global Ebola cases. A Health Advisory issued to Civil Surgeons of all districts, government hospitals, and medical colleges directs vigilant monitoring of travelers returning from affected countries. If anyone presents Ebola-like symptoms, they will be promptly tracked and isolated. All district hospitals must reserve dedicated isolation wards for suspected cases and ensure ample stocks of PPE kits, N-95 masks, and essential life-support medications. Doctors, nurses, and paramedical staff are instructed to follow established protocols for identifying suspected cases, collecting samples, and treating patients safely to prevent transmission. Currently, no Ebola cases have been reported in Haryana. The notice underscores preparedness and rapid response measures to avert local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州がエボラウイルスに関する警報を発令、病院に特別勧告を発行...海外からの入国者に厳重な監視
triage.triage_reason: インドで予防的警報が発令されており異常/予想外と判断できるが、現時点で確定患者はなく、実際のイベント発生がない。情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは『現在、ハリヤナ州ではエボラ患者は報告されていない』と明記しており、これは海外での事例に対する予防的警報である。確定患者・死亡者なし。スクリーニング基準『異常/予想外』に該当するが、実際の感染事例がないため WATCH 判定。動物→ヒト感染の可能性や国際的拡大リスクについては記事で言及されていないため『不明』と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Példátlan gyorsasággal terjed a halálos kór - újabb világjárvány jön?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly disease is spreading at an unprecedented speed — is another pandemic coming?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at unprecedented speed: over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases reported in two weeks since the outbreak declaration, with at least 246 deaths; hundreds more samples awaiting laboratory confirmation. WHO Director-General urged affected communities to participate actively and warned that funeral rites involving contact with the deceased can fuel transmission. MSF notes border and airport closures hinder delivery of aid and supplies. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no proven vaccine, unlike the Zaire strain which has a vaccine. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids (blood, vomit, saliva, urine, sweat) and via contaminated objects such as bedding and medical equipment. The true size is uncertain and likely undercounted due to limited laboratory capacity in DRC. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976; Bundibugyo previously caused outbreaks in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012).

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な病が前例のない速度で拡散している - 別のパンデミックが来るのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い死亡率、ワクチン不在の希少株（Bundibugyo）での発生は、国際的に深刻な懸念を招く。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRCでの発生を報道しており、ウガンダは過去の参考事例として言及されている。Bundibugyo株はワクチン開発が未成熟であり、2週間で1,000件以上の疑い例と246死亡が報告されている点が重大。国境・空港閉鎖による人道支援への阻害も確認され、国際的なパンデミック懸念を喚起している。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtící ebola se šíří. Podezření hlásí už i největší země Jižní Ameriky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola is spreading. Even the largest country in South America is reporting suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread: a 37-year-old man in Brazil is in hospital quarantine after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever and other Ebola symptoms; if confirmed, it would be the first Ebola case in Brazil. The outbreak began mid-May in Ituri Province, DR Congo, and has since reached Uganda. World Health Organization data show 906 suspected Congo cases (including 223 suspected deaths) and nine confirmed Uganda cases (including one death). The Bundibugyo lineage driving transmission currently has no approved treatment or vaccine, with mortality estimated between 25% and 90%. This marks the seventeenth Ebola epidemic since 1976; the largest occurred in West Africa in 2013–2014, killing over 11,000. Suspicions have also appeared in Europe (Austria, Italy), a US physician has been hospitalized, and Czech authorities are monitoring, while air travel remains a low-risk transmission route under normal conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラが拡大。南米最大級の国でも疑い例が報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国間伝播（DRC→ウガンダ→ブラジル→欧州・米国への疑い例）、高い死亡率（25～90%）、承認済み治療法なしの現状、および複数国での事例確認により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確であり、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ感染の実際の発生国としてDRC（発端地：イトゥリ州）とウガンダでの確定例、ブラジルでの疑い例が明記されている。オーストリア、イタリア、チェコ、米国での疑い例の言及があるが、これらはサマリー上で『疑い（suspicions）』として記載されており、実際の感染症発生国ではなく監視対象と判断。対象国リストのうち、DRC（203312）とBrazil（3469034）のみが実際の発生地として verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Desak Tinjau Ulang Pembatasan Perjalanan akibat Wabah Ebola 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Urges Reevaluation of Travel Restrictions Due to the 2026 Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO chief Tedros urged reevaluation of travel restrictions and border closures amid a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. At Bunia, Ituri Province, he stressed community-centered responses and cautioned that visa suspensions and border shutdowns could impede transparent case reporting. Canada and the United States have restricted travel for residents from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda tightened border controls, with Rwanda banning foreigners who recently traveled to the Congo (within 30 days). The outbreak is concentrated in eastern DRC’s Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, plus Uganda. As of May 29, 2026, WHO reports at least 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, with over 1,000 suspected cases since the May 15 outbreak declaration. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; authorities continue coordinated surveillance and local engagement to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、2026年エボラ出血熱の流行に伴う渡航制限の見直しを促促
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の多数死亡例を伴う確認症例および疑い例、複数国への国際的拡大、各国による渡航制限・国境閉鎖の実施により、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻で国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地：DRC（イツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）およびウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。2026年5月31日付の報道であり、タイムスタンプが将来日付（2026年）となっているため、実際の配信日時の確認が必要。カナダ、米国、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに追加しない。

article.articleHeadline: Somaliland oo diyaargarowga ugu jirta cudurka Ebola - Radio Dalsan
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Somaliland is stepping up Ebola preparedness after cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In Hargeysa, Minister Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi chaired a briefing on evaluating and strengthening national readiness to prevent and respond to an Ebola outbreak. The government aims to align with global standards, initiating a series of national meetings inviting other ministries, international organizations, and health partners to ensure coordinated, sustained vigilance. Somaliland emphasizes safeguarding public health and rapid access to safe, quality services, and readiness to deploy laboratory capacity and isolation facilities if needed. The gathering highlighted ongoing planning and collaboration with international partners. Participants included the deputy minister, the director general, and experts from General Health, Planning and Policy, Immunization and Child Health, Emergency Affairs, and the National Laboratory, signaling a whole-of-government approach.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリランドがエボラ出血熱への準備態勢を強化 - ラジオダルサン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の予防的準備報告であり、ソマリランド自体での確認患者はなし。DRCとウガンダでの事例を受けた予防措置であるため、現在の段階では直接的な公衆衛生影響は確認されていないが、エボラの高い重篤性と国際的拡大リスクを考慮し、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはソマリランド（ソマリアの一部）の準備会議を主題としているが、ソマリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。一方、実際のエボラ事例はDRC（対象国）とウガンダで報告されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。ソマリランドは国際的な懸念の対象地域だが、現時点での確認患者はない。DRCでのエボラ流行の詳細情報が不足しているため、フルRRAで追加情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية .. جهود محلية ودولية لمحاصرة التفشي الجديد لوباء إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Local and international efforts to contain the new Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged local communities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to play a pivotal role in containing the new Ebola outbreak. His appeal followed his arrival in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, which is identified as the outbreak’s main hotspot. The statements emphasize a coordinated response that combines local community engagement with international support to curb Ebola transmission in the affected districts. The report notes the ongoing focus on mobilizing residents in the affected areas to cooperate with containment efforts, underscoring the importance of community leadership in controlling the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の新規流行封じ込めに向けた地域的・国際的取り組み
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において極めて高いリスクを持つ疾患であり、新規流行の発生と複数の基準該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、およびWHO事務局長による直接介入と国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の新規流行がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアを震源地として報告されており、WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際支援体制の構築が進行中。この疾患の致死性、ヒト-ヒト感染性、地域紛争下での管理困難性を考慮するとフルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Fifth confirmed case of Wuhan virus in Singapore: MOH
article.articleSummary: Fifth Wuhan virus case confirmed in Singapore: a 56-year-old Chinese woman from Wuhan who arrived on Jan 18. She was asymptomatic on the flight, developed symptoms on Jan 24, and was admitted to Tan Tock Seng Hospital on Jan 26. Test results confirmed Wuhan coronavirus infection on Jan 27; she is now warded in an NCID isolation room and is stable. She has no known links to the other confirmed imported cases and had been staying at home on Ceylon Road since symptom onset. As of Monday noon, 62 suspect cases tested negative, four tested positive, and the fifth case was confirmed at 2pm. MOH identified 115 close contacts from the first four cases; 86 remain in Singapore, with 75 contacted and quarantined or isolated; 11 await contact. Close contacts will be quarantined 14 days; low-risk contacts under daily surveillance. Earlier Singapore cases included a 66-year-old Wuhan man at Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa, his 37-year-old son, and a 53-year-old woman; the fourth case was a 36-year-old Chinese man from Wuhan at Village Hotel Sentosa. China reports 81 deaths and >2,700 cases. New measures include enhanced temperature screening and compulsory leave for students/teachers returning from China.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールで武漢ウイルスの5番目の確定患者：MOH
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の国際的なヒト-ヒト伝播を示す異常なイベント。シンガポールへの輸入症例が増加し、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク、重症度（死亡報告あり）が認められIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではシンガポールでの症例報告が主題だが、対象国リストではシンガポール（GeoNames ID 1880251）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはChinaのみに限定。中国での81死亡と2,700以上の症例報告、シンガポールへの輸入症例の増加、および新規対策の実施から、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の全項目が該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: PANIKA U AMERICI: Laboratorijski majmun napao radnika, svijet u strahu od novog 'Wuhana'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PANIC IN AMERICA: A LABORATORY MONKEY ATTACKED A WORKER, THE WORLD FEARS A NEW 'WUHAN'
article.articleSummary: Montana Republicans urge an urgent investigation into Rocky Mountain Laboratory after a November 2025 incident in which a lab worker, protected by PPE, was bitten by a monkey infected with Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Ebola strain; the employee did not contract disease and returned to work. Three months later, in February 2026, the same worker faced a potential exposure to Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever while handling lab mice due to a PPE gap. Senator Tim Sheehy, citing these events, warned, 'we do not want Montana to be the next Wuhan' and pressed the state inspector general for scrutiny. The piece also reports Laura Loomer’s allegations that security lapses point to a national-security scandal and claims against Vincent Munster—no criminal charges were filed against him—stemming from a January 2026 Africa trip and a Detroit airport detainment over bottles of unknown contents. A whistleblower alleges unrestricted access for Munster and colleagues at the facility, prompting calls for thorough vetting of scientists with foreign ties.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカでパニック：実験室のサルが労働者を攻撃、世界が新たな『武漢』を懸念
triage.triage_reason: CCHF・エボラに関する懸念を示唆する記事だが、実際の感染症発生ではなく、実験室での曝露インシデントの報道である。感染者が出ていない点、情報が論争的・推測的である点から、フルRRAの前にさらなる検証が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は実験室での曝露インシデント（2025年11月、2026年2月）についての報道であり、実際の感染症患者の発生を報告していない。曝露した労働者は感染していない。Montana（米国）での事象だが、対象国リストに米国は含まれないため、verified_locationsはChinaのみ（『新たな武漢』との比較言及による）。記事は政治的・推測的な主張を多く含むため、事実検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tingkat Kematian Ebola Bundibugyo Mencapai 50 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo ebolavirus case fatality rate reaches 50 percent.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Bundibugyo ebolavirus could reach a 50% case fatality rate as the 2026 Ebola outbreak unfolds in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Technical lead Anais Legand notes historical CFRs for Bundibugyo of 30–50%. No commercial vaccine tailored to Bundibugyro exists yet; supportive care remains recommended. Two vaccine candidates show promise: single-dose rVSV Bundibugyro by IAVI (development expected in 7–9 months) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyro from Oxford and Serum Institute of India, estimated for clinical evaluation within 2–3 months. Outbreak status (as of 28 May 2026): 125 confirmed cases, 17 deaths across 13 health zones; 906 suspected cases with 223 deaths. WHO emergency status persists but travel/trade bans are not advised; strict exit screening for travelers from affected areas is required. EU political pressure, including Italy’s Meloni, calls for stronger border surveillance. Testing expansion may push case counts higher while peak remains uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの致命率が50％に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高い致命率、国際的拡大リスク、国境検査強化への政治的圧力）。WPROスクリーニングでも5項目全て該当。CEPR対象国DRCで確認された大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: イタリア・インドは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主たるアウトブレイク地で、イタリアは政治的圧力の国、インドはワクチン開発関連国のため除外。125確認例、17死亡、906疑い例、223死亡という大規模アウトブレイク。ワクチン候補の開発進行中（7-9ヶ月、2-3ヶ月）が記載されている。WHO緊急事態ステータス継続中だが、渡航・貿易制限は勧告されていない一方、厳格な出国時スクリーニング実施。

article.articleHeadline: Gigitan HPR di Kabupaten TTU Tahun 2026 Tembus 1231 Kasus, 1 Korban Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies-Transmitting Animal Bites in Timor Tengah Utara Regency in 2026 Surpass 1,231 Cases, 1 Fatality
article.articleSummary: Rabies-transmitting animal bites in Timor Tengah Utara Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, reached 1,231 cases from January through May 2026, with 1 fatality. Plh Kepala Dinas Kesehatan Pauyulia Alfira reported the tally on May 31, 2026. Bites are predominantly from dogs, and TTU is described as an endemic rabies area with suspicion that all dogs may be infected. Authorities urge anyone bitten by a rabies-transmitting animal to seek immediate care to receive post-exposure prophylaxis (VAR). Dog-health surveillance runs on day 7 and day 21; if the dog remains healthy by day 21, the victim’s VAR course ends by day 7, and no VAR on day 21 is required. A multi-sector response is urged, including dog vaccination, culling of unowned rabies-positive animals, and intensified public education by the Information Service. Ongoing rabies control efforts rely on cross-sector collaboration in TTU.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ティモール・テンガー・ウタラ県の狂犬病媒介動物咬傷1,231件を超える、1人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地方自治体における狂犬病の高い発生率（5ヶ月間で1,231件、死亡者1名）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度（死亡）、流行しやすさ（犬媒介、地方病性）、管理可能性（多セクター対応呼びかけ）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月31日配信（将来日時）。ティモール・テンガー・ウタラ（TTU）県が地方病性狂犬病地域として記載されており、短期間での多数の咬傷事例（5ヶ月間で1,231件）と死亡事例は異常。当局による多セクター対応（犬予防接種、野犬の淘汰、公衆教育）が報告されており、管理課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virüsü Brezilya'ya mı sıçradı! Yolcu São Paulo'da karantinaya alındı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has the Ebola virus jumped to Brazil? A passenger was quarantined in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths reported, while neighboring Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. The WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia, the eastern city hardest hit, urging an end to risky funeral rituals that fuel transmission and noting concern over community spread. In Bunia, authorities have deployed hygiene disinfection at airports and urged cessation of traditional rites. The outbreak is linked to a deadly Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine, and treatment remains supportive, with about one-third of patients dying. Separately, Brazil confirmed a suspected imported case in São Paulo: a 37-year-old man who had returned from DRC was quarantined in a specialized Infectious Diseases institute.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがブラジルに飛び火したのか？乗客がサンパウロで隔離された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、予想外の国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。DRC・ウガンダでの大規模エボラ流行と、ブラジルへの輸入症例確認により、国際的公衆衛生脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行は1,000件以上の疑い患者と246死亡を報告。ウガンダでも9確認患者1死亡。Bundibugyo型ウイルスはワクチンなし。ブラジルサンパウロで37歳男性（DRC帰国者）の輸入症例が確認され隔離。WHO事務局長もBunia訪問。国際的リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго зафиксирована очередная вспышка лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola outbreak recorded in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading unusually fast at the outset, according to MSF. As of May 20, 2026, eleven medical zones across Ituri and North Kivu provinces—centered on Bunia—are affected. The rapid early transmission has overwhelmed health systems and logistics; local laboratories are overloaded, with hundreds of blood samples awaiting testing, hindering rapid isolation of contacts. MSF and other responders have deployed additional mobile laboratories to accelerate testing and bring cases under control. Officials emphasize that Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The WHO Director-General visited Bunia to oversee operations. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has stepped up border controls as a precaution. No global threat is implied, with a focus on regional containment and medical infrastructure support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の新たな流行が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行であり、初期段階で異常に急速に伝播しており、複数の医療圏が影響を受け、保健システムが圧倒され、国際的な対応が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州およびNorth Kivu州のBuniaを中心とした11の医療圏で流行が確認されている。Bundibugyo株は確認されたエボラウイルス種の一つであり、初期段階での異常な急速伝播、保健システムの圧倒、検査能力の不足が報告されている。ロシアは国境管理を強化しているが、サマリーでは「グローバルな脅威は示唆されていない」と述べられているため、現段階では地域的な封じ込めが主眼である。ただしWHO事務局長が現地を訪問するなど国際的対応が既に展開されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: [Video] Tổng giám đốc WHO trực tiếp tới tâm dịch Ebola ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Video] The WHO Director-General travels directly to the Ebola epicenter in Congo.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled directly to the Ebola epicenter in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster international efforts against an outbreak that has killed hundreds. Africa CDC reports more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths in less than two weeks in the affected region. WHO says it will continue supporting Congo’s outbreak response and emphasizes the crucial role of local communities in the response. The visit highlights ongoing international involvement as health authorities coordinate efforts to manage the outbreak in the eastern DRC and prevent further impact on local populations. The epicenter remains under close scrutiny by international health agencies.

triage.headline_ja: [動画] WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱感染の中心地を直接視察
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全項目該当。数百人の死亡、2週間以下で1,000人以上の疑似症例、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い社会政治的関心がある。フルRRA評価を進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生。2週間以下で246人の死亡、1,000人以上の疑似症例が報告されている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な対応の重大性を示している。東コンゴが感染の中心地とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Nearly Double As WHO Chief Rallies Response In Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare and highly challenging variant. The article reports that Ebola cases nearly double, signaling a sharp transmission upturn. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment specifically designed for Bundibugyo, leaving health workers dependent on early detection, isolation, supportive care, and rigorous contact tracing to slow spread. Ongoing response efforts are framed around strengthening surveillance, laboratory confirmation capacity, and community engagement as the WHO chief rallies partners to bolster action. Critical background emphasizes reliance on non-specific measures until genotype-targeted medical countermeasures exist. The report centers on Congo; it does not provide detailed case counts, deaths, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数がほぼ倍増、WHO事務局長がコンゴでの対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の患者数増加、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）、およびWPRO基準5つ全て該当。稀で治療法なしのBundibugyo株による患者数倍増は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルス種の中でも稀な株であり、ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しない。患者数の急速な増加（ほぼ倍増）とWHO事務局長による対応強化の呼びかけは、国際的な懸念を示唆している。詳細な患者数・死亡者数は記事サマリーに記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 感染拡大「類見ない速度」エボラ熱、医療団体が警鐘「短期間でこれほど多くの症例が...」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infection is spreading at an unprecedented speed: Ebola fever, medical organizations warn, 'So many cases in such a short period...'
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo at an unprecedented speed, with MSF warning that ‘never before have so many cases been reported in such a short period.’ Limited testing capacity leaves hundreds of samples untested.
