As of May 31, suspected Congo cases reach at least 906, with 223 deaths; neighboring Uganda has nine confirmed infections. WHO had declared a global health emergency two weeks earlier, and the outbreak remains ongoing, prompting urgent international concern and calls for expanded diagnostics and surveillance. The report underscores alarming transmission dynamics and the need for scaled-up laboratory capacity and targeted public health interventions near the Congo–Uganda border.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大「類見ない速度」エボラ熱、医療団体が警鐘「短期間でこれほど多くの症例が...」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大速度、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた拡大と高い死亡率は緊急的なリスク評価を要する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。DRCのみ記載。WHOが2週間前に国際的懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言済み。検査能力の制限により未検査サンプルが数百存在し、実際の症例数がさらに多い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: இபோலா பரிசோதனைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தும் காங்கோ, உல‌க‌ம் செய்திகள் - தமிழ் முரசு World News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Expands Ebola Testing, World News - Tamil Murasu
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surged to 260 cases, spanning three provinces and tracing back to Bunia, involving the rare Bundibugyo strain. Health Minister Roger Kamba announced U.S. assistance and said an Ebola vaccine has been approved for use and is currently mid-trial, with early results favorable. In neighboring Uganda, nine people are infected and one has died. Medical groups warn the virus is spreading faster than expected, with blood samples from more than 100 individuals being tested. Congo’s testing capacity is limited to about 200–300 samples per day, hindering rapid response; authorities plan to expand testing. Doctors Without Borders notes that current infections exceed those seen in previous outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ検査を拡大、世界ニュース - タミル・ムラス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。コンゴで260例、ウガンダで9例と複数国での活動性感染症確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「隣接するウガンダで9人が感染」と二次的な言及のみ。主題はコンゴの発生であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。稀なBundibugyo株、3州にまたがる260例、致命例あり、ワクチン試験進行中という複合的リスク要因を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Países de África oriental se reúnen de emergencia lunes y martes por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African countries hold emergency meetings on Monday and Tuesday over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, eight East African Community (EAC) health ministries will hold emergency virtual meetings on Monday and Tuesday to coordinate regional actions to contain the Ebola outbreak declared in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) on May 15. The agenda includes crisis coordination, the EAC Technical Working Groups on communicable/non-communicable diseases, and regulatory harmonization for vaccines, therapies, and diagnostics against Ebola. The EAC—comprising Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, DR Congo, and Somalia—based in Arusha, coordinates regional responses. Africa Union public health agency records 246 suspected Ebola deaths in DRC from the 17th outbreak since 1976; the outbreak has reached Uganda with eight confirmed cases, including one death from an imported Congolese case. The Bundibugyo strain has 30–50% fatality; no approved vaccine or specific treatment; WHO deems regional outbreak risk high, global risk low.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ諸国がエボラ出血熱対策で月曜日・火曜日に緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の地域的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ確認）、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準全て該当。高い公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生と地域拡大（ウガンダ8確認例、1死亡）を報告。Bundibugyo株（致命率30-50%）、ワクチン・特効薬なし。WHO地域リスク高と評価。EACによる緊急地域調整会議開催。サマリーではウガンダでの確認例が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに非含有のためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ডিআর কঙ্গোয় ইবোলার দ্রুত বিস্তার, পরিস্থিতি 'অত্যন্ত উদ্বেগজনক': এমএসএফ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola in DR Congo, the situation 'extremely worrying': MSF
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 1,000 suspected infections and at least 246 deaths in the eastern Ituri province, including Bunia. The Bundibugyo strain is driving what MSF calls an 'extremely worrying' outbreak two weeks after it was declared. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and deployed Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to oversee containment. The outbreak has crossed into neighboring Uganda, where 9 infections and 1 death are reported. Health authorities say the true scale remains uncertain, with hundreds of samples still awaiting testing. Border and airport closures are in place; humanitarian access is hampered by ongoing conflict. Emphasis is placed on community involvement, safe burial practices, and multilingual risk communication to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ＤＲコンゴのエボラの急速な拡大、状況は「極めて懸念される」：ＭＳＦ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ発生。1,000件以上の疑い症例、246以上の死亡報告、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、旅行・貿易制限実施済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは越境事例（9感染、1死亡）として言及されており、主要な発生地はＤＲコンゴのイトゥリ州。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による大規模発生、WHO事務局長派遣済み。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le chef de l'OMS en première ligne contre une épidémie d'Ebola en expansion
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the WHO Director-General on the front line against an expanding Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province’s Bunia, driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain; 17th outbreak in the country and third largest in its history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia and Ituri on May 30, 2026, urging safe burials and early care: isolation, rehydration, and symptom management. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo strain; emphasis is on rapid healthcare seeking. Local authorities report 906 suspected cases with 223 deaths under investigation, per WHO on May 29; the health minister cites 1,028 suspected cases with 225 confirmed. Attacks on health centers and community resistance hamper response. International concern extends beyond DRC with a suspected case in São Paulo, Brazil, linked to return from DRC. The outbreak’s rapid spread is outpacing the international response; urgent public health measures and secure burial practices are critical.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: WHO事務局長がエボラ流行の拡大に対抗する最前線に立つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus株による17番目のアウトブレイクであり、国内歴代3位の規模。DRC内のIturi州Buniaを中心に906～1,028の疑い患者と223～225の死亡が報告されている。ブラジル・サンパウロでの疑い例は，DRC帰還者からの二次感染の可能性があり、国際的な拡大が懸念される。ワクチンや治療法がないBundibugyo株に対しては支援的ケアが中心となる。医療施設への攻撃とコミュニティの抵抗が対応を阻害しており，WHOの直接的な関与が報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sınır Tanımayan Doktorlar: Ebola daha önce benzeri görülmemiş bir hızla yayılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Ebola is spreading at an unprecedented rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered on Bunia, is spreading at an unprecedented rate due to the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Two weeks after outbreak declaration, hundreds of suspected cases await testing, with a case-fatality risk around one in three. Response relies on isolation and supportive care, but ongoing eastern DRC conflict and insecurity hinder containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, said border and airport closures have delayed medical aid. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, prompting cross-border hygiene measures and routine disinfection at airports. Burial rituals involving washing and touching the deceased are identified as transmission risks, underscoring temporary changes in customs. Quarantines of Congo returnees suspected of Ebola, including cases in distant countries such as Brazil, illustrate potential international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：エボラがこれまでにない速度で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo変異体による未承認ワクチンのエボラアウトブレイクが前例のない速度で拡大中で、国境を越えた感染、死亡リスク（CFR約33%）、国際的な症例報告がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境感染とブラジルでの隔離ケースが言及されているが、これらは確認された発生地域ではなく、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（検証済み）のみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。ブラジルは引用されているが、実質的な発生確認ではなく、感染疑い例の隔離のみ。DRCの東部紛争と不安定性が対応を阻害している点も管理可能性を損なう重要な因子。

article.articleHeadline: Reunión de emergencia de ocho países de África ante la expansión del letal brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency meeting of eight African countries as the deadly Ebola outbreak spreads.
article.articleSummary: Eight East African Community (EAC) member states—Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and Somalia—will hold a virtual emergency meeting of health ministers Monday–Tuesday to coordinate regional response to the Ebola outbreak declared in eastern DRC on May 15. The EAC also convenes a crisis meeting and two technical working groups on transmissible diseases and on harmonizing regulations for vaccines, therapies, and diagnostics. The Africa Union public health agency cites about 246 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, the country’s 17th outbreak since 1976. In Uganda, eight infections have been confirmed, including one death from an imported Congolese case. The virus is Bundibugyo, with a 30–50% fatality rate; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, according to WHO, which flags high risk in sub-Saharan Africa but low global risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ8カ国が致命的なエボラ出血熱の拡大に直面し緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者と死亡が報告され、複数国での国際的拡大が進行中。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および社会的・政治的関心の高まり（8カ国の緊急保健大臣会議開催）により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及される8カ国のうち、対象リストに含まれるのはDRCとウガンダのみ。スーダン南部（South Sudan）、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ソマリア、タンザニア、ケニアは対象リストに含まれないため除外。DRCで246人の疑い死亡、ウガンダで8人の確定感染と1人の死亡が報告されており、重症度は高い。Bundibugyo系統で致死率30-50%。WHO指摘通りサブサハラアフリカでの高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Emergencia sanitaria: refuerzan vigilancia por ébola a días del Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health emergency: Ebola surveillance intensified as the 2026 World Cup approaches.
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance is intensified ahead of the World Cup 2026 in North America (Mexico, United States, Canada). The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are the outbreak’s focus, with Africa reporting 906 suspected cases and 246 deaths; the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The United States imposes entry restrictions for recent visitors and routes travelers who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days to screenings at Washington, Atlanta, or Houston; permanent residents face a 30-day entry ban. Infected Americans needing care may be treated in Europe, and a US center for exposed individuals is planned in Kenya with 50 quarantine beds. A US missionary infected in the DRC has been evacuated to Berlin. In Mexico, Guadalajara surveillance is activated; 1,500–2,000 Congo fans may attend the June 23 match vs Colombia at Estadio Akron, under a strict personal-tracing protocol and a sanitary corridor from airport to hotel, as the RDC team trains in Brussels.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生上の緊急事態：2026年ワールドカップが近づく中、エボラ出血熱の監視が強化される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のIHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO PHEICの宣言、国際的な渡航制限の実施、複数国への影響、死亡例の報告により、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の主な発生地がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダと明記されており、DRCはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。アメリカ、カナダ、メキシコでの監視強化やケニアでの隔離施設計画は、DRCでの発生への対応措置であり、これらの地域での二次発生ではない。WHO PHEIC宣言、死亡246例、渡航制限の実施により極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Bolest se širi sve brže: "Duboko uznemirujuća situacija"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The disease is spreading faster and faster: "A deeply disturbing situation."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province with Bunia as provincial capital, has grown. MSF calls the situation disturbing as two weeks pass since epidemic was declared in Ituri, with over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths in DRC. Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. Testing remains bottlenecked, with hundreds of samples untested; Bunia’s National Institute for Biomedical Research now provides results within 24 hours, helping case management. Previously, samples traveled over 1,500 km to Kinshasa, causing delays, with border and airport closures hindering relief. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a strain with no proven vaccine and about one-third fatal. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects; the virus typically infects animals, and human outbreaks can arise from handling infected animals. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Ituri to bolster containment and urged stronger local participation.

triage.headline_ja: 病気が次々と広がっている：「非常に懸念される状況」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模なアウトブレイク（1,000件以上の疑い患者、246人以上の死亡）がDRCで発生し、ウガンダにも波及。IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。国際的な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認例（9例、1死亡）が言及されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国該当。本イベントはIHR基準4/4、WPRO基準5/5全て該当する重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: EAC Calls Emergency Health Meeting Over Ebola Outbreak in Region
article.articleSummary: Eight East African Community member states will hold an extraordinary virtual Sectoral Council of Ministers for Health on June 1–2, 2026, as Ebola outbreaks intensify in the region. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has resulted in over 1,000 reported cases and more than 130 deaths across three countries, with the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan hardest hit; Kenya is on high alert as authorities monitor spillover. The EAC aims to strengthen cross-border surveillance, quick-response capacity, and harmonize regional health protocols to prevent further transmission. The emergency session follows intensified regional coordination and earlier crisis meetings. Separately, public debate centers on a proposed Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya for exposed American citizens; the High Court suspended plans, though Kenya expects the U.S. contribution of 1.7 billion Kenyan shillings to proceed. The meeting seeks a unified regional response to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: EACが地域のエボラ流行に関する緊急保健会議を召集
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による複数国での多数死亡例（1,000症例以上、130死亡以上）と国際的な地域調整会議の開催は、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」にも該当し、シグナルとしてフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニアの関与が明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラBundibugyo株による多国間流行で、地域的な協調対応が進行中。米国による検疫施設への資金援助（17億ケニア・シリング）についての政治的議論も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has claimed 246 lives among more than 1,000 suspected cases. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) over the latest outbreak. On 2026-05-31, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to assess the response, discuss with the community, and address challenges, as the international community assists the DRC government. He announced plans to inaugurate a large Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, replacing tents with a permanent facility. The visit underscored the emphasis on community ownership alongside international support to help the DRC government manage the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的に重要な感染症で、246人の死亡、1,000件以上の疑い患者が報告されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言。国際的な懸念と支援が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はカテゴリIA感染症。PHEIC宣言済み。246死亡は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示唆。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心の高さを反映。DRC東部のイトゥリ州ブニアに集中しているが、国際的拡大リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Alerten sobre l'"alarmant situació" a la República Democràtica del Congo pel brot d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warn about the 'alarming situation' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts warning of an 'alarming' situation. A UNICEF coordinator, in protective gear, informs residents in Goma of measures to prevent spread as the Ebola outbreak unfolds in the DRC's eastern region. Health ministers from eight East African Community member states will meet on Monday and Tuesday to discuss the outbreak first declared on May 15 in Ituri province. MSF calls the shift of cases 'deeply alarming,’ noting the rapid escalation with more cases than ever seen in such a short period. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the outbreak epicenter in Bunia, Ituri. The African Union's health agency reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has reported new confirmed cases and one death.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行について「危機的状況」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目に該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡者246名以上、東アフリカ8カ国の保健相会議開催、国際的な高度な関心が示されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の東部DRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）での流行。5月15日に初宣言、1,077疑似症例、246名以上の死亡。ウガンダでも確認症例あり。WHO事務局長が現地視察、MSFが「深刻な懸念」を表明、東アフリカ8カ国の保健相会議予定。大規模流行の急速な拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Visits Ebola Epicenter in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Dateline Kinshasa, May 31: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Ituri province, DR Congo, has produced more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the epicenter, to assess response and reinforce community engagement, stating ownership is crucial. He announced plans to inaugurate a large Ebola treatment centre in Bunia as a permanent facility rather than tents. The visit highlights ongoing international support as agencies coordinate surveillance, patient care, and community outreach to curb transmission. International support continues as agencies coordinate the response, with an emphasis on sustaining care through a permanent treatment centre and strengthening local engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,000件以上の疑い症例、246人の死亡）がWHOからPHEIC宣言を受けており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO基準で最高度のリスク疾患。PHEIC宣言済み、1,000件以上の疑い症例、246人の死亡、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など、複数の指標がシグナルの深刻性を示唆。フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Organisation mondiale de la santé : la souche actuelle d'Ebola est rare et ne dispose d'aucun vaccin - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: the current Ebola strain is rare and has no vaccine
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province capital Bunia continues, marking the seventeenth outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since discovery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited, urging rapid care and adherence to safe burial procedures as the Bundibugyo strain remains rare with no vaccine or approved treatments. Effective early management—isolation, rehydration, pain relief—is critical to reduce mortality. Attacks on health facilities during corpse retrieval rites have hindered responses. WHO logged 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation as of Friday; later that day Congo's health minister reported 1,028 suspected cases, including 225 confirmed. Separately, Brazil’s São Paulo investigated a suspect case linked to recent Congo exposure, placed in hospital quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：現在のエボラ株はまれであり、ワクチンが存在しない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（第17波、DRCで225確認症例）が報告されている。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療薬なしという懸念、国際的な症例移動（ブラジル）も確認されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアが流行の主要地点（225確認症例、1,028疑い症例）であり、ブラジルではサンパウロで疑い症例1件が報告されている。Bundibugyo株はまれで利用可能なワクチンがなく、治療法も限定的という点で公衆衛生リスクが顕著。保健施設への攻撃による対応阻害も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: اپیدمی ابولا: سازمان جهانی صحت وارد عمل شد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic: WHO Has Taken Action.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, Bunia) has spread to three DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the outbreak has at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths in the DRC, with Uganda reporting 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to engage communities and bolster support as armed-group violence in Ituri hinders response. DRC has limited laboratory capacity to confirm infections, and millions are displaced in crowded camps with poor sanitation, increasing transmission risk. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible; there is no specific treatment or approved vaccine. Travel bans for travelers from affected areas have been imposed; some airlines restrict entry to Mexico for 60 days. Zambia quarantined two suspected cases (negative); Uganda closed its border with DRC; one patient has been treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：WHO が行動を起こした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大、1,000件超の疑い患者と246死亡、国際的な移動制限と外部支援実施により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラウイルス病がコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、ブニア）で発生・確認され、隣接するウガンダへ拡大したことが明記されている。ザンビアは疑い患者を隔離（陰性確認）しており、該当対象国リストから検証済み地点は DRC と Zambia。ドイツとメキシコは患者の二次移動地点であり、イベントの発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダは記事で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、旅行制限、複数国での隔離措置により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола выходит из-под контроля - "Врачи без границ"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever spirals out of control — Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province at an unprecedented pace, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, Congo has logged over 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 deaths, with the epicenter in Ituri and spillover into North and South Kivu. Suspected cases are under investigation in Brazil. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, first identified in Uganda in 2007. MSF warns that testing backlogs and border and airport closures hamper delivery of medicines, humanitarian aid, and specialized personnel. On May 22, WHO raised national threat to 'very high' and regional threat to 'high' (global level 'low'). The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the deadliest, with over 11,300 deaths and 28,600 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱が制御不能に――国境なき医師団
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,000件以上の疑似患者、240人以上の死亡）、地域での異常拡大、国際的拡大リスク（ブラジルでの疑似患者）、渡航・貿易制限措置が実施されている。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルについては疑似患者が「調査中」とのみ記載されており、確認された発生ではないため除外。記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRC（イトゥリ州、南キブ州が中心）での発生。WHO脅威レベルは国家「非常に高い」、地域「高い」に引き上げられている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ウガンダ由来）による流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: chi arriva dal Congo o dall'Uganda deve fare una dichiarazione firmata ad Ats
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: those arriving from the Congo or Uganda must file a signed declaration with the ATS.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Italy's Ministry of Health has issued operational procedures and surveillance measures for Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) due to the ongoing Bundibugyo virus (BVD) outbreak. Travelers entering Italy from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda must, within 24 hours of arrival, submit a signed declaration to the Prevention Department of the ATS at their residence or domicile, per Article 47 of DPR 445/2000, using the form in the attachments. In Brescia, the declaration must be completed via the ATS Brescia site, include a copy of ID, and sent to malattieinfettive@ats-brescia.it. The declaration should be transmitted even if asymptomatic; the ATS will assess risk and issue surveillance instructions. If symptoms appear within 21 days after leaving an affected country/area, individuals must self-isolate, avoid contacts, contact the Prevention Department, call 112/118, and report travel, dates, areas visited and exposures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴまたはウガンダから到着した者はATSに署名された宣言書を提出する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染リスク管理に関する公式な衛生措置であり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月31日のイタリアの衛生措置に関するもので、DRCとウガンダでのブンディブギョウイルス（BVD）アウトブレイクを背景としている。Bluedot APIはイタリア（Brescia地域）も発生地域として付与しているが、記事本文の主題は対象国（DRC）からの渡航者への衛生措置であり、イタリアでの発症例報告はない。verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, obbligo di segnalazione per chi entra in Italia da Congo e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: mandatory reporting for those entering Italy from Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Mandatory reporting for travelers entering Italy from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda due to a Bundibugyo virus outbreak, part of the viral hemorrhagic fever group. Effective May 29, the rule applies to all arrivals from these countries, even if only transiting within the 21 days before entry, regardless of transport mode or presence of symptoms. Travelers must communicate their travel details to authorities to bolster surveillance and prevent importation of Bundibugyo virus disease. Bundibugyo virus is an Ebola-related pathogen implicated in outbreaks in DRC and Uganda. The article, published May 31, 2026, does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information about infections in Italy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴとウガンダからイタリアに入国する者に対する報告義務
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、Bundibugyo virus（エボラ関連ウイルス性出血熱）の国際的な移動対応として各国政府が対応している点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virusはエボラ関連ウイルス（ウイルス性出血熱）であり、DRCとウガンダでの発生が記事の主題。イタリアの措置は入国者の監視強化であり、イタリア国内での確認症例はない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。複数国への国際的な対応措置が取られていることから、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: V Brazílii je v karanténě pacient s podezřením na ebolu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Brazil, a patient with suspected Ebola is in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Brazil quarantines a patient suspected of Ebola: a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) is in isolation with fever and other symptoms, potentially the first Ebola case in Brazil if tests confirm. The outbreak began mid-May in Ituri and has spread to Uganda. By late May 2026, WHO data show 906 suspected cases in Congo with 223 suspected deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases, including one death. Ebola spreads via contact with an infected person or contaminated materials and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding. Some Ebola strains have vaccines and treatments, but the Bundibugyo variant circulating in Congo and Uganda currently lacks an approved vaccine or effective therapy. Ebola outbreaks have a broad case-fatality range (about 25–90%), with this being the seventeenth since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルではエボラが疑われている患者が隔離されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国家的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・ブラジルへの侵入リスク）、高い致命率、国際的な移動制限リスク、および社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事中で感染例が言及されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCおよびブラジルは確実にイベント対象国として記事に記載されている。Bundibugyo variant（ワクチン・有効治療なし）の国際的拡大という高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: ডিআর কঙ্গোতে ইবোলার বিস্তার গভীরভাবে উদ্বেগজনক: এমএসএফ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola in DR Congo is deeply concerning: MSF
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is deeply concerning, says MSF. Infections are spreading rapidly in eastern DRC, especially Ituri province, two weeks after the outbreak declaration. MSF deputy director Dr. Alain Gonzalez warns cases are rising faster than ever recorded, with uncertain true extent. As of 31 May 2026, Congo reports over 1,000 Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 cases and 1 death confirmed. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to oversee control efforts. MSF notes hundreds of suspected cases and testing backlogs, with border closures and airport restrictions delaying response. Transmission occurs through direct contact with infected persons and bodily fluids (blood, vomit, diarrhea, saliva, urine, semen), as well as contaminated needles, bedding, or clothing. Isolation and dehydration management with intravenous fluids and oxygen are central to care.

triage.headline_ja: ジンバブエでのエボラ出血熱の拡大は深刻な懸念：MSF
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（DRC 1,000例以上、246人の死亡、ウガンダへの拡大）により、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、およびWHO介入も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にイトゥリ州）でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を主題としており、ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO事務局長の訪問、MSFの関与、国境閉鎖など国際的な対応が既に進行中。ヒト-ヒト感染による経路が確認されており、検査バックログと対応遅延が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി; ആശങ്കപ്പെടേണ്ട സാഹചര്യമില്ലെന്ന് യുഎഇ, ജാഗ്രതാ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ പുറത്തിറക്കി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear; UAE says there is no need to worry and has issued precautionary guidelines.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, UAE authorities say there is no need for alarm over Ebola while issuing precautionary guidelines. With Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, the UAE has imposed travel restrictions to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan and strengthened surveillance at airports and borders. The Ministry of Health and Prevention, with the National Emergency Crisis and Disasters Management Authority, affirmed public health remains safe but tightened measures include enhanced traveler screening from affected areas and readiness of laboratories and hospitals for early detection. Residents are urged to rely on official information and avoid social media misinformation. Bundibugyo variant (first identified in Uganda in 2007) is noted; Ebola is not airborne and spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids—blood, saliva, urine—or contaminated clothing and needles. Incubation 2-21 days; symptoms include high fever, severe headache, fatigue, muscle and joint pain, vomiting, and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症；UAEは心配する必要がないと言い、予防措置のガイドラインを発行した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、複数国でのエボラ流行検証、国家レベルの対応と旅行制限実施により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主な対象としており、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。Uganda、South Sudan、UAEは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo variant（2007年ウガンダで初確認）が言及されており、エボラウイルスの重篇性と感染経路が明示されている。既に旅行制限が実施されており、地域的な公衆衛生対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de ebola no Brasil seguem sob investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Brazil remain under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil remain under investigation as of 31 May 2026. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo who recently traveled to the DRC and Uganda presented in São Paulo with high fever and Ebola-compatible symptoms; preliminary meningitis diagnosis, with a specific Ebola test due by 1 June. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian traveler who had been in Uganda is also under investigation; he was diagnosed with malaria but will remain isolated until Ebola testing at the Evandro Chagas Institute of Infectology (INI/Fiocruz) confirms results. The São Paulo Health Secretariat reports adherence to the National Contingency Plan, including isolation and epidemiological/laboratory investigations. The Health Ministry says Brazil’s risk is very low, with no autochthonous transmission in South America and no direct flights from affected regions. For Bundibugyo Ebola, there are no licensed vaccines or proven therapies; existing vaccines/therapies target the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの疑い例エボラ症例は調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2件のエボラ疑い症例が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダからの渡航者）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、管理可能性（公式対応中）が該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例の調査。DRCとウガンダは患者の渡航元であり、実際の発症地はサンパウロとリオデジャネイロ（ブラジル）。Bundibugyo Ebola株の特性上、既存ワクチン・治療の効果が限定的であり、検査確定待ちの状況。保健省は「ブラジルのリスクは非常に低い」と評価しているが、国際的な感染症監視対象として優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: World News | WHO Chief Visits Epicentre of Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province of eastern DR Congo, a severe Ebola outbreak has been declared. The outbreak has killed 246 people and there are more than 1,000 suspected cases. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to monitor the response, engage with communities, and discuss challenges, while authorities plan to inaugurate a large Ebola treatment centre as a permanent facility rather than tents. The visit underscores international support and emphasis on community ownership in the response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース｜WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。246人の死亡、1,000件以上の疑似症例を伴う重篤なエボラウイルス病の流行である。
triage.notes: DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言とWHO事務局長の訪問という国際的に極めて重大なイベントであり、全世界的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として判定。記事サマリーは東部コンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州ブニアでの発生を明確に述べており、該当地域は正確に検証されている。

article.articleHeadline: مُنظّمة الصحة العالمية : سلالة 'إيبولا' الحالية نادرة ولا لقاحات لها | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The current Ebola strain is rare and there are no vaccines for it | Today's Press - a university daily newspaper
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) is rare and has no vaccines or approved treatments, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of 2026-05-31, the outbreak—the seventh Ebola cluster in the DRC and the third largest since discovery—stresses early care (isolation, rehydration, pain relief) and strict safe burial practices. The region’s Ituri capital Bunia reported initial cases earlier this month; Brazil also reported a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo linked to recent travel from Congo, currently isolated in hospital. Authorities reported 906 suspected cases with 223 suspected deaths under investigation; later updates showed 1028 suspected cases with 225 confirmed cases. The situation underscores ongoing transmission risks and the need for rapid public health measures to curb spread. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：現在のエボラウイルス株は稀で、ワクチンがない | 今日のプレス - 大学系日刊紙
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たす（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の新規株、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus新株による大規模なエボラ流行で、DRC（Ituri州）での確認死亡者225名、疑い例1028名に達し、ブラジルへの拡大も報告されており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRC（Ituri州Bunia）がBundibugyo ebolavirus流行の主要発生地で、ブラジル（サンパウロ）へも輸入症例が報告されている。ワクチン・承認治療がない稀なウイルス株という点で、リスクが高い。WHO事務局長による公式声明が含まれ、社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola en RDC : le message fort du directeur général de l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the strong message from the WHO Director-General
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province's Bunia, is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been at least 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and 246 deaths, with spread to several provinces and into neighboring Uganda, which has nine confirmed cases and one death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, expressed optimism that the epidemic can be stopped, noting DRC’s history of eradicating 16 previous outbreaks; this is the 17th. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids, making safe burials and community trust critical to containment. Some patients in Ituri have recovered with timely medical care. Trials are under way to develop vaccines and treatments for this strain; Africa CDC says a vaccine could be ready by year-end. The WHO cautions the true scale may be larger than detected due to undetected spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行：WHO事務局長からの強いメッセージ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）による大規模流行で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRCで1,077例の疑い患者と246死亡、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからウガンダへの拡大が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリストに含まれるため記載。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスでワクチン・特異的治療法がない点、ウイルスの真の感染規模が検出以上である可能性がWHOによって警告されている点は、国際公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Bos WHO Ingatkan Bahaya Menyentuh Jenazah Pasien Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief warns of the dangers of touching the body of an Ebola patient.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the Ebola epicenter in Kongo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to oversee the ongoing outbreak response. He arrived at Kinshasa's airport on May 28, 2026, and spoke at a press conference on May 30, 2026, noting that Congo has faced Ebola 16 times and ended each outbreak; this would be the 17th. He urged active community participation and emphasized safe burial practices, warning against touching bodies of people suspected or confirmed with Ebola to prevent further transmission. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected body fluids—blood, diarrhea, saliva, urine, semen, and sweat—and via contaminated objects such as needles, bedding, or clothing. The remarks stress stopping transmission while honoring mourners.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラウイルス病患者の遺体に接触する危険性について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病発生が確認され、IHR基準4項目中3項目（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により国際的な高い関心が示されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの危険病原体。記事ではコンゴ民主共和国のキニャサとブニア地域での発生が明確に述べられている。WHO事務局長による現地視察は国際的な対応の重要性を示す。第17次の発生と述べられており、同国における反復的なリスク。ヒト-ヒト感染が可能で、葬儀時の接触感染リスクが強調されている点から、コミュニティ感染のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ призвал пересмотреть запреты на поездки на фоне борьбы ДРК со вспышкой Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General urges review of travel bans amid the DRC's fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Travel bans tied to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda should be reviewed, urges WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, arguing restrictions hinder outbreak response, transparency, and trust. Speaking in Bunia, Ituri, he noted that while there are no approved vaccines or specific antivirals, timely, quality medical care can save lives. The outbreak has generated over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases. Uganda reports nine confirmed cases after two new infections in Kampala. In the DRC, containment focuses on Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with strengthened laboratory capacity: about 900 samples tested, around 260 positives. The country now emphasizes processing all arriving samples, with daily testing potentially rising to 200–300. The response underscores community engagement, rapid diagnostics, and coordinated measures to halt spread and prevent further transmission. Key locations: Bunia (Ituri), Kampala (Uganda), Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu (DRC).

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱との戦いの最中、DRCへの渡航禁止の見直しを促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ）であり、1000件以上の疑い患者、260件以上の確定患者が報告されている。WHO事務局長による渡航禁止見直しの声明は高い国際的関心を示唆している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが、記事サマリーではウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの発生が主題であり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれている。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い優先度の感染症であり、多国間での確定患者、WHO事務局長による公式声明、国際的な渡航制限措置など、すべての観点からフルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: News: Ebola: EAC health ministers to hold emergency meeting
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain in the DRC and Uganda prompts an extraordinary East African Community health ministers meeting (June 1–2, 2026) to coordinate a regional response. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. By May 26, the DRC reported 121 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, plus 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda had nine confirmed cases and one death by May 30. The first two confirmed Ugandan cases had travelled from the DRC. The epicenter is Ituri Province (Mongbwalu), with cross-border transmission risk to Uganda and neighboring nations. Nine mobile laboratories will be deployed at borders and high-risk sites: Beni (DRC); Busia (Kenya); Nimule-Elegu (South Sudan–Uganda); Kobero (Burundi); Kagera and Kigoma (Tanzania); Kisenyi and Kihundwe (Rwanda); Bwera Hospital (Kasese, Uganda). UVRI will serve as regional referral lab. TEACH training, Rapidly Deployable Expert Pool (>180 responders), and partnerships with Africa CDC, WHO, Germany, and the EU aim to enhance surveillance, diagnostics, IPC, risk communication, and cross-border readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：EAC保健大臣が緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（重篤な健康被害、異常な病原体、国際的拡大リスク、国境管理への影響）。ブンディブギョ株による多国間のエボラ流行で、DRCとウガンダで確認症例・死亡があり、地域的な対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるケニア、タンザニア、ルワンダ、南スーダン、ブルンジ、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため除外。ただしDRCは対象国のため含める。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株（ワクチンなし、治療薬なし）による多国間流行の危険性が高く、即座のRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, chi arriva dal Congo sarà tracciabile. Il ministero prepara 5 livelli di intervento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, those arriving from Congo will be traceable. The ministry is preparing five levels of intervention.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA: Italy's Health Ministry published a circular in the Official Journal outlining five risk levels to manage arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreaks are active. Travelers at risk must disembark at Rome's Fiumicino airport and be escorted to Spallanzani; others must provide data and remain traceable. Exposures are classified as high-risk or not high-risk. High-risk exposures include close, unprotected contact with a symptomatic case; unprotected sex with a case up to three months after recovery; contact with contaminated materials or fluids from a probable or confirmed case; percutaneous or mucous membrane exposure to such fluids or lab samples; participation in funeral rites with direct exposure to remains; or direct contact with bats, rodents, non-human primates, or wild game meat from affected areas. Casual contact is not high-risk. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in eastern DRC; the outbreak extends to three eastern provinces, with Uganda reporting nine confirmed cases, including one death.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴからの到着者は追跡可能になる。保健省が5段階の対応を準備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）の2項目該当。WPRO基準でも異常性、流行可能性が該当し、社会的・政治的関心も確認される。DRCでのエボラ発生およびウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアがDRCとウガンダからの到着者に対する管理対策を公開したことを報じている。実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみが対象国リストに該当する（ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外）。WHO事務局長がDRCの東部を訪問中であり、3つの州に拡大、ウガンダで9例の確定例（死亡1例）が報告されている。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの活動的な流行が継続中である。

article.articleHeadline: لقاح صيني جديد بتقنية mRNA يحقق نتائج واعدة ضد سلالات متعددة من فيروس الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Chinese mRNA vaccine shows promising results against multiple strains of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers report a new broad-spectrum Ebola vaccine using mRNA technology, named [GPs+NP]@LNP, designed to protect against multiple Ebola strains by encoding surface glycoproteins and a conserved nucleoprotein. Described in a PNAS paper, the collaborative effort includes the University of Science and Technology of China, the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Anhui Medical University, and labs focused on emerging infectious diseases. In preclinical studies, mice with Ebola infection showed 100% survival and a marked reduction in viral load in key organs; other animal models indicated lasting protection. The team plans onward testing in non-human primates before initiating human trials. Ebola virus disease is a highly lethal filovirus infection; the vaccine aims for broad cross-strain protection, though further studies are required before use in people.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい中国製mRNAワクチンがエボラウイルスの複数の株に対して有望な結果を示す
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症の発生報告ではなく、実験段階の医療技術開発ニュースであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。既存のエボラ患者や流行の報告がなく、公衆衛生への即時的な脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルスに関するもので中国が関連しているが、これは新規ワクチン開発の科学報告であり、感染症イベント（患者発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではない。したがって対象国リストには含めない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : comment expliquer cette nouvelle flambée, malgré les vaccins qui ont amélioré la lutte contre les épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: how to explain this new flare-up, despite vaccines that have improved the fight against outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: A concerning Ebola flare-up since April 2026 affects eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, driven by Ebola Bundibugyo (BDBV). As of May 19, 2026, there are over 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths. Diagnosis delays likely stem from PCR methods optimized for Ebola Zaïre (EBOV), hindering rapid identification of BDBV and enabling silent spread. The outbreak is complicated by severe insecurity in eastern DRC, with armed conflict, population displacement, distrust of authorities, and limited access to care, echoing challenges from the 2018–2020 North Kivu/Ituri crises. Ebola comprises several species (EBOV, SUDV, BDBV, TAFV, RESTV); Reston has not caused severe human disease, while Bombali remains under surveillance. Vaccines exist and are WHO-approved, notably rVSV-ZEBOV (Ervebo) and Zabdeno/Mvabea, but vaccination’s impact varies by species, and challenges persist in outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ワクチンが流行対策を改善したにもかかわらず、この新たな流行をどのように説明するか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Ebola Bundibugyo による新規流行で500以上の疑い例と131死亡が報告され、東部DRCとウガンダに拡大。重大な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大、予想外の事態（BDBV による流行）、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているがサマリーでは東部DRCが主な発生地で、ウガンダへの影響は限定的。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Ebola Bundibugyo による流行で、既知の EBOV に最適化された診断法が有効でなく、迅速同定の遅延により静かな拡大が進んでいる点が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: PS Issues Travel Warning Amid Ebola Scares
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, Kenya issued a travel advisory urging non-essential trips to Ebola-affected countries amid rising importation risk. Democratic Republic of Congo reports 900–1,077 suspected Ebola cases, with 121–134 laboratory-confirmed infections concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has nine confirmed infections, linked to travel from DRC, raising cross-border transmission concerns. Case fatality rates among confirmed DRC cases are about 14%, rising to roughly 23% when suspected cases are included. Kenya’s trade links with Uganda and DRC, via Busia and Malaba corridors and thousands of Kenyan truck drivers delivering goods along regional routes, amplify importation risk. Kenya has activated its national Incident Management System, intensified surveillance at Points of Entry, designated testing laboratories, and strengthened national-county coordination. At JKIA, Gate 16 screens flights from Ebola-affected countries; aircraft wastewater surveillance collects samples for Ebola, Mpox, Cholera, Polio, and Meningitis to detect pathogens early.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念の中、PS（国務長官）が渡航警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急増、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。対象国DRC・Uganda・Kenyaでの複数疾患の同時発生は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアが発令した渡航警告を主題としているが、実際の感染症イベントの発生地はDRC（900-1077疑い例、121-134確定例）とウガンダ（9確定例）。複数の高危疾患（エボラ、Mpox、コレラ、ポリオ）が同時に検出されており、広域スクリーニング体制が始動している点が特筆される。ケニアは対象国に含まれるが、サマリーではケニア国内での発症報告はなく、輸入リスク管理の段階であるため verified_locations からは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Podejrzenie eboli w Brazylii. Pacjent trafił do izolacji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Brazil. The patient has been placed in isolation.
article.articleSummary: In Sao Paulo, Brazil, health authorities are investigating a suspected Ebola infection in a man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently traveled there and is now in isolation at a hospital specialising in care for patients with suspected or confirmed viral or infectious diseases in the epidemic phase. The case follows fever reported by the patient. As of May 29, WHO recorded about 906 probable Ebola cases in the DRC with 223 deaths; Africa CDC data cited by the article show 246 deaths and over 1,000 probable cases. The piece notes Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years, and the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak alone claimed nearly 2,300 lives. Separately, WHO confirmed the first full recovery of a Bundibugyo strain Ebola infection, with the patient discharged after two negative tests, marking a milestone for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラ疑い例。患者が隔離措置を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い例がDRCからブラジルへの国際移動に関連して報告された。国際的な拡大リスク、異常性、渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準で複数該当、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRC発症者のブラジル（サンパウロ）への国際移動に関連したエボラ疑い例。DRCでは進行中の流行があり（WHO記録で906例、223死亡）、患者の移動による国際的な感染拡大リスクが存在する。Bluedotの発生地域にはSão Paulo市も含まれているが、記事サマリーで確認されるのはDRC発症、ブラジル国内での疑い検査のため、両国を verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Congo: en dos días, los casos de ébola casi se duplicaron
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: Congo: In two days, Ebola cases nearly doubled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia. Confirmed Ebola cases reached 225 as of yesterday, nearly double the 121 reported on the previous Wednesday, with suspected cases at 1,028 and deaths unchanged. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was visiting the outbreak epicenter and urged communities in the central outbreak zone to play a critical frontline role, while calling for improved coordination among humanitarian and health actors under the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He emphasized that communities understand problems and solutions, and that international assistance should support the government's response, with ongoing dialogue to address any difficulties. The article notes ongoing transmission with no change in the fatality count.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：2日間でエボラウイルス症の症例がほぼ2倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス症の急速な症例増加（121→225）、高い死亡リスク、国際的支援が必要な状況であり、明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス症は致死率が極めて高く、2日間で症例がほぼ倍増（121→225）しており、疑い例も1,028件存在。WHO事務局長が現地視察中で国際的な関心が高い。DRCは対象国リスト対応であり、PICKUP判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: "Nadie conoce la verdadera magnitud": La oscura advertencia sobre el "profundamente alarmante" brote de ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No one knows the true magnitude: The grim warning about the "deeply alarming" Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after declaring an Ebola outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) deputy operations director Alan González calls the situation 'deeply alarming' and a legitimate cause for concern. He notes unprecedented rapid case accrual, with frontline teams unable to keep pace with the outbreak’s spread. The true magnitude and severity remain unknown as daily suspected cases are reported and hundreds of samples await laboratory analysis. The warning underscores the urgent need for expanded testing, surveillance, and response capacity to curb transmission in the affected regions, highlighting ongoing challenges in outbreak management and diagnostic throughput.

triage.headline_ja: 誰も真の規模を知らない：アフリカの「深刻な懸念」をもたらすエボラ出血熱の暗い警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の複数国での急速な拡大で、専門機関による懸念表明があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ発生ですが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRC のみを対象国として検証。MSFによる『深刻な懸念』との公式見解、前例のない急速な患者発生、検査容量不足などから、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Le ministre de la Santé promet de vaincre Ebola d'ici 4 à 6 mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Minister of Health Promises to Defeat Ebola Within 4 to 6 Months.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba told reporters in Bunia that the epidemic could be defeated or contained within four to six months, citing the virus's incubation period and advances in surveillance. He noted that all samples have been processed in a single night, with more than 900 specimens analyzed and over 260 testing positive. Of these, 142 patients were receiving care in treatment centers across the three provinces. The visit of WHO Director-General to Bunia underscored international support for surveillance, patient management, and community sensitization. Authorities urged strict adherence to barrier measures to interrupt transmission while continuing outbreak response activities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：保健大臣がエボラ熱を4～6ヶ月以内に撲滅することを約束
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動的な流行が複数州で確認され、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的懸念）の2つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）でも複数該当し、WHOの国レベル関与により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)の列挙可能疾患（Annex1）であり、高い伝播性を持つ。現在進行中の流行で260例以上の陽性確認、142例が治療中。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な懸念と支援の必要性を示唆。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西出现首例伊波拉疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports first suspected case of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports its first suspected Ebola case in São Paulo state: a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo who recently traveled to Africa is isolated in a facility for suspected cases, with confirmation pending. If confirmed, it would mark Brazil’s first Ebola diagnosis. Brazilian health authorities have activated emergency measures, including isolation and epidemiological/laboratory investigations. Earlier suspected cases in Italy and India were negative. The current outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain; there are no approved vaccines or antibody therapies, so control relies on isolation, surveillance, and supportive care. Since May 15, the DRC has reported at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. As of May 30, DRC had 260 confirmed cases and 349 suspected cases under testing. MSF warns of rapid spread and delays due to border/airport closures; WHO chief Tedros urged border-control reassessment and vaccine/therapy trials progress.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初のエボラ疑似患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患という極めて高い死亡率を持つ疾患の国際的な地理的拡大（DRCから南米ブラジルへの輸入症例）であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「重症度」「長期曝露リスク」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」すべてに該当し、かつ公式な保健当局対応と国際機関（WHO、MSF）の警告あり。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでのエボラ疑似患者（DRC渡航歴あり）を主題としており、DRCでの流行継続も詳述。イタリアとインドの疑似患者は陰性と記載されているため対象国から除外。ウガンダについても発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主要な焦点はブラジルとDRCであるため、ウガンダは除外。稀なBundibugyo株による流行で、ワクチン/抗体療法が未承認という重大なリスク要因を提示。

article.articleHeadline: Över 1 000 misstänkta ebolafall - nu slår MSF larm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases - MSF sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (referred to as Kongo-Kinshasa) is rapidly expanding. Since mid-May, over 1,000 suspected cases have been reported, with hundreds of deaths; Africa CDC confirms at least 246 deaths. New suspected cases are reported daily, while hundreds of samples have not yet been tested. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) calls the situation deeply concerning and warns that border and airport closures are delaying essential medical equipment, humanitarian aid, and highly skilled personnel. MSF Deputy Director Alan Gonzalez notes this is unprecedentedly high case reporting so soon after outbreak confirmation. The article details ongoing delays in laboratory confirmation and uncertainty about true case counts due to testing backlogs and impediments to response resources.

triage.headline_ja: 1,000件以上のエボラ疑い例 - MSFが警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当。コンゴ民主共和国での急速拡大するエボラ発生（1,000件以上の疑い例、246死亡確認）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の高い報告数、国際的拡散リスク、渡航制限リスクを全て満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5/5項目該当。国際的な対応機関（MSF、Africa CDC）からの警告あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、国境・空港の閉鎖による人道支援の遅延など国際的影響も記載されている。MSFおよびAfrica CDCという国際的に信頼できる情報源からの警告が含まれており、フルRRA実施の優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ما الذي تخفيه واشنطن ونيروبي داخل قاعدة كينية بشأن إيبولا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are Washington and Nairobi hiding inside a Kenyan base regarding Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s Supreme Court blocked a government plan to host a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km north of Nairobi, to receive American nationals exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The move followed a Katiba Institute constitutional challenge, with a ruling due next week. US reports described a facility run by American medical staff that was to open the Friday before the ruling; Nairobi has not publicly confirmed the arrangement, though Washington pledged $13.5 million for Kenya’s health preparedness. Kenyan medical and legal associations warned the plan could threaten life, health, public participation, and parliamentary oversight, and risk turning Kenya into a “garbage dump” for diseases. The Congo outbreak has over 1,000 suspected cases and about 220 deaths; Ituri accounts for >90% of cases; Uganda reports 7 cases and 1 death; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. EU leaders are urged to heighten vigilance at borders.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンとナイロビがケニアの基地内でエボラについて何を隠しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の懸念）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）、社会的・政治的関心が高く、複数国での事例報告あり。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベント（Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak）はDRC Ituri州で発生。ケニア（Laikipia）は隔離施設の計画地であり、ウガンダはヒト症例報告地だが、記事サマリーではDRCが流行の主要な発生地。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。DRC での1,000件超の疑似症例と220件の死亡報告、並びに承認ワクチン・治療法なしという状況は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Tình hình lây lan dịch Ebola vẫn đáng báo động
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of Ebola virus disease remains alarming.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains alarming, with the epicenter in eastern DRC reporting over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. A newborn in Mongwalu, eastern DRC, died after birth to an infected mother, highlighting vertical transmission risk. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment exists. MSF warns of rapid spread and response hindered by border/airport closures and ongoing conflict. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to stress community engagement and government leadership while accelerating care capacity. WHO, DRC, and Uganda are evaluating three candidate therapies and two candidate vaccines; emphasis on early detection and safe burials. US, Mexico, and Canada announced unified public health measures for travelers from high-risk African regions ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の流行拡大状況は依然として警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で死亡者多数、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク高く、北米での公衆衛生措置発動により渡航制限のリスクあり。フルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による大規模流行。DRCが対象国のため verified_locations に含める。記事ではUSA、Mexico、Canada、Ugandaの言及があるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO、MSF等による警告強調、縦方向感染事例（新生児死亡）、ワクチン・治療法不在、境界・空港閉鎖による対応困難等が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ministros de salud de 8 países de África se reunirán de urgencia este lunes por la epidemia de ébola declarada emergencia internacional por la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health ministers from eight African countries will hold an emergency meeting this Monday regarding the Ebola outbreak declared an international emergency by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Eight East African Community (EAC) member states—Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, DR Congo, and Somalia—will hold a virtual emergency meeting on May 31–June 1, 2026, to coordinate regional actions against the Ebola outbreak declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO on May 16, affecting DR Congo and Uganda. The gathering includes crisis talks and Technical Working Groups on transmissible diseases and on harmonizing regulations for vaccines, therapies, and diagnostics. The African Union health agency reports about 246 suspected Ebola deaths in DR Congo as part of the country’s 17th epidemic since 1976. The outbreak is tied to the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate of 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Separately, São Paulo, Brazil is investigating a possible imported Ebola case in a traveler from DR Congo; incubation 2–21 days; lab confirmation pending.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの8ヶ国の保健大臣がエボラ流行に関して月曜日に緊急会議を開催予定（WHOが国際的な緊急事態と宣言）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患がIHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHO認定PHEIC、複数国への拡大、高い致死率（30-50%）、ブラジルへの越境症例の可能性があり、フルRRAを進めるべき高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を2026年5月16日に宣言済み。DRコンゴで246人の疑い死亡例、Bundibugyo株で致死率30-50%。ブラジル・サンパウロではDRコンゴからの渡航者に輸入症例の可能性あり、検査結果待機中。対象国リストから東アフリカの複数国（タンザニア、ケニア、ルワンダ等）は含まれていないため、DRコンゴ・ウガンダ・ブラジルのみ verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola tem meningite meningocócica confirmada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola has confirmed meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, hospitalized in São Paulo at Instituto Emílio Ribas with suspected Ebola, has been confirmed to have meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis. Diagnosis was by Instituto Adolfo Lutz via qPCR; further analyses are ongoing to rule out Ebola. The patient, who recently traveled to the DRC where an Ebola outbreak is active, remains in isolation at Emílio Ribas. Investigations followed his symptoms and travel history. Even with meningitis confirmation, surveillance and clinical teams continue testing until all results are complete. The risk of introduction to Brazil and South America is very low due to no local transmission, no direct flights, and transmission requiring contact with bodily fluids from symptomatic cases. Health services are advised to maintain vigilance for febrile patients with recent travel to Ebola-affected areas within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染が疑われた患者は髄膜炎菌髄膜炎が確認された
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からのアクティブなエボラアウトブレイク地域からの渡航者がブラジルで髄膜炎菌髄膜炎を発症しており、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、異常性、公衆衛生への影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、患者はコンゴ民主共和国からブラジルへの国際移動例であり、アクティブなエボラアウトブレイク地域からの渡航歴がある。髄膜炎菌髄膜炎確定だが、エボラ除外までの検査継続中。両国が対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に DRC と Brazil を記載。記事は2026年架空日時のため参考情報として扱うが、評価フレームワーク上の判断基準には影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Der Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo ist aufgrund der rasanten Ausbreitung der Infektionen sehr besorgniserregend
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is highly concerning due to the rapid spread of infections.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with case numbers rising and testing capacity and medical resources stretched. The situation is described as 'very concerning' two weeks after the outbreak was detected. MSF called for rapid expansion of the response, improved access to relief supplies and trained personnel. As of May 28, 2026, official counts across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu show 125 confirmed cases, 906 suspected cases, and 223 deaths. The true scale remains hard to gauge due to limited testing and the inaccessibility of some areas. The organization emphasizes that this marks a notably rapid accumulation of Ebola cases in the DRC, signaling a critical strain on health systems in the affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: MSF: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は感染の急速な拡大により極めて憂慮される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。現在進行中の大規模流行で、MSFが急速な対応拡大を要請しており、国際支援の必要性が明白。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行が検出後2週間で既に125確定症例・906疑似症例・223死亡に達している。医療リソースと検査能力の逼迫が報告されており、アクセス困難地域があるため実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性。MSFによる緊急対応拡大の要請は国際支援の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Director general de OMS visita provincia de RDC afectada por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits Ebola-affected province of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 31 May: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Ebola-affected Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Bunia he met with military governor Lt. Gen. Johnny Luboya Nkashama, health minister Roger Kamba, and other officials; reaffirmed WHO's commitment to support Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu where Ebola is present. He underscored a community-centered response, leveraging DRC's Ebola experience, and noted ongoing surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory testing, and patient care. Regarding Bundibugyo, there is currently no vaccine; research and clinical trials for vaccines and treatments are ongoing. Multisector partners (Congo Red Cross, Africa CDC, UNICEF, WFP) participate in the response. He urged countries to reconsider travel restrictions that hinder response and transparency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ感染影響下のコンゴ民主共和国の州を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患（IHR通知対象疾患）が複数州で発生中。IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当（3/4）。WHO事務局長が直接訪問する高い政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患はIHR通知対象疾患。記事ではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州でのエボラ発生を言及。Bundibugyo型に関しても言及があり、ワクチン未開発との報告。WHO事務局長自身が訪問しており国際的関心が極めて高い。複数の多国籍パートナー機関が対応に参加している。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西出现首例伊波拉疑似病例 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports first suspected case of Ebola - International - Real-Time International
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports its first suspected Ebola case in São Paulo state — an imported case from Congo. The 37-year-old man, who recently traveled to Africa, is in isolation at a hospital designated for suspected Ebola patients; confirmation would mark Brazil’s first Ebola diagnosis. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved vaccine or antibody therapy; control relies on isolation, monitoring, and supportive care. Italy and India previously reported suspected cases that tested negative. Since May 15, Congo (DRC) has reported at least 1,077 suspected cases with 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death; as of yesterday, DRC had 260 confirmed cases and 349 suspected cases under testing. MSF warns of rapid spread and border/airport disruptions delaying response. WHO Director‑General Tedros urges border policy reassessment while vaccines/therapies are in trials; Frieden notes preparedness gaps.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラの初の疑似患者を報告 - 国際 - リアルタイム国際
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4つ全てに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）、さらにWPRO基準も4つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。エボラウイルス感染症の疑似患者が従来発生国外で初めて確認され、複数国での確認例と国際的警告が発せられているため。
triage.notes: 記事中でBundibugyo strain エボラウイルスによるDRCでの大規模発生（246死亡・1,077疑似患者）が述在し、ブラジルではコンゴからの輸入症例が初めて確認された。イタリアとインドの過去の疑似患者は陰性確認済みだが、今回のブラジル症例は確認待ち。WHO事務局長による警告と国際的対応の必要性が強調されている。Bluedot APIが付与した「Africa」「Italian Republic」「Uganda」は記事内で主要な発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した（Italyは過去の陰性ケースの記述のみ、Ugandaは数値のみ）。

article.articleHeadline: Lahir dari Ibu Terinfeksi, Bayi di Kongo Tak Selamat dari Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Born to an Infected Mother, a Baby in Kongo Did Not Survive Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak intensifies in eastern Kongo, with a newborn dying in Mongwalu hospital after birth to an Ebola-infected mother on May 31, 2026. The case underscores mother-to-child transmission during this worsening outbreak in the region. The World Health Organization reports about 900 suspected Ebola cases, of which 101 have been laboratory-confirmed. Meanwhile, roughly 220 deaths across eastern Kongo and neighboring Uganda are suspected to be linked to the virus. Health experts warn that women and children are among the most vulnerable to Ebola exposure, highlighting the risk of perinatal transmission and the need for heightened surveillance and infection control in maternal-neonatal settings. The update reflects ongoing transmission and the strain on healthcare facilities in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 感染した母親から生まれた赤ちゃん、コンゴでエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の集団発生で900疑い症例、101確定症例、220死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの広がり）、異常な高い死亡率を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東部コンゴでの主要な発生が述べられており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれている。ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストにない）での確認も言及されているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は世界的にもトップ優先度の疾患であり、母子感染や医療施設への負荷が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: WHO-Chef Tedros fordert bessere Zusammenarbeit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO Director-General Tedros calls for better cooperation.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Ituri Province, has prompted WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to call for better coordination among all stakeholders and for listening to and supporting communities. More than 1,000 Ebola-suspected cases have been reported since the outbreak began in the middle of the month, with about 250 deaths among the ill. In neighboring Uganda, nine confirmed Ebola cases have been reported by WHO, including at least one death. Observers note skepticism among residents toward prevention measures such as isolating patients, as such actions clash with local social norms. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the need for strengthened, collaborative public health responses across borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHO事務局長テドロスがより良い協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。1,000件以上の疑い患者と250人以上の死亡、国境を越えた感染拡大、そして社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも9例の確定患者が報告されているが、Bluedot発生地域にUgandaが含まれていても、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリスト内の対象国（ID: 203312）であり、Ituri州での集中的な流行が記述されている。1,000人以上の疑い患者と250人以上の死亡、WHO事務局長の直接的な声明、およびコミュニティの信頼欠如による対策困難という複数の懸念要因が存在する。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산에 국제사회 우려 증폭...민주콩고 의심환자 1000명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International concern grows as Ebola spreads; suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 1,000 with at least 246 deaths as of May 30, 2026, centered in Ituri Province. Hundreds of samples remain untested, and officials warn the true scale is unknown while on-the-ground containment struggles to keep pace. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited eastern Ituri to assess the response. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Transmission occurs from wildlife reservoirs (fruit bats) to humans and via human-to-human contact with blood, vomit, diarrhea, saliva, urine, semen, sweat, contaminated needles, bedding, or clothing. Border and airport closures are among restrictions hindering response and delivery of aid; international health groups call for strengthened containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大で国際社会の懸念増幅...民主共和国の疑い患者が1000人超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病による大規模流行で、1000人超の患者と246人以上の死亡を伴い、ウガンダへの越境拡大、国際的な懸念と対応制限が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでウガンダの患者は確認例として言及されているのに対し、主流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リスト内(203312)で確認。WHOとの国際調整、複数の越境制限、大量の未検査検体が存在することから管理可能性の課題が明らかであり、フルRRA進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: [Video] Phòng tránh bệnh dại mùa nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Video] Rabies prevention during the hot summer.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Vietnam rises during hot summer months, with May–August seeing higher numbers of cases and deaths. The disease remains endemic across many localities, especially mountainous provinces, and is mainly transmitted by unvaccinated dogs and cats. Rabies carries near 100% mortality once clinical symptoms develop. Public health guidance from the Ministry of Health emphasizes prevention: vaccinate 100% of pets with full vaccination and annual boosters; leash and muzzle dogs when outdoors; eliminate roaming and stray dogs; avoid rough play with animals. If bitten by a dog or cat, immediately wash the wound with soap and running water for 10–15 minutes, disinfect with 70% alcohol or iodine, and promptly seek advice at a vaccination center for rabies vaccination as directed by a clinician.

triage.headline_ja: [動画] 暑い季節の狂犬病予防
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムにおいて風土病であり、致死率は高いが、本記事は予防啓発・衛生指導の性質であり、新しい異常な流行を示す証拠は明記されていない。既知の季節的パターンの範囲内での公衆衛生通知と解釈される。
triage.notes: ベトナムは狂犬病の風土病地域であり、5月～8月に症例数が増加する既知の季節パターンが示されている。記事は保健省からの予防啓発メッセージであり、新たな流行疫学や異常な増加を示唆していない。致死率はほぼ100%と高いが、患者数の絶対値や増加トレンドは記事に記載されていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では複数該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみ、かつ情報不足により確実な判定が困難であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Je to alarmující. Tolik případů eboly za krátký čas ještě nebylo, tvrdí experti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's alarming. There have never been so many Ebola cases in such a short period, experts say.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of alarming, rapid Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) two weeks after outbreak declaration. Official estimates suggest more than 1,000 suspected cases with at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda reports several cases and one death. MSF deputy Alan Gonzales criticized authorities for barriers such as border and airport closures and for many samples remaining untested, complicating containment. Ebola, first identified in 1976 in what is today the DRC, is associated with five virus strains—Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, Reston, and Zaire—with three known to cause severe disease in humans. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids of the sick, and health workers are often affected. The illness can infect both humans and animals, highlighting zoonotic and occupational risks. The BBC cited MSF warnings.

triage.headline_ja: 非常に深刻だ。これまでにないほど短期間に多くのエボラ患者が報告されたと専門家は述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。DRCで急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の重大な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）と渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの2週間以内での1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡は極めて重大。MSFによる警告と専門家の懸念が強く、国際的支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief hails 5 Ebola recoveries as a new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: On 31 May 2026, WHO Chief Tedros announced five recoveries from Bundibugyo ebolavirus in eastern Congo's Bunia, amid the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Ituri. The Bundibugyo virus, the current Ebola strain, has no approved treatment or vaccine; the WHO noted that one patient had previously recovered, marking the first documented recovery of a confirmed Bundibugyo patient in this outbreak. The WHO's latest figures show 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death. MSF says the outbreak is spreading faster than the response, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of aid, and sustained medical supplies. Attacks on health centers by local militias and the Allied Democratic Forces, plus M23 activity in North Kivu and South Kivu, hinder response. Officials emphasize symptomatic treatment and early care, with community involvement as key to containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHOチーフが5名のエボラ出血熱治癒者を称賛、コンゴ東部で新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的に重大な感染症イベントであり、隣接するウガンダへの国際的拡大が既に確認されている。重症度も高く、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは9例1死亡の隣接国での二次的な拡大であり、主たる発生地はコンゴ民主共和国である。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は治療法やワクチンがなく、医療施設への攻撃や武装勢力による阻害が報告されており、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Wabah penyakit Ebola di Kongo sangat mengkhawatirkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Ebola outbreak in Kongo is very worrying.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province is described as very worrying. In Mongbwalu village, health workers were seen transporting a death suspected to be Ebola on May 25, 2026. As of late May 2026, more than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported across the DRC, with 223 deaths among those suspected; the rapid spread exceeds previous waves. Frontline responders struggle to keep pace with daily new suspected cases, and slow laboratory confirmation hampers timely diagnosis. Authorities say testing capacity must be scaled up to regain some control. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri as the agency has declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as public health emergencies of international concern. The earlier DRC outbreak ended in October 2025. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: MSF：コンゴのエボラ病の流行は非常に懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ病の大規模流行（900件以上の疑い例、223人の死亡）、国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダ）により、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC内での流行が主題であり、ウガンダへの確認患者情報がないため verified_locations から除外。WHOが両国の状況をPHEIC宣言しているが、具体的なウガンダでの症例報告は記事に記載されていない。検査キャパシティの不足が認識されており、管理難度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolanın nadir türü (bundibugyo) hızla yayılıyor! Ebola nedir, belirtileri neler, nasıl bulaşıyor?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rare Ebola strain (Bundibugyo) is spreading rapidly! What is Ebola, what are its symptoms, and how is it transmitted?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province is spreading quickly, alarming international health bodies. Doctors Without Borders reports case numbers rising to levels described as deeply concerning, with no approved vaccine or proven treatment for this strain. Two weeks after the outbreak was declared, containment remains challenging. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged temporary suspension of certain traditional practices to aid control. Ebola, identified in 1976 in Sudan and DRC near the Ebola River, is a filovirus with bats as the natural reservoir. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, saliva, or other body fluids, or contaminated surfaces; it is not airborne or waterborne. Men can sexually transmit the virus for up to seven weeks after recovery. Early symptoms include fever, weakness, and muscle/throat pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, rash, kidney/liver dysfunction, and bleeding. Lab findings show leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated liver enzymes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの稀な型（ブンディブギョ）が急速に拡大している！エボラとは何か、症状は何か、どのように感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、ブンディブギョエボラは稀で高リスク株。DRCでの急速な拡大、国際保健機関の警報、ワクチンなし、収束困難な状況。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラはスーダン種の稀な変異体で、2026年5月31日時点でDRC東部イトゥリ州で急速拡大中。WHO事務局長が声明を発表、MSF（国境なき医師団）が懸念を表明。ワクチンなし、治療法確立されていない。発生地域にはUgandaとSudanも列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内での流行のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Lions have died in Gujarat's Gir due to a suspected infection. An Expert Explains why this isn't an emergency
article.articleSummary: Eight lions, including cubs, died in Gujarat’s Gir region from suspected Babesiosis caused by the Babesia parasite. The state forest department has isolated lions within a 10-km radius of affected areas in Gir Somnath and Amreli districts and is treating those suspected of infection. Babesia is a tick-borne protozoan endemic in livestock and wild ungulates; reservoirs include chital and nilgai. Infected lions show lethargy, anemia, enlarged spleen, and high fever; under stress or with co-infections, the parasite can cause organ failure and death. With about 1,000 Asiatic lions, experts say there is no emergency. The Serengeti epidemic of the mid-1990s killed roughly one-third of its lions, underscoring the risk to bottlenecked Asiatic lions. Conservationists advocate multiple safety-net populations; Gir provides a 250 sq km exclusive habitat, while elsewhere range overlaps humans and livestock; translocation is discussed.

triage.headline_ja: ライオンはグジャラート州のギルで疑われる感染症により死亡。専門家は、これが緊急事態ではない理由を説明します
