triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（ライオン）を対象とした限定的なバベシア症イベント。ヒト感染の兆候なく、公衆衛生上の直接的な深刻な影響は不明。ただし、希少なアジアライオンの個体群への潜在的な脅威と、公衆衛生への間接的リスク（ベクター・野生動物貯蔵池）があるため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのグジャラート州ギル地域の野生ライオン（Panthera leo persica）における限定的なバベシア症イベントに焦点。タンザニア（Serengeti）はセレンゲティ疫病の歴史的参照として言及されるのみで、現在のイベント発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。記事サマリーはヒト公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないと明言。ただし、希少なアジアライオン個体群の脅威と、バベシア原虫の流行可能性（マダニベクター媒介、家畜・野生ウシ科動物の貯蔵池）に着目して経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, DRC officials appeal to Congolese as Ebola spreads
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread with no vaccine available for this strain. Officials warn cases may be undercounted and rising faster than estimates. Mistrust and conspiracy theories are fueling resistance to measures such as testing, contact tracing and isolation, and attacks on health facilities complicate containment. Effective control now hinges on sustained community cooperation. Limited resources and cuts to foreign aid have weakened the response, raising fears of wider regional spread. WHO and DRC officials are appealing to Congolese communities to cooperate to slow transmission and counter misinformation during this ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRC当局がエボラ拡大に伴いコンゴ国民に訴え
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性を示し、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPRO基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、新規エボラ株の発生、有効ワクチン欠如、地域社会の信頼低下による対応困難、医療施設への攻撃、限定的リソース、外国援助削減による対応弱化など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が確認されている。地域感染拡大の懸念が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: No new suspected Babesia cases in past 3 days; 17 lions under observation: Gujarat minister - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: No new suspected Babesia infections among Asiatic lions in Gujarat’s Gir landscape have been reported in the past three days, with 17 lions under observation following the deaths of eight cubs from a suspected Babesia infection. Deaths occurred in revenue areas outside the Gir sanctuary, notably Gir Gadhada (Gir Somnath district) and Babra Kot (Amreli district). Babesia is a tick-borne parasitic disease that can cause weakness, coughing and nasal discharge in affected animals. About 500 lions have undergone deworming and tick treatment over the past three months as part of control efforts, with medicines administered in ring cages. To prevent spread, authorities isolated lions within a 10-km radius of reported infections. The Asiatic lion’s remaining wild population is confined to Gujarat’s Gir forest landscape, its last natural habitat, and a veterinary team continues round-the-clock monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 過去3日間でバベシア症の新たな疑い例なし。17頭のライオンが観察下に：グジャラート州大臣
triage.triage_reason: 動物（ライオン）における日和見感染症の集団発生であり、ヒト感染のリスクは現在のところ記事に記載されていない。獣医学的関心は高いが、IHR基準の公衆衛生的影響（ヒト）の観点からは直接的な証拠が不足しており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（アジアライオン）における寄生虫感染の集団発生である。ヒト感染リスクについての言及がないため、IHR基準の『公衆衛生への深刻な影響』の判断は「不明」とした。ただしグジャラート州の絶滅危機種保護という文脈で政府関心が高く、続報でヒト感染事例が報告される可能性を考慮し「WATCH」と判定。バベシア症は通常ヒト-ヒト感染しないが、ダニ媒介であるため環境的な疫学的懸念がある可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Medici fără Frontiere: Răspândirea Ebola în RD Congo este profund alarmantă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The spread of Ebola in the DRC is deeply alarming
article.articleSummary: Two weeks after WHO declared an Ebola outbreak in Ituri, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF reports unprecedented case counts expanding rapidly, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. Dr. Alan Gonzales says never before have so many cases been recorded so soon after declaration, as field teams race to contain a virus spreading faster than interventions can keep up. Daily new suspected cases are reported, with hundreds of samples awaiting testing. Isolation efforts and humanitarian deliveries are delayed by major constraints, including border and airport closures. The outbreak is worsened by ongoing conflict, hampering response and laboratory confirmation; WHO leadership is visiting Ituri to coordinate containment.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大は極めて懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。大規模かつ急速に拡大するエボラ流行であり、複数国での確認と国際的懸念がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事では二次的な発生地として言及されているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの流行が記事の主要な主題であり、1,000件超の疑い例、246死亡、急速な拡大が報告されている。国際的な懸念と WHO の現地対応も確認。

article.articleHeadline: 'Nobody Knows The True Scale': MSF Warns Ebola Outbreak In DR Congo 'Deeply Alarming'
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ituri province Ebola outbreak is deeply alarming as of 31 May 2026, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. MSF warns the rapid rise in cases at this early stage is unprecedented, with major gaps in testing and surveillance slowing containment and hundreds of samples untested. The WHO had declared the outbreak two weeks earlier, and Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged stronger coordination, funding, and community engagement as international support increases. Uganda has nine confirmed Ebola cases, including one death. Health systems are strained by limited laboratory capacity, ongoing insecurity, and displacement in conflict-affected areas, complicating response efforts. Transmission is believed to have begun before detection, and Ebola remains a highly contagious haemorrhagic fever spread through bodily fluids and close contact.

triage.headline_ja: 「真の規模は誰もわからない」：MSFがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を「深く懸念している」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全てに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,000以上の疑い症例、246死亡）、国際的拡大（ウガンダで9例確認）、検査・監視体制の大きなギャップが認められる。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での流行を主題としており、ウガンダについても言及されているがDRCが主要な発生地。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO宣言済み（2週間前）で、MSFを含む国際機関による関心が高く、「深く懸念」との公式警告が出されている。早期段階での急速な症例増加と検査・監視体制の大きなギャップが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil Selidiki Dugaan Kasus Ebola di Sao Paulo, Pasien Baru Pulang dari Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Investigates Suspected Ebola Case in São Paulo, New Patient Returns from the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, São Paulo state health authorities are investigating a suspected Ebola case in a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ebola is described as a deadly, highly contagious disease in the report. The patient has developed fever and is currently isolated in a hospital designated to manage suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. No laboratory confirmation is reported in the briefing. The investigation follows ongoing Ebola activity linked to the Congo region, prompting Brazil to maintain vigilance and monitor potential contacts while containment measures are implemented.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンパウロのエボラ疑似症例を調査、患者がコンゴから帰国
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な越境リスク、疑似症例の検出、および対象国への確認された移入経路（コンゴからの渡航者）が存在するため、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)の通知対象疾患であり、確定診断がなくても疑似症例の検出および国際的な移入経路の確認は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念である。コンゴからの渡航者からの患者であることが確認されている。未確認症例であるため続報による検査確認結果が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumsel catat 1.426 kasus DBD hingga Mei 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sumatra Health Office records 1,426 dengue cases as of May 2026.
article.articleSummary: South Sumatra reports 1,426 dengue fever cases with 11 deaths from January to May 21, 2026. Palembang city accounts for the most cases (413) with 1 death, followed by Muara Enim (281, 2 deaths), Ogan Ilir (141, 1 death), and Lubuk Linggau (109, 2 deaths). Other districts show smaller counts, with notable totals in Banyuasin, OKU Timur, Lahat, and Muba. In 2025, total dengue cases were 2,084; 2024 saw 4,430 cases with 37 deaths, while 2025 had 20 deaths. The 2026 decline is linked to reduced early-year rainfall and ongoing prevention efforts, plus a dengue vaccination program begun late last year. Authorities urge continued vector control via 3M Plus—drain, close, and recycle containers—to prevent a rise during the rainy season."

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ保健局、2026年5月までにデング熱1,426件を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱流行は地域的に既知の疾患で、過去比では減少傾向にあるが、死亡例（11例）と複数州での継続的な発生が確認されている。情報不足の部分（国際的拡大リスク、社会的・政治的関心の詳細）があるため、続報による監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・南スマトラ州に限定した報告。記事にはアンゴラが記載されているが、サマリーはインドネシアのみが主題のため、Angolaは verified_locations から除外。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（serious_impact）だが、WPRO基準で3つ該当し、重症度・継続曝露・流行リスク性がある。ただし国際的拡大リスクが不明で、社会的関心についても記事に明示されていないため、「WATCH」判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला का नया स्ट्रेन ग्लोबल इमरजेंसी घोषित, इससे भारत को कितना डरना चाहिए?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new strain of Ebola declared a global emergency; how much should India fear it?
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with early genetic analyses suggesting the strain may have circulated silently for weeks to months. The virus spreads primarily through direct contact with blood, saliva, feces, urine, or other bodily fluids; it is not airborne. After entry, Ebola first proliferates in lymph nodes, then disseminates via blood to organs, targeting immune cells and enabling rapid systemic infection as immunity weakens. Early symptoms resemble fever, cold, infection, or malaria-like illness; patients may temporarily improve before progressing to severe signs, including bleeding from various sites, increasing infectiousness. As of May 2026, India has no confirmed cases, with risk considered low. Surveillance at major airports, health checks, rapid testing in large hospitals, and WHO alert systems aid case identification. Caution persists due to travel and trade links with African nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの新種が世界的緊急事態と宣言、インドはどの程度恐れるべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ新株発生であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCで確認されたエボラ新株が「グローバルエマージェンシー」宣言されている。インドは現在確認症例なし（低リスク評価）だが、アフリカ諸国との渡航・貿易リンク経由での波及懸念が記事で言及されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれ、インドが含まれるため両国を verified_locations に列挙。シグナルレベルのイベント。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS celebra cinco recuperaciones de ébola en Congo con nuevo centro de tratamiento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO celebrates five Ebola recoveries in Congo with a new treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Five recoveries from Bundibugyo Ebola virus in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the WHO chief inaugurates a new treatment center amid an ongoing Ituri outbreak. Four patients were discharged today and one yesterday, bringing total recovered to five. Official figures cite 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing the response, urging expanded diagnostics, faster humanitarian deployment, and sustained medical supplies. Healthcare workers face heightened risk amid distrust over corpse-management protocols, with at least three attacks on health centers. The WHO stresses community engagement for earlier presentation and care. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, and this marks the first documented recovery from infections with this strain. The outbreak also involves North and South Kivu, with rebel activity impacting response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴの新しい治療センターでエボラ熱の5例の回復を祝う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（223死亡、906疑い症例）、異常・予想外（Bundibugyo株の初の回復例）、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、高度なリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus株は承認された治療法またはワクチンがなく、本株からの初の回復例である。ウガンダでの確認事例（9確定例、1死亡）も報告されているが、サマリー上の主題はDRCのIturi/South Kivu outbreak。医療施設への攻撃3件以上、信頼の欠如など社会的課題がリスク増幅要因。MSFの警告に基づき、対応能力不足が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨世卫组织总干事：政府主导及社区参与可阻止埃博拉疫情-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | WHO Director-General: Government-led and community participation can stop the Ebola outbreak - International Online
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have reported 134 confirmed Ebola cases (125 in the DRC, 9 in Uganda) and 18 deaths (17 in the DRC, 1 in Uganda). The outbreak, centered in eastern DRC’s Ituri Province, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no vaccine or specific therapy for this strain. Prompt, high-quality medical care—including isolation, rehydration, and pain control—remains crucial for survival, and some Ituri patients have recovered. WHO and partners are pursuing clinical trials of vaccines and therapeutics. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri and urged government leadership plus broad community engagement to stop transmission. The Congolese health minister called for international support, noting the response is expected to last about 4–6 months and will adapt as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ｜WHO事務局長：政府主導及びコミュニティ参加でエボラ感染拡大を阻止できる - 国際オンライン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の複数国での確認例、死亡、ワクチン・治療法の不在、国際支援要請があり、公衆衛生的な深刻な脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ患者を報告しているが、対象国リストはDRCのみを含む。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による現在のアウトブレイクは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。WHO事務局長の実地視察と国際支援要請が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Wabah Ebola, Kemenkes Perketat Pengawasan di Bandara Soetta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Ebola Outbreak, the Ministry of Health Tightens Surveillance at Soekarno–Hatta International Airport.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health tightened surveillance at international entry points, including Soekarno–Hatta International Airport, amid WHO’s health-emergency designation for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The alert signals global vigilance, though Ebola is not yet a pandemic. Authorities note travel-associated cases in Congo, Kampala (Uganda), and Kinshasa, driven by high mobility and limited regional health capacity. Indonesia has deployed field health workers, strengthened traveler screening, and prepared referral pathways to internationally staffed hospitals; 24/7 monitoring via SKDR and PHEOC, with national lab capacity on standby. Ebola strains include Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), Sudan Virus Disease (SVD), and Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD). Transmission via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms fever, weakness, myalgia, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding. Fatality ~50%; vaccines limited; no widely used cure. Public urged PHBS and to avoid misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の拡大予防対策として、インドネシア保健省がスカルノ・ハッタ国際空港での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO保健緊急事態宣言されたエボラ感染症の対応であり、複数国での確認と入国監視強化により、スクリーニング基準も複数満たし、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事主題はインドネシアの空港での入国監視強化であり、背景としてDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が言及されている。DRCとインドネシアのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に採用。ウガンダはリストにないため除外。Swine Vesicular Disease も疾患リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではエボラが主要テーマであり、豚の疾病については具体的な発生報告がない。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ призвал пересмотреть запреты на поездки на фоне борьбы ДРК со вспышкой Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief called for a review of travel bans amid the DRC's fight against an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries that imposed travel bans or closed borders over the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to review these measures, saying restrictions can hinder the response and undermine transparency and trust needed to save lives. As of May 31, DR Congo reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases, while Uganda has nine confirmed cases after two new infections in Kampala. The outbreak primarily affects Ituri province (Bunia) and the North and South Kivu provinces. DR Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba said containment and ending the outbreak within four to six months is a best-case goal. Laboratories have strengthened testing; around 900 samples have been processed with about 260 positives, with capacity to handle 200–300 daily. Even without licensed vaccines or antivirals, patients can recover with timely, quality care, and Ghebreyesus’ visit emphasized engaging affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行との戦いの中で渡航禁止の見直しを呼びかけ - DRCおよびウガンダ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的に重大な公衆衛生危機（1000件以上の患者、複数国への波及、国際的な渡航制限）であり、IHR基準の複数項目およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダは9件の確認症例」と限定的な記載であり、主要な流行はDRC（Ituri州とKivu州）で発生している。対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リスト内（ID: 203312）。エボラは致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染性が高いため、複数のWPRO基準に該当。WHO事務局長による公式コメントにより国際的関心も確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-járvány: a WHO főigazgatója személyesen méri fel a helyzetet a járvány gócpontjában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the WHO Director-General personally assesses the situation in the outbreak's epicenter.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ituri province, with spillover into Uganda. As of 31 May 2026, Africa CDC reports about 1,100 suspected cases and 246 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus travelled to Ituri to assess the response amid the outbreak’s spread in eastern DRC and Uganda. One patient recovered and was discharged after two negative tests, the first confirmed Ebola carrier in the current outbreak. The virus is typically rodent-borne, but this outbreak involves a rare Ebola strain capable of human-to-human transmission; there is no vaccine yet, though Oxford researchers are nearing one, not expected to be market-ready for this outbreak. Militia conflicts linked to Islamic State control many areas, and nearly 1 million people live in crowded camps near Ituri’s capital. Uganda and Rwanda closed border sections; Kampala imposes a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from Congo. The United States tightened travel restrictions for travelers from DRC, Uganda or South Sudan. The 2018-2020 DRC outbreak killed about 2,300 from 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症アウトブレイク：WHO事務局長がアウトブレイクの震源地で状況を直接評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの確認された流行事例で、複数国への越境拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、WHO指導部による現地視察が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 本イベント情報は2026年5月31日付の記事であり、未来日付となっている。ただしシグナルトリアージの対象として評価を実施した。発生地域リストに含まれるUganda（226074）はサマリーで「spillover into Uganda」と記載されており、二次的な確認例が生じている可能性があるが、主要な流行地はDRC東部Ituri州であり、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de Ebola viajou de SP para o RJ de ônibus, diz Ministério da Saúde | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola traveled by bus from São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro, says the Ministry of Health | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases in Brazil: a traveler who arrived May 22, 2026 from Johannesburg to Guarulhos, then traveled by bus to Vila Isabel, Rio de Janeiro. He previously visited Uganda; no internal movements or known contacts with sick individuals. The patient presents with chills, cough, and diarrhea but no fever or headache; he is isolated at INI/Fiocruz, and five residents of his lodging are under surveillance and asymptomatic. No laboratory confirmation yet; the case is under epidemiological investigation, and Brazil's risk of transmission is considered low. A second suspected case in São Paulo involves a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, hospitalized and isolated at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. Surveillance is conducted by federal, state, and municipal teams. Ebola viruses are not transmitted during incubation or via respiratory routes, and precautionary measures are in place.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス疑似患者がサンパウロからリオデジャネイロへバスで移動、保健省が発表 | ラジオ・イタティアイア
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（EVD）の疑似症例が複数国（ブラジル、コンゴ民主共和国との関連）で報告されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ブラジルにおけるEVD疑似症例は極めて異例かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、EVD疑似症例がブラジル（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ）とコンゴ民主共和国での報告が明記されているため、両国を verified_locations に含める。南アフリカはジョハネスブルグからの旅行経由地として言及されているが、発生地ではなく除外。ウガンダは患者の訪問歴として記載されているが、発症地ではなく除外。ブラジルでのEVD疑似症例は地域的に極めて異例であり、国際的な公衆衛生的影響が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda to continue anti-ADF operations despite Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Uganda will continue joint operations with the Democratic Republic of the Congo against the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) in eastern DRC despite the Ebola outbreak there. UPDF spokesperson Chris Magezi said there have been no calls to halt operations as the ADF continues to kill and abduct civilians. The joint operations with Congolese forces began in November 2021 and will proceed with Ebola prevention measures and adherence to Ebola SOPs. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appealed for a ceasefire by armed groups in eastern DRC to allow health workers access to affected communities and help contain Ebola, which he described as very complex due to conflict, insecurity, displacement, food shortages, and community mistrust.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク中もADF対抗作戦を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生に関する報告であり、IHR基準で深刻な影響（Yes）と異常性（Yes）が確認され、複数国での流行展開と紛争地での感染制御困難性が明記されており、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではUgandaはADF対抗作戦の実施国として言及されており、エボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主体。サマリー上でウガンダ国内でのエボラ患者発生は明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、国境地域での感染リスク拡大の可能性があり、WHO事務局長による国際的なアピール（停戦要請など）が行われている点で国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jale Refik Rogers'tan Ebola uyarısı: Bulaşıcı Hastalıklar Yasası'nı işaret etti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jale Refik Rogers' Ebola warning: pointed to the Infectious Diseases Law.
article.articleSummary: Independent MP Jale Refik Rogers warns of an Ebola outbreak in Africa, citing the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where a rapidly spreading new Ebola subtype has produced about 1,000 suspected cases and over 200 deaths, with the outbreak not yet controlled. In Cyprus, hundreds of students study at universities from these regions, underscoring potential importation risk without panic. Rogers points to the 45/2018 Infectious Diseases Law, highlighting responsibilities of the Health Ministry and the Cabinet. He argues that the affected regions should be declared 'infected zones,' enabling notification, contact tracing, and quarantine for entrants from those zones. Emphasizing early action, he says risk should be addressed while it is still outside the door. He also asks whether the government will implement the law to protect public health and prepare a concrete response.

triage.headline_ja: ジャレ・レフィク・ロジャース議員からのエボラ警告：感染症法に言及
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡200人以上、1000人以上の疑い患者）、国際的拡大リスク（キプロスへの輸入リスク言及）を示す。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行が明記されているが、対象国リストはコンゴ民主共和国(203312)のみを含む。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。キプロスは地理的に対象外。新種エボラサブタイプの急速な拡大、死亡率の高さ、未制御の状況が確認されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola avança na África e diretor da OMS faz apelo urgente por mobilização internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak advances in Africa, and the WHO director makes an urgent appeal for international mobilization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies, centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. On May 30, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged heightened community engagement and international support to curb transmission during his visit to Bunia. The outbreak has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases with hundreds of deaths in the region; Africa CDC data cite more than 246 confirmed deaths among suspected cases, with figures likely undercounted due to testing limits in remote areas. The current strain is the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, rare and without an approved vaccine specifically for it. The virus has been identified in several Congolese provinces and has crossed into neighboring Uganda, where authorities report new cases. Response is hampered by armed conflict, population displacement, and weak infrastructure, underscoring the need for rapid international mobilization and strong community participation to prevent spread to new areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカで拡大、WHO事務局長が国際的動員を緊急に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認例、1,000件以上の疑い例と246件以上の確認死亡例、稀なBundibugyo株の流行、国際的動員の必要性から、直ちにフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州Bunia）での発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO事務局長による緊急の国際動員呼びかけ、稀なBundibugyo株の流行、武装紛争による対応困難など、複数の懸念要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de ebola em SP e no Rio têm diagnóstico de meningite e malária, mas doença segue sob investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro have been diagnosed with meningitis and malaria, but the disease remains under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil are under investigation after diagnoses of meningitis and malaria. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo presented with fever; malaria tests were inconclusive and he was diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis). Ebola testing is pending, with results expected within about 48 hours, as the state health secretariat and the Ministry of Health oversee the case. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian man who had been in Uganda—a country with Ebola activity—has malaria but remains isolated until Ebola is ruled out, and has been transferred to INI/Fiocruz for evaluation. Transmission occurs via direct contact with fluids from symptomatic, acutely ill patients. WHO data for the Bundibugyo outbreak report 18 deaths among 134 confirmed cases; 223 deaths and 906 cases are under investigation. Actions emphasize isolation and infection-control protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのサンパウロとリオデジャネイロの疑い例がエボラではなく髄膜炎とマラリアと診断されたが、疾病は引き続き調査対象
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の2つ以上に該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、高病原性ウイルス感染症（エボラ）の疑い事例が複数国にまたがって報告されており、検査結果待ちの状況が続いているため、フルRRA実施の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポルトガル語メディア報道で、エボラ疑い事例が複数国の渡航者に関連（DRCおよびウガンダへの渡航歴）。DRCはBundibugyo Ebolaの流行地であり、WHO報告の死亡者数が高い。ウガンダはリスト対象国でないため verified_locations に含めていない。現在検査結果待ち段階であるが、ブラジルでのエボラ初例の可能性と国際旅行者への接触が関係者の不安を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Brasil: turista isolado na Fiocruz-RJ e congolês intubado em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Brazil: tourist isolated at Fiocruz-RJ and a Congolese man intubated in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil on May 31, 2026: in Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian tourist arriving from Uganda is isolated at Fiocruz with cough, chills and diarrhea; a malaria test was positive, but Ebola testing is pending with results expected Monday; epidemiological surveillance is tracing contacts in Rio. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who recently traveled there, was admitted to a UPA with high fever and rapid deterioration, then intubated at Emílio Ribas and sedated; meningococcal meningitis was identified, but Ebola suspicion remains until specific tests confirm it on Monday; contacts from the UPA and on the flight are being monitored. The current outbreak is Ebola Bundibugyo, with 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, plus 906 cases and 223 deaths still under investigation; there is no vaccine or approved specific treatment. The UN says international flight risk is low, but Brazil’s protocol remains at maximum level.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのエボラ出血熱：観光客がフィオクルス-RJで隔離、コンゴ人がサンパウロで気管挿管
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な移動ケース（ウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国からブラジルへ）であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「予想外の発症」「重症度」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に言及されているウガンダはBluedotの地域リストに含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。確認された2つの疑似症例：(1)ベルギー国籍の観光客がリオデジャネイロで隔離、ウガンダからの入国；(2)コンゴ民主共和国出身の37歳男性がサンパウロで気管挿管。当該地域の進行中アウトブレイク（エボラブンディブギョ：確定症例134、死亡18）の背景。検査結果は月曜日予定。ブラジルの公衆衛生当局が最高レベルの対応プロトコルを維持している。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases surpass 1,000 in latest outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), has 1,077 suspected cases and 246 probable deaths since its May 15 declaration. The eastern DRC outbreak faces surveillance and healthcare-delivery challenges amid insecurity and population movement. Africa CDC lists 11 other African countries at high risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi and Somalia. BVD is rarer than Zaire; there are no approved vaccines or targeted therapies. Early laboratory testing focused on the Zaire strain, delaying BVD confirmation. Transmission is via contact with infected blood or bodily fluids or with infected animals; fruit bats are suspected reservoirs. Incubation 2–21 days; contagious after symptoms appear, not airborne. Symptoms start with fever, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, liver/kidney impairment, and confusion. Management relies on rapid case detection, testing, contact tracing, infection prevention, safe burials, and community engagement; CFR for past BVD outbreaks ranged 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: 疑い例が1,000件を超える。最新のエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,077疑い例、246死亡例）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、アフリカ地域11カ国への高リスク評価が示されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白であり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアフリカ12カ国が列挙されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC、Zambiaの2カ国のみ。記事サマリーで明示的に高リスク国とされているRwanda、Kenya、Central African Republic、Tanzania、Ethiopia、Burundi、Somaliaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。BVD（Bundibugyo virus disease）の治療法がなく、過去の致死率30～50%という極めて高い重症度が特徴。東部DRCでの治安悪化と人口移動が拡大リスクを増幅。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya strengthens Ebola preparedness amid DRC outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Kenya is strengthening Ebola preparedness amid the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Specialized Ebola isolation and treatment facilities have been established at Kenyatta National Hospital, the Kenya National Police Hospital, and the Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital. More than 10 high-risk border counties have identified additional response sites to enable swift action for suspected cases. In partnership with the United States government, Kenya is also establishing a facility at a military installation in Laikipia County to boost disease monitoring, isolation, and emergency response. The effort aims to improve surveillance systems, laboratory diagnostic capacity, emergency preparedness exercises, medical supplies, and rapid response mechanisms. The government emphasizes regional coordination and lessons from COVID-19, noting a UN Nairobi facility supported emergency response and that investments will strengthen health security beyond Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがDRC感染症流行の中でエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱とCOVID-19の同時発生、DRCでの流行に対するケニアの準備体制構築、国際協力（米国）の関与、複数州での対応施設整備など、国境を跨ぐ地域的脅威として評価される。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行に対するケニアの準備体制。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCはリストに含まれるため記載。米国の関与記載あるが、米国も対象国外。エボラとCOVID-19の複合リスク、複数州での施設整備、国際協力体制の構築が戦略的対応を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Le directeur général de l'OMS salue la guérison de cinq patients atteints d'Ebola | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General welcomes the recovery of five patients with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Five patients recovered from a rare form of Ebola in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, during the current outbreak. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain—lacking approved treatment or vaccine—saw the first documented recovery since the outbreak began. Official counts report 906 suspected cases and 223 presumed deaths; Uganda has nine cases and one death. MSF warns the outbreak spreads faster than response, urging expanded testing, rapid humanitarian deployment, and sustained medical supplies. Health workers face risk amid community anger over corpse-handling protocols, with at least three attacks on health centres. Attacks by armed groups in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu hinder response; rebels include ADF and M23. Authorities stress community involvement and early care to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ患者5人の回復を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の回復事例、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株という治療法・ワクチン未承認の希少株による大規模アウトブレイク、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）での確認、武装勢力による対応阻害が認められ、フルRRAの実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、Bundibugyo Ebola株による現在進行中のアウトブレイクが主題。DRCのイトゥリ州・ブニア市での感染確認が中心。ウガンダについても9例・死亡1例の記載があるが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク対応。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。906例の疑い例、223名の死亡報告があり、治療法・ワクチン未承認株による大規模流行という点で極めて高いリスク評価。MSF（国境なき医師団）による支援拡大の緊急呼びかけ、武装勢力による保健施設への攻撃（少なくとも3件）が対応を著しく阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Югорчан предупредили об инфекциях, которые переносят насекомые в тропиках
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yugra residents warned about tropical infections transmitted by insects.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, residents of Yugra are advised to beware tropical infections transmitted by insects when vacationing in Vietnam or Thailand during the rainy season. Mosquitoes, midges and gnats in the tropics can carry malaria, dengue fever and other dangerous infections. Before travel, consult a physician about vaccination and prophylactic medications; bring a first-aid kit with prophylactics for infections, as well as antifungal and antibacterial agents. Use repellents every 3–4 hours, especially at dusk and dawn. Sleep in rooms with mosquito screens on windows or with the window fully closed. If fever, headaches, feverishness, muscle pains, nausea, or diarrhea occur, seek medical attention immediately.

triage.headline_ja: ユーゴル地方住民が熱帯で昆虫が媒介する感染症について警告を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシア地域の住民に対する渡航時の感染症予防啓発であり、ロシア領内での実際の感染症発生ではない。記事はベトナム・タイ渡航時の注意喚起が主題であり、対象国内での疾患の流行や深刻な被害状況は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はロシア地域住民に対する渡航予防啓発であり、マラリアおよびデング熱の流行地を言及しているのはタイとベトナムだが、これらの国での実際の疾患発生・流行状況の報告ではない。シグナル対象とするに値する疾患負荷または流行情報が記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Director-geral da OMS visita o epicentro da doença na RDC - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the WHO visits the epicenter of the disease in the DRC - O País - The Truth as News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers on Bunia, Ituri province, drawing a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of May 31, 2026, Ghebreyesus spoke at a joint press conference with the Congolese government in Bunia, urging affected communities to help craft responses tailored to their own circumstances, arguing that communities understand their challenges best and can propose locally appropriate solutions. He stressed that authorities must provide clear guidance while also listening to communities to enhance outbreak control. The WHO chief pledged ongoing support for frontline health workers on the ground for as long as necessary and reaffirmed a commitment to maintaining essential health services amid the Ebola response. The visit underscores emphasis on community engagement and sustained health-system support during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の中心地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラは公衆衛生上の重大な影響を持ち、異常かつ予想外であり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクがある。また、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い社会的・政治的関心を反映している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則上の指定疾患であり、DRCでの発生は常に重大なシグナルである。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な懸念の高さを示唆している。コミュニティ・エンゲージメントへの強調は、地域での流行対策の複雑性を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Ärzte ohne Grenzen: Ausbreitung von Ebola in der DR Kongo "sehr alarmierend"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Spread of Ebola in DR Congo 'highly alarming'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) is described as highly alarming by Doctors Without Borders (MSF). As of May 31, 2026, the outbreak has caused 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases, with many samples awaiting laboratory confirmation, underscoring a rapid spread responders are struggling to keep pace with. Officials note the surge has occurred unusually soon after the outbreak was officially announced, leaving the true scale of transmission unclear. MSF calls for substantial strengthening of on-the-ground medical relief and a rapid expansion of testing capacity. The organization stresses the importance of engaging local communities to curb transmission and prevent further spread, highlighting a need for increased support to health facilities in the affected DR Congo regions.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：DR コンゴにおけるエボラの拡大は「極めて深刻」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い致死率、国際的懸念、深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認され、国際支援が明らかに必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。1,000件以上の疑い患者と246名の死亡、多くのサンプルが検査待ち状態。公式発表直後の急速な拡大が報告されており、実際の感染規模が不明。国際支援（医療体制強化、検査能力拡大、地域との関係構築）の必要性が強調されている。AFRO地域の懸念事項として最優先対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in the DRC: A Complex Public Health Challenge
article.articleSummary: DRC confirms its 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri province on May 15, 2026; cases exceed 900, with the virus crossing into Uganda and reaching North and South Kivu, areas now controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23. No vaccine exists for this strain, complicating containment as Goma—eastern DRC’s logistical hub—is occupied by an armed group and MONUSCO has downsized to Ituri and North Kivu. The international health response faces funding gaps, including USAID dismantling and the U.S. withdrawal from WHO, against a backdrop of a strained global health architecture. The outbreak emerges amid long-standing conflict, poor infrastructure, and porous borders, with initial reports suggesting weeks of undetected spread and underprepared local health systems. Past outbreaks showed responses become political acts in conflict zones, underscoring the need for conflict analysis, MONUSCO coordination, and no-regrets planning—challenges that persist in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)でのエボラ流行：複雑な公衆衛生上の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。17回目のエボラ流行で900例超、ウガンダへの越境確認、国際的資金難、新規ワクチンなし、複数州への拡大と高い国際的懸念。フルRRA実施すべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダとルワンダへの越境拡大も記載されているが、対象国リストに該当がないため verified_locations には DRC のみ含める。発生地域に Uganda と Rwanda が含まれているが、記事の主題は DRC でのエボラ流行であり、ウガンダ・ルワンダは二次的な関心。DRC は対象国 ID 203312 として確認。

article.articleHeadline: Смертельно опасный вирус Эбола вышел из-под контроля - Аргументы Недели
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly Ebola virus has gotten out of control - Arguments of the Week
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, Ebola virus is spreading through Central Africa at record pace, with infections so high that doctors cannot adequately protect healthy residents. The outbreak may have crossed borders, as suspicious Ebola cases are being investigated in Brazil. In response to the escalating danger, the United States has closed its border to residents of all countries deemed at risk for Ebola transmission for the first time, and authorities propose deporting infected Americans from the country; Russia has also tightened border controls. Ebola remains one of the world's deadliest viruses, with mortality up to 90% and severe physical suffering for patients. The account highlights ongoing transmission in Central Africa, potential international spillover, and unprecedented travel restrictions tied to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラウイルスが制御不能に陥った - Arguments of the Week
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラの中央アフリカでの大流行、国際的な症例疑い（ブラジル）、米国・ロシアによる前例のない国境閉鎖・渡航制限が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のすべてが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中央アフリカでの主流行が強調されているが、中央アフリカは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルでは「疑わしいエボラ症例が調査中」と記載されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。米国・ロシアの対応は記載されているが、これらは対象国ではないため含めない。信頼性に関する注記：2026年5月の将来日付であり、架空のシナリオの可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Lima Pasien Pulih dari Ebola Langka di Kongo Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Five Patients Recovered from a Rare Form of Ebola in Eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare strain, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). WHO disclosed on Sunday, May 31, 2026, during Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus's visit to Bunia in Ituri Province. Four patients were discharged that day and one had been discharged two days earlier, marking the first documented recoveries from Bundibugyo within the current outbreak, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The DRC outbreak has officially reported 906 cases and 223 deaths, while neighboring Uganda confirmed 9 cases and 1 death as of the same period. MSF warns that despite better-equipped facilities and aid arrivals, transmission is outpacing response, and calls for expanded testing, rapid deployment of aid workers, and continued access to medical supplies. At the ceremony inaugurating a new Ebola treatment center, Tedros urged early care-seeking and community involvement, noting that Ebola can be stopped and infected individuals can recover with timely support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：東コンゴの稀なエボラから5人の患者が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な状況、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は治療法やワクチンがない稀な株で、DRC 906例・死亡223例、ウガンダでも9例の確認がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのBundibugyo Ebola（稀な株）の多数の症例と死亡、ウガンダでの確認例を述べている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。WHO事務局長による訪問とコミュニティ対応の強化呼びかけが報告されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。MSFの警告により管理可能性への懸念も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique de l'Ouest sous tension : Ebola, économie et signaux sociaux face à la crise - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Africa under strain: Ebola, the economy and social signals in the face of the crisis - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: West Africa on edge as Ebola resurges in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting regional health and economic alerts as of 31 May 2026. Africa CDC reports only 290 million of the initially pledged 500 million dollars to fight Ebola are secured, highlighting funding fragility. A continental plan worth 319 million dollars covers June–November 2026. The WHO has released 3.9 million from its emergency fund, and UNICEF is shipping over 100 tonnes of equipment to the DRC. While the epicenter remains in the DRC, West African health systems remain vigilant after the 2014–2016 outbreak that killed more than 11,000. The crisis strains budgets, donors, and vulnerable populations, risking social and political stability in the Sahel and West Africa. For Mali, border restrictions, disrupted trade, and stretched health services heighten vulnerabilities amid ongoing security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 西アフリカが緊張状態：エボラ、経済と危機に直面する社会的シグナル - マリ・アクチュ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の再発生が報告され、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRCが主な発生地であり、地域的拡大リスク、国際的関心、経済・社会的影響が顕著。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ再発生が主題。West African health systemsの警戒が述べられているが、マリはDRCの国境制限・貿易影響の文脈で言及されており、マリ自体でのエボラ発生は報告されていない。したがってマリは含めない。資金不足（500百万ドル中290百万ドル確保）、WHO緊急基金の拠出、UNICEF機器支援などから国際的な対応が進行中。2014-2016年の大流行（11,000人以上死亡）の記憶がある中での再発生。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Wabah Ebola saat Bepergian ke Luar Negeri : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of the Ebola outbreak while traveling abroad: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with cases also reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization (WHO) designated the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 16 May 2026. Indonesian Health Ministry data up to 15 May 2026 show 246 suspected Ebola cases in Ituri Province, DRC, including eight laboratory-confirmed, with 80 deaths (case fatality rate 32.5%). Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects from infected humans or animals. Ebola belongs to the Orthoebolavirus genus. Since its first identification in the DRC in 1976, notable outbreaks include West Africa (2014–2016) with >28,000 cases and ~11,000 deaths. No specific therapy or approved vaccine exists for BDBV; no Ebola cases detected in Indonesia, but international travel remains a concern.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行中のエボラ出血熱の流行に注意：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定済みの確認済み流行であり、複数国への拡大報告あり。
triage.notes: DRCでの確認済みエボラ流行（BDBV、246疑い例、8確認例、死亡者80名、致命率32.5%）。ウガンダでも報告例あるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシアでは未確認だが、記事がインドネシア向けの渡航警告であり、インドネシア保健省が言及しているため verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC指定（2026年5月16日）済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert: the health emergency forcing Meloni to demand border controls in Europe
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda; confirmed 15 May in eastern DRC; WHO tally just over 1,000 cases with 233 deaths if probable included; Uganda reports six infections and one fatality. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments; containment relies on strict isolation during a three-week incubation, impractical in active conflict. Ituri’s violence has displaced about 100,000 in the past month, hampering contact tracing as transmissions spread through makeshift corridors and informal mining settlements. Italy intensifies airport screening at Rome's Fiumicino and Milan Malpensa; Spallanzani specialists head to Kinshasa; Brussels urged to standardise passenger screening. Rome seeks a video conference of EU health ministers ahead of the June European Council to address imported risk across Schengen borders. The situation links border-control politics with pressing public health readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：メローニがヨーロッパの国境管理を要求する健康上の緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスクが高く、EU各国での検疫強化と国家間の調整が急速に進行中。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC（イトゥリ州）およびウガンダでのエボラ発生を報道しており、イタリア・ベルギーの記載は空港検疫強化の対応地点。WPROスクリーニング基準において、1,000例超・233死亡（疑い例含む）の重症度、承認済みワクチンなし、紛争地での接触者追跡困難による継続的曝露、Bundibugyo株の高い伝播性、イタリア・EU各国の検疫体制強化という管理課題が全て該当。EU首脳会議での協議予定から国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief hails five Ebola recoveries as new treatment centre opens | BreakingNews
article.articleSummary: Five recoveries from Bundibugyo-type Ebola are reported as a new treatment centre opens in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo, amid an eastern outbreak. WHO says four discharges today and one the day before yesterday; the Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine, and the WHO noted the first documented recovery of a confirmed Bundibugyo patient in this outbreak. As of 31 May 2026, DR Congo reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death. The outbreak continues to spread faster than response despite better facilities and aid, with doctors calling for expanded testing and sustained supplies. Health workers face heightened danger and local burial rites fuel community tensions, leading to at least three attacks on health centres. The illness has also appeared in North Kivu and South Kivu (M23 controls parts of Goma and Bukavu; two cases reported).

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、新しい治療センターが開所する中、エボラ出血熱の5人の回復を称賛 | BreakingNews
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの東部での大規模流行であり、DRコング・ウガンダで計1,129疑い患者・224疑い死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコングの東部地域（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）での大規模なBundibugyo型エボラ流行を報告。ウガンダへの越境事例（9例1死亡）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。906疑い患者・223疑い死亡（配信日時31 May 2026時点）という高い疾病負荷、治療センター不足、保健労働者への攻撃、社会的緊張など、複数の管理上の課題が存在。WHOが回復例をハイライトしている一方で、拡大速度が対応を上回っているとの報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief hails 5 Ebola recoveries as a new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare type of Ebola in Bunia, eastern Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Sunday during a visit to Bunia, the heart of an outbreak in Ituri province. He noted that four people would be discharged today and one had been discharged the day before yesterday, as a new Ebola treatment center opened in Bunia, the provincial capital of Ituri. The remarks came during his visit to the city, highlighting progress in the outbreak response and the expansion of care capacity in Bunia. The report provides no further details on total cases, deaths, laboratory confirmation, or transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部での5人のエボラ回復者を称賛、新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という極めて高い致命率と公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持つ疾患の発生が確認されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当するシグナルとして認識される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は世界保健機関と国際社会が最優先監視対象とする感染症。記事はポジティブな回復事例の報告だが、依然として進行中の発生状況であり、総症例数、死亡者数、検査確認状況など詳細情報が不足している。フルRRAでの詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الدغيس: لا إصابات بإيبولا في ليبيا والمرض منحصر في بؤره الرئيسة - اخبار ليبيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Al-Daghis: No Ebola cases in Libya, and the disease is confined to its main foci - Libya News
article.articleSummary: Libya's National Center for Disease Control reports no Ebola cases in Libya or North Africa as of May 31, 2026. Ebola is re-emerging in primary foci, notably the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with cases also reported in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The World Health Organization's declaration of Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern is noted as globally concerning. A week earlier, Libya's CDC denied any confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in Libya, reaffirming a stable epidemiological situation. The center's teams remain on high alert with continuous surveillance and enhanced health monitoring, ready to detect and manage any suspected case per approved procedures. Citizens are urged to consult official sources only; any developments will be communicated through the center's official channels.

triage.headline_ja: ダーギス氏：リビアではエボラウイルス感染者なし、疾病は主要な感染地域に限定 - リビアニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの複数国での再出現（DRC、ウガンダ、ギニア、シエラレオネ、リベリア）により、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）の複数に該当し、WHOの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）の宣言も記載されているため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの複数国での再出現が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニア、ウガンダはWPRO/AFRO対象外のため記事内容は把握するが verified_locations には含めない。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte Ebola : l'urgence sanitaire qui oblige Meloni à exiger le contrôle des frontières en Europe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: the health emergency that forces Meloni to demand border controls across Europe
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda triggers European alert. As of May 15, the WHO reports a bit over 1,000 cases (confirmed and suspected) and 233 deaths; Uganda confirms 6 cases and 1 death. The epicenter is Ituri's Bunia, where fighting has displaced about 100,000 people in the past month, hindering contact tracing. The current Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved specific therapy; control relies on strict isolation during the 21-day incubation, a strategy impractical in a war zone. Rome strengthens airport surveillance at Fiumicino and Malpensa; Spallanzani specialists head to Kinshasa. Italy presses Brussels to harmonize EU passenger screening and convene a health ministers’ videoconference ahead of the June European Council, highlighting sovereignty debates over border control in a context of an imported risk ahead of the tourist season.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒: メローニ首相がヨーロッパ全域での国境管理強化を要求する保健上の緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）で1,000例以上・233死亡、欧州への拡大リスク明確、渡航制限・国境管理の政治的議論が発生している。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC東部（Ituri・Bunia）およびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク。イタリア・ベルギー・ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー上は対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（対象国リストにない）での事例報告も記載されているが、主な流行地はDRC。既知の流行状況報告であり、新規感染の急速なエスカレーション情報は不明だが、戦闘地帯での接触者追跡困難、ワクチン未承認株という懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por Ébola: la emergencia sanitaria que obliga a Meloni a exigir el control de fronteras en Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert: The Health Emergency That Forces Meloni to Demand Border Controls in Europe.
article.articleSummary: As of May 15, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda prompts European border-control discussions. The epicenter is Ituri province near Bunia; official counts show about 1,000 cases (confirmed or suspected) and 233 deaths, with Uganda reporting six cases and one death. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccines or approved therapies exist; the only medical option is strict isolation during the roughly three-week incubation, a strategy impractical amid active conflict and mass displacement (around 100,000 people in the last month). Italy’s government presses Brussels to unify passenger screening for direct and indirect arrivals from the Great Lakes region; Rome’s airports Fiumicino and Malpensa have regional protocols, while Spallanzani Hospital sends resources to Kinshasa. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus warns transmission control is nearly impossible on the ground; a EU videoconference is proposed ahead of the June Council.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：メローニ首相がヨーロッパの国境管理を要求させる保健衛生上の緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（確定・疑い1000例以上、233死亡例）がDRC東部で発生しており、ウガンダでも報告。IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。欧州各国・EU行政機関での高い政治的関心を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRCのイトゥリ州およびキンシャサ市での発生であり、ウガンダでの確認例もあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イタリア・ローマへの言及は感染症イベント自体の発生地ではなく、欧州の政治的反応を記述しているため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株の出現、ワクチン/治療法の欠落、武力紛争下での制御困難さが深刻度を増している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les fermetures de frontières imposées dans la région pour contenir l'épidémie de Bundibugyo n'ont pas mis fin aux mouvements transfrontaliers
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Border closures imposed in the region to contain the Bundibugyo outbreak have not halted cross-border movements.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the border region persists despite border closures, with cross-border movements continuing at formal and informal points along the Uganda–DRC border (Cyanika, Busunga, Bunagana, Mpondwe, Goli, Vurra, Busanza, Ntoroko) for economic, family, and return reasons. An IOM situation report (covering May 22–27) accompanies a May 22–23 trilateral Kampala meeting between the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, which produced a memorandum of understanding and collective funding commitments to bolster regional preparedness and response (amounts not disclosed). IOM highlights significant funding gaps hindering deployment, with unaddressed needs in community surveillance, community engagement, psychosocial support, logistics, and mobility tracking in insecure areas. WHO risk prioritization lists Priority 1: DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Burundi, Rwanda; Priority 2: Angola, Central African Republic, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of the Congo, Tanzania, Zambia. By May 25 the outbreak had over 900 suspected and 101 confirmed cases in DRC, and 7 confirmed cases with 1 death in Uganda, following WHO’s May 16 PHEIC declaration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：地域内で実施された国境閉鎖はブンディブギョ流行を封じ込めることができず、国境を越えた移動が続いている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示している。確認された死亡例、複数国での急速な症例増加、地域内での制御困難な国境越え移動が記録されており、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大事象である。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC（国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態）は2026年5月16日に宣言済み。Bundibugyo亜種エボラウイルスの流行で、DRCで900以上の疑い患者と101人の確認患者、ウガンダで7人の確認患者と1人の死亡が報告されている。複数の対象国リスト上に記載されているが、主要な実発生地はDRCとウガンダ。スーダン南部は記事に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsに含めない。Zambia はWHO優先度2リストに含まれるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Rezza: "Italia prima in Europa a blindare confini" | "Governo ex negazionista, ora senza ideologia"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Rezza: "Italy first in Europe to seal off borders" | Ex-denialist government, now without ideology
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts Italy to seal borders and implement a stringent surveillance regime, including mandatory quarantines, Class 4 biocontainment, and travel restrictions for travelers from affected areas. Italian Health Minister Orazio Schillaci signs an ordinance reflecting Europe’s early, precautionary response. Ex-Director of Prevention Giovanni Rezza commends the approach but cautions about nonuniform implementation across autonomous regions and reliance on traveler-provided information; penalties apply for non-compliance. No vaccines are approved for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant currently circulating; vaccines effective against other strains are not protective here, and therapies are limited to monoclonal antibodies and antivirals for supportive care. MSF’s Enzo Porpiglia links weaker outbreak response to years of healthcare cuts. Diagnostic challenges persist: tests for the Zaire strain miss Bundibugyo, requiring Kinshasa labs for confirmation from distant sites. First death occurred April 24; official epidemic declaration May 17. As of May 31, 2026, the outbreak persists in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、レッツァ：「イタリアはヨーロッパで最初に国境を封鎖した」｜元否定主義政府、現在はイデオロギーなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準3項目該当。エボラ出血熱の流行拡大、特にBundibugyo株の対策困難性と複数国への波及による渡航制限措置が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、イタリアの対応（国境封鎖、監視体制強化）はDRC発生事象への二次的反応。Bundibugyo株という診断困難な亜種の流行、ワクチン非対応性、医療体制の脆弱性が指摘されており、地域的管理可能性への懸念あり。首例死亡4月24日、流行宣言5月17日、統計基準日5月31日時点で継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Chuột mang theo các bệnh truyền nhiễm nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Which infectious diseases do mice carry?
article.articleSummary: Plague, hantavirus, rabies, rat-bite fever, and leptospirosis are diseases carried by mice. Plague (Yersinia pestis) has bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic forms, spread mainly by fleas on infected rodents; transmission can also occur via contact with blood or tissues, with pneumonic plague capable of person-to-person droplet spread. It remains sporadic in Africa, Asia, and the Americas and is treatable with antibiotics if detected early. Hantavirus, shed in rodent urine, feces, and saliva, causes hantavirus pulmonary syndrome or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; global cases are estimated at 10,000–100,000 annually, concentrated in Asia and Europe. Rabies virus is almost always fatal after symptoms appear; Vietnam uses Verorab and Abhayrab vaccines, with 0–3–7–14–28 or 0–3–7–28 schedules and tetanus prophylaxis as indicated. Rat-bite fever includes Haverhill (Streptobacillus moniliformis) and Sodoku (Spirillum minus), with mortality up to 10–13% if untreated; a Hanoi case is described. Leptospira transmission occurs in areas with poor sanitation, flooding, or crowded urban settings.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミが媒介する感染症にはどのようなものがあるか
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重症感染症（ペスト、ハンタウイルス、狂犬病）に関する教育的記事。ベトナムでの個別症例言及があるが、組織的アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は主にネズミ媒介感染症の一般的な情報提供。ハノイでのラット咬傷熱症例の言及あるが、組織的な患者数増加やアウトブレイク宣言ではない。スペイン（カナリア諸島）はBluedotが付与しているが、記事本体ではスペインの具体的イベントは記述されていないため除外。アフリカ大陸への言及は散発的発生の背景情報に過ぎず、検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible contagio de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Brazil is investigating a possible Ebola infection in a 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and presents with compatible symptoms. The patient is hospitalized in São Paulo awaiting laboratory results. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat says the case is under investigation and the risk of regional spread is considered unlikely, citing the absence of direct flights from the Congo region to South America and that Ebola transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organization reported 49 new infections and eight additional deaths in the past week, with 160 suspected cases and 47 probable deaths under analysis.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの可能な感染を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）、および確認された患者が複数国にまたがるシグナル。DRCでの継続的な流行との関連も懸念される。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行（週49件の新規感染、8件の追加死亡）の背景下でのブラジルでの疑い患者報告。患者はDRC渡航後に症状を呈しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。現地当局は地域的拡大リスクは低いと評価しているが、エボラの重症度と国際的拡大リスクの潜在性から、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : pourquoi l'Afrique francophone retient son souffle - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Why Francophone Africa Is Holding Its Breath - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 101 confirmed cases, 139 deaths, and about 900 suspected infections, with transmission focused in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is circulating, and there is no licensed vaccine available. WHO classifies the regional risk as very high for the DRC and high for the broader region. The response faces challenges from armed conflict, displaced populations, and strained health systems. In the Sahel, Mali and other AES states reinforce border surveillance to prevent importation and preserve stability. MSF and other organizations report operational difficulties in insecure areas, underscoring cross-border cooperation gaps. The crisis highlights vulnerabilities in Francophone African health security and the need for coordinated regional preparedness to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱：フランコフォンアフリカがなぜ息を詰めているのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、スクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス確認、複数国での流行リスク、国際支援要件が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。マリはサヘル地域での境界監視強化の文脈で言及されているが、確認事例は発生していない。Bundibugyo株の流行、ワクチン未供給、900例の疑い例を含む大規模流行状況。武力紛争と保健システム脆弱性が対応を大きく阻害。CEPR EBS活動の対象地域内での優先シグナルとしての価値高い。

article.articleHeadline: DGS atualiza procedimentos para responder a casos suspeitos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DGS updates procedures to respond to suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: On 31 May 2026, Portugal's DGS updated procedures for suspected Ebola and other filovirus fever. Reference hospitals are Curry Cabral and São João in Porto for adults, and Dona Estefânia for children, with infectious-disease teams coordinating with INEM and INSA. A suspected case is fever above 38°C with symptoms (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, anorexia, bleeding) after exposure in areas with Ebola circulation. Clinicians must notify DGS by phone and via the National Epidemiological Surveillance platform; DGS validates cases, INEM transports, and INSA confirms diagnosis. Suspected cases require isolation in dedicated, well-ventilated units with strict hygiene and mask use until INEM arrives. Travelers to endemic areas should have pre-travel consultation, register on Portal das Comunidades, and obtain travel insurance, plus 21-day self-monitoring after return; blood donation is not advised for 60 days. Europe risk remains very low per ECDC/WHO. The Congo outbreak began May 15, with >246 deaths and ~1,000 suspected cases; Uganda has nine confirmed cases, two new; WHO declared PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: DGS、エボラ疑い患者対応手順を更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2つ以上）。コンゴでの大規模エボラ流行とWHO PHEIC宣言がシグナルであり、ポルトガルの疑い患者対応手順更新は国際的感染症危機の顕れ。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポルトガルにおける疑い患者対応手順の更新を主題としているが、実際の感染症イベント（エボラ流行）はコンゴとウガンダで発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴでの246死亡、約1,000疑い患者、WHO PHEIC宣言という深刻な状況が背景。ポルトガルの対応手順更新は二次的な関心事であり、プライマリイベントはコンゴ流行。

article.articleHeadline: نسب الوفيات تصل لـ 50%.. معلومات خطيرة بشأن فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case fatality rates reach up to 50%... Alarming information about the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreaks are escalating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with case fatality rates up to 50% in some areas. The virus remains highly dangerous and spreads mainly through direct contact with infected individuals or contaminated bodily fluids, risking rapid transmission when preventive measures falter. The Congo strain currently has no vaccine. Egypt reports no Ebola cases and says the health system is under control, with 24/7 surveillance at airports, seaports, and land borders; arrivals from outbreak zones are isolated, quarantined, and tested. Early symptoms resemble influenza (fever, fatigue, body aches) but can progress to immune dysfunction, hemorrhaging, dehydration, and shock if untreated. Some experts note Ebola spreads quickly between people, unlike Hantavirus, which is mainly rodent-to-human; a survivor may remain infectious after death, and handling the deceased's belongings can transmit the virus. Elderly and those with chronic diseases are especially at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡率が50%に達する...エボラウイルスに関する警告情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCでのエボラ流行は重大な公衆衛生上の影響（50%の高い致死率）、異常で予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク（隣接国エジプトでの国境警戒）、渡航制限の可能性を示唆している。WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染性が高い。
triage.notes: エジプトはサマリーで「no Ebola cases」と明記されており、主題はDRCの流行。エジプトは警戒体制を敷いているが患者報告なしのため verified_locations から除外。Hantavirus と Influenza も疾患名に含まれているが、記事の主題はエボラの流行警告。

article.articleHeadline: 2주 만에 1000명대...민주콩고서 역대 최고 속도로 에볼라 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In two weeks, the number has reached the thousands... Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the fastest rate on record.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province's Mongwalu area, with no approved vaccine or therapy for this strain. As of May 29—two weeks after the May 15 outbreak declaration—suspected cases reached 1,077 with 246 deaths, the fastest and third-largest on record. Transmission appears to have begun among medical staff during an April surgery on a woman who miscarried, indicating early nosocomial spread. The illness incubates up to 21 days and mimics malaria and typhoid, hindering detection. Health systems face shortages of protective gear, testing kits, and clean water; seven health workers have died. In Mongwalu, violence and mistrust erupted: a ward was burned, 18 suspected patients escaped, and about 100 Catholic followers attacked the hospital to retrieve bodies. US funding has diminished; Washington pledged $23 million after withdrawals by WHO and USAID, but experts call it insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間で1000人台...民主コンゴでエボラが過去最高速度で拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。即座にフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる急速な拡大で、2週間で1,077疑い患者と246死亡を記録（過去最高速度）。病院での暴力発生、医療従事者の死亡、個人防護具と検査キットの不足、医療不信など複合的な懸念が存在。米国資金投入が不十分と指摘されている。発生地域にワシントンDC（米国）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC内での発生に焦点を当てており、米国での発生を示唆する記載がないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: FAAN, Lagos govt step up Ebola surveillance at airport
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) surveillance at Lagos' Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA) has been reinforced as of 31 May 2026 by FAAN, Lagos State Government health officials, and Port Health Services, in response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. A joint readiness inspection assessed the airport’s ability to detect, monitor, and respond to potential cases as travellers arrive. Lagos State Commissioner for Health Akinola Abayomi and stakeholders reviewed the emergency preparedness and response plan, risk assessments, and screening procedures. Airlines from high‑risk destinations have been identified, with screening forms administered to passengers on such flights and responsibilities under the emergency framework assigned. FAAN Airport Manager Olatokunbo Arewa and Port Health Head Abdullahi Lawal stressed swift action and adherence to health regulations. The exercise aims to prevent importation and spread of EVD via MMIA Lagos.

triage.headline_ja: FAAN、ラゴス州政府が空港でのエボラウイルス病の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（コンゴDRCでの発生）、および国際的に高い関心のあるリスク事象。IHR基準2つ以上該当、かつ社会的・政治的関心が顕著。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生に応じてナイジェリア（ラゴス）が国境検疫強化を実施する記事。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。ただし、DRCは対象国（ID 203312）であり、国際的な重大感染症イベントとしてのシグナル価値は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. pledges over $162 million for Ebola response in Uganda, DR Congo - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the United States pledges over $162 million for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, funding surveillance, contact tracing, infection prevention, treatment capacity and border screening in affected and at‑risk areas. U.S. support includes about $350 million via UN OCHA pooled funds for the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, plus $50 million to OCHA's Central Emergency Response Fund to establish treatment clinics and sustain operations. Regional measures align travel screening with Canada and Mexico ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026, with advisories elevated for travelers from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan. UNICEF, IOM, Samaritan's Purse, FHI 360 and International Medical Corps back PPE, border screening, laboratory testing and Ebola treatment facilities; Kenya preparedness will receive $13.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応に1億6200万ドル以上を誓約 - Radio Tamazuj
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR Annex2の重要疾患）の国際的な感染リスク、複数国での同時発生、北米への輸入リスク、国際的支援と調整の必要性により、IHR基準3項目該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニアでのエボラ対応が記述されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC(203312)のみ。米国、カナダ、メキシコは対象国外のため除外。発生地域フィールドに複数国が含まれているが、実際の主題はアフリカ中部での流行対応と北米への輸入防止。FIFA World Cup 2026に関連した国際的な移動制限との関連性も高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تعافي 5 حالات إصابة بفيروس إيبولا.. ومازلنا نعمل على التوصل للقاحات وعلاجات - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Five cases of Ebola virus infection have recovered, and we are still working on vaccines and treatments - Shorouk Gate.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that five patients recovered from a rare form of Ebola virus infection in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, during the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Ituri’s capital. Four recovered today and one yesterday, underscoring that recovery is possible even as vaccines and treatments are still under development. The WHO update also shows 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths in the outbreak area. Uganda reported nine Ebola infections and one death, according to its Ministry of Health. Ghebreyesus emphasized community involvement in containment, noting that people who present to health facilities with symptoms receive care and have a better chance of recovery. The current response continues to focus on timely treatment and public health measures while vaccines remain under development.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルス感染5例が回復、ワクチンと治療法の開発を継続中 - ショロウク・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ発生は国際的に極めて高い関心事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでエボラ発生が主要事項。ウガンダでも9例の感染が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。906例の疑い症例と223例の死亡が報告されており、深刻な爆発であることが明示されている。治療センターの開設とワクチン開発継続中という記述から、長期的な対応が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: No lion deaths reported in last three days amid viral outbreak in Gir: Minister
article.articleSummary: Asiatic lions in the Gir landscape, Gujarat, are experiencing a Babesia-related viral infection outbreak. By May 31, 2026, eight lion cubs have died, and 17 other lions have been infected, though no lion deaths were reported in the last three days following intensified monitoring and veterinary treatment. The state Forest Department reports ongoing round-the-clock surveillance, isolation of lions in affected zones, and emergency medical preparedness at the Sasan lion hospital, with teams patrolling Jamwala Rescue Centre, Babariya forest, and Jasadhar Animal Care Centre. Babesia is a parasitic disease transmitted by ticks and can cause weakness, fever, coughing, and nasal discharge in infected animals; infection is treated as a potential threat due to rapid transmission risks in open forests and adjoining revenue areas. The government emphasizes conservation and continued monitoring, with special teams of forest personnel, veterinarians, and field staff providing medical care as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ギル地域のウイルス発生の中、ここ3日間でライオンの死亡は報告されていない：大臣
triage.triage_reason: バベシア症は動物（ライオン）での感染事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の直接的な証拠がない。動物での重症度と蔓延性は認識されるが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクについての記述がなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（Asiatic lion）におけるバベシア症の集団発生である。公式には動物疾患であり、ヒトへの感染リスクについて記事では明示されていない。獣医的対応が進行中であり、現在死亡が3日間報告されていない点は管理下にある可能性を示唆する。ただし、長期曝露リスク（開放林での急速な蔓延リスク）が記載されており、さらなるヒト感染の可能性や越境への拡大についての情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc WHO báo tin vui: 5 bệnh nhân Ebola đã hồi phục ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General reports good news: 5 Ebola patients have recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced five Ebola patients infected with the Bundibugyo strain have recovered; four were discharged that day, with one previously discharged two days earlier. This marks the first confirmed Bundibugyo recovery in the current outbreak. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Official figures show 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths related to the outbreak. In neighboring Uganda, authorities reported 9 cases and 1 death as of May 30. Response challenges include community resistance to strict medical procedures and traditional burial rites. Tedros urged early healthcare seeking and active community engagement, expressing cautious optimism that the outbreak can be controlled with partner support. A new Ebola treatment center was inaugurated in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が朗報報告：コンゴでエボラ患者5人が回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の集団発生であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行性」「長期曝露」の複数項目に該当。DRCおよびウガンダでの二国間感染例と政策的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株による集団発生。906疑似症例、223死亡という高い死亡数。隣国ウガンダへの波及確認済み（9例、1死亡）。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であり、コミュニティ抵抗や埋葬慣行による感染制御の課題が存在。WHO事務局長による公式声明で国際的関心が高まっている段階。新しい治療センターがBuniaに開設された。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupación en Brasil por un posible caso de ébola detectado en un hombre con fiebre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern in Brazil over a possible Ebola case detected in a man with fever.
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola virus disease case detected in Brazil in a man with fever. The response protocol includes isolation, immediate notification, laboratory investigation, and monitoring, as explained by Regiane de Paula of the regional Disease Control Coordination. Brazilian health authorities say the risk of transmission in Brazil is very low due to no autochthonous transmission and the absence of direct flights between Brazil and the Ebola-affected African region. Health officials have called on healthcare facilities to monitor all people who have returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and present fever. A laboratory examination is underway to confirm infection and determine the scope of surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで発熱している男性から検出された可能性のあるエボラウイルス疾患症例について懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患は極めて重篤な疾患であり、国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準で2つ以上該当）とWPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当）を満たす。ただし可能性段階での検査中であり、フルRRA実施を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジルでの可能検出事例が主題。DRCはエボラの発生地域として言及されているが、本記事の主題イベント発生地はブラジル。現段階は疑い事例で検査進行中。エボラウイルスの致死性と国際拡大リスクから高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les fermetures de frontières imposées dans la région pour contenir l'épidémie n'ont pas mis fin aux mouvements transfrontaliers
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Regional border closures imposed to contain the outbreak have not halted cross-border movements.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak persists with cross-border movements despite regional border closures. IOM monitoring (May 15–24) at formal and informal Uganda–DRC crossings—Cyanika, Busunga, Bunagana, Mpondwe, Goli, Vurra, Busanza, Ntoroko—found continued movement for economic, family, and return reasons. The May 22–27 situation report notes a trilateral Kampala meeting (May 22–23) among DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, which yielded a memorandum of understanding and collective funding pledges for regional preparedness; amounts were not disclosed. IOM highlights funding gaps hindering response, with unaddressed priorities including community surveillance, community engagement, psychosocial support, logistics, and mobility tracking in insecure areas. WHO risk ranking places Priority 1 countries as DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Burundi, Rwanda; Priority 2: Angola, CAR, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of the Congo, Tanzania, Zambia. As of May 25, the outbreak reported >900 suspected and 101 confirmed cases in DRC, plus 7 confirmed and 1 death in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：地域の国境閉鎖は流行を封じ込めるために課されているが、国境を越えた移動を停止していない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間流行で、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、複数の死亡・確定患者、国境を越えた継続的な人的移動による長期曝露が認められ、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダンも含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。DRCとザンビアは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーに明記されている。エボラBundibugyo株による多国間流行で、5月25日時点でDRCで900以上の疑似患者と101の確定患者、ウガンダで7人の確定患者と1人の死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo registra a menor incidência de dengue da Região Metropolitana em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo records the lowest dengue incidence in the Metropolitan Region in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Bernardo do Campo records the lowest dengue incidence in the São Paulo Metropolitan Region for populations over 300,000 in the first 17 epidemiological weeks of 2026, at 5.4 cases per 100,000. Across the region, Carapicuíba (6.3) and Itaquaquecetuba (6.8) follow, while Santo André (13.6), Diadema (38.7), and Mauá (43.4) show higher rates. Up to EW17, São Bernardo has 36 confirmed dengue cases and zero deaths; 2025 had 1,769 cases and 3 deaths, and 2024 had 6,133 cases and 10 deaths. The seven-city Grande ABC reported 365 cases and one death (Mauá) by April. Health actions include CCZ vector-control, Dengue-Days, awareness campaigns, and the Clic app for real-time reporting. Vaccination: 1,412 doses administered; among 10–14-year-olds, 29,648 first doses and 16,789 second doses (about 35% coverage).

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルド市、2026年にサンパウロ都市圏でデングの最低罹患率を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は既知の流行疾病であり、本記事は特定都市における罹患率低下を報告する定期的な疾病監視情報です。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準において異常性や重症度の懸念は認められず、社会的関心も限定的です。
triage.notes: ブラジル（サンパウロ州）における定期的なデング感染症監視報告。罹患率は前年比で大幅に低下しており、地域の公衆衛生対応（予防接種キャンペーン、蚊媒介対策）が機能している。死亡数も限定的。新規感染症イベントとしての要素は認められない。
