article.articleHeadline: UK Foreign Secretary to visit India, China for talks on Iran war, Ukraine crisis, and Ebola threat - Connected to India News I Singapore l UAE l UK l USA l NRI
article.articleSummary: 31 May 2026 — UK Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper will travel to China on Monday and then to India for a two-nation tour focused on tackling global challenges and bolstering cooperation. In Beijing, she will meet Vice-President Han Zheng and Foreign Minister Wang Yi, then travel to Shenzhen for a science-and-technology programme. In New Delhi, Cooper will meet External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar and engage with entrepreneurs, academics and government partners as part of the UK-India Vision 2035, following the signing of the India-UK Free Trade Agreement last July. The trip also aims to address the Ebola outbreak in Africa, the Strait of Hormuz tensions, and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Bilateral trade rose to £47.4 billion in 2025, up 11.7% year-on-year, and is expected to rise with CETA implementation despite steel-import hurdles.

triage.headline_ja: UK外務大臣がイランの戦争、ウクライナ危機、エボラの脅威についての会談のためインド、中国を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラアフリカ流行を言及しているが、主題はUK外交官の訪問であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行状況）の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域リストには China (1814991) と India (1269750) が含まれるが、記事サマリーは アフリカのエボラ流行について外交官の会談テーマとして言及しているのみであり、中国やインドでの実際のエボライベント発生を報告していない。記事は政治外交ニュースであり、感染症イベント情報そのものではないため、対象国での verified_locations は空とする。アフリカでのエボラ流行の詳細情報がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Five Ebola patients recover in Congo as WHO opens new treatment centre
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients infected with a rare Bundibugyo strain have recovered in the Democratic Republic of Congo as the WHO opens a new treatment centre in Bunia, Ituri province—the outbreak’s epicenter. Four patients were discharged on Sunday and one more left two days earlier, per WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The WHO noted a prior Bundibugyo recovery and reiterated there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. As of 31 May 2026, official figures cite 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in the DRC, with neighbouring Uganda reporting nine cases and one death. Aid agencies warn the outbreak is outpacing response; MSF calls for expanded testing, faster deployment, and uninterrupted medical supplies. Health workers face community resistance over burial protocols, including at least three attacks on facilities. Tedros urged early care-seeking and emphasized that the outbreak is everyone’s business with hope for recovery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者5人がコンゴで回復、WHOが新治療センター開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてが該当し、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）と高い死亡率（223/906）を示す。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてが該当し、シグナルとしての優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（DRC）での「Bundibugyo」エボラ株アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダへの波及（9例、1死亡）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加していない。ワクチンなし、治療法なし、コミュニティ抵抗、保健従事者への攻撃など対応困難な状況。WHOの公式発表と新治療センター開設により政府・国際機関の関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ebola patients have recovered from rare strain of virus, WHO chief says
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, five patients have recovered from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscoring that recovery is possible despite no approved treatment or vaccine. The WHO says four are being discharged today and one was discharged the day before, in the context of a new Ebola treatment center opened in Bunia, Ituri province. The outbreak has produced 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths among suspected cases; 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths among confirmed in Congo and neighboring Uganda, with Uganda reporting nine confirmed cases and one death. The virus is spreading faster than response, even as health facilities improve and aid arrives. Attacks on health centers linked to burial practices hinder control efforts. Authorities emphasize early care, community involvement, expanded testing, rapid aid deployment, and sustained access to medical supplies to bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス患者5人がウイルスの稀な株から回復、WHO事務局長が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間感染（DRC、ウガンダ）、確認患者134名・死亡18名、国際的拡大リスク、地域での対応困難を示しており、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準全て該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにUganda（1269750対象国リスト外）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダも「neighboring Uganda」として感染確認が述べられている。ただし、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイクで、ウイルスの拡散速度が対応を上回っている状況、保健施設への攻撃による対応困難が報告されている。確認患者134名、死亡18名、複数国への拡大という深刻性からフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة" تدعو المسافرين للكونغو وأوغندا إلى الالتزام بالإجراءات الوقائية من فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health urges travelers to the Congo and Uganda to adhere to preventive measures against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Oman’s Ministry of Health urges travelers to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to follow Ebola prevention measures. Ebola virus disease (EVD) is a severe illness with a high fatality rate up to 90%, affecting humans and some mammals such as monkeys and fruit bats. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids, or contaminated objects, and through handling infected animals or cadavers; it is not airborne and not spread by food or water. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and rash; progression can lead to kidney and liver failure and bleeding, with onset typically within two months of exposure. Preventive guidance emphasizes avoiding travel to affected areas, avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals, hand hygiene, avoiding wildlife and undercooked meat, and limiting nonessential health facility visits. Arrivals from affected regions to Oman should monitor health for 21 days and seek care promptly if symptoms appear, reporting travel history. The Civil Aviation Authority issued memorandum 2026/1 aligning with WHO guidance.

triage.headline_ja: オマーン保健省、コンゴとウガンダへの旅行者にエボラウイルスの予防措置の遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率（最大90%）を持つ重篤な疾患であり、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。複数国での発生と国際的な旅行警告の発出が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。オマーンは発生国ではなく、旅行警告を発出した国のため除外。記事サマリーからはDRCとウガンダでのエボラウイルス発生が主題であり、DRCのみ対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Päť pacientov sa zotavilo zo vzácneho typu eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients have recovered from a rare form of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, five patients have recovered from a rare form of Ebola in Congo's Ituri province, with a new treatment center opened in Bunia by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Four patients will be discharged today, and one had been released the day before. Separately, WHO confirmed a recovery from the Bundibugyo variant, a novel Ebola strain lacking approved therapy or vaccine, marking the first documented recovery from this variant in the current outbreak. Official Congo data show 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda reports 9 cases and one death. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that transmission outpaces response despite improved facilities and aid, calling for expanded testing, faster humanitarian deployment, and sustained access to medical supplies. Outbreak focus remains Bunia, Ituri province, with cross-border implications for the region.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の患者がまれな型のエボラから回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo変異株）の確認症例、死亡例、国境を越えた拡大リスク、WHO総長の現地対応など、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。公開情報であるが国際的影響が大きい。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株は承認された治療法またはワクチンがない新規エボラ株であり、この変異株からの初の回復例である。DRCでの疑い症例906件、死亡223件、隣国ウガンダでも9件の症例と1件の死亡が報告されている。MSFは伝播が対応を上回っていると警告。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief speaks out after visiting epicenter of Ebola virus as death rate revealed
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in DRC's Ituri province, Bunia epicenter, is the deadliest in recent memory. As of reporting, 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in DRC; 9 confirmed cases and 1 death in Uganda. Among confirmed infections, fatality rate estimated at 30–50%. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines, making this crisis especially precarious versus the Zaire strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia amid a fast-moving spread worsened by armed conflict (ADF, M23), access challenges, and community resistance to body handling protocols. A Kenyan court blocked the US from quarantining up to 50 exposed Americans at Laikipia Air Base; one American missionary physician exposed, treated in Prague. The US has pledged over $112 million; 230 CDC staff, including 54 screening at four US airports. Prioritized treatments: remdesivir and two monoclonal antibodies; a vaccine candidate could take up to nine months for trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラウイルス流行の震源地を訪問後に声明、死亡率が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で、死亡率30-50%、既承認治療薬なし、複数国への拡大確認。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国、チェコ、ケニア、ウガンダを発生地域として付与しているが、これらは輸入症例または隔離対象国。記事サマリーの主題はDRC Ituri州Buniaの爆発的流行。ウガンダは9確認症例と1死亡を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国リスト(203312)に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Veja tudo o que se sabe do homem em estado grave com suspeita de ebola em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See what is known so far about the man in serious condition with suspected Ebola in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, involving a 37-year-old man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He presented with fever and severe illness and was hospitalized at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas under biosafety protocols. On May 30, 2026, he tested positive for meningococcal meningitis; prior evaluation at a UPA noted high fever and inconclusive malaria tests. The patient arrived in grave condition with diarrhea and disorientation, requiring intubation; the incubation window is about 10 days after leaving the DRC. Samples are being analysed by the Instituto Adolfo Lutz using genetic sequencing, with malaria and other diseases also tested. As of 7 PM on May 30, Ebola testing was negative, and the case is being treated as suspected. Investigation is coordinated by federal, state, and municipal health authorities; province of origin in the DRC remains unconfirmed. Brazil’s risk assessment remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで重篤な状態のエボラ疑い症例について現在判明していることをご覧ください
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例が対象国ブラジルで報告され、DRC渡航歴のある患者の重篤な臨床像が確認されている。IHR基準では異常性・予想外性と国際的背景を満たし、WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・流行可能性・管理面での関心が該当する。検査確定待ちながら、公式な検査体制と多機関連携による対応が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、患者は2026年5月30日時点でエボラ検査は陰性となっているが、DRC渡航歴と重篤な臨床像から疑い症例として管理されている。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎が確定診断されたが、マラリアも同時に疑われており、複合的な疾患背景を持つ事例。ブラジル当局のリスク評価は「非常に低い」とされているが、検査体制の確立と多機関連携により適切に対応されている。DRC内での発症地域が未確認という点で、逆方向のリスク（DRC内での流行の有無）の確認も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de ebola no Brasil recebem diagnóstico de meningite e malária | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Brazil are diagnosed with meningitis and malaria | A TARDE.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil have been diagnosed with meningitis and malaria, with Ebola testing ongoing as of May 31, 2026. Both patients recently traveled from Ebola-affected regions: a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in São Paulo, hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas after fever and inconclusive malaria tests. He deteriorated with diarrhea and disorientation and was intubated; Neisseria meningitidis was detected, indicating meningococcal meningitis. Ebola tests are expected on Monday, June 1, 2026. The Rio de Janeiro case involves a Belgian traveler from Uganda, diagnosed with malaria but isolated until Ebola is excluded. Investigations are coordinated by the Municipal and State Health Secretariats and Fiocruz’s Evandro Chagas Institute. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; no autochthonous transmission in the Americas. Congo/Uganda outbreak: 134 confirmed, 18 deaths; 906 suspected, 223 deaths under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラ疑い症例が髄膜炎とマラリアと診断される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者がブラジルで検出され、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。コンゴ・ウガンダ発の進行中の流行地からの渡航者による輸入症例であり、確定診断待ち中の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで報告されている2症例はいずれもブラジルで医療対応中。コンゴとウガンダは流行地の背景情報であるが、実際の患者発生地はブラジルのサンパウロとリオデジャネイロ。エボラ確定診断は未確定だが、疑い症例の検出と検査進行中であることから高リスク。当該国の保健当局と国際機関（Fiocruz）が既に対応を開始している。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola scourges Congo, experts warn of link to eating wild animals
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared May 15; more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths, with WHO suspecting the outbreak is larger than reported. The Congo Basin wild meat trade, including Kinshasa's Masina Market, underscores spillover risk from hunting, butchering, and processing meat of bats, monkeys, and other wildlife. Ebola spreads between humans via close contact with the bodily fluids of the sick or deceased; health workers face high risk without protective gear. Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain, has no approved medicines or vaccines. The outbreak unfolds amid armed violence and displacement in eastern Congo; experts call for One Health education to explain how Ebola starts and spreads and to avoid meat from unknown or dead animals. Congo has had 17 Ebola outbreaks; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected ~28,000 and killed >11,300.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを襲う中、専門家は野生動物を食べることとの関連を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイク（1,000件以上の疑い例、220人以上の死亡）であり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行しやすさが該当。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが東部コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。アンゴラはBluedot APIに記載されているが、サマリーでは主題外のため除外。ブンディブギョ株は稀な株で承認医薬品やワクチンがないことが重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Új információkat közöltek az egész világot rettegésben tartó járványról
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New information has been released about the pandemic that is terrifying the whole world.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa worsens with 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of May 30. Official records show more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation in the two countries, indicating the true infection burden is likely higher than laboratory-confirmed figures. The substantial pool of unresolved cases places additional strain on already overwhelmed health systems and complicates precise transmission tracking. The region has experienced recurrent Ebola outbreaks, prompting concern among international health authorities. Current estimates place the case fatality rate at about 16% among confirmed cases. Reported by Reuters. The data highlight the ongoing threat to regional and global public health.

triage.headline_ja: 世界全体を恐怖に陥れている流行病について新しい情報が公開された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例263例、死亡43例、疑い症例1,100例以上で重篤な公衆衛生影響あり。中央アフリカ地域での異常な流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダでの発生を述べている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く、疑い症例1,100以上の未解決事例は大規模な流行を示唆する。国際保健当局の深刻な懸念が報道されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, inaugurato a Bunia un nuovo centro con il direttore Oms Ghebreyesus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new center inaugurated in Bunia with WHO Director-General Ghebreyesus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the World Health Organization intensified its Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo with the inauguration of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the ceremony. The facility is equipped with advanced intensive-care capabilities, with a capacity of about 100 beds, of which 45 are currently operational. The center will receive all Ebola cases registered in Bunia and surrounding areas, where the virus continues to spread rapidly. This development strengthens regional capacity to care for patients and consolidate outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOグテレス事務局長がブニアで新センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクを満たし、DRCで継続的な拡大が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行性が明確に該当し、WHOの高官対応と新施設整備から管理可能性の懸念も存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行地域（東DRC、ブニア）における WHO の高官対応と新治療センター開設は、地域の感染制御強化の試みであるが、同時に「ウイルスが継続的に急速に拡大している」という記述から、進行中の深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が明らかである。フルRRA（迅速リスク評価）に進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO hails five Ebola recoveries as new treatment centre opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Bundibugyo-type Ebola in Bunia, Ituri, as a new Ebola treatment centre opened on May 31, 2026. Four patients were discharged on Sunday and one the day before, says WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The Bundibugyo virus, the current outbreak strain, has no approved treatment or vaccine, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths reported. Uganda has nine cases and one death. The outbreak continues to spread faster than the response despite better facilities and new aid, with MSF calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of aid workers, and sustained medical supplies. Attacks on health centres by the Allied Democratic Forces and other militias, plus burial-practice tensions, hinder control. North Kivu and South Kivu have cases; Goma and Bukavu are under M23 rebels, who report two cases. The core message: hopeful outcomes through symptomatic treatment and community involvement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ5件の回復を称賛、コンゴ東部で新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは最高リスク疾患で、DRCとウガンダの複数地域での継続的な流行、死亡報告、国際的拡大の現実的な懸念がある。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで9件、1件の死亡」と言及されているため、実際の流行はDRCが主体。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo型エボラは承認治療なし、222死亡報告、武装勢力による保健施設への攻撃が対策を阻害し、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Llega Tedros a Ituri, epicentro de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros arrives in Ituri, Ebola epicenter.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers on Bunia, with Ituri described as the epicenter. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia on May 31, 2026, to visit a treatment center and meet local authorities, health workers, and affected families, aiming to bolster support for the response. Despite improvements in facilities and aid, the virus continues to outpace response at the epicenter. As of May 31, 2026, authorities report 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths in the DRC; neighboring Uganda has confirmed 9 cases and 1 death. The visit underscores international assistance and ongoing efforts to strengthen containment, patient care, and community engagement in the outbreak zone around Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: テドロスがエボラの中心地イトゥリに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。DRC 906例・223死亡、ウガンダ9例・1死亡の報告があり、WHO事務局長の現地訪問も国際的関心を示している。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでウガンダは確認症例9例・1死亡のみであり、主たる発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアである。対象国リストにUgandaが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により、国際的な高い関心と支援の必要性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Un Belge potentiellement infecté par Ebola admis à l'hôpital à Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Belgian potentially infected with Ebola admitted to hospital in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Belgian man potentially infected with Ebola admitted to the Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. He arrived from Uganda, where Ebola outbreaks are ongoing. The Ebola reference center for Brazil’s Health Ministry reported that the patient was admitted yesterday afternoon with cough, chills and diarrhea; given his origin from an Ebola-endemic country, isolation and specialized care were activated pending a definitive diagnosis. Medical care was provided and samples collected. Laboratory testing confirmed malaria, a disease whose symptoms include fever, muscle pains and headaches. An Ebola screening test was also performed, with results not yet available at the time. The patient remains in isolation while the case is monitored by the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat (SES-RJ).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した可能性のあるベルギー人がリオデジャネイロの病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ疑い症例の国際移動、進行中の流行地からの入国者という要素が複合的に存在し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの流行状況に言及しているが、当該イベント（症例の入院）はブラジル・リオデジャネイロで発生しており、患者は入国者である。したがってverified_locationsはブラジルのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Ebola検査結果未確定の段階だが、エボラ流行地からの入国者による疑い症例は国際保健上の優先度が高い。マラリア確定診断済み。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges trust, open borders as DR Congo races to contain Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri province’s Bunia, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Declared May 15, 2026; by May 31, 2026, over 1,000 suspected cases and more than 230 suspected deaths reported in the past two weeks. Uganda has nine confirmed cases. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; some Ituri patients have recovered with timely care. Laboratory capacity has strengthened to about 900 samples tested (≈260 positives) with current capacity of 200–300 tests per day. Authorities aim to contain the epidemic within the three provinces; Ituri bears most cases, North Kivu fewer, South Kivu one case; response projected to last 4–6 months. WHO warns against border closures, stresses trust and international support, and emphasizes basic public health measures; vaccines and treatments are in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が信頼と開放的な国境を促す、DRコンゴがエボラ流行抑制に全力対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolasの大規模流行（1000件以上の疑似症例、230人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの拡大）は重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示す。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダは確認症例9件の二次的な場所として扱われており、主要なイベント発生地はDRコンゴ。ワクチンと治療薬は臨床試験段階で、4～6ヶ月の対応期間を見込んでいる。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织总干事：政府主导及社区参与可阻止埃博拉疫情_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: Government-led and community participation can prevent the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola cases total 134: 125 confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), all in Ituri Province in eastern DRC, and 9 confirmed in Uganda, with 17 deaths in DRC and 1 in Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Timely, high-quality medical care—including isolation, rehydration, and pain relief—can still lead to recovery, and some Ituri patients have recovered. The WHO reports ongoing vaccine and therapeutic trials in collaboration with partners. DRC’s government, led by the health ministry, emphasizes that firm government leadership and broad community participation are essential to ending transmission. International support is urged; the response is expected to last about 4–6 months and will be dynamically adjusted based on the outbreak’s evolution and control effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：政府主導と地域社会の参加はエボラ疫情を阻止できる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。134例の確定症例、複数国での発生、高い致死率を伴う現在進行中のエボラウイルス疫学である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）とウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダ（1269750に対応するID不在）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による現在進行中の疫学、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療薬試験の進行中状況、4〜6ヶ月の長期対応予測などから、IHRおよびWPRO基準で全項目に該当する重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: des mesures frontalières spéciales en vigueur au Canada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Special Border Measures in Force in Canada
article.articleSummary: Ebola border measures are in force in Canada as of May 31, 2026. Until August 29, travelers who have stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan face arrival screening; asymptomatic individuals must quarantine for 21 days, regardless of visa status, while symptomatic travelers must isolate in hospital for evaluation. Canada also suspended all immigration documents from these three countries for 90 days, blocking temporary resident visas, electronic travel authorizations (eTA), and approved permanent resident visas from entering Canada during the suspension, with further suspensions of related applications possible. Affected individuals should monitor symptoms and report health status to federal authorities. The Ebola outbreak has recorded over 1,000 cases in recent weeks, with 246 deaths confirmed, predominantly in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: カナダで特別な国境措置が発効
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。対象国DRCでの複数国への越境感染と、カナダでの入境スクリーニング導入により、実質的な国際的懸念が顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ発生は主にDRCで確認されており（1000例以上、246死亡）、ウガンダとスーダンも発生国として言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。カナダはこれら3国からの入境者に対する防疫措置を導入しており、国際的な感染拡大への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pět pacientů se zotavilo ze vzácného typu eboly, uvedl ředitel Světové zdravotnické organizace (WHO) Tedros Adhanem Ghebreyesus během otevření nového centra pro léčbu eboly v Bunii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients have recovered from a rare form of Ebola, said WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare form of Ebola, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Médecins Sans Frontières stated that there have been unusually high early case counts in eastern Congo, with Alan Gonzalez, MSF’s deputy operations director, noting the surge as occurring sooner after the outbreak than seen before. The report highlights ongoing Ebola response efforts in the region and the establishment of enhanced treatment capacity in Bunia to address the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 5人がエボラ熱の稀な型から回復、WHO事務局長テドロス・アダノム・ゲブレイェスス氏がブニアの新しいエボラ治療センターの開所式で発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例（DRC）であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的な懸念を伴う疾患。DRCにおける新しい治療センターの開設と異常な初期症例数の増加が報告されており、地域的な流行対応が進行中。WHOの公式発表が含まれているため信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: कांगो में इबोला बेकाबू! हालात उम्मीद से ज्यादा गंभीर...MSF ने दी ये बड़ी चेतावनी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: Ebola Out of Control in Congo! The Situation Is More Serious Than Expected... MSF Has Issued This Major Warning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province is accelerating, with MSF warning transmission is spreading faster than expected. Since the outbreak was confirmed in eastern Congo about two weeks ago, over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases have been reported and at least 246 deaths. Uganda has nine confirmed cases, including one death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to reinforce international support, urging better coordination, increased funding, and active local participation to control the outbreak. Authorities cite challenges: limited testing facilities, security concerns, and fragile health systems amid conflict and displacement. WHO cautions the true caseload may be higher, as transmission likely began before detection. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and close contact and has caused extensive fatalities in Africa, with more than 15,000 deaths across past outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大：コンゴでエボラが制御不能に！状況は予想以上に深刻...MSFが重大警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の加速、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスによる急速な感染拡大、死亡数増加、複数国への波及が確認されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での急速な感染拡大が主題。ウガンダの感染事例も言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。MSFが『状況は制御不能』と警告し、WHOも国際的対応を強化している。検査施設不足、セキュリティ上の課題、脆弱な保健システムなど、制御困難な状況が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Estado da Saúde confirma meningite meningocócica em paciente internado com suspeita do vírus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Department confirms meningococcal meningitis in hospitalized patient with suspected Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningococcal meningitis confirmed by qPCR at Instituto Adolfo Lutz in a São Paulo patient initially classified as an Ebola suspected case. Ebola and other viral differential diagnoses remain under investigation with genomic analyses in progress. The patient, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo with recent travel there, is isolated at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, Brazil’s reference unit for suspected/confirmed cases. Meningitis confirmation is reported while Ebola testing continues. SES-SP notes very low risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil/South America, due to no autochthonous transmission and no direct flights; transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic cases. Ebola symptoms include abrupt fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea; incubation 2–21 days. No licensed vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo; existing vaccines target Zaire and are not proven for Bundibugjo. Suspected cases must be reported to CIEVS (Notas Informativas 01/2026 referenced).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健局、エボラウイルス疑い患者から髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い患者の検出とコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航歴という国際的リスク要因、および髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確定診断という複合イベントがIHR基準および社会的関心基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からブラジル（サンパウロ）への渡航歴あり。エボラウイルスは確定されていないが疑い患者として検査進行中。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎はqPCRで確定。ブラジル当局は南米へのエボラ導入リスクは低いと評価しているが、国際的警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата се шири во Конго, досега околу 250 смртни случаи - СЗО соопшти дека пет од заразените се опоравиле
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo, so far about 250 deaths - WHO announced that five of those infected have recovered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province (Bunia), with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. The epidemic is driven by a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage with no approved vaccine, and a case-fatality rate around one third. MSF warns the on-the-ground response is lagging behind spread; WHO declared an outbreak about two weeks ago. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to oversee containment, noting burial practices involving touching the deceased fuel transmission. Border and airport closures and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo further hinder control. In Brazil, authorities are investigating a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the DRC and is in isolation. Five people have recovered; four are to be discharged today and one was discharged the day before yesterday, at a new treatment center in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大、これまでに約250人の死亡 - WHOは感染者5人が回復したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大と複数国での確認、高い致死率、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。スクリーニング基準も全項目で該当し、国際的支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州で1,000件以上の疑いケースと246人以上の死亡が報告されており、致死率約33%の稀なBundibugyo Ebolaウイルス系統が原因。ウガンダでも9件の確定例と1人の死亡が報告されている。さらにブラジルで最近DRCから帰国した37歳男性に疑いケースが発生し、現地での対応の遅れとコンゴ東部の紛争が制御を妨げている。WHO事務局長が現地視察を実施するなど国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumsel catat 1.426 kasus DBD hingga Mei 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sumatra Health Office records 1,426 dengue fever cases as of May 2026.
article.articleSummary: 1,426 dengue fever cases and 11 deaths were recorded in South Sumatra, Indonesia, from January through May 21, 2026. The monthly trend shows a peak in January (444), then 402 in February, 305 in March, 239 in April, and 36 in May (as of May 21). Palembang City accounted for the most cases (413, 1 death), followed by Muara Enim Regency (281, 2 deaths) and Ogan Ilir (141, 1). Other districts with notable counts include Lubuklinggau (109, 2), Banyuasin (85, 2), OKU Timur (82), Lahat (80), Musi Banyuasin (53, 1), OKI (44), PALI (34, 1), Muratara (35), Mura (34), Prabumulih (14), OKU (11), Pagar Alam (5, 1), Empat Lawang (4), and OKU Selatan (1). Compared with 2025’s 2,084 and 2024’s 4,430, 2026 shows lower totals, due to less rainfall and vaccination efforts. Public health authorities urge continued 3M Plus actions (drain, cover, recycle) to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ保健局、2026年5月までにデング熱1,426件を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで毎年流行するデング熱の定期的な発生報告。前年比で件数は減少しており、死亡率も低い。疫学的には制御されている状況であるが、ベクター関連の感染症として継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで風土病的に流行する疾患であり、2026年の件数（1,426件、死亡11件）は2024年（4,430件）や2025年（2,084件）と比較して減少傾向を示している。発生地域にパリがリストされているが、記事サマリーではインドネシア（特に南スマトラ州）における地域的な発生のみが主題であり、国際的な拡大を示す証拠はない。公衆衛生当局による予防対策が実施されており、管理可能な状況と判断される。継続的な監視は推奨されるが、フルRRA進行の基準を満たしていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pět pacientů se zotavilo z nového druhu eboly, proti němuž neexistuje léčba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients have recovered from a new strain of Ebola, for which there is no treatment.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a Bundibugyo strain of Ebola for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Four are being discharged today and one was released the day before yesterday, according to WHO, marking the first documented recovery of a confirmed patient in the current outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO data show 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths; Uganda’s Ministry of Health confirms nine cases and one death. MSF says transmission remains rapid despite better-equipped facilities and aid, urging expanded testing, faster deployment of humanitarian workers, and sustained access to medical supplies. WHO has shortlisted promising vaccine and treatment candidates for Bundibugyo. Health workers face higher risk amid anger over strict body-handling protocols clashing with local funeral rites, with three attacks on facilities. Ituri declared an outbreak on May 15; it spread to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の患者が治療法のない新しいエボラの一種から回復した
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株エボラの確認患者による新規発生であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性、国際的拡大リスク（DRC→ウガンダへの既に確認された越境伝播）を満たす。WPRO基準でも未承認治療の存在、重症度、国際的な拡大可能性、管理困難性を満たし、複数の基準該当によりシグナル判定。
triage.notes: Ituri州（DRC）を発生地とし、ウガンダへの越境が既に確認されている。Bundibugyo株は従来株とは異なり承認された治療法・ワクチンが存在しない重篤な状況。906疑い症例、223疑い死亡が報告されており、MSFは急速な伝播継続と医療アクセスの困難性を警告。地域的な葬儀慣習との衝突による健康施設への攻撃も報告されている。WHOが治療候補薬とワクチン候補を検討中だが、承認までの間の管理可能性が低い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola daha önce benzeri görülmemiş bir hızla yayılıyor" - Havadis Gazetesi | Kıbrıs Haber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading at an unprecedented rate
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Bunia, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Two weeks after outbreak declaration, cases have surged and hundreds of suspected infections await testing, with a case fatality of about one in three. Response is hindered by ongoing conflict and rapid transmission, leaving frontline teams to rely on isolation and supportive care. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns that border and airport closures to facilitate aid slow the medical response. The outbreak has reached Uganda with fatalities, prompting regional hygiene measures at international hubs. Distant countries, such as Brazil, quarantine Congo returnees suspected of Ebola, underscoring a potential global threat. Traditional funeral rites involving touching and washing are risk factors; temporary modifications are urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱が前例のない速度で拡散している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による急速な伝播、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ブラジルへの検疫措置）、高い致命率（約33%）、国際的な懸念と対応の遅延が報告されており、フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダやブラジルが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではDRC Ituri州Buniaを中心とした発生が主題であり、ウガンダは死亡例のみ、ブラジルは検疫措置のみの記載であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株はワクチンや特異的治療法がない稀な変異体であり、紛争地帯での対応困難が指摘されている重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente internado com suspeita de Ebola em SP testa positivo para meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient hospitalized with suspected Ebola in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, a patient in São Paulo, Brazil, with recent travel from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola virus disease outbreaks (Bundibugyo strain) are ongoing, is hospitalized under isolation with suspected Ebola. The patient initially presented fever and other non-specific symptoms; clinical-epidemiological criteria triggered a suspected case investigation. Laboratory testing by Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirmed meningococcal meningitis, while the clinical-epidemiological team maintains the differential diagnosis to complete Ebola and other viral tests. SES-SP and CVE-SP updated Informational Note 01/2026, outlining surveillance, case definition, notification, isolation, initial management, and laboratory investigation. In São Paulo, suspected cases must be reported immediately to municipal epidemiologic surveillance. Technical assessment by SES-SP indicates very low risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil/South America, given no endemic transmission, no direct flights, and transmission requiring close contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで入院中のエボラ疑い患者がマイコプラズマ髄膜炎で陽性
triage.triage_reason: エボラとメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の混合シグナルで国境越え接触歴あるが、確定診断はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎でありエボラ検査未完了。地域当局の実施した技術的リスク評価では導入リスク低いと判定されている。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC滞在歴があり、エボラ流行地域からの入国者（症状発現）。ただし確定診断はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎。当局はエボラ検査継続中で、ブラジルへの導入リスクを低く評価。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎自体は重症化リスク高く報告義務対象。続報注視で差し支えない状況。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite meningocócica confirmada em paciente sob vigilância para Ebola em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis confirmed in a patient under surveillance for Ebola in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis confirmed in a 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, who was hospitalized under suspicion of Ebola. Neisseria meningitidis detected by Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirms meningococcal meningitis; Ebola testing and other viral etiologies continue with laboratory and genomic analyses. The patient remains in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, with strict biosafety measures. He is a native of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and had recent travel to his country; despite the meningitis diagnosis, investigations for Ebola and other viral causes are ongoing. Brazilian health authorities reinforced surveillance through Nota Informativa nº 01/2026, prepared with CVE-SP and IAL, referencing the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the DRC. The assessed risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil/South America remains very low, though vigilance persists. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea; incubation 2–21 days; transmission via contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ監視下の患者においてサンパウロで髄膜球菌性髄膜炎が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当し、ブラジル国内での髄膜球菌性髄膜炎確認例は公衆衛生上の関心事である。同時にエボラ疑い患者での検査継続という点で国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国出身で同国への最近の渡航歴がある。ブラジル保健当局は正式な情報通知（Nota Informativa nº 01/2026）を発行し、エボラ監視を強化。記事ではエボラ導入のリスクは「非常に低い」と評価されているが、進行中のエボラ検査と感染症監視活動の継続により、シグナルとしてピックアップが適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: PS defends Ebola isolation facility amid public concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Principal Secretary for Aviation and Aerospace Development, Teresia Mbaika, defended government plans to establish and strengthen Ebola isolation and quarantine facilities in Kenya to safeguard Kenyans amid regional Ebola threats from neighboring Congo and Uganda. Speaking at a prize-giving day at AIC Mwaani Secondary School in Kilungu Subcounty, she warned that Ebola could cross borders due to movement of people and goods, and emphasized preparedness and adherence to public health protocols rather than creating mere holding camps. She noted ongoing surveillance and screening at entry points, including airports and border posts, as part of preventing importation. The remarks address fears Kenya could become a regional hub for Ebola response; she framed readiness as essential, highlighting Kenya's role as a regional leader in health and emergency response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが地域のエボラ脅威に対応するため隔離施設の強化を防衛
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的な越境リスク（DRC、ウガンダからの脅威）、ケニアの公式な国家的準備体制の確立、および地域的な拡大可能性が示唆されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPROスクリーニング基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの隔離施設整備の防衛であり、ケニア国内でのエボラ発生の報告ではなく、隣接するDRC・ウガンダからの越境リスクに対する準備体制に関するもの。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダ（226074）も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ebola patients have recovered from rare strain, WHO chief says - AOL
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain driving the Congo outbreak, is centered in Ituri’s Bunia area. Five patients have recovered, with four discharged today and one the day before, continuing confirmed-case recoveries since the outbreak began. Overall, 906 suspected cases have been reported with 223 deaths among the suspected; among 134 confirmed cases, 18 deaths have occurred. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. There is no approved vaccine or treatment; authorities stress early care and symptomatic treatment to improve outcomes. A new Ebola treatment center opened in Bunia to bolster response. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing response and calls for expanded testing, faster deployment of aid workers, and sustained access to medical supplies. Attacks by the Allied Democratic Forces and ethnic militias hinder response. Outbreaks also in North Kivu and South Kivu (Rwanda-backed M23 controls Goma and Bukavu), with two cases reported by the rebels.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ患者が稀な株から回復した、WHO事務局長が発表 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus株）は致死率の高い感染症であり、複数国での発生、死亡者、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、医療対応の限界が確認されている。
triage.notes: DRC内のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で発生。ウガンダも9症例・1死亡報告あるが、記事の主題はDRC発のBundibugyo virus株の流行。MSFによる対応不足の警告、ADF・民兵組織による治安問題による対応阻害など、複雑な状況が報告されている。ワクチン・治療薬なし、早期ケアと対症療法が主要な介入。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Pět lidí se zotavilo z nového druhu eboly, proti němuž neexistuje léčba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Five people have recovered from a new strain of Ebola, for which there is no treatment.
article.articleSummary: Five people have recovered from a rare Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province. Four patients will be discharged today, one had been discharged the day prior. This marks the first documented recovery from the Bundibugyo variant during the current outbreak, where there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Official WHO data from the DRC show 906 people with suspected Ebola and 223 suspected deaths. Across the border in Uganda, the Ministry of Health confirmed nine cases and one death. MSF warned that transmission remains outpacing response despite better-equipped facilities and humanitarian aid, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of aid workers, and sustained access to medical supplies.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラの新種から5人が回復、これに対する治療法は存在しない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo変異株）の感染が確認され、DRCで906例の疑似症例と223例の死亡が報告されており、治療法・ワクチンが存在しない状況。IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株からの初回の記録された回復例。DRC内で906例の疑似症例と223例の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。ウガンダでの9例の確認により国際的な拡大リスクあり。MSFの警告により対応が需要に追いついていない状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Canadian pilot, 30, evacuates family of American doctor who contracted Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infection involving an American physician who had been working at Nyankunde Hospital. As of 2026-05-31, the physician was evacuated separately to Germany for specialized treatment. Canadian pilot Villeneuve, 30, with Mission Aviation Fellowship, flew the physician's family to safety in neighboring Uganda. The wife, who is also a physician, their children, and another doctor with direct exposure to the virus were aboard the flight piloted by Villeneuve; the patient was transported separately to Germany. The report provides limited clinical details, with no symptoms, case counts, or laboratory confirmations disclosed. This operation highlights international coordination for Ebola evacuations, linking Uganda and Germany with hospital-based exposure and care arrangements.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ人パイロット、30歳、エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師の家族を避難させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染事例が複数国にまたがり、国際的な医療避難が実施されている。IHR基準の複数該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準の重症度・長期曝露が該当。
triage.notes: DRCのNyankunde Hospitalにおけるエボラウイルス感染事例。患者はアメリカ人医師で、複数の濃厚接触者（配偶者、子ども、別の医師）が存在。国際的な医療避難（ドイツ、ウガンダ経由）が実施されている。ウガンダはDRCの隣国で経由地として記載されているが、サマリーに基づき実際のウイルス発生地はDRCのみ。ドイツはエボラ患者の受け入れ先だが感染発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Oglasila se SZO o stanju pacijenata zaraženih ebolom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues a statement on the condition of patients infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 906 Ebola cases and 223 deaths reported in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia hosting a new Ebola treatment center. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current outbreak; four patients are to be discharged today (one yesterday), marking the first documented recovery of a Bundibugyo-strain patient in the current outbreak. Uganda confirms nine cases and one death. WHO notes progress but warns the outbreak outpaces control measures, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of humanitarian workers, and sustained medical-supply access. Health workers face community hostility over strict body-burial protocols, and attacks on health centers in Ituri hinder response. Conflict-related impediments include Allied Democratic Forces and ethnic militias. The outbreak activity also reaches North Kivu and South Kivu, where M23 rebels control key towns such as Goma and Bukavu.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ感染患者の状態について声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の患者発生と死亡（重篤な公衆衛生影響）、複数国での確認（国際的拡大リスク）、流行が制御措置を上回る状況（異常・予想外）、WHOが警告声明を発表（社会・政治的関心）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの9症例1死亡が記載されているが、APIの発生地域にはウガンダが含まれている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の多発地域での拡大、制御困難（武装勢力による妨害、保健従事者への攻撃）、国際支援の必要性が高い。WHOの警告声明が発表されている点も社会的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Brasil? Casos suspeitos em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro estão sendo investigados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Brazil? Suspected Ebola Cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro Are Being Investigated.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro after travelers returned from regions with Ebola circulation. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever, diarrhea, and disorientation, was intubated and treated with antibiotics and hydration; meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis was confirmed, but Ebola testing remains pending with results expected on Monday (June 1). In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian traveler from Uganda presented with cough and diarrhea and was diagnosed with malaria; he was transferred to the Evandro Chagas Institute and placed in isolation while Ebola-specific tests are conducted to exclude infection. Health authorities continue monitoring both patients until definitive laboratory confirmation excludes Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのエボラ？サンパウロとリオデジャネイロの疑い症例が調査中
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、マラリア）が対象国ブラジルで確認・検査中であり、IHR基準の「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い症例がブラジルで初めて報告される極めて重要なイベント。記事にはDRC、ウガンダの地域も記載されているが、サマリーの主題はブラジルでの疑い症例であるため verified_locations はブラジルのみ。確認済みの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎とマラリアの2症例に加え、エボラ検査結果待機中（6月1日予定）。国際保健上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Brasil: veja tudo o que se sabe sobre os casos | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Brazil: See all that is known about the cases | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases, one in Rio de Janeiro and another in São Paulo, linked to travel in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo where outbreaks are active. A suspected case requires recent exposure in an active transmission country within 21 days plus fever, diarrhea, vomiting, or hemorrhagic signs. The Rio de Janeiro patient arrived May 22 from Johannesburg to Guarulhos, then by bus to Rio, staying in Vila Isabel; five housemates were isolated. He reported chills, cough, and diarrhea but not fever or headache; malaria had been detected earlier. He remains in isolation at INI/Fiocruz while Ebola is confirmed or ruled out. The São Paulo patient, a 37-year-old man, presented with diarrhea and rapid deterioration, was intubated, and transferred to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas; malaria was suspected. No Ebola is confirmed in either case; labs are ongoing. Transmission risk in Brazil/South America is considered low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのエボラ熱：症例について現在知られていることすべてを参照してください
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、エボラ熱という極めて高リスク疾患の疑い事例がブラジルで報告されている。確定例ではないが、検査進行中であり、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラ熱の疑い事例2件がブラジルで報告。両事例とも確定診断ではなく検査進行中だが、ウガンダおよびDRCでの活発な感染発生地への渡航歴があり、IHR基準を満たす。ブラジルはWPRO地域外だが、極めて高リスク疾患であるため優先度が高い。DRCも対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。

article.articleHeadline: 5 متعافين من إيبولا يمنحون الأمل لشرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola survivors give hope to eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola survivors from the Bundibugyo strain in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo have been discharged from treatment centers—four on Sunday and one two days earlier—offering hope as the outbreak intensifies in Ituri’s Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, opened a new Ebola treatment center and noted that recovery is possible despite no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo. The first documented recovery occurred last Friday. Official figures: 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in the DRC; neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. MSF warns transmission is outpacing response, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of medical teams, and robust supply chains. Security challenges persist, with health facilities attacked by locals opposing isolation and safe burial measures; officials emphasize community engagement and government-led coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ生存者が東コンゴに希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された集団発生であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、複数国での事例と管理上の課題が認識されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの集団発生。DRCで906例の疑い例、223例の死亡報告；隣接するウガンダでも9例の確認例と1例の死亡報告あり。ただし対象国リストではウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOトップの現地訪問、MSFによる警告、セキュリティ上の課題が報告され、国際的な関心と支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını için dünya seferber oldu: Vaka sayısı artıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world mobilizes for the Ebola outbreak: Case numbers are rising.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 260, with the World Health Organization declaring a global emergency as the Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak across more than a dozen health zones in three Kongo provinces. Uganda reports 8 cases including 1 death near the border, while Bunia in Ituri province serves as an epicenter where infections among 5 healthcare workers have raised concerns about hospital infection control. Lab-confirmed and suspected case counts remain uncertain; suspected cases dropped from 1,077 to 349 after laboratory testing, though over 900 tests have been conducted with capacity up to 300 per day. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola, but US CDC-backed second-phase trials of an experimental antibody therapy are underway, and WHO prioritizes three drug candidates. WHO Director Tedros notes early treatment can save lives, citing recoveries in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行に世界が動員：患者数が増加中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO全球緊急事態宣言済みで、Bundibugyo株による多地域流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは国境付近での8症例が言及されるに留まり、主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のIturi州Bunia。対象国リストに存在するのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は対象国外の感染症であるが、DRCが明確に関与しているため本トリアージでは取得した。WHO緊急事態宣言・Bundibugyo株の未承認ワクチン/治療という深刻な状況からPICKUPレベルのシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de ebola no Brasil segue sob investigação após novos diagnósticos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Brazil remains under investigation after new diagnoses.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil were ultimately diagnosed with meningitis and malaria on May 30, but Ebola infection remains under investigation. The two men had recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda and are isolated in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro under health surveillance. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old immigrant from the DRC presented with fever; malaria tests were inconclusive, later developing diarrhea and disorientation requiring intubation. Neisseria meningitidis was identified, yet Ebola testing continues with results expected around June 1. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian traveler who visited Uganda has malaria and viral-type symptoms and remains in isolation pending Ebola test exclusion. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with fluids during the acute phase. Outbreak data: in DRC and Uganda, 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths; 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation, with no autochthonous transmission in South America.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例は新しい診断後も調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの既存アウトブレイク）と、南米（ブラジル）への輸入症例の可能性が存在。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、国際的な公衆衛生関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジル（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）とDRC、ウガンダでの発症が確認されている。Bluedot APIはウガンダも列挙しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルはDRCからの輸入症例の可能性が高く、現在エボラ検査が進行中。DRCでの既知アウトブレイク（134確認症例、18死亡）との関連性が存在し、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: पिछले तीन दिन में 'बेबेसिया' संक्रमण का कोई नया मामला सामने नहीं आया: गुजरात के मंत्री मोढवाडिया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No new case of 'Babesia' infection in the last three days: Gujarat's minister Modhwadia.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, no new Babesia infections have been reported among Asiatic lions in Gujarat's Gir region in the last three days, with 17 lions under surveillance after eight cub deaths were attributed to suspected Babesia. Officials visited Jamwala Rescue Center, Babaria Forest Range, and Jasadhar Animal Care Center to review the situation. Babesia is a tick-borne parasite causing weakness, coughing, and nasal discharge. Outside the Gir Sanctuary, deaths in lions have been reported in Gir Gadhada (Gir Somnath district) and Babra Kot (Amreli district), linked to suspected Babesia. Minister Arjun Modhwadia praised the measures, noting around-the-clock monitoring by veterinary teams and isolation of lions within a 10-km radius of affected zones to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 過去3日間で『バベシア』感染の新規症例なし：グジャラート州大臣モディワディア
triage.triage_reason: バベシア症は野生動物（ライオン）の感染症であり、直接的な人間への脅威や国際的な拡大リスクは現時点では明確でない。ただし監視継続中であり、追加情報により判定が変わる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントはインド・グジャラート州のギール聖域のアジアライオン集団におけるバベシア症の発生である。人間への直接的なリスクは記事に示唆されていない。野生動物の感染症であることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的と判断される。ただしティック媒介性寄生虫であり、監視が継続中であるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Homem com suspeita de ebola é diagnosticado com meningite em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man with suspected Ebola is diagnosed with meningitis in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, hospitalized with suspected Ebola virus disease; he tested positive for meningococcal meningitis, while Ebola testing continues. The patient is from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and recently traveled to the region, triggering precautionary Ebola investigations under national and state protocols. Laboratory confirmation identified Neisseria meningitidis as the meningitis cause. Ebola work-up and other viral differential diagnoses remain ongoing until further laboratory and genomic analyses are completed. SES-SP notes the risk of introducing Ebola to Brazil and South America is very low due to no endemic transmission, no direct flights from the affected region, and transmission requiring direct contact with bodily fluids or tissues. Health services should monitor febrile patients with recent travel within 21 days and contacts of suspected cases. No licensed vaccines or approved therapies exist for Bundibugyo; existing vaccines/therapies target other strains and have no proven efficacy for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラウイルス疑いの男性が髄膜炎と診断
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い事例（実際には髄膜炎と確認）により国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが検討対象となるが、確定診断はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎であり、SES-SPが南米へのエボラ導入リスクは極めて低いと評価しているため。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、情報確度と確定診断の明確性から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準は4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も4つ該当するが、最終確定診断はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎（Neisseria meningitidis）であり、エボラ検査は進行中だが陽性未確認。患者のDRC渡航歴がエボラ懸念を喚起しているが、SES-SPの公式評価では南米へのリスク極めて低いと指摘。確定診断明確化待ちのためWATCH判定としたが、エボラ確定検査結果によってはPICKUPへ格上げが必要。

article.articleHeadline: México se 'blinda' en salud ante el Mundial 2026: el plan para evitar contagios de ébola o sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico strengthens its health defenses ahead of the 2026 World Cup: the plan to prevent Ebola or measles outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Mexico is strengthening health defenses ahead of the 2026 World Cup, coordinating public hospitals and conducting simulacros from aircraft to identify and treat suspected Ebola or other diseases. With an estimated 5 million visitors, authorities must ensure universal medical access and test the national health system's capacity. The event unfolds amid three international outbreaks—measles, Ebola, and hantavirus—with low global spread risk for the latter two, though increased mobility raises import potential. A tri-national health plan with the United States and Canada, including a General Plan for Sanitary Security. Surveillance is reinforced via the OPS EWARS platform, and reporting time for suspected cases has fallen from 7 days to 48 hours. Measles cases exceed 17,800 with 41 deaths since Feb 2025 but are declining. Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a travel concern, not players. Training: 1,301 health professionals trained across 20 units in 10 nationwide events.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコが2026年ワールドカップに向けて保健防御を強化：エボラとはしかの感染拡大を防ぐための計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での麻疹・エボラの国際的アウトブレイクが報告され、大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした医療システムの準備状況が記述されている。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコがワールドカップに向けて保健準備を進めている状況を報告しており、メキシコ自体での感染アウトブレイクではなく、国際的な麻疹・エボラの脅威への対応である。DRCでのエボラ発生は記事で明示されているため verified_locations に含める。メキシコ、米国、カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。麻疹症例数17,800件・死亡41件という重症度の高いデータが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sabiá circula no Brasil há mais de 140 anos e sofreu mutações, aponta estudo | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sabiá virus has been circulating in Brazil for more than 140 years and has undergone mutations, according to a study | Rádio Itatiaia.
article.articleSummary: Sabiá virus (SABV) has circulated in Brazil for around 142 years and accumulated genetic changes that reduce detection by older tests. CADDE researchers, with FAPESP and in the journal PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases, report two fatal cases in interior São Paulo retrospectively identified: a 52-year-old man from Sorocaba who sought care in December 2019 with suspected yellow fever and died January 2020, and a 63-year-old rural worker from Assis who died later. Genomic analyses show ~89% similarity to older SABV strains, indicating ongoing evolution, including mutations in the protein used for cell entry. New primers were developed and sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz for diagnostics. The natural reservoir remains unknown; wild rodents are suspected, with transmissions in rural areas. SABV poses high aerosol transmission risk in laboratory settings; no South American facility currently has such biosafety; Orion lab at CNPEM Campinas is planned to operate by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: サビア・ウイルスはブラジルで140年以上前から流通しており、突然変異を起こしている、研究によると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：複数の死亡例、予想外性：新たに同定された既知ウイルス、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）。科学的注目が高く、診断・検査能力向上は重要な対応。
triage.notes: 記事はサビア・ウイルス（SABV）に関するもので、イエローフェバーではなくArenavirus。複数の死亡例が確認され、遺伝学的変化が検出困難性につながっている。バイオセーフティレベル4での高い空気感染リスクが指摘されており、南米の現有施設では対応不十分。診断プライマーの改善と新しいBSL4施設の建設が進行中。野生げっ歯類が自然宿主と推定されるが未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Fünf Genesene in Ebola-Gebiet aus Klinik entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Five recovered patients discharged from hospital in the Ebola region.
article.articleSummary: Five recovered Ebola patients have been discharged from a hospital in the Ebola-affected region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with four released on Sunday and one on Friday, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit. He stressed that recovery is possible with good and early treatment and urged people with symptoms to seek care promptly. A new treatment center was opened in Bunia to bolster response efforts and community involvement. The first survivor of the Bundibugyo variant—an uncommon strain with no approved treatment or vaccine—was confirmed by the WHO last Friday; the CDC notes case-fatality between 25% and 50% for Bundibugyo. The outbreak, centered in eastern DRC, has surged since it was identified about two weeks ago, with containment hindered by ongoing clashes between militias and security forces. International support commitments were reiterated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：エボラ地域の診療所から5人の回復患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の流行が東部DRCで確認され、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。国際的支援要請と高い致死率を伴う新規株の出現により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発で致死率25-50%と高く、2週間前の同定以降急速に拡大。東部DRCの武装勢力紛争による対応困難化と国際支援の必要性が記事で明記されている。WHO事務局長による現地視察と新治療センター開設が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Homem vindo de Uganda é isolado no Rio por suspeita de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man from Uganda is isolated in Rio on suspicion of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, a man traveling from Uganda is isolated in Rio de Janeiro on suspicion of Ebola after presenting cough, chills, and diarrhea. Initial malaria tests were positive; the patient was transferred to Evandro Chagas National Institute of Infectious Diseases (INI/Fiocruz) for Ebola evaluation. The Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat (SES-RJ) activated the Ebola surveillance protocol via the Centre for Strategic Information in Health Surveillance (CIEVS). Fiocruz subsequently reported malaria positivity, but the patient remains in isolation pending definitive Ebola results. Epidemiological surveillance teams in Rio de Janeiro state and city conduct contact tracing of individuals who had contact with the patient; contacts are advised to report fever, severe headache, or muscle/joint pains. The Centre for Health Intelligence (CIS-RJ) notes ongoing monitoring of public health threats, including dengue and rare diseases like Ebola, with protocols aimed at rapid threat identification and outbreak prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダからの男性がエボラ疑いでリオデジャネイロで隔離される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者が国際渡航後に確認され、ブラジルで隔離・検査が実施されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）でも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダからの渡航者がブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）で隔離された事例を述べており、エボラ出血熱疑いの国際的な病例である。マラリア陽性が確認されているが、エボラ検査結果待機中。接触者の追跡調査が実施されており、公衆衛生的な懸念が高い。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはBrazilのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Un Belge suspecté d'avoir contracté le virus Ebola hospitalisé à Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Belgian suspected of having contracted the Ebola virus is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, a Belgian citizen suspected of Ebola infection was placed in isolation at a Rio de Janeiro hospital in Brazil. Recently arrived from Uganda, a country currently affected by an Ebola outbreak, the patient was admitted to the Evandro Chagas Institute of Infectious Diseases. He presents with cough, chills and diarrhea; fever and headaches were reported, prompting precautionary measures. Initial tests revealed malaria, which can explain part of the symptoms, but Ebola remains a suspected diagnosis. A screening test for Ebola has been performed and results are pending. Isolation will continue until definitive laboratory confirmation or exclusion of Ebola. The case represents an imported suspected infection from Uganda; authorities are monitoring as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染が疑われるベルギー人がリオデジャネイロで入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。ウガンダからブラジルへの越境感染疑い例であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのエボラ流行中にウガンダからブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）への越境移入が疑われる。患者はベルギー国籍だがブラジルで検査・隔離中。マラリアも陽性だが、エボラは診断未確定。検査結果待ちの段階だが、国際的な感染症危機管理の観点から重要。ベルギーは検出国ではなく患者の国籍であり、実際のイベント発生地はブラジルのため verified_locations はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Plantas belas, mas que exigem atenção: essas espécies podem virar foco de mosquitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beautiful plants, but they require attention: these species can become breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Ornamental and domestic plants can become mosquito breeding grounds when water collects in leaf cups or containers, aiding Aedes aegypti and raising dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risks. As of 2026-05-31, several popular species require vigilant care: bromeliads (especially imperial bromeliads) accumulate water in central cups; pineapple; Sansevieria (spider/snake plant); Aloe vera; Peace Lily (lily) and other ferns; Anthurium; Agave; Colocasia; Dieffenbachia (costela-de-adão); Marantas; banana plants; taioba; copo-de-leite; and heliconia. Management includes removing standing water, ensuring adequate drainage, and periodic substrate maintenance; in some cases, sand or biological larvicides are recommended. Also emphasize proper ventilation and avoiding overwatering, along with regular leaf cleaning to reduce risk. While these plants beautify interiors and urban landscapes, household and public spaces should implement routine water-management practices to prevent mosquito proliferation and associated health threats.

triage.headline_ja: 美しい植物だが注意が必要：これらの種はボウフラの発生地になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 記事は蚊の繁殖地となる可能性のある観葉植物の管理方法についての教育的コンテンツであり、実際のデングゥ、ジカ、チクングニヤの発生状況や臨床患者情報を報告していない。イベント検出の基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの家庭および公共スペースにおけるネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の繁殖地管理に関する予防啓発記事である。実際の感染症発生事例、患者数、重症度、流行状況などの疫学情報を含まない。蚊媒介感染症のリスク因子（蚊の繁殖環境）についての一般向け情報記事であり、シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Forest and Environment Minister visits Gir forests, reviews infection situation among Asiatic lions
article.articleSummary: Gujarat's Forest and Environment Minister Arjunbhai Modhwadia visited the Gir forests on May 31, 2026, to review the infection detected among Asiatic lions. He inspected the Jamwala Rescue Centre, the Babariya Forest area, and the Jasadhar Animal Care Centre, and discussed response measures with senior officials and veterinary teams. Modhwadia said the situation is completely under control due to timely measures, and no lion has died from the viral infection in the last three days. As a precaution, special 24x7 teams of Forest personnel, veterinary experts, and field staff are maintaining continuous health surveillance. Under Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel's guidance, the government and Forest Department are committed to protecting Gujarat's pride. The minister praised the dedication of staff and veterinarians working to ensure the roar of the Asiatic lion echoes in Gir for generations.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート森林環境大臣がギール森を訪問、アジアライオン間の感染状況を検証
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（アジアライオンの不明な感染症）であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクが示されていない。当局による対応状況は統制下にあると報告されている。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（アジアライオン）の感染症であり、ヒト感染の報告はない。記事は地域当局による対応状況の報告であり、感染症危機管理の観点からのシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades sanitarias y OMS alertan sobre la rápida expansión del brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities and WHO warn about the rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola virus variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has registered more than 1,000 suspected cases, with Bunia in Ituri Province identified as the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, stressed that local communities must take a decisive role to halt the virus's spread. Humanitarian organizations warn that international response efforts are failing to keep pace with what is described as one of the fastest-spreading outbreaks on record. The report notes the status as suspected cases; no laboratory-confirmed counts or details are provided, and there is no mention of infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局とWHOが、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクの急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも深刻な重症度と国際的対応の必要性が確認される。1,000件以上の疑い例が報告され、WHO事務局長が現地訪問するほどの国際的関心が示されている。
triage.notes: 2026年5月31日時点で疑い例1,000件以上が報告されており、イツリ州ブニアが震源地とされている。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し警告を発しており、人道支援機関は国際対応が歴史上最速級のアウトブレイクのペースに追いつけていないと指摘している。ただし、検査確定例数、感染源、国際的な症例輸出入の詳細は記事では不明である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде и ДР Конго 43 человека умерли от Эболы, пишет FT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 43 people have died of Ebola, FT reports.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) total 263 laboratory-confirmed cases and 43 deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya disclosed these figures in a Financial Times column. In the DRC alone, the WHO reported 125 laboratory-confirmed infections and 17 deaths across 13 provinces as of Thursday. The World Health Organization has designated the situation an emergency and a risk to other countries. A prior Ebola outbreak in the DRC ended in October 2025. The report, corroborated by FT coverage, is accompanied by imagery of a hospital in Kampala, Uganda, underscoring the cross-border nature of the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより43人が死亡（FT報道）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生影響（死亡43人、確認患者263人）、複数国での異常な同時発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがある。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとDRCの両国での発生を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが緊急事態宣言を発出し、Africa CDC長官が公式な統計を発表している。2025年10月に終結したDRCの前回アウトブレイクから約7ヶ月後の新規発生であり、極めて高い警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de Ebola em SP testa positivo para meningite - Jovem Pan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis - Jovem Pan.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, was found to be meningococcal meningitis instead. A 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is occurring, presented with fever and is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. Laboratory confirmation by Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified the meningococcal meningitis bacteria as part of a differential diagnosis; the Ebola investigation continues. Preventive measures include isolation, immediate reporting, laboratory testing, and monitoring per current protocols. In 2014, the same hospital reported three suspected Ebola cases that were discarded. Authorities updated guidelines last week on handling suspected Ebola, specifically Bundibugyo strain identified in the DRC. Officials consider the risk of introduction to Brazil and South America very low, but vigilance remains for febrile patients with recent travel to outbreak areas within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: São Pauloの疑い例がエボラではなくメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎と判明
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行との関連性があり、ブラジルで輸入例の可能性が指摘されているが、当該患者はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎と確定診断されている。国当局はブラジル・南米への導入リスクは非常に低いと評価しており、現時点で国際的拡大の直接的なリスクは低い。ただし、DRC由来の輸入感染症の可能性と、メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の制御可能性に関する情報が限定的であるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は疑い例がエボラではなく確定的にメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎であることを示している。DRCのエボラ流行との地理的・時間的関連性があり、輸入例の可能性が考えられるが、当局によるリスク評価は低い。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎は流行性の高い病原体であるため、集団発生の可能性は除外できない。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: عائد من الكونغو إلى البرازيل مشتبه في إصابة بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A returnee from Congo to Brazil is suspected of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil health authorities are investigating a suspected Ebola case in a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo, reported by the state capital’s health department on Saturday. The patient developed fever and is in isolation at a hospital that specializes in caring for suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. The case is treated as imported, with laboratory confirmation pending. The Democratic Republic of Congo is currently experiencing an Ebola outbreak, which triggered the alert after the traveler’s recent visit. Officials have not yet confirmed the diagnosis, and results are awaited to determine whether Ebola is the cause and what public health steps may follow.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国したブラジルの男性がエボラ感染の疑い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な移動例（輸入症例）であり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認待ちであるが、現在のコンゴでの流行背景とブラジルへの持ち込みリスクは高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、患者はコンゴから帰国後ブラジル（サンパウロ）で疑い症例として検出された輸入症例である。コンゴではエボラ流行中であり、ブラジルは対象国のため検証位置として両国を含める。診断は検査待ちだが、症状発現と隔離対応が記載されており、シグナルとしてピックアップする根拠は十分。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola? Pacientes que passaram por áreas com surto são investigados no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola? Patients who passed through outbreak areas are being investigated in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil after patients who recently traveled to Ebola-affected areas showed compatible symptoms. The Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda are currently experiencing Ebola outbreaks. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man, native to the DRC, developed fever after returning from Africa and is in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology, a reference center for suspected cases. Initial tests reportedly indicated meningitis, but Ebola remains a possibility and additional testing is ongoing. The second patient, initially diagnosed with malaria, is also being monitored by epidemiological surveillance teams, with lab results pending to confirm or rule out Ebola. The Ministry of Health and state secretariats are following biosafety protocols, and Brazil maintains a contingency plan for suspected Ebola with traveler monitoring and isolation procedures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ？発生地域を通過した患者がブラジルで調査対象になっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事例、国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準で複数該当。疑似患者発生と検査進行中であり、初期段階のシグナル識別として適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはDRC（203312）、Uganda（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者調査であり、DRC・ウガンダは感染源地域として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみに限定。初期検査結果は髄膜炎の可能性を示唆しているが、エボラは除外されておらず追加検査中。マラリア患者との二例目も含め、検査完了までWATCH段階への転換の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola em São Paulo tem meningite, diz secretaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo has meningitis, says the health department.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo health authorities confirm a 37-year-old Congolese patient with suspected Ebola has been diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis; the Ebola investigation remains ongoing with a battery of tests. The man recently travelled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is active, and is isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, the state’s reference center. Even with meningitis confirmed, the Ebola workup continues. The risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil or South America is considered low due to no local transmission history and no direct flights from the affected region; Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals, not via asymptomatic travelers. Those with travel in the last 21 days should monitor for fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or abdominal pain. Emílio Ribas previously treated three suspected cases in the 2014–2016 outbreak, all ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロのエボラ疑い患者が髄膜炎と診断、保健局が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラとメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の複合シグナルであり、DRCでのエボラ流行との関連があるが、記事サマリーではブラジルへの導入リスクが低いと明示されており、情報精査が必要な段階である。
triage.notes: 記事は確定患者ではなく疑い患者を報道。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎が確認されたが、エボラ検査は継続中。ブラジル当局はブラジルおよび南米へのエボラ導入リスクを低いと評価。DRCでのエボラ流行がバックグラウンドにあるため、エボラ検査結果の追跡が必要。IHR基準2つ該当のためPICKUP判定と同等の関心が必要だが、現地当局がリスク低評価を示しているため「WATCH」寄りで、続報を注視すべき状況。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de Ebola em São Paulo testa positivo para meningite; investigação continua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis; investigation continues.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old patient hospitalized with suspected Ebola tested positive for meningococcal meningitis due to Neisseria meningitidis and is in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Infectious Diseases Institute. Ebola diagnosis remains under investigation, with samples undergoing laboratory and genomic analyses to confirm or exclude infection and to assess other possible viral etiologies. The patient had recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country with Ebola activity. In Rio de Janeiro, a separate traveler who had been in Uganda is malaria-positive and remains in isolation while awaiting Ebola test results. The Congo and Uganda are the only countries currently reporting Ebola. Final confirmation depends on ongoing laboratory and genomic testing; both cases are monitored under continuous epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロのエボラ疑い患者が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で陽性反応；調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク要因が存在：(1)エボラの国際的拡散の可能性（DRC滞在歴）、(2)髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確認と並行したエボラ疑い、(3)複数国（ブラジル、リオ）での関連患者検出、(4)国際的な移動に伴う感染リスク。IHR基準で複数該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUganda（対象国外）とDRC（203312、対象国）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでの患者検出である。DRCとウガンダは患者の渡航歴・背景情報として言及されているため、発症地として verified_locations には含めない。ただし、ブラジル国内での複数患者検出（サンパウロとリオ）、エボラの国際的拡散リスク、治療中の分子生物学的検査により高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Canadian pilot, 30, evacuates family of American doctor who contracted Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Dominic Villeneuve, a 30-year-old Canadian Mission Aviation Fellowship pilot, evacuated the family of an American doctor who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The May 20 flight lasted 1 hour 15 minutes and carried the doctor’s wife (also a physician), their children, and another doctor with direct exposure to safety in Uganda; the Ebola patient was evacuated separately to Germany for treatment. The Nyankunde Hospital worker’s infection occurred amid a rapidly evolving outbreak driven by a rare variant, prompting the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16. The DRC reports 125 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976; MAF has supported six prior outbreaks. Canada pledged $8 million to international Ebola response efforts. Villeneuve noted the family was asymptomatic and PPE was used during the flight.

triage.headline_ja: 30歳のカナダ人パイロット、エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師の家族を避難させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的流行（DRC主要発生地、ドイツへの患者移送、ウガンダへの曝露者避難）であり、IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが5月16日にPHEIC宣言済みの急速進展中の流行。
triage.notes: DRC以外の国（米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、カナダ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。ただしDRCでの流行は継続中で、患者の国際移送と家族の避難が進行中。WHO PHELIC宣言済みの重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: FAQ: What you should know about monkeypox
