article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Singapore: A 38-year-old man tested positive on May 9 and is isolated at NCID. He likely contracted it from bush meat in Nigeria. Close contacts are quarantined; asymptomatic. Transmission is from animals (rodents, monkeys) via blood, bodily fluids, or lesions; eating inadequately cooked meat is a risk. Human-to-human spread requires prolonged close contact and is not currently sustaining transmission; Singapore’s risk is low. Symptoms: fever, headache, swollen lymph nodes, back/muscle pain, fatigue; a rash appears 1–3 days after fever, starting on the face and spreading to hands/feet. Severe cases can include pneumonia, sepsis, encephalitis, or vision loss; illness lasts 14–21 days. Diagnosis is in labs; no specific treatment or vaccine, though smallpox vaccine is ~85% effective. Monkeypox was identified in 1970 in DRC; outbreaks occur in central/west Africa. The US faced a 2003 outbreak linked to Ghana, with UK and Israel cases in 2018.

triage.headline_ja: FAQ: サルトウイルス（モンキーポックス）について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: シンガポール発の確定症例の報告であり、複数国での歴史的事例（DRC、ガーナ、米国、英国、イスラエル）を含む多国間の懸念材料がある。IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度ポテンシャル、流行可能性が認識される。
triage.notes: 記事はシンガポール発の症例を主題としているが、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCとガーナはMpox流行の歴史的エピセンターとして記事内で言及されており、対象国として含める。米国、英国、イスラエル、ナイジェリアは記事内で参考情報として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事は2026年5月のシンガポール症例を報告しており、人獣共通感染症として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeito de Ebola em São Paulo tem resultado positivo para meningite meningocócica - Portal Em Tempo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo has tested positive for meningococcal meningitis - Portal Em Tempo
article.articleSummary: In São Paulo, Brazil, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who recently traveled from an Ebola-affected area, was investigated as a suspected Ebola case. Laboratory testing confirmed meningococcal meningitis: qPCR detected Neisseria meningitidis, with the diagnosis confirmed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. The Ebola investigation remains ongoing as clinicians continue specific assays to rule out Ebola. The patient is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, the reference center for infectious diseases, and is under standard biosafety protocols. The case illustrates differential diagnosis in travelers from Ebola-affected regions; however, current results establish meningococcal meningitis as the diagnosis, while authorities have not announced a timeline for completing the Ebola testing.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで疑い事例のエボラ患者がメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で陽性 - Portal Em Tempo
triage.triage_reason: コンゴからブラジルへの国際的な渡航に関連した事例であり、エボラ感染地域との接触があるため国際的拡大リスクあり。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎は深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、エボラ検査が継続中であることから予想外性がある。
triage.notes: エボラ感染地域(DRC)からブラジルへの国際渡航者がメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で確認。エボラ検査は継続中であり、結果が出揃うまでは国際的な関心が高まる可能性がある。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎単独の確認でもWPRO基準を複数満たし、IHR基準も3つ以上該当するためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in the DRC is 'deeply alarming,' warn medics
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri Province, the area worst hit, is deeply alarming, with at least 246 deaths and more than 1,000 suspected cases; two weeks after the outbreak was declared. Uganda reports one death and 9 confirmed cases. MSF deputy director Dr Alan Gonzales called the pace and scale unprecedented, noting uncertainty about the true scale. WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri and urged communities to play a bigger role, warning that practices such as touching the bodies of Ebola victims can spread the virus and stressing safer rites to end the cycle of grief.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の拡大は『極めて深刻』と医療専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大により、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常な流行ペース、複数国への国際的拡大、およびパンデミック対応が必要な状況が確認される。
triage.notes: Ugandaは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事の主題であるため含める。エボラ出血熱の高い伝播性、高い致死率、国境を越える拡大リスク、および国際的な懸念の高さからPickupの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Бразилия разследва предполагаем случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil is investigating a suspected case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 – São Paulo, Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case reported in the state capital. A man from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever after recently visiting the African country where an Ebola epidemic is underway. The patient has been isolated in a hospital equipped to treat suspected and confirmed Ebola cases, according to local authorities. No laboratory confirmation is described in the report, and authorities are conducting standard public health procedures to determine exposure, assess symptoms, and trace contacts. The incident marks a potential importation of Ebola into Brazil, highlighting the ongoing risk of travel-associated cases from Ebola-affected regions. Further updates are expected as testing and epidemiological investigations proceed, with the hospital implementing infection control measures to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの疑い患者を調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な輸入例の疑いであり、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への深刻な影響）に複数該当。ブラジルでの初の疑い患者として社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジル・サンパウロ州での疑い患者と、コンゴ民主共和国での感染源の両方が明記されている。実験室確認前の段階だが、エボラの国際的な輸入例の可能性が高く、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルである。Bluedotの発生地域にはSão Pauloが含まれているが、これは正確に検証された。

article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser kalder hurtig spredning af ebola for "dyb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders call the rapid spread of Ebola "deep".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows an unprecedented rapid spread, with Doctors Without Borders (MSF) stating that never before have so many Ebola cases been registered so soon after the outbreak was declared. Alan Gonzales, MSF's operational deputy director, describes the current DR Congo outbreak as more intense than anticipated, underscoring the urgency of containment efforts. The article notes the scale of transmission but does not provide specific case or death counts in the excerpt. There is no detail on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or exported/imported cases within the text provided. The report, dated May 31, 2026, highlights the severity of the situation and MSF's concern about how quickly the virus is spreading in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がエボラの急速な拡大を「極めて懸念すべき」と指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。重症で急速拡大するエボラ outbreak は即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ outbreak における「前例のない急速拡大」は明らかにIHR通知基準を満たす。MSFによる深刻な警告、outbreak宣言後の異例の短期間での多数の症例報告は、国際的懸念を喚起するシグナル。具体的な症例数・死亡数の記載がないが、MSFの運用副責任者による強い警告文言から重症性は明白。緊急のフルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: O que a ciência computacional nos ajuda a entender sobre o vírus do Ebola? | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What Computational Science Helps Us Understand About the Ebola Virus? | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man in São Paulo on Saturday (30) rekindles questions about contagion risk and potential outbreak. A Cell Genomics study (2023) used genomics and computational science to show how EBOV can hide and evolve in different body sites. Researchers analyzed over 400 tissue samples from rhesus macaques infected with a lethal dose of the Kikwit variant, mapping disease progression. RNA-seq revealed host genes activated or silenced, and Ebola's disruption of tissue integrity helps explain severe symptoms. The virus disseminates to nearly all tissues within days, detectable in all organs up to day 6, using monocytes as vehicles to travel via blood. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs through bodily fluids. Incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, body aches, fatigue, with diarrhea, vomiting and bleeding as it worsens. In Brazil, only one suspected case exists; surveillance measures aim to minimize spread.

triage.headline_ja: 計算科学がエボラウイルスの理解にどのように役立つのか？| CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの疑い例報告により異常/予想外の基準を満たし、エボラウイルスの重症度と国際的拡大リスクから、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるエボラウイルスの疑い例は極めて異常。記事では計算科学的な分析が述べられているが、具体的な臨床転帰や確定診断状況は不明。ただし疑い例の報告自体が高いアラート価値を持つ。対象国リストにはザンビア、フィリピン等が含まれるが、本記事の主題はブラジルに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Congo and Uganda report 263 confirmed Ebola cases with 43 deaths, Africa CDC says
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as of May 30, with 43 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warns the outbreak—DRC's 17th and the third-largest since Ebola's discovery—is outpacing the global response. Health officials and aid workers report shortages of basic supplies such as masks after spread went undetected for weeks. Kaseya urged rapid activation of national incident systems and permanent investments in pandemic preparedness, with international partners aligning with African strategies. The outbreak underscores ongoing vulnerability in the region and the need for strengthened surveillance and response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダが263例の確認されたエボラ患者を報告、43人の死亡—アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な規模、国際的拡大のリスク、国際的対応の必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。シグナルとして確実にピックアップし、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地で、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCは対象国リスト(id=203312)に該当するため含める。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病で、DRCの17番目のアウトブレイク。1,100以上の疑い例が調査中。国際的な支援不足とサーベイランスの弱さが明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يحذر من تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو ويدعو إلى الدفن الآمن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General warns of Ebola outbreak in the Congo and calls for safe burials
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-31, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the country’s seventeenth outbreak, during a visit to the hardest-hit areas. He urged early treatment and strict adherence to safe burial protocols to curb transmission and warned against direct handling of corpses. The outbreak is challenging due to the absence of vaccines or approved treatments for the circulating rare strain. Latest figures show more than 1,000 suspected cases and 225 laboratory-confirmed infections in the DRC. Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in a man who recently returned from the Congo, underscoring cross-border import risk. Public health measures, community engagement, and rapid case management are emphasized to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行を警告し、安全な埋葬を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例1,000件以上の流行（DRC）、ブラジルでの輸入症例疑い例、国際的な拡大リスク、WHO事務局長の警告など、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ出血熱第17次流行、225例の検査確認例、ワクチン・承認治療法なしの稀有な流行株。ブラジルでの輸入症例疑い例は国際的拡大の懸念を強化。WHO事務局長の公式警告により政治的関心が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Dobrá správa od WHO: Päť pacientov s ebolou sa zotavilo a prepustili ich z nemocnice, na lieku stále pracujú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Good news from WHO: Five Ebola patients have recovered and been discharged from hospital, and work on the drug continues.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare type of Ebola in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, at a new Ebola treatment center opened by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Four patients were discharged on May 31 and one the day before; ongoing work on vaccines and therapies continues. Earlier, one patient had recovered from the Bundibugyo variant, the first documented recovery in the current outbreak for that strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO data show 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths in Congo; neighboring Uganda reports nine cases and one death. MSF warns that transmission remains faster than the response, urging expanded testing, rapid humanitarian deployment, and sustained medical supplies. Attacks on health facilities in three instances reflect community anger at corpse-handling protocols. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and has since spread to Uganda; Bundibugyo appears to be circulating.

triage.headline_ja: WHO報告：エボラ患者5人が回復し病院から退院、治療薬開発は継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準を満たす。エボラウイルス病の新規アウトブレイク（特にBundibugyo株）は稀で予想外であり、DRCからウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ(Uganda)も含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読するとウガンダは二次的な事例報告であり、主要なアウトブレイクはDRCのイトゥリ州で発生している。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが検証対象。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株の出現は医学的に重要であり、WHO長官による施設開設やMSFの警告など国際的関心も高い。フルRRAへの進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Миру грозит новая пандемия: смертоносный вирус вышел из-под контроля - АБН 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new pandemic threatens the world: a deadly virus has gotten out of control - ABN 24.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in Central Africa is out of control as of 2026-05-31, with transmission accelerating at an unprecedented pace. The outbreak threatens to cross the African continent, with Brazil investigating suspected infections. The United States has imposed a full ban on entry from high-risk countries. Ebola can have mortality up to 90% and causes severe, painful symptoms and physical suffering. Russia has tightened border controls to screen travelers returning from abroad. The report underscores the urgent international threat and highlights the need for enhanced surveillance, travel restrictions, and border measures as part of the response by health authorities worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: 世界は新たなパンデミアの脅威に直面：致死的ウイルスが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの大流行報告であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。国際的な感染拡大の危険性が高く、複数国での対応措置が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域では Central Africa および Africa が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当する中央アフリカ国（DRC等）が特定されていない。サマリーでは「ブラジルが疑い症例を調査」と明記されているため、Brazil のみを verified_locations に含めた。ただし、実際の主要発生地は中央アフリカであり、対象国リストの DRC (203312) や他の中央アフリカ国に該当する国が特定できれば、それも verified_locations に加える必要がある。記事本文が提供されていないため、詳細な地域特定ができない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертельных случаев Эболы в ДРК и Уганде выросло до 43 - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the DRC and Uganda has risen to 43 - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have risen to 43, with 263 confirmed cases and over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30, 2026, according to Africa CDC Director Jean Kasaya. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Doctors Without Borders warns of unprecedented speed of spread and calls for expanding testing, boosting international medical and humanitarian aid, and ensuring access to affected regions. The last Ebola outbreak in the DRC ended in October 2025; the most severe outbreak (2013–2016) in West Africa caused over 28,000 cases and about 11,000 deaths. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and in the DRC near the Ebola River, affecting humans, some primates, and hoofed animals. Fatal outcomes are driven by massive bleeding, toxin effects, and shock.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダのエボラ死亡者数が43人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言している公衆衛生上の最重要事象。263確定例と1,100以上の疑い例、43人の死亡、急速な拡大が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言、Doctors Without Bordersの警告、250以上の確定例と1,000以上の疑い例、43人の死亡、「前例のない拡大速度」との報告により、極めて高いリスク水準。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事主文ではDRCを主として言及しており、ウガンダの詳細な発生確認が記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Тедрос: Пет пациенти од источно Конго ја преживеаја еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros: Five patients from eastern Congo survived Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; four are to be discharged today and one was discharged two days ago, announced WHO Director Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, capital of Ituri. Recovery pertains to Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO reports 906 cases and 223 deaths; Uganda confirms nine cases and one death. MSF warned the virus spreads faster than containment and urged expanded testing, faster humanitarian deployment, and continued access to medical supplies. Local residents have attacked health centers amid strict body-handling protocols conflicting with burial customs. In Ituri, attacks by Allied Democratic Forces linked to Islamic State and allied ethnic militias disrupted response; outbreaks also reported in North and South Kivu, where M23 controls Goma and Bukavu.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス：東部コンゴから5人の患者がエボラを生き残った
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例（WHO報告906例、死亡223例）、複数国への拡大（ウガンダで9例確認）、治療法・ワクチンなし、地域紛争による対応困難という深刻な状況が該当。IHR基準3項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは確認例の報告にとどまり、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（South Kivu、North Kivu、Ituri）。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株による集団発生、治療法・ワクチン不在、地域紛争による保健対応の阻害、MSFによる拡大警告あり。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser kalder hurtig spredning af ebola "dybt al
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders call the rapid spread of Ebola "a deep alarm".
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) reports a record-high number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo), occurring soon after an Ebola outbreak was declared. Alan Gonzales, MSF’s operational deputy director, describes the rapid spread as a 'deep alarm' for the response. The excerpt underscores the unusually swift and broad escalation of the current DR Congo outbreak, signaling a critical situation for affected communities and responders. Specific case counts, laboratory confirmation details, and transmission origins are not provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がエボラの急速な拡大を「深刻な懸念」と指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の記録的症例数と急速な拡大はシグナル基準を満たす。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最優先度の国際感染症。記録的症例数と「深刻な懸念」の専門家所見により、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。具体的な症例数や実験室確認数は記事では未提供のため、追加情報収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Fem patienter har tillfrisknat från nya ebolavarianten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients have recovered from the new Ebola variant.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, five patients have recovered from a new bunyavirus variant of the Ebola virus, according to the World Health Organization (WHO) via AP. The outbreak has sickened about 906 people and caused 223 deaths. The Democratic Republic of Congo has been hardest hit, with transmission also reaching Uganda, a neighboring country. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that progress on vaccines and treatments continues, but recovery demonstrates that patients can survive Ebola even as response efforts persist. The report highlights ongoing transmission and the need for continued public health measures and surveillance to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラウイルス変異株から5人の患者が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスの新規変異株による大規模流行（906人感染、223人死亡）であり、複数国での拡大、高い重症度と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的に言及されている発生国はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみに該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし、Uganda（226074）がBluedot APIで指定されている場合、対象国でないため verified_locations から除外。エボラの新規変異株（bunyavirus variant）という表現に注意。WHO指導部の発言により政治的関心の高さが確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре рассказали, как защититься от холеры за границей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor explains how to protect yourself from cholera abroad
article.articleSummary: Cholera remains unsettled globally in 2026: since the start of the year, more than 78,000 cases have been reported across 23 countries, with Africa bearing the majority. Nigeria alone reports 943 confirmed cases, 37 deaths, and over 1,700 suspected, a situation worsened by recent heavy rains. Rospotrebnadzor recommends travelers from cholera-affected areas follow strict personal hygiene and safe food-water practices: drink bottled water, avoid ice made from untreated water, wash hands with soap after crowded places, and use sanitizers; avoid ready-to-eat cut vegetables/fruits and foods from markets; meat and seafood should be consumed only after thorough cooking. The agency also noted it held talks with Congo on the Ebola outbreak on May 28, 11:48. WHO has expressed concern about Ebola and whether it could reach Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾルが海外でのコレラからの身を守る方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: コレラは2026年に23カ国で78,000例以上が報告され、ナイジェリアで943例・37死亡が確認されている。また記事はコンゴのエボラ危機にも言及しており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「公衆衛生影響」に複数該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」にも該当する。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアのコレラ流行を詳述しているが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に入れない。ただしコンゴ（DRC）はエボラ危機として記事で明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため included。ロシアへの言及は当局の警告として記述されているに過ぎず、実際の発生地ではない。IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で複数該当し、社会政治的関心も明確であることから PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola verspreidt zich gevaarlijk snel: 'We lopen achter de feiten aan'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading dangerously fast: "We are playing catch-up with the facts."
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is accelerating, with the Bundibugyo virus strain causing rising cases and deaths. WHO official Dick Chamla warns this could become a large outbreak, citing more than 1,000 suspected or confirmed cases and about 250 deaths as of May 31, 2026. The Bundibugyo variant is less common and currently lacks a vaccine or specific treatment; care is largely supportive, and vaccination exists only for the Zaïre variant. Containment is hampered by limited testing capacity and cultural burial practices. The outbreak may have spread to neighbouring South Sudan, prompting a WHO team deployment to Juba and heightened regional preparedness in ten countries. The international community has pledged roughly half of a $0.5 billion funding need. The US is restricting entry for non-US travelers from Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが危険なほど速く広がっている：「我々は事実に追いつくのに必死だ」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの活動的な多国籍流行で、死亡・重症例多数、国際的拡大のリスク高く、既に渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ザイール株以外）、1,000超の疑い例・確定例、約250人の死亡者が報告されている。WHOが大規模流行の警告を発出。南スーダンへの拡大の可能性が示唆されているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な確定例言及がないため verified_locations には含めない。米国が既に渡航制限を実施。資金不足（$2.5億必要だが$2.5億しか約束されず）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Naděje: Pět pacientů se zotavilo z nového druhu eboly. Léčba proti němu přitom není
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope: Five patients have recovered from a new strain of Ebola. There is no treatment for it.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare Ebola strain at a new treatment center in Bunia, Ituri, Congo. Four will be discharged today and one yesterday; earlier, one patient recovered from Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Congo reports 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths; Uganda has nine cases and one death. MSF warns transmission remains faster than response, urging expanded testing, quicker deployment of humanitarian workers, and sustained supplies. Health workers face greater risk as burial rituals clash with protocols, with three attacks on facilities. Africa CDC declared the Ituri outbreak on May 15; it has spread to Uganda. A Brazilian 37-year-old man in quarantine after returning from Congo could be Brazil’s first Ebola case; a 19-year-old Austrian woman, asymptomatic, tested negative twice after volunteering in Kampala and remains under observation in Vienna. Six Ebola viruses exist; past outbreaks include West Africa 2013–2016 (>11,000 deaths) and Congo 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: 希望：新種のエボラから5人の患者が回復。それに対する治療法はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、複数国への国際的スプレッド懸念（ブラジル、オーストリアで疑い例）、高い死亡率と重症度を示す。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri州Bunia）とウガンダでの新種エボラ発生を主題としており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ブラジルとオーストリアも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため検証地点から除外。記事にインド言及なし。verified_locationsはDRCのみ追加すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Cinco doentes já recuperaram na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Five patients have already recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues with five patients recovered in Bunia, Ituri province, where WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new treatment center; four more will be discharged today and one yesterday. There is no approved specific treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo; symptomatic care is yielding recoveries, including the first documented Bundibugyo-confirmed recovery in this outbreak reported on Friday. In the DRC, 246 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases have been recorded; the virus has been detected in three provinces. Uganda reports two new confirmed cases, bringing its total to nine. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing response and calls for expanded testing, rapid deployment of health workers, and sustained medical supplies. Ituri remains the epicenter, with weak rural health services and armed groups affecting response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国で5人の患者がすでに回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株の大規模流行で246人の死亡、1000人以上の疑い例、ウガンダへの越境確認。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州ブニアにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行を主題としている。ウガンダへの越境が記載されているが、記事サマリーの主要な焦点はDRCの流行である。WHO事務局長による治療センター開設、MSFによる警告など国際的関心が高い。ワクチンと特異的治療がない稀な株であることが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Expands Ebola Testing as Outbreak's Real Scale Eludes Officials
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus. The World Health Organization and other health organizations warn of the risk of further spread and have expanded testing to gauge the outbreak’s true scale. Officials say confirmed Ebola cases are being tracked as the situation evolves. The WHO Director-General urged affected people to seek early treatment, noting that Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus can be survived with good medical care. The report highlights the strain's role and the ongoing response to laboratory-confirmed infections, emphasizing rapid testing and treatment as key measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ検査を拡大、流行の実態が把握困難に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による確認症例の増加と、WHOを含む複数保健機関による国際的警告があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による急性ウイルス性出血熱。WHO及びMSFによる公式警告と、確認症例数の増加報告あり。検査能力の拡大は流行規模が実態より過小評価されている可能性を示唆。高い致死率と人間への直接影響。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ лично вылетел в эпицентр заражений Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General personally flew to the epicenter of Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) region hardest hit by Ebola hemorrhagic fever. He urged residents to seek medical care promptly and to strictly follow safe burial practices for deceased relatives. He noted that for the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, there are no approved drugs or vaccines, making supportive care essential, including patient isolation, fluid replacement, and pain control. The DRC has endured 16 previous Ebola outbreaks; officials view this as the seventeenth outbreak in the country. The message emphasizes surveillance, rapid supportive treatment, and community engagement as critical to outbreak response, given the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for the current strain. The article is dated 2026-05-31.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱感染の震源地に自ら飛行
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の爆発的感染イベント。DRCの第17回アウトブレイク、WHO事務局長の現地視察という異例の対応、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および医療対策の不在が確認された。IHR基準3つ該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株）は既知のエボラウイルス種。承認された治療薬やワクチンが存在せず、支持療法が中心。DRC第17回アウトブレイク。WHO事務局長の現地視察という極めて異例の対応が、国際的な懸念水準の高さを示している。2026年5月31日配信という2026年の将来日付であるが、イベント内容は明確な感染症危機管理上の懸念事項を示しており、シグナルとして優先度高。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola va en escala, alertan brote a países que no tienen medicinas para otras enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola on the rise; warnings of an outbreak in countries lacking medicines for other diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, during a WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visit to Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks escalate two weeks after declaration. The Bundibugyo variant is driving unprecedented spread, with no approved vaccines or specific treatments and diagnostic challenges due to scarce laboratory capacity. Suspected cases mount daily, and hundreds of samples remain untested. Cross-border and airport closures are impeding the arrival of vital medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and experts. MSF and other medical groups warn that response capacity is far from sufficient, with only a handful of specialized organizations operating locally. Urgent, large-scale diagnostic testing and rapid, coordinated deployment of aid—along with safe corridors for supplies and personnel—are needed. Crucially, community engagement, addressing rumors, and building trust are essential to ensure people seek care and to prevent collapse of essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱が拡大、他の病気の医療物資を持たない国への警告として流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ熱の深刻な流行拡大、Bundibugyo変異株による前例のない感染拡大、診断・治療能力の欠如、医療サプライチェーン遮断による国際的影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長によるBunia視察時点での報告。Bundibugyo変異株は公表されたワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、検査能力の著しい不足により診断が困難。国境・空港閉鎖により国際的な医療支援が阻害されている。MSFを含む国際医療団体が対応能力の不足を警告。多くのスクリーニング基準がすべて該当するため、即座のフルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉恐已衝出非洲 巴西錄疑似首例 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola May Have Already Spread Beyond Africa; Brazil Reports a Suspected First Case
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Brazil's São Paulo state under investigation after a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever and other symptoms and is hospitalized in a facility equipped for Ebola patients, with isolation precautions in place. The Ebola outbreak ongoing in DRC, centered in Ituri Province around Bunia; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visiting the region emphasizes Bundibugyo virus strain currently lacks a vaccine or approved therapy; early case finding, rapid isolation, and supportive care crucial; deceased patients' bodies remain highly infectious and must be handled safely for burial. Médecins Sans Frontières reports shortages and hundreds of samples awaiting testing, complicating surveillance. Health Minister Kamba of DRC says the government has experience and resources to meet testing needs and denies the outbreak is out of control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカから流出した可能性 ブラジルで疑い例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスのアフリカ域外への地理的拡大は極めて高い公衆衛生上の脅威であり、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ブラジルの疑い例は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。DRCのイツリ州での進行中アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus strain）との明確な関連性あり。WHO事務局長が現地視察中。検査サンプルの滞留やMSFによる物資不足など対応上の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: В нескольких странах Африки 43 человека умерли от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In several African countries, 43 people died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of May 30, 2026, laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases reach 263 with 43 fatalities across both countries, while over 1,100 suspected infections remain under investigation. Earlier WHO official Anais Legand reported 125 cases and 17 deaths in DR Congo across 13 provinces as of Thursday. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya provided the updated totals, noting ongoing investigations for more than 1,100 suspected cases. The World Health Organization has declared the current Uganda-DR Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The previous DR Congo Ebola outbreak ended in October 2025. The report emphasizes the ongoing outbreak status, regional impact, and emergency designation, without detailing symptoms, laboratory methods, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの複数の国でエボラ熱により43人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の多国間アウトブレイク（ウガンダとDRC）で263の確定症例と43人の死亡が報告されており、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も全5項目に該当するため、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDで対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ただし記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを明示している。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。WHOのPHEIC宣言は国際的対応の必要性を示す重要な指標。1,100超の疑い症例が調査中であり、状況は動的で拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Es clave el control de pasajeros para evitar el ingreso del Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passenger screening is key to preventing Ebola from entering.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted a WHO alert and reinforced health checks at Venezuela’s airports and ports. Dr. José Trujillo, a toxicologist, warns that Ebola is a filovirus with a 2–21 day incubation, so an infected traveler can enter before symptoms appear. The DRC reports about 246 suspected deaths tied to the seventeenth epidemic since 1976. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; it is not waterborne or vector-borne, and wildlife reservoirs include bats. A vaccine, Ervebo, exists, but strong preventive measures are essential. Venezuela, declared Ebola-free by WHO, should maintain screening by requiring travelers from Africa or Asia to complete an epidemiological form noting origin and stay duration to enable rapid cordon sanitaire if needed. Symptoms are abrupt fever, severe headache, generalized weakness, and hemorrhagic signs; dehydration and comorbidities worsen prognosis.

triage.headline_ja: 乗客検査はエボラ出血熱の侵入を防ぐための重要な対策である
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク報告であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の疾患発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: DRCでの17番目のエボラアウトブレイクが報告されており、246人の疑い死者が報告されている。記事はベネズエラでの検疫強化について述べているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当国であるため、ベネズエラは除外。WHO警報が発令され、複数国での検疫体制強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Шефот на СЗО: Во Конго пет лица успешно се излекуваа од ебола, продолжуваме да работиме на вакцини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief: In Congo, five people have recovered from Ebola; we are continuing to work on vaccines.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with four people to be discharged today and one discharged the day before at a new treatment center in Bunia, Ituri Province. WHO reports 906 infections and 223 deaths in Congo, with nine cases and one death in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Doctors Without Borders warns transmission is outpacing health facilities and aid, urging increased testing. Health workers face elevated risks amid hostility over body-management protocols, including at least three attacks on health centers by residents and ongoing clashes involving the Allied Democratic Forces (an ISIS-linked group) and local militias. The WHO Director-General emphasized that ending the outbreak concerns everyone and requires inclusive action.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：コンゴでエボラから5人が回復、ワクチン開発を継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による進行中の流行で、治療法・ワクチン未承認、保健施設の対応能力を上回る伝播が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも9症例1死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo株は比較的稀な株系統で、治療法・ワクチン未承認という重大な課題がある。保健施設の能力不足、武装勢力との衝突、住民による医療施設への攻撃など、セキュリティ上の懸念も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Says 5 Patients In Africa's Ebola Outbreak Have Recovered (Live Updates)
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, including the first documented Bundibugyo recovery, with four more discharged following Friday's release. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, notes vaccines and treatments remain in development, but recoveries demonstrate potential for disease control. As of May 29, there were 134 confirmed active Ebola cases and 18 confirmed deaths in Congo and Uganda, with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths reported as of May 27. WHO is scaling up diagnostic capacity to identify cases earlier, amid challenges from conflict, misinformation, and distrust in the region. The outbreak’s epicenter is Bunia, DRC, with broader regional implications. The report also references evacuations and quarantine discussions in Kenya and US airport screenings for travelers from affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がアフリカのエボラ熱アウトブレイクで5人の患者が回復したと発表（ライブ更新）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大のリスクを持つ一類感染症。DRC・ウガンダでの確認患者134例、死亡18例、疑い例906例の規模と、国際的な検疫対応（ケニア、米国空港スクリーニング）により、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Kenya、USAも含まれていたが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ熱アウトブレイク」であり、Kenya・USAは検疫対応国として言及されているにすぎない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。5月29日時点で確認患者134例（DRC・ウガンダ計）、死亡18例の大規模アウトブレイク。BundibuyoエボラへVPRIの初回回復例を含む。WHOによる診断能力の強化と、紛争・偽情報・不信による課題が並行して報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Revolucija u lečenju jetre! Prvi "funkcionalan lek" protiv hepatitisa B daje rezultate koji do sada nisu viđeni, moguć preokret u borbi protiv jedne od najopasnijih hroničnih infekcija u svetu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revolution in Liver Treatment! The First 'Functional Drug' Against Hepatitis B Delivers Results Never Seen Before, a Possible Turning Point in the Fight Against One of the World's Most Dangerous Chronic Infections.
article.articleSummary: Bepirovirsen, an experimental drug for chronic hepatitis B, may represent a major advance by delivering a 'functional cure'—long-term viral suppression, while trace virus remains, without ongoing therapy. In two international studies involving 1,838 participants, about 20% of those receiving weekly bepirovirsen injections plus standard therapy achieved prolonged viral suppression after stopping treatment, yielding clinically stable status off medication. The compound acts on the virus's genetic material, lowers replication, and enhances the immune response. Results were presented in Barcelona and published in NEJM, with Singapore's National University Health System physician Seng Gi Lim among investigators. Developed by GSK and Ionis Pharmaceuticals, bepirovirsen is under accelerated FDA evaluation, with decisions anticipated in Japan, China, and the European Union. Hepatitis B affects over 250 million people worldwide and can cause cirrhosis, liver failure, and liver cancer. Adverse effects were mostly mild, including injection-site reactions and transient liver enzyme changes.

triage.headline_ja: 肝臓治療の革新！B型肝炎に対する初の「機能的治療薬」が前例のない成果をもたらし、世界で最も危険な慢性感染症との闘いに可能性をもたらす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はB型肝炎の実験的治療薬（ベピロビルセン）の臨床試験結果報告であり、新規感染症の発生やアウトブレイクではなく、医学的な治療進展を報道しているもの。シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の発生・検出・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既存のB型肝炎に対する治療薬の開発進捗を報道しているもの。臨床試験サイト（バルセロナ）やNEJM掲載は医学的なニュース価値であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルではない。Bluedot APIが抽出した複数国は記事言及により付与されたと考えられるが、いずれの国でも新規感染症イベントは報告されていない。対象国リストとの照合でも該当する実質的なイベント発生地域なし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro investiga suspeita de Ebola após caso semelhante em São Paulo: o que se sabe até agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro Investigates Suspected Ebola After a Similar Case in São Paulo: What Is Known So Far.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Brazil investigates suspected Ebola cases in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. In Rio, a Belgian man who had traveled from Uganda tested positive for malaria; authorities monitor contacts as investigations proceed. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo presented fever and was confirmed with Neisseria meningitidis at Instituto Adolfo Lutz; he is isolated at Emílio Ribas. If confirmed as Ebola, these would be the first cases outside Africa since the new outbreak and the first in Brazil; Brazil had no prior confirmed Ebola. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola; no approved vaccine and limited therapies. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. The WHO declared a PHEIC; Brazil activated the National Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers; no border closures. Congo outbreak: 906 suspected, 223 deaths; 134 confirmed, 18 deaths; 9 confirmed in Uganda (May 27).

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロがサンパウロの類似事例後のエボラ疑い症例を調査：現在判明していること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。アフリカ外での初の可能性あるエボラ確認例であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの言及があるが、主たるイベント発生地はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ）とコンゴ民主共和国。ウガンダは背景情報（トラベル履歴、アウトブレイク地域）として記載されているため verified_locations には含めない。記事サマリー上ではまだ確定診断ではなく「疑い症例」だが、WHO PHEIC宣言、アフリカ外初の可能性、ブンディブギョエボラの高致命性を考慮し PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: ¿La crisis del ébola empezó con la muerte de 43 chimpancés en una semana de 1994?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did the Ebola crisis begin with the death of 43 chimpanzees during a week in 1994?
article.articleSummary: Beginning in November 1994 in Taï National Park, Ivory Coast, Ebola spread within a wild chimpanzee community, with 43 individuals vanishing or dying in weeks—about 25% of a group. A mother carried her dead infant for over a day as others fell ill and died; laboratory tests confirmed the first documented Ebola outbreak in wildlife in its habitat. Boesch and OMS veterinarian Pierre Formenty traced transmission to chimpanzees’ consumption of red colobus monkey meat, establishing a bushmeat-related spillover route and giving rise to the Taï Forest virus variant. Three decades later, an active Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo (BDBV). As of May 22, 2026, about 600 suspected cases and at least 139 deaths have been reported; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola viruses belong to Orthoebolavirus, Filoviridae; notable strains EBOV, SUDV, BDBV; historical CFRs range 25–90%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機は1994年の1週間で43頭のチンパンジーが死亡したことから始まったのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（BDBV）による現在の複数国流行（DRC、ウガンダ）で、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事は1994年の歴史的なタイ国立公園でのエボラ群発も言及しているが、現在の活動的流行はDRCとウガンダで報告されており、現在時点での主要な公衆衛生上の脅威はこの両国である。ただし対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言により国際的な関心度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Gujarat Forest and Environment Minister Visits Gir Forests, Reviews Infection Situation Among Asiatic Lions
article.articleSummary: In Gujarat's Gir Forests, infection detected among Asiatic lions is being actively reviewed. On 31 May 2026, Forest and Environment Minister Arjunbhai Modhwadia visited Gandhinagar's Gir ecosystems, inspecting Jamwala Rescue Centre, Babariya Forest area, and Jasadhar Animal Care Centre to assess ground-level response. He held discussions with senior officials and veterinary teams and reported that the situation is completely under control due to timely and effective forest department measures. Notably, no lion deaths due to viral infection have been reported in the last three days. As a precaution, special teams comprising Forest Department personnel, veterinary experts, and field staff are conducting round-the-clock surveillance to prevent lapses in monitoring. Under Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel's guidance, the state government reiterates commitment to protecting Gujarat's Asiatic lions and their conservation.

triage.headline_ja: インド・グジャラート州ニュース | グジャラート森林環境相がギル森を視察、アジアライオンの感染状況を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは野生動物（アジアライオン）における感染症であり、ヒト向け公衆衛生上の直接的リスクを示す根拠が不足している。国際的な拡大リスク、貿易制限リスクも認められず、既に当局の管理下にあると報告されている。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（アジアライオン）の感染症に関する動物衛生上のニュースである。影響カテゴリは『animals』と明記されており、ヒト向けの感染症警戒シグナルではない。IHR(2005)Annex2基準は全て未充足。当局が既に対応中であり、過去3日間で死亡例なしとの報告から重症度も低い。ただし将来的にヒト-動物感染境界疾患への転化の可能性がないとは言えないため、継続的な監視は必要だが、現段階ではシグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO appeals for more international support during Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating, with the death toll nearing 250 and more than 1,000 suspected cases. Doctors Without Borders and the World Health Organization warn the spread is unprecedented and responders are rapidly exhausting resources. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus is in Bunia, the epicentre, overseeing containment and urging communities to curb transmission, which can occur through direct contact with bodily fluids. With a vaccine not expected for more than nine months, authorities caution that control will be difficult. The DRC government has allocated $20 million and is mobilizing with partners under presidential and prime ministerial leadership to stop the outbreak. The article underscores the urgent need for international support to bolster surveillance, case management, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行中、WHOが国際的支援をさらに求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、死亡者約250人、疑い患者1,000人超、ヒト-ヒト感染、ワクチン供給不足、国際支援の緊急要請により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の中心的主題はDRC東部のエボラ出血熱流行であり、死亡者約250人、疑い患者1,000人超という重大な数字が示されている。WHO事務局長がBunia（流行中心地）に現地入りし、国際支援の緊急要請がなされており、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。資源枯渇、ワクチン供給までの長期間、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、DRC政府による2,000万ドル予算配分など、管理可能性が低く国際支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Longleng reviews TB, HIV/AIDS control measures
article.articleSummary: Longleng district, Nagaland, conducted a May 29 meeting of the District Tuberculosis Forum and the District AIDS Prevention and Control Committee to review TB and HIV/AIDS control. Chaired by Deputy Commissioner W Manpai Phom, the forum stressed coordinated actions and community participation, detailing government support for TB patients—free diagnosis and treatment, nutritional support, and honorariums for treatment supporters. Tongang outlined the ongoing 100-day TB Mukt Bharat campaign to identify asymptomatic cases at the village level. Lita briefed on the district’s current HIV/AIDS situation, while SSHAKTI Kabit described Mission AIDS Suraksha, a Government of India effort to reach HIV epidemic control and make districts 'Surakshit Plus' by December 2027; the plan targets 15 Nagaland districts to improve testing, linkage to care, and adherence. Hampong Yingli Mission Society updated on targeted interventions. Officials called for stronger coordination to eliminate TB and control HIV/AIDS.

triage.headline_ja: Longleng reviews TB, HIV/AIDS control measures
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は行政レベルの政策会議・コントロール施策レビューの報告であり、新規の感染症エスカレーションや異常な疾患発生の報告ではない。既知感染症（TB、HIV）の地域管理状況についての進捗報告にすぎず、IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は Longleng district（ナガランド州）での TB・HIV/AIDS 管理施策に関する行政会議の報告。新規ケースの報告やアウトブレイクシグナルではなく、既知感染症の地域コントロール進捗に関する定期的な政策レビュー。行政部門の関心はあるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 263 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα και 43 θάνατοι σε Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: By May 30, 2026, 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths attributed to the rare Bundibugyo strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. Kaséja, Africa CDC director, in a Financial Times op-ed, urged immediate activation of national outbreak-response systems and permanent investments in pandemic preparedness. International partners play a key role, but support should align with strategies developed by African institutions and governments. The World Health Organization has declared the Congo–Uganda outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). No infection source details or information on imported/exported cases are provided in the report. This highlights an ongoing, multi-country outbreak requiring strengthened case management and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダで263例のエボラ確認症例と43例の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラの複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）における確認症例と死亡者の報告、WHO公式のPHEIC宣言、国際的感染拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているDRCでの263例確認症例と43死亡。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株は稀な株。1,100以上の疑い症例調査中。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة يدعو لدفن آمن خلال زيارة لبؤرة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director Calls for Safe Burial During Visit to Ebola Outbreak Epicenter
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the Ebola outbreak epicenter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and urged residents to seek prompt treatment and practice safe burials to curb transmission. The outbreak is the seventh in the DRC and the third largest since the virus was first identified roughly 50 years ago. Tedros acknowledged the global response days before traveling to Kinshasa on Thursday as authorities intensify containment, with emphasis on community engagement, early care, and proper burials to reduce mortality and secondary infections linked to burial practices.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の流行中心地訪問時に安全な埋葬を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高危険度病原体の流行で、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WHO事務局長の現地訪問という国際的関心の高さも確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の流行はDRCのキンシャサを中心に発生していることが明確。これはDRCの第7番目の流行で、WHO事務局長による現地訪問が報告されており、国際的な高い関心と対応の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Imbau Kenali Gejala Ebola, Dari Demam hingga Pendarahan : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Urges Public to Recognize Ebola Symptoms, From Fever to Bleeding: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a concern with outbreaks in several African countries, prompting Indonesia’s Ministry of Health to issue an alert. The disease’s incubation is 2–21 days, with symptoms typically appearing after 8–10 days post-exposure. Early signs mimic other infections and include sudden fever, severe fatigue, muscle and joint pains, headache, and sore throat. As illness progresses, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and liver or kidney dysfunction may appear, with bleeding that can occur internally or from vomit, stool, nose, gums, or vagina. No cases have been reported in Indonesia, but a public alert has been issued. Border authorities are advised to screen travelers showing fever, headache, limb pain, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, or bleeding. Returnees from affected countries with such symptoms should seek medical care promptly for further handling and investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラの症状認識を呼びかけ、発熱から出血まで：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ流行が背景にあり、インドネシアが警戒体制を敷いているシグナルだが、インドネシア国内での確認患者はなく、現段階では予防啓発段階。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカでのエボラ流行が背景として述べられているが、主題はインドネシアの保健省による警戒態勢・啓発活動。インドネシア国内での確認患者はないとの明記により、現在は予防段階。アフリカの具体的な発生国名が記事サマリーに明記されていないため、Africa大陸自体は verified_locations に含めず、記事の主対象であるインドネシアのみを対象国として採用。IHR基準は2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するが、国内患者不在のため WATCH での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the outbreak of a rare kind of Ebola as cases outpace response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Congo and Uganda: Congo reports 134 confirmed cases and 17 deaths; Uganda confirms 9 cases and 1 death. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain with no approved medicines or vaccines, drives this outbreak—the worst linked to Bundibugyo to date. First cases emerged in late April in Bunia, Ituri province, and Mongbwalu, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Rwanda-backed M23 rebels control key cities including Goma and Bukavu, where two cases have been reported. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding. Initial response was delayed as officials tested for the more common Ebola virus. International response includes an Africa CDC high-level meeting and WHO advisory group evaluating candidate vaccines for trials in coming months. Funding: EU aid arrived May 28; the US added $80 million that day, bringing total commitments to over $112 million.

triage.headline_ja: 症例数が対応を上回る中、稀なタイプのエボラ出血熱の流行について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola（稀な株）による確認症例134例、死亡17例、WHO PHEICの宣言、国際的な資金・支援動員、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチン開発動向など、全てのシグナルが満たされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（226074）とルワンダ（49518）にも言及しているが、発生地域の記述から見ると主要な流行地はDRCのイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ州である。ウガンダは9症例との言及はあるが、DRCからの越境という文脈であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo Ebola（BDBV）による大規模流行、WHO PHEIC宣言、治療薬・ワクチン未承認、紛争地での流行拡大という複合的リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 260 de cazuri confirmate de Ebola până la 30 mai în Congo și Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 260 confirmed Ebola cases as of May 30 in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases were reported across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Forty-three deaths have been confirmed, all linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. This outbreak is the 17th Ebola episode in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus’s discovery about 50 years ago. Dr. Jean Kaseya, director-general of Africa CDC, urged rapid activation of national response systems and permanent investments in pandemic preparedness, noting international partners are most effective when aligned with African institutions and governments. The World Health Organization has declared the DRC–Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Officials warn that basic supplies, including masks, are scarce, and that transmission went undetected for weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月30日時点でコンゴとウガンダで263件のエボラ確定症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)を宣言しており、アフリカの疾病管理センター長も国際的対応を強調している。エボラウイルスの多国間アウトブレイクであり、直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの稀なBundibugyo株による17番目のDRCアウトブレイク。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。1,100件以上の疑い症例があり、基本的な医療用品の不足が報告されている。DRCとウガンダの両国で確定症例が報告されており、対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dois casos suspeitos de ebola em SP e no Rio; ebola ainda não foi descartado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; Ebola has not yet been ruled out.
article.articleSummary: On 31 May 2026, Brazil investigates two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, with Ebola not yet ruled out. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old Congolese immigrant with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo presented with high fever, diarrhea, and disorientation and is intubated; laboratory testing at Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified Neisseria meningitidis (meningitis), while Ebola tests remain pending. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian traveler who had been to Uganda exhibits mild symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) and tested positive for malaria; Ebola testing is also pending. Both cases are in isolation and under surveillance. Authorities emphasize very low Brazil risk due to no local transmission history and absence of direct flights, noting Ebola requires contact with fluids from symptomatic patients. Globally, Ebola outbreaks are centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu) and Uganda, with 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, and 906 cases/223 deaths under investigation per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロとリオデジャネイロでエボラ疑い例2件を調査中。エボラはまだ除外されていない
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い例は異常かつ予想外だが、検査結果は陰性（髄膜炎）または保留中であり、現在のところ確定例はない。情報が部分的であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: São Pauloの症例は髄膜炎（Neisseria meningitidis）と特定、Rio de Janeiroの症例はマラリア確定。両症例のエボラ検査は未決定だが、症状から別疾患の可能性が高い。ブラジルは国内伝播歴なく直行便もない低リスク地域とされている。アフリカでのアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）から距離がある。情報不足のため一段階進めないが続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS déclare l'urgence mondiale, le Mali et le Sahel en alerte - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO declares a global health emergency, Mali and the Sahel on alert - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, has produced 101 confirmed cases and 10 deaths. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri Province and has begun to spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and neighboring Uganda, with the first cases reported in Mongbwalu; health workers are among the victims. WHO elevated the DRC’s national risk from high to very high, while regional risk remains high. Although Mali does not border DRC, Sahel-adjacent countries—Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger—must maintain heightened vigilance due to regional circulation. Responses emphasize rapid detection, case isolation, and contact tracing; movement controls are discussed. Africa CDC and WHO call for swift, regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：WHO が世界的保健上の危機を宣言、マリとサハル地域は警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言であり、複数国への拡大リスク、死亡事例、国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: マリ、ブルキナファソ、ニジェールが記事で言及されているが、これらは警戒対象国であり、記事サマリーの主題となる実際の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、高度なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS alerte sur une souche actuelle rare et sans vaccin disponible - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns about a currently circulating rare strain with no available vaccine - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola driving the Democratic Republic of the Congo's 17th outbreak; no vaccine or approved treatment available for this strain. As of May 31, 2026, 1,028 suspected cases including 225 confirmed in the Ituri region’s Bunia; the WHO is reviewing 223 suspected deaths. The WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to urge rapid care and strict safe-burial practices, noting that corpses are highly contagious and traditional funeral rites fuel transmission. International concern grows with a suspected imported Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, linked to recent travel from DRC. Health facilities have faced attacks by grieving families demanding body retrieval for traditional ceremonies. Authorities emphasize modifying funeral practices to curb the outbreak, which is described as the third-largest in the DRC’s history since Ebola’s discovery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO が現在流行中の稀な株でワクチンがないことを警告 - ラプレス・デ・チュニジ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo variant によるコンゴ民主共和国での大規模アウトブレイク（17番目）で、ワクチンなし、死亡例多数、ブラジルへの国際的な輸出症例報告あり。WHO事務局長による直接介入と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は Bundibugyo variant（ワクチン未開発株）による DRC の第17次アウトブレイク（5月31日時点で確定症例225、死亡疑い223件）と、ブラジル（サンパウロ）への輸出症例を報告。WHO事務局長 Tedros が Bunia を訪問し、伝統的葬儀慣行による伝播抑制を重視。国際的懸念が明確である。対象国リストから DRC と Brazil が verified_locations に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected cases of Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where a new Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15, is in isolation at a specialized infectious disease institute; laboratory confirmation has not yet been obtained. In Rio de Janeiro, a man from Uganda with viral symptoms including cough, chills, and diarrhea is under investigation; the city reports malaria positive. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has produced over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, and Uganda has also reported detections. The World Health Organization has activated an international health alert, but officials say the risk of introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low, with no confirmed cases in Brazil yet.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの2つの疑わしい症例を調査している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。対象国ブラジルでエボラ疑い症例が報告され、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク背景下での国際的シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: DRCで5月15日に宣言された新規エボラアウトブレイク（1,000以上の疑い症例、246死亡）の背景下で、ブラジル（サンパウロとリオデジャネイロ）で国際的に関連のある疑い症例が報告された。WHOが国際保健警報を発動。ウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。実験室確認はまだ得られていないが、国際的な懸念の高さと公衆衛生影響の可能性からピックアップ対象と判定。

article.articleHeadline: World Health Organization hails recovery of five Ebola patients
article.articleSummary: Five people infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have recovered, with four more to be discharged and one already sent home, as a new Ebola treatment centre opens in Bunia, Ituri province. The DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak involves a strain with up to 50% case fatality and currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the recoveries on 2026-05-31. MSF described the situation as deeply alarming, noting the outbreak is spreading faster than any previous eruption and is difficult to diagnose due to limited testing capacity. Official figures cite more than 220 suspected deaths and nearly 1,000 suspected cases; Uganda reports one death and nine cases across the border. No confirmed cures; emphasis on containment, surveillance, and diagnostic capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ患者5人の回復を称賛
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行感染性、管理可能性）。高リスク株による大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）Ituri州Buniaでのエボラアウトブレイク。ウガンダでの越境症例は確認されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生。Bundibugyo株で最大50%の致命率、利用可能なワクチンなし。過去のアウトブレイクより速く拡大（MSF報告）。疑い死亡220以上、疑い症例1000近くと規模が大きく、公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Reunión de emergencia de los países de África oriental por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency meeting of East African countries over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompts an emergency meeting of eight East African Community health ministers on Monday–Tuesday (June 1–2, 2026). The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri and adjacent areas, shows ongoing cross-border risk, with Uganda reporting transmission potential. A suspected imported case in Brazil concerns a 37-year-old Congolese-origin man hospitalized in São Paulo’s Hospital Emilio Ribas, after recent Congo travel and ICU care, currently in quarantine awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged heightened coordination among humanitarian and health actors and the DRC government during a visit to Ituri. An Ebola case outside Africa is also confirmed: a U.S. citizen infected while caring for patients in Congo, treated in Germany. Diagnostic capacity is hampered by the Bundibugyo strain’s limited testing availability, hindering early detection.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ東部諸国によるエボラ出血熱に関する緊急会議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の重篤な流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→ブラジル→米国→ドイツ）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi地域での流行が主軸であり、ウガンダ（対象国外）との国境越境リスク、ブラジルへの輸入疑い例を記載。米国・ドイツでの症例確認も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO事務局長による対応の必要性が示唆されており、国際的な関心は極めて高い。Bundibugyo株による検査困難が早期検出を阻害している点も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Agro Record - Semana de combate à brucelose bovina começa em Goiás
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agro Record - Week-long campaign against bovine brucellosis begins in Goiás.
article.articleSummary: Bovine brucellosis campaign begins in Goiás, Brazil, with a week-long initiative focusing on vaccination and disease-control actions to curb Brucella infections in cattle. The program targets state-wide herds in both dairy and beef sectors, emphasizing immunization and biosecurity measures to reduce transmission. Producers are reportedly in the pineapple harvest season, and the report notes that technology is increasingly aiding dairy routines in family farming. The piece does not include case counts, symptom reports, laboratory confirmation, or identified sources of infection, nor details on imported or exported cases. The campaign, published May 31, 2026, underscores vaccination campaigns as a key public-health measure to control bovine brucellosis in Goiás.

triage.headline_ja: アグロ・レコード - ゴイアス州での牛ブルセラ症対策キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは牛のブルセラ症対策キャンペーンの報道であり、実際の疾病発生やアウトブレイクではなく、予防的な公衆衛生施策の実施報告である。IHR基準やWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、国際的拡大リスクや人の健康への直接的な脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物疾患（獣医公衆衛生）の定期的な対策キャンペーンの実施報告であり、実際の患者数、症例報告、ラボ確認、感染源の特定がない。人への感染リスクや国際的な保健脅威の兆候を示さないため、CEPR EBS活動における感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente em SP com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil: A 37-year-old man hospitalized with suspected Ebola has been diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis, confirmed by a blood PCR test, according to the São Paulo State Health Department. As of 2026-05-30, Ebola suspicion remains under investigation, with the patient slated for further laboratory and genomic analyses. The case involves an imported patient who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country currently experiencing an Ebola outbreak. After arriving in Brazil with high fever, he was admitted to the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology in São Paulo and placed in isolation. Protocol requires suspected cases to be immediately reported to municipal epidemiological surveillance and to CVE-SP. The Emílio Ribas institute serves as the state's reference for suspected/confirmed cases; the Adolfo Lutz Institute conducts laboratory investigations and differential diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者がエボラ疑いでエボラ検査を受けるも髄膜炎で陽性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患（DRC発生）と髄膜炎菌髄膜炎の複合事例。患者はDRCから渡航した輸入症例であり、国際的拡大リスク、重症度、および渡航・貿易制限リスクを持つ。IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで感染後にブラジルへ渡航した輸入症例。エボラ疑いは未確定だが、DRCでのエボラ流行と関連。髄膜炎菌髄膜炎の確定診断と同時に、エボラの除外検査が進行中。両国とも対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に両国を記載。

article.articleHeadline: Gir Lion Infection: Situation 'Completely Under Control,' Says Minister
article.articleSummary: Viral infection detected among Asiatic lions in Gujarat’s Gir forests is reported as 'completely under control' by Forest Minister Arjunbhai Modhwadia. There have been no lion deaths from the infection in the last three days, attributed to swift, 24x7 monitoring and response measures. On-ground assessment saw Modhwadia reviewing operations at Jamwala Rescue Centre, Babariya Forest area, and Jasadhar Animal Care Centre and discussing containment with senior officials and veterinary teams. The response relies on continuous surveillance by special teams of forest personnel, veterinarians, and field staff to prevent lapses. Under Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel’s directive, the state government emphasizes protection and conservation of Gujarat’s Asiatic lion, commending frontline staff for their dedication and hard work in keeping the roars alive.

triage.headline_ja: ギル・ライオン感染症：大臣が「状況は完全にコントロール下にある」と発表
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（アジアライオン）の感染症で、人間への深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が報告されていない。既に管理下にあると当局が発表しており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は動物（アジアライオン）の感染症であり、人間への感染拡大リスクが報告されていない。当局による適切な監視・管理下にあると発表されている。IHRおよびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさず、国際的な感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Hantam Kongo dan Uganda, WHO: Penyakit karena Merawat Orang Tercinta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak strikes the Congo and Uganda, WHO: Disease caused by caring for a loved one.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, is ongoing. The virus spreads primarily through close contact, especially when caring for symptomatic relatives. WHO warns that transmission occurs within households unless strict precautions are followed, urging families not to touch patients. Case fatality rates from Ebola outbreaks typically range from 30% to 50%, but outcomes can improve with optimized intensive care and early diagnosis. A recent DRC patient recovered and was discharged after rapid treatment. Trials are advancing, with three candidate therapies prioritized for confirmed Ebola patients as WHO coordinates evaluation of new treatments and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴとウガンダを襲撃、WHO：愛する者の看病による感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と人-人感染能力を持つハイリスク病原体であり、複数国での同時発生はPHEIC相当の懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）でのエボラ発生が主題であり、ウガンダについては『隣国ウガンダ』との記載にとどまる。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていない。Bundibugyo株、30-50%の致死率、家庭内感染、療法候補の臨床試験進行中といった情報から、これは現在進行中の重篤な流行と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El brote de ébola deja ya 43 muertos y 263 casos...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The Ebola outbreak has claimed 43 lives and 263 cases...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province with spillover into Uganda, has reached 43 deaths and 263 laboratory-confirmed cases, as of May 31, 2026. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation region-wide. Ituri accounts for about 88% of confirmed cases, while Uganda has nine confirmed infections, including one death. The cross-border spread is attributed to ongoing conflict-driven population movement and overburdened health systems; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists for this outbreak strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is in Bunia to assess the situation, meeting with DRC health authorities led by Health Minister Roger Kamba, who has pledged a four-to-six month window to defeat or contain the outbreak. The crisis underscores regional transmission risks and the need for rapid public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ出血熱の流行により既に43人が死亡、263例が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻な感染症であり、国際的拡大リスク、死亡・重症事例の多発、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性、及び地域保健体制を超える管理課題を示している。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは9例の流入感染のみで、主な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）である。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO事務局長がブニアに派遣されるなど国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Шефът на СЗО приветства пет излекувани от ебола, докато в Източно Конго отваря нов център за лечение
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief welcomes five Ebola survivors as Eastern Congo opens a new treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola Virus Disease is unfolding in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered on Bunia in Ituri Province. Five patients have recovered; four to be discharged today and one yesterday, according to WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at the opening of a new treatment center in Bunia. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no approved treatment or vaccine; the recovery of a confirmed Bundibugyo patient is the first documented recovery in this outbreak. WHO data show 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. Across the border, Uganda reports nine cases and one death. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing response, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment of humanitarian workers, and steady access to medical supplies. Community engagement is essential to reduce attacks on health centers and encourage early care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ出血熱の5人の回復者を歓迎、東コンゴに新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での流行は国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも9例と1死亡が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC（Ituri州Bunia）の流行。Bundibugyo strain EVDは治療法・ワクチンが承認されていない。MSFは対応が流行に追いついていないと警告。検査拡大と人道的支援の迅速配置が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго и Уганде достигло 43
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola deaths in DR Congo and Uganda has reached 43.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda show 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, with about 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The World Health Organization declared the outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15. By May 24 Reuters reported about 900 possible cases in the DRC, and on May 25 WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited roughly 220 deaths in the DRC since the start of the outbreak. An infectious-disease specialist noted that early Ebola symptoms resemble flu and that the illness can be highly lethal. The article characterizes a highly worrying situation with outbreak response lagging behind rapid transmission; it provides no details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の確認死亡者数が43人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での同時多発集団発生で、WHO が PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。263確認例、43死亡、1,100疑似例の大規模流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダの両国での流行を述べているが、Bluedot API の「発生地域」フィールドに Uganda (226074) が含まれている一方、対象国リストには Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO の PHEIC 宣言（2026年5月15日）により国際的な懸念が極めて高い。シグナルレベルは最高度。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda o plano de contingência do Brasil contra o Ebola após duas suspeitas em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand Brazil's Ebola contingency plan after two suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Brazil activated the National Contingency Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers to guard against Ebola. On May 30, São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro investigated suspected cases; no Ebola cases have been recorded in Brazil. WHO reports an outbreak across ten African countries; by May 27 the DRC logged 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths among suspected, with 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths among confirmed. Brazil's plan strengthens surveillance of travelers from the DRC to identify suspected cases, isolate patients, and monitor contacts; suspected cases testing negative require a second blood sample 48 hours later. The plan, last updated in 2024, does not call for border closures; Brazil has no direct flights to affected regions. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment; three Brazilian Red Cross volunteers have died; risk in Brazil remains low. The outbreak occurs in a conflict zone with about 250,000 displaced.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのエボラ対策：サンパウロとリオデジャネイロでの2件の疑い例後の対応計画を理解する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国家アウトブレイク（アフリカ10カ国）、DRCで900件超の疑い例と223死亡、ブラジルでの疑い例報告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ（DRC中心）でのエボラアウトブレイク（10カ国で発生）とブラジルでの疑い例検査について報告。ブラジルでは確定例は記録されていないが、対応計画が発動されている。DRCでは確定例134、死亡18の深刻な状況。ブラジルのリスクは「低い」と評価されているが、検出体制が強化されている。紛争地帯での約25万人の避難民がいるため、状況は複雑。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 4 nouveaux malades guéris en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 4 newly recovered patients in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola virus disease patients recovered in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, all four being nurses including a woman at Centre Médical Évangélique (CME) in Bunia. Under Dr. Calvin Ambitapio, they received symptomatic care addressing malaria, antibiotics, and large-volume fluids (Ringer’s lactate and NaCl). Follow-up tests on May 26 and May 30 were negative, supporting recovery; authorities note there is no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine currently available, with outcomes achieved through symptomatic management. The four were presented to the WHO Director-General in Ituri on May 31. Dr. Jeanne Alasha urged residents to report suspected cases promptly and cooperate with health teams, emphasizing early identification and rapid care to curb transmission. A nearby patient at the Rwampara treatment center on Bunia’s southwest outskirts had also recently recovered under similar symptomatic therapy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：イトゥリで4人の新規患者が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最重要感染症であり、DRCでの確認事例は常にシグナル対象。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州ブニア市の医療施設での4人の看護師を含むエボラ患者の回復事例。WHO事務局長への報告など政治的関心も高い。マラリアとの併記があるが、記事の主題はエボラ。早期発見と迅速な対応の重要性が強調されており、対症療法による成功事例として注目される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the outbreak of a rare kind of Ebola as cases outpace response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola variant, is driving an outbreak in eastern Congo and neighboring Uganda. As of May 29, Congo reports 134 confirmed cases and 17 deaths; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern to spur action, though there are no approved medicines or vaccines for Bundibugyo. The outbreak is hampered by conflict in Ituri’s Bunia region, population distrust, and displacement, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu near M23 and ADF fronts. Bundibugyo was first identified in Uganda (2007–2008) and Congo (2012); this is the worst known Bundibugyo outbreak, with an estimated fatality rate around 30–50%. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated materials; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding. International aid groups are active, and WHO is evaluating candidate vaccines for trials.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラウイルスの発生について知るべきこと：症例数が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）の発生で死亡例あり、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、国際拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、治療法・ワクチンなし、推定致命率30-50%と深刻。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではBundibugyo ebola outbreakがコンゴ東部及びウガンダで発生と述べられているが、対象国はDRCのみ。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み、国際支援活動進行中、治療法・ワクチン未承認が重大懸念。

article.articleHeadline: World briefs | Brazil probes suspected Ebola case in São Paulo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, health authorities in São Paulo state, Brazil, are investigating a suspected Ebola case in the state capital. The patient is a man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo who presented with fever after recently visiting the DRC, which is experiencing an Ebola outbreak. He is in isolation at a hospital that specializes in suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. The report provides no laboratory confirmation and offers no further details on symptoms, exposure, or contacts. No additional cases or transmission information are disclosed. The item appears in a World Briefing roundup, with the Ebola case under ongoing investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドブリーフス | ブラジルのサンパウロで疑い例のエボラウイルス感染症を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。疑い例であるが、DRCの流行地からの輸入症例であり、確認症例では国際対応が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは疑い例（未確認）の報告であるが、DRCでのエボラ流行と関連する輸入症例であるため、確認待ちの段階でもシグナルとしてピックアップ対象。実験室診断確認が重要な次ステップ。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατροί Χωρίς Σύνορα: Η εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό είναι βαθιά ανησυχητική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is deeply concerning.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, Ebola virus disease (EVD) is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province in the east bearing the brunt. The DRC reports over 1,000 suspected EVD cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. Two weeks after the outbreak was declared, MSF Deputy Director Dr. Alan Gonzalez described the situation as extremely concerning, noting that cases have surged unusually quickly and hundreds of samples remain untested. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was visiting Ituri to oversee containment. Response efforts and humanitarian aid deliveries are delayed by significant obstacles, including border and airport closures, while ongoing conflict in the region further hampers outbreak control and timely laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラの拡大は極めて懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行でありシグナルとして確定的に認識。
triage.notes: DRC外でウガンダでの確認例もあるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行。MSFおよびWHOが関与し、国際的な関心と対応が高い。地域紛争による対応の阻害が追加的懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей из-за Эболы в Африке достигло 43
