article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Africa has reached 43.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 263 confirmed cases, 43 deaths, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30, per Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a public health emergency and a threat to other countries. This follows a Congo outbreak that ended in October 2025. In Ituri province, MSF deputy operations director Alan Gonzalez described the pace of spread as unprecedented, two weeks after the outbreak was publicly announced, with responders unable to keep up. The cross-border cluster raises international risk and underscores the need for intensified surveillance, rapid case investigation, and cross-border coordination to prevent exportation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ死亡者数が43人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例263例・死亡43例、疑い例1,100例以上、WHO公式宣言による公衆衛生上の緊急事態、国境を越えた感染拡大リスク、拡散の速度が前例のない水準。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州におけるエボラ発生を主題としている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダでの事例は言及されず、主にDRCでの状況と国境を越えたリスクについて述べられている。MSFによる現地報告、WHOによる公式宣言、Africa CDCディレクターのコメントなど、複数の国際機関による確認情報あり。緊急度が極めて高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: En Sao Paulo y Río de Janeiro: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: Brazil investigates two suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil trigger investigations in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo in Sao Paulo is in isolation at a specialized infectious disease institute after presenting fever and Ebola-like symptoms; tests have not confirmed the disease. In Rio de Janeiro, a man from Uganda with fever, chills, and diarrhea prompted security measures; the city reports malaria positivity and the case remains under investigation. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, with Africa CDC reporting over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; cases have also appeared in Uganda. The World Health Organization activated an international health alert. Sao Paulo authorities describe the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil and broader South America as very low at this time.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロとリオデジャネイロ：ブラジル、2件の疑い例のエボラウイルス病を調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC発生→ウガンダ→ブラジル への地理的拡大）、WHO国際保健警報の活性化、対象国（ブラジル）での疑い例検出により、IHR基準2つ以上該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）とUganda（GeoNames ID: 226074）のエボラ発生を背景情報として述べているが、本イベントの主体はブラジルでの2件の疑い例検出である。verified_locationsはブラジルのみを含める。DRCおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOが国際保健警報を活性化し、DRCでは1,000超の疑い例と246死亡が報告されており、重篤性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: Ο τροπικός ιός που μπορεί να "φέρει" στην Ευρώπη η κλιματική αλλαγή
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: The tropical virus that climate change could bring to Europe.
article.articleSummary: Climate-change-driven expansion of Aedes mosquitoes could enable chikungunya to reach Europe and North America. The chikungunya virus, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, currently circulates mainly in Central and South America, the Caribbean, Indian Ocean islands, Africa, and parts of South and Southeast Asia. A Zhejiang University study finds warming temperatures create favorable conditions for these vectors, with the Asian tiger mosquito accounting for the majority of projected spread because it tolerates cooler conditions better than Aedes aegypti. When suitable mosquitoes establish, local transmission of chikungunya becomes more likely. The virus rarely causes death but can trigger prolonged joint pain and disability. Since the year’s start, about 33,000 cases have been reported. Future risk zones include northern/central Europe, northeastern North America, and eastern Asia. Public-health measures include vector surveillance, healthcare worker training, and intensified vector control in temperate regions. Chikungunya derives from Kimakonde meaning 'to become deformed.'

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア：気候変動がヨーロッパにもたらす可能性のある熱帯ウイルス
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの地理的拡大リスク（ヨーロッパ、北米へ）と気候変動による媒介蚊の分布拡大が国際的に重要な懸念。年間33,000件以上の報告と持続的な影響（関節痛・障害）を伴う重度の公衆衛生課題。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチクングニアの全球的リスク評価が中心で、Zhejiang Universityの研究がトリガーとなっているが、実際の発生は浙江省および中国で報告されている。年間33,000件以上の報告は主にアメリカ大陸・アフリカ・アジア全域から。気候変動に伴う媒介蚊（ヤブカ）の温帯地域への拡大予測が国際的関心の焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Folkhälsomyndighet: 43 bekräftade dödsfall i ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health Agency: 43 confirmed deaths from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, 43 people have died from Ebola in Congo and Uganda, according to Jean Kaseya, director-general of the African Union’s Public Health Agency, cited by the Financial Times. In total, about 1,100 people are suspected to be infected, including 263 deaths among the suspected cases, per the health authority. The true burden is believed to be higher, as the outbreak involving the unusual Bundibugyo variant was detected belatedly. Ebola laboratory-confirmation capacity is severely limited in the affected areas, hindering rapid case confirmation and surveillance and complicating outbreak response across the cross-border regions of Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生機関：エボラ感染による確認死亡者43人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的多国間発生（DRC・ウガンダ）で、深刻な公衆衛生影響（43確認死亡、1,100疑い症例）、国境を越えた拡大、異常な Bundibugyo 亜種の検出、渡航・貿易制限リスクあり。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーに「Congo and Uganda」と明記されているが、対象国は DRC のみ該当。Bundibugyo 亜種は通常のザイール亜種よりも稀であり、異常性が高い。検査能力の深刻な制限により実際の感染規模は報告数を大幅に上回る可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемиологическая ситуация по холере в РФ остается стабильной, заявили в Роспотребнадзоре
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemiological situation regarding cholera in the Russian Federation remains stable, according to Rospotrebnadzor.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Russian Federation remains stable as of May 31, 2026, with no transmission on territory and no imported cases registered. Nigeria currently reports a cholera outbreak with 943 confirmed cases, 37 deaths, and over 1,700 suspected cases. Russia notes only isolated imported cases in recent years, for which full anti-epidemic measures are organized. The country maintains high readiness through the integrated Sanitary Shield system and enhanced border surveillance, including the AIS Perimeter quarantine control. Diagnosis uses a rapid test that detects Vibrio cholerae and assesses whether it poses an epidemic threat. Travelers to cholera-affected countries are advised to drink bottled water, avoid ice from untreated water, wash hands, use sanitizers, avoid questionable prepared vegetables/fruits and street foods, and ensure thorough cooking of meat and fish. In 2025, four Russian cases were reported, all originating in India; transmission can progress rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア連邦における結果は依然として安定していると、ロスポトレブナゾール（ロシア保健監督機関）が発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアにおいて943確定例、37死亡を含む活発なコレラ発症が報告されているが、対象国（インド）での現在の伝播状況が不明確。ロシアでは2025年にインドからの輸入症例4例のみ報告されており、国内伝播なし。追加情報待機が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはロシアの状況を主軸としており、ナイジェリアの発症は参考情報として含まれている。対象国リストではインドのみが該当。ロシアとナイジェリアは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。インドにおける現在の流行状況については記事内で2025年の4例輸入症例のみの記載であり、現在の伝播状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-főigazgató: öten felépültek az ebola ritka variánsával történt fertőzésből - továbbra is dolgoznak az oltóanyagokon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: five have recovered from infection with a rare Ebola variant — they are still working on vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Five people recovered from infection with the rare Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. At a ceremony opening a new treatment center in Ituri province’s capital, four patients were discharged today and a fifth yesterday. The director-general emphasized that vaccine and treatment development continues, but recovery from Ebola is possible. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no approved vaccine or therapy. The outbreak began in mid-May in northeastern DRC and has since crossed into Uganda. Africa CDC, the African Union’s health body, reported over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation and 246 deaths linked to the outbreak as of May 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：5人がエボラウイルスの稀な変異体からの感染から回復 — ワクチン開発は継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な変異体、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。DRCとウガンダでの進行中のエボラ発生は重要なシグナルとして認識すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事内で言及されているが、サマリーの主な焦点はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo変異体はワクチン・治療法が未承認であり、死亡数246人、疑い症例1,100以上の進行中の公衆衛生緊急事態。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Naděje uprostřed smrtící epidemie: Pět lidí se zotavilo z eboly, na kterou není lék
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope in the midst of a deadly epidemic: Five people have recovered from Ebola, for which there is no cure.
article.articleSummary: Five people have recovered as of May 31, 2026 from the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola currently spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where there is no cure or vaccine for this strain. Four will be discharged today and one yesterday, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In the DRC’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia, authorities report 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda has confirmed nine cases and one death. The African CDC declared the outbreak in Ituri on May 15, with spread into Uganda. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that transmission is outpacing response despite improved organization and aid, urging expanded testing, rapid deployment of humanitarian workers, and uninterrupted supplies. Health workers face rising risk amid community anger over safe-burial rules, which have triggered three attacks on facilities. Symptoms include fever, bleeding, vomiting, diarrhea, and muscle pain; Bundibugyo lacks vaccines or effective therapies. This outbreak recalls past epidemics, including the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak and the 2018–2020 DRC crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な流行の中での希望：5人がエボラから回復、治療法がない病気
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの有効な治療法・ワクチンがない新規アウトブレイク、DRCとウガンダでの多数の疑い例・死亡例、国境を越えた拡大により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは2026年5月15日にアフリカCDCが宣言。DRCのIturi州（Bunia中心）で906疑い例・223疑い死亡例、ウガンダで9確定例・1死亡例が報告されている。有効な治療法・ワクチンがなく、MSFは対応が伝播に追いつかないと警告。ウガンダはBluedot APIで発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーでは「neighboring Uganda has confirmed nine cases」と述べられており、主要発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 深观察｜埃博拉疫情蔓延 刚果（金）应对能力"极限承压"-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In-Depth Observation | Ebola outbreak spreading; Democratic Republic of the Congo's response capacity under extreme pressure - CRI Online
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in Ituri (Bunia) and extending into North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. More than 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 deaths have been reported; confirmed cases surged from 121 to 225 within two days. Cross-border spread has reached Uganda (9 infections, 1 death), with Uganda and Rwanda closing their borders with DRC. The United States has restricted entry for non-U.S. passport holders who recently visited the region. Experts warn of delayed testing and response, community violence over burial practices, and border/air restrictions hampering relief. Funding for outbreak control has fallen from roughly $498 million to $219 million, underscoring a strained global response, while WHO Director-General Tedros visited Bunia to assess progress.

triage.headline_ja: 深い観察｜エボラ疫情の蔓延 コンゴ民主共和国の対応能力が「極限の圧力」下に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予期しない大規模流行、国際的拡大・複数国への越境感染確認、渡航制限発令）。WHO公式のPHEIC宣言、1000件超の疑い患者と240名の死亡、確認患者の急増、複数国への越境感染があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: サマリーにおいてウガンダとルワンダへの越境感染が明記されているが、両国は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外した。対象国はDRCのみ。WHO PHEC宣言済み、複数国による渡航制限・国境閉鎖、資金不足による対応能力低下など、複合的な危機要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Internado com suspeita de ebola em São Paulo está com meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inpatient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo has meningitis
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis, the meningococcal meningitis bacterium, was detected in a 37-year-old man in São Paulo who is being investigated as a suspected Ebola case. The Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirmed the meningitis pathogen, while authorities say the Ebola investigation remains ongoing as of May 31, 2026, until definitive diagnostic results are available. The patient, recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo during a regional Ebola outbreak, presents with fever and other clinical-epidemiological criteria. He is hospitalized in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, São Paulo. Brazilian health authorities emphasize the overall very low risk of Ebola introduction, citing no endemic transmission in South America, no direct flights from affected areas, and Ebola's requirement for direct contact with infected body fluids. Clinicians are advised to remain alert for fever in travelers or contacts of suspected/confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ疑い患者が髄膜炎と確診
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜菌性髄膜炎とエボラ両方の可能性がある輸入感染症事例であり、IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、さらにWPRO基準で重症度・流行可能性が該当。DRCからの渡航歴があり管理可能性の判断も必要。
triage.notes: サマリーより、患者はDRCの地域的エボラ流行時期から渡航した輸入疑い患者。髄膜菌性髄膜炎は確認されたが、エボラ検査は継続中（5月31日時点）。隔離入院対応済み。ブラジル当局はエボラの南米への導入リスクは非常に低いと評価しているが、確定診断までは監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Current Ebola outbreak the largest ever - Earthnews365
article.articleSummary: More than 28,600 Ebola cases have been reported, making the current outbreak the largest on record. In May, over 1,000 suspected and confirmed cases occurred across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 134 confirmed cases (nine in Uganda) and about 240 deaths. The World Health Organization (WHO) has classified the regional spread as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and spreads through direct contact with the blood or body fluids of an infected person; implicated fluids include vomit, diarrhoea, urine, saliva, sweat, breast milk, and semen, and contaminated items may transmit infection. Healthcare-associated transmission and unsafe burial practices amplify spread. Kenya, with no confirmed cases, has been urged against hosting Ebola patients; Port Health Services at JKIA have reviewed screening, isolation facilities, laboratory readiness, and cross-border surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最大規模 - Earthnews365
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）の指定があり、また28,600件以上の症例報告と240件以上の死亡者が記録されている。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスクは極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、確認された発生地域はDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ケニアについては「確認症例なし」と明記されているため、検査対応国として記載されているが、実際の患者発生地ではないため除外。DRCのみを verified_locations に指定。本イベントはWHOによるPHEIC指定済みで、緊急度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief calls for reconsideration of travel bans as DR Congo battles Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (epicentre Bunia, eastern DRC) and Uganda as of May 31, 2026, driven by Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. DRC reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases and more than 220 suspected deaths; Uganda has confirmed nine cases, including new infections in Kampala. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, urged countries to reconsider travel bans and border closures, saying such measures hinder outbreak response, transparency and trust. Response efforts focus on direct engagement with affected communities; timely, quality medical care can lead to recovery. The outbreak’s geography centers on Bunia, with cross-border spread evidenced by Kampala infections, underscoring ongoing transmission and need for coordinated public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ大流行との闘いの中で渡航禁止の見直しを呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目中5項目該当。複数国での確認、死亡者発生、ヒト-ヒト感染確認、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（226074）が含まれており、記事サマリーにおいても「Uganda has confirmed nine cases, including new infections in Kampala」と明記されている。しかし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国であるため列挙。エボラウイルス疾患はPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）のトリガーイベントであり、920例以上の疑い症例、220例以上の死亡、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo）、複数国での確認、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など極めて高いリスク要因を複数保有している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Fünf Genesene in Ebolagebiet aus Klinik entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: Five Recovered Patients Discharged From Hospital in Ebola-Affected Region.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with four discharged on Sunday and one on Friday, per WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, where a new treatment center opened. The recoveries show that timely care can lead to survival amid an active outbreak. On Friday, WHO confirmed the first recovery from infection with the Bundibugyo strain, a rare lineage for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The Bundibugyo variant carries an estimated 25–50% mortality rate per CDC. Tedros pledged continued international support to Ebola-affected regions. The outbreak in eastern DRC emerged about two weeks ago and is hampered by ongoing fighting between militias and security forces, hindering containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ集団発生：エボラ影響地域の診療所から5人の回復患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株という治療法・ワクチンなしの希少株による初回回復例の報告であり、東部DRCでの進行中の集団発生は国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの稀な系統で、承認された治療法またはワクチンが存在しない。CDC推定致死率25-50%。東部DRCでの進行中の集団発生は約2週間前に出現し、民兵と治安部隊間の戦闘により対応が阻害されている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問とWHO公式確認により、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu i Ugandi potvrđena 263 slučaja infekcije virusom ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo and Uganda, 263 cases of Ebola virus infection confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, according to Africa CDC director Jean Kaseja. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, and 43 deaths have occurred among those infected with the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The figures were disclosed in an interview cited by Reuters via the Financial Times. Kaseja urged rapid activation of national incident management systems and sustained investments in pandemic preparedness. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and laboratory confirmation in both countries but provides no detail on infection sources, clinical symptoms, or travel/export specifics. The updating figures reflect the situation through May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルス感染263例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での確認、高い致命率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみ対象国。記事では両国での確認が報告されているが、検証可能な対象国はDRCのみ。エボラの稀な亜種（Bundibugyo株）で43人の死亡が確認され、重大な懸念事項。Africa CDCの公式声明に基づく情報。

article.articleHeadline: Belg met symptomen van ebola vloog van Oeganda naar Brazilië: in isolatie en opvolging door ziekenhuis Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belgian with symptoms of Ebola flew from Uganda to Brazil: in isolation and monitoring by a hospital in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-suspected case in Brazil involves a traveler from Uganda, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing, admitted yesterday afternoon to the Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas in Rio de Janeiro. The patient, reportedly Belgian, arrived from Uganda and displayed cough, chills, and diarrhea, triggering the safety protocol for specialized care and isolation until a definitive diagnosis is established. An Ebola test has been conducted, with results not yet available at the time of reporting. The case is being monitored by the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat (SES-RJ) and by Fiocruz, the Ebola reference center for Brazil’s Health Ministry. If confirmed, this would be the first Ebola case recorded in Rio de Janeiro. The patient was collected at home by a dedicated ambulance, with medical staff in protective clothing.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダからブラジルに飛来したエボラ症状のベルギー人：リオデジャネイロの病院で隔離・経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: Ebola疑い患者の国際移動（ウガンダ→ブラジル）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的感染拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、および公衆衛生への深刻な影響が高い。
triage.notes: Ebola疑い患者はウガンダからブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）に渡航。発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ(226074)が含まれるが、記事サマリーではブラジルが主題であり、実際のイベント発生地はブラジル。検査結果は未確定だが、確認されればリオデジャネイロ初の事例となる。複数の国家機関（SES-RJ、Fiocruz）が対応中で、感染管理体制は整備されている。ウガンダでの進行中の流行背景と患者の国際移動により国際的リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: CDC: 263 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα και 43 θάνατοι σε Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC: 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths attributed to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. African CDC officials call for immediate activation of national incident-management systems and sustained investment in pandemic preparedness. International partners are crucial but support is most effective when aligned with strategies developed by African institutions and governments. The World Health Organization has declared the Congo and Uganda outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), a designation noted by Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: CDC: コンゴとウガンダで263例のエボラ確定患者と43人の死亡者を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確定患者263例と43人の死亡という深刻な事象であり、複数国での発生、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOのPHEIC宣言等、IHR基準を複数満たす。直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も列挙されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国である。エボラウイルス（特にBundibugyo型）による283人の患者と43人の死亡、1,100人以上の疑い患者がいる状況は、IHR Annex2の全4基準とWPROの全5基準を満たす重大な事象。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: OMS advierte riesgos de cerrar fronteras en Congo ante brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the risks of closing borders in Congo amid an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO warns against border closures to contain the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, citing limited delay and potential hindrance to surveillance and humanitarian access. Several neighbors, including Uganda and Rwanda, have temporarily tightened border controls. As of May 31, 2026, there are more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and hundreds of deaths in Congo. No vaccine or approved specific treatment exists for this variant. Global risk remains low, but regional risk in sub-Saharan Africa is high. The crisis unfolds amid armed conflict and mass displacement, complicating containment. WHO calls for a strengthened health response: improve case finding and tracing, expand testing, and ensure safe access for responders, prioritizing evidence-based measures over travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱流行下でのコンゴ国境閉鎖のリスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生影響深刻：1,000名超の疑い例と数百人の死亡、異常・予想外：Bundibugyo ebolavirus、国際拡大リスク：ウガンダ・ルワンダでも確認、渡航・貿易制限：複数国で国境管理強化）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境管理強化の対応国として言及されているが、記事の主題イベント発生地はDRCであり対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイールエボラとは異なる株）の流行であり予想外。武装紛争と大量避難民が複合リスク要因。ワクチンなし、承認治療なし。地域リスク（サハラ以南アフリカ）は高いと明記。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS llegó al Congo y pidió más recursos para enfrentar un brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The director of the WHO arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and called for more resources to tackle an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast with Bunia as the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to press for more resources and intensified international support as the outbreak accelerates beyond initial containment. Official data from the WHO and local health authorities indicate rising cases and deaths, with true figures possibly higher due to access challenges in conflict zones. Containment relies on case isolation, contact tracing, and patient care, but is hampered by fighting in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The WHO even urged a temporary ceasefire to secure humanitarian corridors. While international aid is arriving, resources remain insufficient. The outbreak involves a Ebola strain for which there is no vaccine, raising the risk of regional spread and highlighting fragile health systems in one of Africa’s most volatile regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラ熱流行に対する資源増強を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行でWHO事務局長が現地入りするレベルの重大事象であり、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン未利用のエボラ株による流行、紛争地帯での感染制御困難、WHO事務局長の現地訪問による国際的な危機感の高さが確認される。地域蔓延と脆弱な保健システムがリスク要因として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: נגיפי האבולה וההאנטה מעוררים בהלה ולא פחות מכך - מבלבלים את החוקרים
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and hantaviruses are causing panic and, not least, perplexing researchers.
article.articleSummary: Two unusual outbreaks drive concern: Ebola Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Andes hantavirus on a Dutch luxury cruise ship in the Atlantic. WHO reports over 1,000 Ebola infections in DRC with 246 deaths, noting undercounting due to delays in detection. In the northern and eastern provinces near Uganda and Rwanda (North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri), nine infections and one death have been recorded in a specific area. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate; there is no vaccine or targeted therapy for this strain, while vaccines and antivirals exist for Zaire and Sudan strains. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Uganda and 2012 in Congo. The Andes hantavirus, usually rodent-borne and transmitted via saliva/urine, caused person-to-person spread aboard the ship: 13 passengers infected, 3 deaths. Incubation 2–21 days; diagnosis is hampered by early symptoms resembling malaria and limited field testing. Trials and potential vaccines are anticipated by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスがパニックを引き起こし、研究者を困惑させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株・伝播経路、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、1,000感染246死亡）およびオランダ豪華客船でのハンタウイルス集団発生（Andes株、13感染3死亡）を報告。Bundibugyo株は30-50%の致死率を持つ稀なエボラ株で、ワクチン・標的治療がない。ハンタウイルスの人-人感染伝播は異常。ウガンダ・ルワンダは隣接地域として言及されるが、サマリーの主要なイベント発生地はDRCのみ確認される。

article.articleHeadline: FT: В ДР Конго и Уганде от редкого штамма Эболы погибли 43 человека
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FT: In the DRC and Uganda, 43 people have died from a rare Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain is unfolding across the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths reported. The Bundibugyo strain is described as rare; there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for this variant. The affected region is under heavy pressure as borders are porous and population movement continues, with health systems operating at the limit. The report highlights the lack of a vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain and the challenging public health response as the outbreak persists in both countries. Details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or imported/exported cases were not provided.

triage.headline_ja: FT: コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで稀なエボラウイルス株により43人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀な株による異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会政治的関心が高い。稀なBundibugyo株、ワクチン/治療法の欠如、複数国への拡大が重要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの両国に言及しているが、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株は稀であり、ワクチン・特異的治療が利用不可という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。国境が多孔的で人口移動が継続しているため、国際的拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Потврђено 263 случаја еболе у ДР Конгу и Уганди
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 Ebola cases confirmed in DR Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: 263 Ebola cases confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of May 30, 2026, with 43 deaths from the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The World Health Organization has declared this outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. National incident-management systems should be rapidly activated and sustained investments in pandemic preparedness emphasized, with essential support from international partners aligned with African institutions. Frontline health and humanitarian workers report shortages of basic supplies, including masks, in affected areas. The report notes ongoing transmission and containment efforts; no infection source details or travel-related import/export cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ＤＲコンゴとウガンダでエボラ263症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全てに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確定的なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による稀な株の確認。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。1,100以上の疑似症例が調査中。保健従事者の物資不足が報告されている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 250 cas confirmés en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 250 confirmed cases in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has 263 confirmed cases as of May 30, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation and 43 deaths linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus was discovered about 50 years ago. Health authorities urge rapid activation of national incident-management systems and sustained investments in pandemic preparedness. International partners are essential but most effective when aligned with strategies of African institutions and governments. Frontline health workers report shortages of basic supplies, such as masks, complicating the response.

triage.headline_ja: RDCとウガンダで250例以上の確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また複数のWPRO基準にも該当し、国際的な支援が必要な大規模エボラ流行。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（Uganda）は提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事はDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ流行を報じているが、シグナルトリアージの対象国ベースの検証では対象国に該当する地域のみを列挙する。本イベントは43名の死亡、263の確認症例、1,100以上の疑い例を伴う深刻な流行であり、Bundibugyo株という稀な株による第17次DRC流行。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which recently declared a new Ebola outbreak, presented fever and symptoms consistent with Ebola and is in isolation at a specialized infectious-disease institute; laboratory tests have not confirmed Ebola. In Rio de Janeiro, health authorities reported a man from Uganda with viral symptoms such as cough, chills and diarrhea; the city said malaria was confirmed and the case remains under investigation. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, with over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, according to Africa CDC; Uganda has reported detections of the virus as well. The WHO activated an international health alert, while Sao Paulo's authorities say the risk of introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの疑い例2件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは高リスク病原体で、DRCでの流行中に国を超えての輸入例検出は国際的懸念事項。WHO国際保健警報発令済み。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでの2件の疑い例調査を主題としている。DRCとウガンダはエボラ/マラリアの背景情報として記載されているが、イベントの主要な発生地はブラジル。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、本記事の主題はブラジルでの輸入例調査である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。実験室確認されておらず推定段階だが、DRCでの流行中の国際的輸入例として高リスク。WHO国際保健警報発令がシグナル強度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola relief: WHO chief hails five recoveries as new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, eastern Congo, features Bundibugyo strain, a rare form with up to 50% fatality. WHO says more than 220 suspected deaths and global cases previously rising to 900. Five patients infected with Bundibugyo have recovered; four more to be discharged today and one released Friday. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new Ebola treatment centre in Bunia to bolster outbreak response. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. The article notes ongoing relief efforts amid the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The announcement underscores ongoing relief efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱救援：WHO事務局長が5人の回復を賞賛し、東部コンゴで新しい治療センターがオープン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株という致死率50%の希少株、220人以上の死亡疑い、国際的な症例発生の事実があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: DRC第17次エボラ流行。Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチンや治療法がない希少株で、致死率は最大50%。WHO事務局長の治療センター開設宣言と回復事例報告は国際的な関心を示唆しており、世界的症例拡大の歴史がある。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Bangka Tengah optimalkan pencegahan DBD melalui skrining kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Bangka Regency optimizes dengue prevention through health screening
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention in Central Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands Province, is being intensified through health screening and community education. The Central Bangka Health Office, led by Zaitun in Koba, says government-mandated screening helps detect dengue cases earlier, enabling early treatment and more accurate data. In 2025, five dengue cases were recorded in Central Bangka, up from three the previous year, attributed in part to improved detection and surveillance. Prevention efforts emphasize the 3M vector-control campaign—drain, close, and recycle items likely to become Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Public outreach via puskesmas and health cadres focuses on environmental cleanliness, especially during the rainy season when mosquito populations rise. Residents are urged to seek medical evaluation if dengue-like symptoms appear; community involvement is essential to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ中部県がデング熱予防を健康スクリーニングで最適化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのバンカ中部県におけるデング熱の予防強化に関する記事。2025年の報告症例数は5件（前年3件）と限定的であり、異常な流行状況ではなく、既知疾患の定期的な対応である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、社会的関心も一般的な公衆衛生活動に限定される。
triage.notes: 記事は予防活動および既知疾患の管理実績に関する定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、シグナルレベルのリスクはない。デング熱はインドネシアで風土病であり、年間数件の検出は異常ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DGS revê orientações para dar resposta a suspeitas de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DGS reviews guidelines to respond to suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Portugal’s Directorate-General of Health (DGS) updated guidelines for suspected Ebola or Marburg hemorrhagic fever, naming reference centers in Lisbon and Porto. Lisbon: Curry Cabral (adults) and Dona Estefânia (pediatric emergencies); Porto: São João (adults and children). The update follows WHO and ECDC guidance to strengthen early detection and management of imported cases; the ECDC report of May 29 notes the risk to Europe is very low. Context notes filoviruses with major Ebola outbreaks in West Africa (2014–2015) and DRC (2018–2020), plus Marburg in Rwanda (2024); as of May 16, 2026 a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was declared in DRC and Uganda. Ebola incubation ranges 2–21 days (median 3–10); early symptoms are fever, headache, myalgias, asthenia; around day 4 progress to gastrointestinal/wet phase with abdominal pain, vomiting, and profuse diarrhea (up to 10 L/day) causing dehydration and electrolyte imbalance. Suspected cases require fever >38 C plus GI symptoms and exposure; Infectious Diseases teams coordinate with INEM for reception and transfer.

triage.headline_ja: DGSがエボラ疑い例への対応ガイドラインを改定
triage.triage_reason: ポルトガルと対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）で同時にBundibugyo Ebolaが報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。欧州での検査体制強化と新規アウトブレイク宣言により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはポルトガル・アンゴラ・ルワンダ・ウガンダが含まれるが、サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダで報告されたBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク宣言（2026年5月16日）とポルトガルの対応準備。ポルトガル・アンゴラ・ルワンダ・ウガンダは対象国リストに該当しないため除外。Myanmar (1327865)はGeoNamesで対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーにて言及なし。DRCのみが確実に該当する対象国。再検証：ウガンダ記載あり（Bundibugyo Ebolaが2026年5月16日にDRC and Uganda で宣言）。対象国リスト確認：ウガンダID不明のため、確実な対象国はDRC（203312）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: 確診病例激增 專家警告與食用野味有關 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in confirmed cases; experts warn it is linked to eating wild game - Sing Tao Daily
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to worsen, with 225 confirmed cases—nearly doubling in two days in Ituri Province’s Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia on May 30, stressing safe burials and community trust as critical to containment. The U.S. CDC notes Ebola is not usually foodborne, but in Africa cases are linked to hunting, slaughtering, and handling meat from infected animals, with spillovers often starting from fruit bats. Bushmeat remains culturally ingrained; Congo Basin harvest is estimated at 4.5 million tons annually, and wild meat is sold across Kinshasa’s Masina Market, where snakes and large rodents fetch about $17/kg. Ugandan virologist Dr. Wayengera warns many communities do not connect bushmeat risk, while Kalema-Zikusoka urges sustained public-health education. Africa CDC’s Dr. Nienstzwa advocates One Health to address human–animal–environment interfaces.

triage.headline_ja: 確診病例激増 專家警告與食用野味有關
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な患者増加（2日で倍増）が報告され、DRCで確認症例225例。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性、国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で懸念あり。
triage.notes: DRCのイツリ州ブニアを中心とした急速な流行拡大。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、ウガンダからの医学的警告等により国際的関心も高い。野生動物接触による人獣共通感染症リスクが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Τι συμβαίνει με τον Έμπολα: Η πραγματική εικόνα πίσω από την επιδημία στην Αφρική - Τι λένε ΕΟΔΥ και Θάνος Πλεύρης
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What’s happening with Ebola: The real picture behind the epidemic in Africa - What EODY and Thanos Plevris say
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows alarming transmission indicators. By May 24 (data through May 23), Congo reports more than 904 suspected Ebola cases, including 119 suspected deaths; 101 confirmed cases and 10 confirmed deaths. Over 1,745 contacts have been identified, with only about 20% being monitored. Bunia Airport has been closed. On May 22, media reports describe two tents in a hospital ward housing Ebola patients set on fire by residents, underscoring security and public fear challenges amid the outbreak. The article notes commentary from Greek authorities (EODY) and Minister Thanos Plevris regarding public health responses, including broader surveillance and migrant health considerations. The piece centers on Congo’s outbreak metrics, contact-tracing gaps, and the contentious on-the-ground environment during this Ebola situation. Keywords: outbreak, Ebola, Democratic Republic of Congo, Bunia, contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱で何が起きているのか：アフリカの流行の背後にある真の姿 - EODY（ギリシャ疫学当局）とサノス・プレブリス保健相の見解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ熱アウトブレイクは、904件の疑似患者、119人の死亡、接触者追跡率の低さ（20%）、空港閉鎖、社会的混乱を示し、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク、予想外の重症度が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGreeceが含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ熱アウトブレイクが主題であり、ギリシャ当局（EODY）の見解報道に過ぎないため、verified_locationsから除外。コンゴ民主共和国のみが実際の患者発生地。接触者追跡率20%、空港閉鎖、医療施設での火災事件などが管理能力の低さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 強化防疫 甘迺迪機場也啟動篩查 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enhanced Epidemic Prevention: Kennedy Airport Also Launches Screening.
article.articleSummary: To address the Ebola outbreak, the U.S. CDC expanded entry screening to New York's JFK, joining Dulles, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, and George Bush Intercontinental as designated entry points with layered measures: outbound screening, airline disease reporting, and post-entry surveillance. Travelers who in the past 21 days visited Congo, South Sudan, or Uganda are directed to a designated area for health questioning, temperature checks, symptom assessment, and exposure-risk surveys, with medical evaluation if indicated. Non-U.S. citizens and permanent residents who recently traveled to affected areas are temporarily barred from entering the United States. Separately, Africa faces backlash to a U.S. plan to build a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at Lokichoggio Air Base in Kenya; the Kenyan High Court paused construction on May 29, with a June 2 hearing. Kenyan doctors’ and lawyers’ groups condemn it as a public-health risk and lack of public participation; Kenya reports no Ebola cases to date.

triage.headline_ja: 強化防疫 甘迺迪機場也啟動篩查 - 星島日報
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数国での感染確認に対応した入国スクリーニング強化という異常事態。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的な渡航制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月31日付けで未来予測シナリオの可能性が高いが、エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大シナリオとして評価。記事サマリーでは Congo, South Sudan, Uganda が影響地域として言及されているが、対象国リストでは DRC（203312）のみが該当。Kenya は施設建設計画についての記載であり、確認された感染事例ではない（記事内で「Kenya reports no Ebola cases to date」と明記）。Sudan は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo a Uganda hlásí 263 potvrzených případů eboly a 43 úmrtí, uvádí Africké centrum pro kontrolu a prevenci nemocí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo and Uganda report 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths, according to the Africa Centre for Disease Control and Prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda reported 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths, according to Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, with fatalities attributed to the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The figures, cited by Reuters, reflect ongoing case verification by national health authorities across the two neighboring countries. The report provides limited detail on geographic distribution, exposure sources, or specific public health responses, and it does not indicate any imported or exported cases. This update highlights ongoing monitoring of Ebola activity across the two nations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダがエボラ出血熱の確定患者263例と死亡43例を報告、アフリカ疾病対策予防センターによると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目が該当。エボラ出血熱という致死性の高い感染症であり、複数国での広がり、高い死亡率、および国際的な拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダを言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれる。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は指定対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。エボラ出血熱の確定患者263例、死亡43例は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、1,100以上の疑い患者調査中の状況は継続的な監視が必要。Bundibugyo株は稀な変異株であり注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo i Uganda potvrdili 263 slučaja rijetkog oblika ebole, preminule 43 osobe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo and Uganda confirmed 263 cases of a rare form of Ebola, 43 people have died.
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths, as of May 30. Over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is responsible, and there are no vaccines or specific treatments. Uganda closed its border with Congo after rising cases and cross-border transmission; the decision was by a local Ebola response team led by Vice President Jesca Alupo, after Ugandan health workers were exposed to patients from Congo who crossed the border before the outbreak was declared on May 15. The US CDC imposed 30-day entry restrictions for travelers who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, with checks on travelers including green-card holders. The WHO says the situation remains critical, with Dr. Anne Ancia noting, 'we are behind, not under control,' though officials expect the response to succeed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダが珍しいエボラ出血熱263例を確認、43人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（国境閉鎖、CDC制限措置）、渡航制限が実行されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダン、米国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の確認事例」である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。スーダンは記事では言及されているが主題ではなく対象国外のため除外。米国は対応国として言及されているが発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは極めて致死率が高く、ワクチンなし、国境閉鎖、米国CDCによる渡航制限が実施されており、WHO評価が「制御下にない」とされているため緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia-Bundibugyo : quatre nouveaux guéris quittent le centre de traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia-Bundibugyo: four new recoveries leave the treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola patients have recovered and left the Ebola Treatment Center at the CME hospital in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with official certificates confirming no Ebola virus in their blood. The event occurred during a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who attended the ceremony alongside health authorities and partners. The outbreak's case fatality rate exceeds 20%. In some Ituri communities, mistrust of Ebola treatment centers remains a major barrier to response, with families hiding patients and suspected cases going unreported. Health workers stress that earlier treatment increases survival chances. Ebola survivors are asked to help with community outreach, lending credibility to messages that are more powerful when delivered by recovered patients. The developments reflect ongoing Bunia-Bundibugyo efforts to control Ebola and engage affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア・ブンディブギョ：4人の新しい回復者が治療センターを退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイク対応を示すポジティブなニュースであり、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行傾向）に該当するが、新規症例報告や急速な拡大を示唆していないため、WATCH段階で継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC内のイトゥリ地域（ブニア・ブンディブギョ）でのエボラアウトブレイク対応を扱っている。ウガンダはGeoNamesデータに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC内での発生を記述しており、ウガンダでの実際の症例報告はない。WHO事務局長の訪問、20%を超える致命率、コミュニティの不信が対応の課題として述べられており、アウトブレイク管理に高い関心がある。ただし新規症例の急増報告ではなく、回復者の陽性を示すニュースのため、IHR基準では2つ以上に該当していない。WPROスクリーニング基準では複数該当し、管理可能性への懸念も示されているため、WATCH段階での継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Virus mortales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Viruses.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory viruses—influenza, COVID-19, and RSV—are increasing in our country. Globally, about 200 of millions of viruses pose meaningful human health risks. Vaccines have eradicated poliovirus, a fecal-oral virus that caused paralysis. The last major epidemics were in the 1980s; vaccination campaigns have halted cases for three decades. Measles remains controlled domestically with no cases in over ten years, though sporadic imported cases occur in the United States and elsewhere among the unvaccinated. Vector-borne viruses—dengue, chikungunya, and Zika—remain a risk. Dengue incidence has declined in the past two years with no deaths; hepatitis and rabies in humans have not been reported. Norovirus concerns persist internationally but are not lethal. Hantavirus can be fatal; Argentina reports about 200 annual hantavirus cases with high lethality. Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda pose risk; traveler monitoring is unclear; 10 million visitors require vigilance. Most viruses have vaccines. Do not panic; learn from COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症が言及されているが、記事は概説・意見記事であり、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行状況の詳細が不足している。Ebola(Congo、Uganda)、Hantavirus(Argentina)に関する言及があるが、現在の活動状況や規模が不明確。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン語の意見記事で、複数のウイルスに関する一般的な情報提供。Ebolasはコンゴとウガンダで言及されているがDRCのみが対象国。Hantavirus(Argentina)、Dengue/Chikungunya/Zika(ベクター媒介)、COVID-19、麻疹、ポリオなどが列挙されているが、現在の具体的な流行や患者数、死亡数については明記されていない。記事サマリーから判断すると、これは「ウイルス脅威の教育的概説」であり、特定の新規アウトブレイク情報ではない。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: claves de una crisis sanitaria que aún puede estar en "la punta del iceberg" - NotiCel - La verdad como es - Noticias de Puerto Rico - NOTICEL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Keys to a Health Crisis That May Still Be at the Tip of the Iceberg.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, a less-known Orthoebolavirus, is driving the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 200 deaths among around 900 reported cases, and additional cases in Uganda. The outbreak, confirmed in Ituri Province on May 15, marks the longest gap since Bundibugyo’s last major appearance in RDC 14 years ago. Detection is delayed because rapid tests target the Zaire strain, and malaria-like symptoms obscure early signs. The WHO has declared a public health emergency to mobilize resources for research and control. Bundibugyo lacks approved vaccines or specific treatments; two vaccines exist for Zaire, while Zabdeno/Mvabea were withdrawn; two Bundibugyo vaccine candidates are in early animal studies, with first human trials possible in 6–9 months. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animal reservoirs and close human contact, with displacement and conflict in Ituri, mining, and deforestation driving spread. Regional risk is high, global risk considered low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：まだ「氷山の一角」である可能性のある保健危機の鍵
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる現在の流行は、DRCおよびウガンダで公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療法の不足による管理難が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province）がブンディブギョエボラの主流行地として詳述されている。ウガンダについても追加症例言及があるが、サマリーの主題はDRCの流行であり、検証可能な情報はDRCのみに限定。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO公開衛生緊急事態宣言、ワクチン候補品の開発状況、地域リスク（高）が文書化されており、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Új információkat közöltek a világot rettegésben tartó járványról
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New information released about the epidemic that is terrifying the world.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Central Africa continues to worsen, affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 30, 2026, officials report 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths, a case-fatality rate of about 16% among confirmed cases. Authorities warn the true burden is likely far higher, with more than 1,100 suspected infections under investigation in the two countries. The surge strains already fragile health infrastructures, and the large number of unresolved cases complicates real-time monitoring and understanding of transmission. International health bodies express growing concern over the spread of the virus. The situation underscores critical gaps in testing and surveillance, hampering precise outbreak tracking amid ongoing transmission and rising mortality in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: 世界を恐怖に陥れているパンデミックについて新しい情報が発表された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者263人、死亡43人、推定疑い患者1,100人以上が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、そして渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでUganda（ウガンダ）も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。中央アフリカ地域での多国間の流行状況だが、対象国に該当する確認地点は DRC のみ。エボラ出血熱の致命率約16%、疑い患者を含むと1,100人以上という大規模な懸念事象であり、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo e Uganda registram 263 casos de Ebola e 43 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo and Uganda report 263 Ebola cases and 43 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. This is the 17th outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus’s discovery roughly five decades ago. Health authorities report the response is hampered by shortages of basic supplies, including masks, with the spread having progressed unnoticed for weeks. Jean Kaseya, director-general of Africa CDC, urges rapid activation of national incident-response systems and permanent investment in pandemic preparedness. International partners are essential, but success hinges on alignment with African institutions and governments, as the outbreak strains response capacities and highlights ongoing preparedness gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダが263件のエボラ確認症例と43人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者263名、死亡43名という深刻な状況。IHR基準は4つ中4つすべてに該当し、国際的に極めて懸念される状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地として記述されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、DRC17回目、過去50年で3番目に大規模な流行。1,100人以上の疑い患者が調査中。医療物資の不足、数週間の探知遅れが懸念される。Africa CDC事務局長による国際的対応の必要性強調あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Kenya moves ahead with US quarantine facility for Americans exposed to the virus, despite restrictions | Today News
article.articleSummary: Kenya advances a US-backed Ebola quarantine and treatment facility at Laikipia Air Base, about 125 miles north of Nairobi, to serve Americans potentially exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, despite a Kenyan High Court injunction. Judge Patricia Nyaundi barred Nairobi from establishing Ebola facilities under US or foreign agreements and from admitting exposed or infected individuals until the case is resolved; the hearing is set for June 2. The facility, a joint effort by the US State, Defense, and Health and Human Services departments, would provide full-spectrum Ebola care, including intensive or critical care, and aims to bolster surveillance, diagnostics, emergency preparedness, supplies, and rapid response capabilities. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; Uganda reports one death and at least seven confirmed cases. Kenya has not reported any Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行：ケニアが制限にもかかわらずアメリカ人向けの隔離施設整備を進める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、ウガンダでの確定症例と死亡報告、DRCでの発症地域、地域的な施設整備と国際対応が進行中であることから、フルRRA対象のシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。しかし、DRCでのエボラ発症地が主要な感染源であり、東アフリカ地域全体での感染拡大リスクが高い。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法がなく、ウガンダで既に1死亡・7確定症例が報告されている点が重要。ケニアの高等裁判所の差し止め命令により政治的複雑性がある。

article.articleHeadline: ТЕДРОС: Пет пациенти од источно Конго ја преживеаја еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TEDROS: Five patients from eastern Congo survived Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Five patients recovered from the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in eastern Congo, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, Ituri province’s capital. Four patients are to be discharged today; one had been released two days earlier, underscoring progress despite no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. As of 31 May 2026, the outbreak totals 906 Ebola cases and 223 deaths, according to WHO. Uganda reports nine cases and one death. Doctors Without Borders warns the virus is spreading faster than containment measures, urging expanded testing, faster humanitarian deployment, and sustained access to medical supplies. Attacks by the Allied Democratic Forces, allied with Islamic State, disrupted response, with hostilities in Ituri; in North and South Kivu, where M23 controls key towns. A new Ebola treatment center opened in Bunia, highlighting community engagement as key to control.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長：東コンゴの患者5人がエボラを生き残った
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の集団発生で、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に該当。国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告（9例、死亡1例）も記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCの発生状況。2026年5月31日時点で906例、223死亡。Bundibugyo株で承認医療がない状況。武装勢力の妨害により対応が困難。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente em SP com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, remains under investigation as of May 30, 2026. A 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing, arrived in Brazil with high fever and was hospitalized at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology in São Paulo. He is in isolation while authorities perform laboratory and genomic analyses to confirm infection. If confirmed, this would be an imported case linked to travel from an outbreak country; however, no laboratory confirmation has been reported yet. In São Paulo, suspected cases must be immediately reported to municipal epidemiological surveillance and to the Center for Epidemiological Surveillance (CVE-SP). The article’s title mentions meningitis, but the body indicates Ebola suspicion under investigation, with no confirmed diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者がエボラ疑い症状でテスト、髄膜炎で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生中における海外渡航歴のある患者の疑い例であり、IHR/WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当する可能性があるが、確定診断が得られていないため、続報による確定情報の待機が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ疑い症例とされているが、見出しでは髄膜炎陽性と報告されており、最終確定診断が不一致。DRC発生地域からの渡航歴が明確であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当する。ただし確定診断の欠落により、確認後のピックアップが適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente isolado por suspeita de ebola tem malária confirmada, diz Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in isolation for suspected Ebola has confirmed malaria, says Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Malaria diagnosed in a patient arriving from Uganda, initially isolated in Rio de Janeiro for suspected Ebola Virus Disease. The patient landed in Brazil on May 22 and was admitted to INI/Fiocruz on May 30 after coughing, chills, and diarrhea; no fever or headache reported. Fiocruz preliminary tests showed Ebola negative in saliva and urine; a blood test is still processing. A malaria diagnosis was subsequently confirmed. Brazil’s Ebola transmission risk remains low, as the virus transmits by direct contact with fluids from symptomatic individuals, not by air. The patient continues hospitalized and isolated per national protocol while specialized care and diagnostic testing proceed. Authorities note Uganda has regions with confirmed Ebola cases and coordinated the response with the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat (SES-RJ) and the Strategic Information Center for Health Surveillance (Cievs).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染疑いで隔離された患者がマラリアと確定診断、フィオクルス研究所が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い患者の報告であり異常・予想外だが、エボラウイルスは陰性で実際の感染事例ではない。マラリア確定診断のみで、国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報確認待機が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダから到着し、ブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）で隔離された。エボラウイルスの初期検査は唾液・尿で陰性。確定診断はマラリア。ウガンダはエボラウイルスの流行地域だが、本患者のエボラ感染は除外されているため、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」は認めない。発生地域にウガンダ（Uganda, 226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは実際のイベントはブラジルで発生しており、ウガンダは患者の出国地であるため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو وأوغندا.. 263 إصابة مؤكدة و43 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in Congo and Uganda.. 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths from the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. Health authorities report more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as the outbreak continues to expand, marking the seventh outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery. Respondents warn of severe shortages of basic supplies, including protective masks, and note that the virus has circulated for weeks before detection. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), underscoring the need for accelerated national emergency measures and strengthened international collaboration aligned with government and African institutions’ plans. Authorities emphasize the role of international partners when their support aligns with local strategies to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴとウガンダで拡大..263人の確認症例と43人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症は極めて重篤で国際的拡大リスク高く、WHO-PHEIC宣言済み。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国外のため除外。WHO-PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による第7次アウトブレイク、1100件以上の疑似症例、物資不足が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Analizan un posible caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They are analyzing a possible case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case under investigation in the Brazilian state of São Paulo after a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo presented fever among compatible symptoms and is hospitalized in isolation at the Emilio Ribas Institute of Infectology. Lab test results are pending. The investigation, activated under infectious disease protocols, includes patient isolation, immediate notification to health authorities, laboratory studies, and epidemiological monitoring. Regiane de Paula, São Paulo’s Disease Control coordinator, said measures aim to confirm or rule out Ebola and prevent transmission. Brazilian authorities stressed that the risk of importing Ebola remains very low due to the absence of local transmission and no direct flights between Brazil and the affected African regions. Hospitals and health centers were advised to reinforce surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の可能性のある症例を分析中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い症例が報告され、DRCからの帰国者で症状があり入院中。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的リスク）、また高リスク病原体の確定待ちのため、確認と対応が急務。
triage.notes: DRC由来の高リスク病原体であり、国境を越えた接触歴がある。検査結果待機中の段階だが、確定前であっても高リスク疾患のため即時対応が必要。ブラジルは検査・隔離・監視体制を整備済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak draws attention to longstanding virus spillover risks in western Uganda
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus is unfolding across western Uganda near the DRC border, with seven Ugandan cases reported as of May 25 and suspected cases in the DRC approaching 1,000. The initial cluster emerged in Ituri province, DRC, in early May, with cross-border movement hindering containment. Bats are considered the most likely reservoir; human exposure occurs through hunting and consumption in border communities. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is a distinct filovirus first identified in 2007–2008 in Uganda’s Bundibugyo district and is genetically different from Zaire and Sudan ebolaviruses (about 32% divergence). Most Ebola vaccines and monoclonal antibodies target Zaire/Sudan strains and may not be protective against Bundibugroyo. Diagnostics can identify Bundibugyo rapidly once samples reach labs (often within four hours). Africa CDC warns 10 other African countries at risk: Angola, Burundi, CAR, Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Zambia. WHO has moved away from place-based naming to avoid stigmatization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行がウガンダ西部の長年の病原体流出リスクに注目を集めている
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの流行がウガンダとDRC国境地域で進行中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的拡大の高リスク、複数国への警告、既知のワクチン/抗体が効かない可能性がある新種系統であるため、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主としてウガンダとDRCでの流行を記述。Africa CDCが警告した10カ国（Angola、Burundi、CAR、Congo、Ethiopia、Kenya、Rwanda、South Sudan、Tanzania、Zambia）のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはZambiaのみ。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスは既存ワクチン・モノクローナル抗体との保護効果が不明であることが重大なリスク要因。DRC国境地域での継続的なヒト-ヒト感染と越境移動が管理困難。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief hails Ebola recoveries as new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) sees five recoveries to date. Four are set for discharge; one returned home Friday, marking the first documented recovery of a confirmed Bundibugyo patient in the current outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros opened a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment and can kill up to 50% of those infected. Doctors Without Borders warns the outbreak is spreading faster than any prior Bundibugyo outbreak and is difficult to diagnose due to limited testing capacity. Latest official figures report more than 220 suspected deaths and nearly 1,000 suspected cases. Uganda, sharing a long border with DRC, has reported one death and nine cases, illustrating cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの事務局長がエボラ出血熱の回復者を称賛し、コンゴ東部に新しい治療センターがオープン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による高死亡率（50%）の急速な流行拡大と国境を越えた伝播が確認されており、フルRRA対象のシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak（バンディブギョ株）。1,000例近い疑い患者、220例以上の疑い死亡、5例の回復例を報告。死亡率50%、ワクチンなし。ウガンダへの国境越え伝播（1死亡、9症例）を確認。診断検査能力が限定的で、過去のBundibugyo流行より急速な拡大速度が報告されている。WHO事務局長が治療センター開設を現地で直接対応。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola en Sao Paulo y Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected cases of Ebola in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil—one in São Paulo and another in Rio de Janeiro—are under precautionary isolation, with tests not confirming the disease for the São Paulo case and the Rio de Janeiro case reported as malaria positive and still under investigation. A separate case involves a man from Uganda presenting viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) prompting health security measures in Rio. The World Health Organization immediately activated an international health alert. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, a new Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 has reached 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases, with detections also reported in neighboring Uganda. Officials say the risk of Ebola entering Brazil and South America remains very low. The report underscores ongoing cross-border surveillance amid a major African outbreak, but no confirmed Ebola diagnosis has emerged in Brazil so far.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロとリオデジャネイロでエボラ感染の疑い例2件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的な広がりリスクと異常性が存在するが、ブラジルでの確定例がなく、情報が限定的。DRCでの大規模発生に関連する国際的な監視体制の重要性は認識されるが、現段階では確定情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: ブラジルでの2件の疑い例はいずれも確定診断されておらず（サンパウロは陰性、リオは検査中でマラリア陽性の報告）、ウガンダ発症例も単一の接触者。DRC発生地のエボラアウトブレイク（5月15日宣言、死者246名、疑い例1000以上）が国際的な懸念の主因。WHOが国際衛生アラートを発動した点で社会的関心は高い。ブラジル・南米へのリスク低と評価されているため、フルRRAに進む前に追加検査結果などの続報を注視すべき段階。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente monitorado por suspeita de ebola no Rio testa positivo para malária, e segue internado sob observação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient monitored for suspected Ebola in Rio de Janeiro tests positive for malaria, and remains hospitalized under observation.
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in a Belgian traveler who arrived in Rio de Janeiro from Uganda; he remains hospitalized under observation at Fiocruz's National Institute of Infectology. The result was confirmed onMay 30, while the investigation into suspected Ebola and other viral hemorrhagic fevers continues. The patient did not meet all criteria for a suspected Ebola case, but, given international epidemiological context, authorities initiated a precautionary evaluation for possible viral hemorrhagic fever. The Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), in coordination with the State Health Secretariat and Fiocruz, continues monitoring to complete all necessary tests. Contacts with the patient are under preventive surveillance while diagnostic work proceeds, highlighting ongoing surveillance and preparedness measures.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでエボラ疑い患者が検査を受けた後、マラリア陽性と判定され、入院観察中
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの旅行者がリオデジャネイロでマラリア陽性確認。エボラ疑いで初期検査されたが確定診断には至らず、マラリア確認のみ。重症度・国際拡大リスク・対象国での実発生が限定的のため、現段階ではWATCHとして経過観察を継続すべき。
triage.notes: ベルギー国籍の旅行者がウガンダから入国した事例。記事の主題はリオデジャネイロでのマラリア確定診断。初期段階ではエボラ疑い患者として監視されたが、マラリア確定、エボラ除外。症例数が単一で、重症度についての詳細記載なし（入院観察中のため不明と判定）。対象国リスト内ではBrazilのみ実発生確認。Belgiumはリスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ebola : le directeur de l'OMS inaugure un centre de traitement à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC-Ebola: WHO Director-General inaugurates a treatment center in Bunia
article.articleSummary: DR Congo – Ebola: WHO Director-General Tedros inaugurates a new Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid a rare outbreak where the virus is spreading faster than the response. The center, equipped for intensive care, has a capacity of 100 beds, with 45 currently available, to treat Ebola patients in Bunia and surrounding areas. The Congolese government will deploy medical staff, including intensive-care specialists from Kinshasa, together with a local partner team. Tedros stressed community engagement as essential to ending the outbreak, noting the facility is ready to admit both suspected and confirmed cases. Four patients had recovered and were to be discharged that day. WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in DRC; neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain currently has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ：WHO事務局長がブニアに治療センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの明確な流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、および治療法・ワクチンなし。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行を主題とする。ウガンダについて言及されているが、サマリーの主要焦点はDRCであり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株は承認された治療法・ワクチンなしという極めて深刻な状況。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と新治療センター開設は対応が緊急段階であることを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola em SP testa positivo para meningite - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleSummary: In São Paulo, Brazil, a 37-year-old man hospitalized with suspected Ebola tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR. Despite this result, Ebola investigation continues; he will undergo laboratory and genomic analyses to clarify the case. He recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing, and developed fever on return. He is admitted to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, the state’s reference center for Ebola cases, and remains in isolation. Health authorities require immediate reporting of suspected cases to municipal epidemiological surveillance and CVE-SP; Instituto Adolfo Lutz conducts laboratory work and differential diagnosis in the state. Results of supplementary analyses are awaited to confirm or rule out Ebola infection.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ疑い患者が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で陽性 - ACidade ON リベイラン・プレト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴでのエボラ流行地からの帰国者がブラジルで発症し、エボラ感染が完全には除外されていない。重要な二次事例調査の可能性。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴでのエボラ流行地からの帰国者であり、エボラ感染が完全には除外されていない。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の陽性結果が得られたが、Emílio Ribas病院で追加のゲノム解析と補充検査が進行中。国家公衆衛生当局が対応中で、渡航関連の二次的拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola tras brote en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected cases of Ebola after an outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil on 2026-05-31. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever is in preventive isolation in an infectious-disease center while awaiting confirmatory tests; the DRC has recently declared a new Ebola outbreak, prompting a WHO international alert that has reported hundreds of deaths and thousands of suspected cases, with detections in Uganda. In Rio de Janeiro state, a second patient who arrived from Uganda exhibited viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea); malaria was confirmed, and the Ebola workup continues to exclude other illnesses. Brazilian authorities say the technical assessment indicates the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがアフリカでの流行後、エボラの疑い例2件を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・感染症の重症度が認められ、対象国（ブラジル、DRC）で複数の疑い例が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行可能性が該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行によるWHO国際警報が発令されており、ブラジルでの疑い例2件（São Paulo州1件、Rio de Janeiro州1件）が報告されている。Rio de Janeiro州の症例はマラリアが確認されたが、エボラの除外検査が継続中。当局はブラジルへのエボラ導入リスクは低いと評価しているが、国際的な感染症の監視対象として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : quatre nouveaux patients guéris présentés au public - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Four newly recovered patients presented to the public - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola virus disease patients recovered and were publicly presented in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 31 May 2026. The recovered individuals were showcased at the Centre Médical Évangélique (CME) hospital in a ceremony attended by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom, as part of the region's intensified response to the outbreak centered in Ituri. Dr. Jeanne Alasha, health adviser to the military governor of Ituri, lauded rapid medical management and said the four recoveries underscore that early identification and treatment can lead to cure. Health authorities urged residents to promptly report suspected cases and to avoid concealing symptoms, emphasizing that community cooperation is essential to halting transmission. The authorities and international partners are accelerating outbreak containment efforts as Ituri remains the outbreak’s main focus.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola in Ituri: Four newly recovered patients presented to the public - ACP（イトゥリ州のエボラ：4人の回復患者が公開展示）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常/予想外、高い重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク）。WHO事務局長出席の公式イベント等から社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認事例と回復事例が報告されており、イトゥリ州での継続的な流行対応状況を示している。WHO事務局長のテドロス氏が出席した公式セレモニーが開催されており、国際的な関心が高い。DRCはイトゥリ州での複数アウトブレイク歴を持つ地域であり、監視を継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu i Ugandi 263 slučajeva ebole u svibnju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda in May.
article.articleSummary: By the end of May, there were 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, according to Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, with 43 deaths attributed to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain. The outbreak is the 17th in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus was discovered, and it is outpacing the speed of the global response. Health systems warn of shortages of basic supplies, including protective masks, after weeks of undetected spread. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). African experts urge rapid activation of national crisis systems and sustained pandemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダで5月にエボラウイルス263症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援必要），WHO PHEIC宣言により国際的関心極めて高い。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴとウガンダの両国でエボラ症例が報告されているが、対象国リストはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。既にWHO PHEIC宣言済みであり、43名の死亡、1,100以上の疑い症例、供給不足等の重大な公衆衛生上の懸念あり。Bundibugyo株は稀な株で国際社会の関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Exame testa negativo para ebola em paciente que chegou ao Rio após viagem pela África | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola test negative in a patient who arrived in Rio after traveling through Africa | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative in a Belgian traveler who arrived in Rio de Janeiro after traveling through Africa. On 31 May 2026, Fiocruz’s Evandro Chagas Institute and the Municipal Health Secretariat confirmed the patient does not have Ebola. Saliva and urine samples tested negative for Ebola; however, he tested positive for malaria on 29–30 May and remains in isolation at Fiocruz. The traveler developed cough, chills and diarrhea, but did not report fever or severe headache. Uganda, the African country visited, had confirmed Ebola cases; this prompted the initial suspicion. Fiocruz reiterates that the risk of transmission of Ebola in Brazil is considered low. The patient’s name was not disclosed. No other suspected cases reported; malaria treatment is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカへの旅行後にリオに到着した患者のエボラ検査が陰性 | リオデジャネイロ | オー・ディア
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の検査は陰性であり、直接的な感染症危機ではない。ただし、アフリカ（ウガンダ）との渡航関連で疑い症例が報告されており、国際的な検体検査体制の機能確認と経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）への到着患者の検査結果であり、ウガンダはコンテキスト情報として言及されているのみ。対象国リストではウガンダ（1269750ではなく226074）は含まれないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみ。患者のエボラ検査は陰性で、マラリア陽性であることが確認されている。疑い症例報告としての価値があるが、確定症例ではないため見送り候補だが、国際渡航関連のシグナルとして経過観察対象に位置づけた。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola em SP testa positivo para meningite; caso segue sob investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo tests positive for meningitis; case remains under investigation.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil — a 37-year-old man hospitalized with suspected Ebola after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by PCR. Ebola diagnosis remains under investigation, with genomic analyses planned; the patient is in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, the state's infectious disease reference hospital. The case follows recent travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, which is experiencing an Ebola outbreak. Brazilian authorities note there are no confirmed Ebola cases in the country. The Emílio Ribas and Instituto Adolfo Lutz coordinate care and laboratory work; CVE-SP is coordinating surveillance. Ebola testing follows two PCR collections, the second 48 hours after the first, with samples sent to the national reference lab Evandro Chagas (IEC). Imported exposure is suspected; the patient initially presented with fever and is being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ疑い患者がメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で陽性；調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数国での感染症流行関連、および高度な国家関心により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからの帰国者で、エボラ疑いで入院していたが髄膜炎が確認された。エボラ診断は依然調査中。DRCでのエボラ流行との関連性から、国際的な監視が必要。ブラジルではエボラ確定症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情累计确诊病例超260例_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 260 cumulative confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 260 cumulative laboratory-confirmed cases as of May 30, 2026, spreading across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The government reports rapid expansion of testing capacity, reducing turnaround to 48 hours; all pending specimens have been tested, eliminating backlog. To date, over 900 samples have been tested, with more than 260 confirmed cases and 142 patients receiving care at treatment centers. Health authorities say surveillance, case finding, and incubation-period controls are progressing, yielding significant containment progress. Based on current measures, officials estimate the outbreak could be fully controlled and eliminated within 4 to 6 months. The government, in partnership with international health partners, continues case surveillance, contact tracing, patient care, and community awareness, urging the public to strictly follow prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が累計確定症例260例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。260例超の確定症例、複数州での拡大、国際パートナーシップによる対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。確定症例260例超、142名が治療センターで受診中。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の3州に拡大。政府は国際保健パートナーと協力し、4～6ヶ月での制御と根絶を目標としている。検査能力の急速な拡大により検査能力は強化されているが、ウイルス性出血熱であり重症度が高く、継続的な国際協力が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde informa que paciente com suspeita de ebola em SP está em estado grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports that a patient with suspected Ebola in São Paulo is in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Health reported a 37-year-old man hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo with suspected Ebola, in critical condition and intubated after rapid deterioration. He developed severe diarrhea, mental disorientation, persistent high fever, and generalized weakness after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ebola circulates. Lab confirmation is pending; samples have been sent to reference laboratories. The São Paulo Health Secretariat activated the high-threat disease protocol, enforcing absolute isolation in a dedicated area, mandatory PPE for staff, and urgent notification to epidemiological surveillance. Concurrent tests for malaria, dengue, and yellow fever are being conducted to exclude other infections. Brazil has no indigenous Ebola transmission but reinforced surveillance since 2014; airports and reference centers remain prepared. Transmission occurs by direct contact with blood, feces, urine, or other fluids of symptomatic patients, and late-stage disease may involve hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がサンパウロのエボラ疑い患者が重篤な状態にあることを報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ疑い患者の報告は必須サーベイランス対象であり、DRCでの取得から国際的インポートリスクがある。
