triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者はDRCからの帰国後の発症で、検査確認待ち。高度隔離プロトコルが実施されている。マラリア、デング、黄熱病の除外検査も進行中。WHOへの即時通知対象。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ назвала выздоровление пяти человек от вируса Эболы важным достижением
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO called the recovery of five people from the Ebola virus an important achievement.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the World Health Organization hailed the recovery of five people infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as an important achievement in the outbreak response. A new Ebola treatment center began operating in Bunia to speed detection and timely care. Nevertheless, the outbreak remains a serious threat: hundreds of suspected cases have been reported in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, with the death toll reportedly exceeding 220. Transmission across several districts is difficult to control due to ongoing armed conflict, weak health systems, and security concerns. The WHO emphasized the need for continued international support and rapid response measures to prevent further spread and scale up outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラウイルスから5人の回復を重要な成果と呼んだ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡220以上）、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）、渡航制限リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブニア地域でのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは『隣国ウガンダで疑い例が報告』という二次的言及に留まり、ウガンダでの実際の確認事例は明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただしIHR基準での国際的拡大リスク判定には考慮している。武力紛争・弱い保健システムによる制御困難性が強調されており、国際支援要請が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada Kasus di Indonesia, Kemenkes Bagikan Tips Sehat Cegah Ebola : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Cases Yet in Indonesia, Ministry of Health Shares Healthy Tips to Prevent Ebola: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases are currently under global scrutiny, with no vaccine or approved therapy for Ebola to date. Indonesia has not reported any Ebola cases. The Indonesian Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) issued a vigilance circular to anticipate the virus’s spread, urging the public to maintain hygienic living practices to reduce transmission. Preventive measures highlighted by the Ministry include: regular handwashing with soap or hand sanitizer; wearing a mask when experiencing illness symptoms; and practicing proper cough and sneeze etiquette. The guidance emphasizes general infection prevention as no cases have been detected domestically, but the ongoing international concern warrants heightened awareness and personal hygiene. The notice aligns with public health risk communications as of May 31, 2026, in Jakarta and across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアではまだ症例なし、保健省がエボラ予防の健康ガイドを共有：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア国内でのエボラ症例は報告されておらず、当該記事は予防啓発と警戒周知のみを扱っている。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、実際の発生イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア保健省による予防啓発と警戒通知の発出を報じたもので、国内での実際のエボラ症例発生ではない。「No cases have been detected domestically」と明記されている。国際的なエボラ関心に対応した予防衛生ガイダンス配布のニュースであり、シグナル識別の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Afrikom: 263 su potvrđena slučaja, umrlo 43
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading across Africa: 263 confirmed cases, 43 dead.
article.articleSummary: End-May 2026: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda total 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The outbreak is the 17th in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus’ discovery, with transmission spreading for weeks undetected and outpacing the global response. Health systems report shortages of basic protective equipment such as masks. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities urge rapid activation of national crisis systems and sustained preparedness for pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカ全域に拡大：263の確認された症例、43名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全てに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラウイルス疾患の多国家アウトブレイク。確認症例263名、死亡43名の重症度、国際的拡大リスク、および管理不十分な状況が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: Uganda（ウガンダ）はGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、verified_locationsには対象国リストに存在するDRCのみを記載。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、確認症例263名、死亡43名、1,100以上の疑似症例、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による17番目のDRCアウトブレイク、保護具不足など、深刻な懸念要因が複数存在。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil investigates two possible Ebola cases amid fears of virus spread outside Africa
article.articleSummary: Two possible Ebola cases being monitored in Brazil as of 2026-05-31: in Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever and Ebola-consistent symptoms; initial Ebola tests were negative and he is isolated at a specialized facility. In Rio de Janeiro state, a man from Uganda presented with cough, chills and diarrhea; Rio officials say malaria was confirmed and the Ebola case remains under investigation. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, has yielded over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths, with Uganda reporting confirmed infections and one death. The World Health Organization cautions the outbreak’s true reach may be wider than detected. Sao Paulo authorities say the technical assessment indicates the risk of introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low despite the suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがアフリカ外への感染拡大懸念の中でエボラ可能性例2件を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大の初期兆候であり、IHR基準3項目（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に該当。DRC発生源の既知流行と連動した越境例報告であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健当局の技術評価では南米への導入リスクは低いと判断されているが、DRC発生源の約1,000疑似例・250死亡と既知流行の深刻性、ウガンダでの確認例・死亡報告、WHOによる実際の影響範囲が検出より広い可能性の警告を踏まえると、国際的リスク増大の初期段階として対応が必要。記事内で他国（ウガンダ）も言及されているが、DRC・ブラジルが主題のため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Screenings Reach JFK as WHO Chief Lands at Outbreak's Ground Zero
article.articleSummary: JFK begins screening travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda within 21 days of exposure, expanding a U.S. program that already screened at Dulles, Atlanta, and Houston; the new JFK checks accompany overseas exit screenings and post-arrival monitoring. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola form with no approved vaccine or treatment, with Congo-confirmed cases at 225 and WHO-recorded 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, eastern Congo, stressing community-centered response. Doctors Without Borders warned the response is not keeping pace. The United States approved a further $80 million in aid, bringing total U.S. support to more than $112 million. An American surgeon treating Congo patients tested positive and was flown to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱スクリーニングがJFKで開始、WHO事務局長がコンゴの感染地に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）の多国間感染として、IHR基準の4項目全てに該当。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限、WHO直接対応、複数国での症例確認など、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、南スーダン、ウガンダからの旅行者スクリーニングを述べるが、実際の発生地はDRC（Bunia）が主題。南スーダン・ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国として言及されるのみで、サマリー上は発生地の記述がないため除外。USA内のスクリーニング地点（JFK、Dulles、Atlanta、Houston）は対象国リストに含まれず、またスクリーニング実施地であって感染症の発生地ではないため除外。ドイツは患者転送先であり発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Pääkirjoitus | Hantavirus sai huomion, ebola leviää hiljaa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Editorial | Hantavirus has attracted attention, Ebola is spreading quietly.
article.articleSummary: Two global health threads unfold: hantavirus and Ebola. Hantavirus cases worldwide remain few—about ten to date—with rapid responses following exposures on the MV Hondius cruise ship, prompting surveillance, testing, and quarantines in Western countries. In Finland, two citizens were potentially exposed on a Johannesburg-bound flight, and Andes hantavirus disease was added to the list of high-consequence infectious diseases, enabling official quarantine. Meanwhile, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to neighboring countries—South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, and Tanzania—per WHO monitoring, with over 900 suspected cases and around 220 possible deaths. Outbreak dynamics reflect poverty, conflict, displacement, weak infrastructure, and community distrust, which delay detection. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The article underscores that surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and isolation remain the most effective tools, while geopolitics and funding cuts threaten health security.

triage.headline_ja: 社説 | ハンタウイルスが注目を集める中、エボラは静かに拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）がDRC東部から南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニアに拡大し、900例以上の疑い症例と約220人の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、異常性）を複数満たし、管理可能性の懸念もある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ拡大が複数アフリカ諸国（南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア）に及んでいると述べられているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ハンタウイルス事例も記載されているが、症例数が少なく（約10例）且つ主題はエボラの拡大。DRC東部でのエボラ流行は医療インフラの脆弱性、紛争、人口移動、コミュニティ不信が原因で検出が遅れており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief attends opening of Ebola treatment centre in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province, Bunia city, driven by Bundibugyo virus. No approved specific treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola, but early care improves outcomes. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, a 100-bed facility (45 beds available) with intensive-care capacity, to admit patients from Bunia and surrounding areas. Ituri remains the outbreak epicentre and is spreading faster than the response despite better health facilities and aid. Tedros cited five recoveries, the first documented on Friday, underscoring that patients can recover with timely care. The Congolese government will staff the centre with doctors and nurses, including Kinshasa-intensive-care specialists, alongside local partners, to bolster the response and stop transmission as quickly as possible.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ東部のエボラ治療センター開設式に出席
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡例あり）、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認められ、4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も5基準すべてに該当。WHO事務局長が現地視察するなど国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）による活発なアウトブレイク。イトゥリ州ブニア市が震源地で拡大速度が対応を上回っている。WHO事務局長Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesuが現地を訪問し、100床（稼働45床）の新規治療施設を視察。キナシャからの集中治療専門医派遣など国家レベルの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Soupçonné d'avoir contracté Ebola, un Belge placé à l'isolement au Brésil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belgian Suspected of Having Contracted Ebola, Placed in Isolation in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Belgian suspected of Ebola in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: admitted to Evandro Chagas Institute with cough, chills, and diarrhea after returning from Uganda amid an Ebola outbreak there. Brazilian health authorities activated the suspected Ebola protocol; patient is isolated in a specialized unit while Ebola test results are pending. Malaria has been diagnosed in the patient. A public health investigation is underway to identify contacts since arrival, with exposed individuals advised to report symptoms such as fever, headache, or joint pains. The patient was transported by ambulance, with medical staff in protective equipment. If Ebola is confirmed, this would be Rio de Janeiro's first recorded case. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals; outbreaks are mainly in Sub-Saharan Africa. Ongoing monitoring and isolation continue until results are confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の疑いがあるベルギー人、ブラジルで隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当。ウガンダでのエボラ流行に関連した国際的な疑似症例報告であり、ブラジルでは初の可能性がある。異国間の移動を伴い、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのエボラ流行が背景にあり、国際旅行者の症状報告。マラリア診断済み、エボラ検査結果待機中。ブラジルでの初の可能性ある症例のため、地域的に重要。記事サマリーの主題はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）でのイベントであり、ベルギーは患者の国籍のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Países de África oriental se reunirán por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African countries will meet over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, health ministers from the East African Community (EAC) — Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Somalia — will hold an emergency virtual meeting on Monday and Tuesday to coordinate regional actions to contain the Ebola outbreak declared in eastern DRC on May 15. The EAC Secretariat has also convened a crisis emergency meeting, a Technical Working Group on communicable and non-communicable diseases, and another group to harmonize regulations for Ebola vaccines, therapies, and diagnostics. The African Union health agency reports about 246 suspected deaths in the DRC from the 17th Ebola epidemic; Uganda has eight confirmed infections, including one death from a Congo-imported case. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, with a fatality rate of 30–50%, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO classifies the outbreak as high risk for sub-Saharan Africa, but low globally.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ諸国がエボラについて会合を開く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの大規模エボラ流行と地域的波及が確認されており、複数国の緊急対応会合開催が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数のEAC加盟国が言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCの東部（5月15日に宣言）であり、ウガンダは輸入症例を確認している。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に列挙。スーダン・ルワンダ・ソマリア・ケニア・タンザニア・ブルンジ・ウガンダは発生地域として Bluedot が列挙しているが、サマリー上では確定的な発生地ではなく地域的対応・調整国として言及されているため除外。Bundibugyo株で致死率30-50%、ワクチン未承認という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo apura caso suspeito de ebola em paciente vindo da África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo probes a suspected Ebola case in a patient arriving from Africa.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo Health Secretariat investigates a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an active Ebola outbreak is occurring (Bundibugyo strain). He has been transferred to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo and remains in isolation while laboratories determine confirmation status; no lab confirmation yet. Diagnostics follow national and international protocols, with parallel testing to rule out other illnesses presenting with similar symptoms, including malaria, dengue, and yellow fever, using hemograms, rapid tests, serologies, and viral markers. Authorities reinforced hospital-network biosafety and isolation procedures, requiring immediate notification of suspected cases. Brazil has no documented autochthonous transmission, but officials maintain heightened vigilance for travelers from Ebola-affected regions and stress continued use of PPE and strict infection-control measures in healthcare settings.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロがアフリカから来た患者のエボラ疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症であり、DRCからの輸入例は国際的に重大な懸念である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の疑い例が南米ブラジルで報告されたもので、DRCの活動的流行地からの輸入症例。未確診だが、検査プロセスは進行中。ブラジルに自動伝播例なしとのことだが、疑い例報告は国際的に重大なシグナルである。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil investigates two possible Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases were under monitoring in Brazil as of May 30, 2026: in Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever and Ebola-suspicious symptoms; initial Ebola tests were negative, but he remains isolated and under observation at a specialized infectious-disease facility. In Rio de Janeiro, a man from Uganda showed viral symptoms; malaria testing on May 30 returned positive, and the case remains under investigation. Sao Paulo's government said the risk of Ebola entering Brazil and South America remains very low. The Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, declared May 15, has exceeded 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths as of May 28, with Uganda reporting infections and one death; the WHO warns the outbreak’s true reach is likely wider. No confirmed Ebola cases in Brazil have been announced; investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラウイルス病の可能性がある2つのケースを調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。新興感染症の国際的な拡大懸念があり、発生地域と関連国での公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC（203312）とUganda（226074）も含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの疑似症例の調査。DRCとウガンダはマニフェストされたエボラ流行国だが、本記事の検出はブラジルにおける輸入感染症リスクが中心。WPROスクリーニングではDRCの大規模流行（1,000疑似症例、250死亡）が報告されており、国際的拡大の懸念がある。ブラジル当局は低リスク評価をしているが、エボラの高い致命率と国際的な懸念から、フルRRAの対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατροί Χωρίς Σύνορα: Η εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό είναι βαθιά ανησυχητική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: The spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is deeply concerning.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, described by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) as extremely worrying. Two weeks after the World Health Organization declared the outbreak, MSF deputy director Dr. Alan Gonzalez said there have never been so many cases in such a short time. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri province in eastern DRC, the hardest-hit area, to oversee containment. In DRC, there are over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. Officials note hundreds of samples remain untested. Containment and aid missions are delayed by significant obstacles, including border and airport closures, with ongoing conflict in the region further hindering the response. The true scale and severity of the outbreak remain uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染拡大は深刻に懸念すべき状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、移動制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。重度の感染症アウトブレイクであり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも隣国で確認例（9例、死亡1）があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCが主要な発生地である。2週間でWHO宣言後に急速拡大中（1,000疑い例、246死亡）。MSFも深刻度を表明。検査未実施サンプル多数、紛争による対応阻害など管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για Έμπολα σε Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα: 263 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα και 43 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Congo and Uganda: 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus as of May 30. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, expanding uncertainty about outbreak size. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The Bundibugyo strain is particularly concerning because there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this form. Response efforts are challenged by strained health systems, difficulties in contact tracing, and limited access in unstable areas. International partners are crucial, but effective support should align with African strategies. Authorities call for rapid mobilization, strengthened surveillance, and sustained preparedness investments to curb transmission amid ongoing regional insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ警戒：263件の確認症例と43人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）による確認症例263件・死亡43件、WHOがPHEIC宣言、1,100件以上の疑い症例、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療薬なし。スクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当し、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は特に懸念される（承認ワクチン・特異的治療薬なし）。区域不安定性が対応を困難化している。

article.articleHeadline: Malária: quais são os sintomas e como tratar? | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: what are the symptoms and how to treat it? | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium protozoa and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a concern in Brazil, with most cases in the Amazon region—Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima and Tocantins—though the disease can affect other states due to severe outcomes outside this area. A patient in Rio de Janeiro suspected of Ebola was diagnosed with malaria and remains in isolation until Ebola is ruled out. Common symptoms: high fever, chills, tremors, sweats, and headache; nausea, vomiting, fatigue, and loss of appetite may precede classic signs. Severe cases include altered consciousness, seizures, hypotension or shock, and hemorrhages; pregnant women and first-time infected children are at higher risk. Treatment is oral tablets provided free by SUS, tailored to Plasmodium species and patient factors; early treatment cures, disrupting transmission. There is no malaria vaccine in Brazil; a vaccine exists in some African countries for P. falciparum, limited to young children.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：症状は何か、そしてどのように治療するのか？| CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるマラリアの継続的な懸念と、リオデジャネイロでのエボラ疑い患者がマラリア診断されたケースが報告されているが、記事は主に教育的・治療情報中心であり、新しい流行事象の報告ではない。情報不足により慎重な経過観察判定。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマラリアに関する一般的な情報提供で、新しいアウトブレイク事象の報告ではない。リオデジャネイロのエボラ疑い患者がマラリア陽性であった点は注視対象だが、詳細情報が限定的。アマゾン地域での継続的な流行は既知の懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Afrikoje - veiksmai prieš Ebolos plitimą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Africa - actions against the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo and Uganda confront a severe Ebola outbreak led by the Bandibadžio variant, with the epidemic centered in DR Congo. Suspected infections exceed 900; confirmed cases 101, with at least 10 deaths attributed to Ebola and a further 220 deaths suspected to be Ebola. Uganda reports two additional infections, bringing its total to seven. Ebola spreads by direct contact with infected body fluids, and the incubation period can reach up to three weeks. The outbreak’s high transmissibility raises regional risk. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the second highest level. Africa CDC then declared an Africa-wide emergency due to regional spread risk. Africa CDC President Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak could spread to ten Central African countries: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo (DRC), Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ - エボラ出血熱の拡散に対する対策
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻で異常/予想外であり、国際的拡大リスク（既に複数国で確認、10カ国への拡大リスク警告）があり、国際的に渡航・貿易制限を招く可能性がある。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bandibadžio変異株による大規模流行。DR Congoを中心に900超の疑似感染例、101の確認例、少なくとも10死亡。ウガンダでも7例確認。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言、Africa CDCがアフリカ全域緊急事態を宣言。Africa CDC会長が10カ国への拡大リスク警告（South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, DRC, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, Zambia）。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とZambia（895949）の2国が記事主題の発生国として確認される。他のリスク国（Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un Belge suspecté d'avoir contracté Ebola hospitalisé à Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Belgian man suspected of having contracted Ebola virus disease hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Belgian man recently returned from Uganda, a country currently affected by an Ebola outbreak, is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro with suspected Ebola virus disease. He was admitted to Evandro Chagas National Institute of Infectious Diseases. Among symptoms are cough, chills and diarrhea; malaria has been diagnosed, explaining fever and headaches, but Ebola remains possible. A screening test for Ebola has been performed, with results pending as of May 31, 2026. Isolation remains mandatory until definitive laboratory confirmation is obtained. The case is an imported suspected Ebola case linked to travel from Uganda, with authorities triggering public health protocols while awaiting diagnostic confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ベルギー人男性がエボラウイルス病の感染を疑われ、リオデジャネイロで入院
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの帰国者によるエボラウイルス病の疑い例であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダのエボラアウトブレイク地域からの帰国者がブラジルで疑い例として検出された国際的なインポート事例。検査結果待機中であり、確定診断に至っていない段階だが、エボラウイルス病の可能性が存在する。公衆衛生上の対応は適切に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Бразилия разследва два възможни случая на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two possible cases of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Two possible Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil, in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak is concentrated, developed fever and symptoms consistent with a probable Ebola case; initial tests were negative, but he remains monitored and isolated in a specialized infectious-disease facility as a precaution. In Rio de Janeiro, a man from Uganda presented Ebola-like symptoms—cough, chills, and diarrhea—and, in a separate update, tested positive for malaria; the case remains under investigation. As of May 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has reported over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases since the outbreak began on May 15, with around 250 deaths; Uganda has confirmed several infections and one death. The World Health Organization cautions the true scope may be larger, while Sao Paulo authorities say the risk of spread in Brazil and South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの2つの可能性のある症例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。進行中のコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行（1,000超の疑い例、250死亡）と関連した国際的波及事例のため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）での疑い例を主題としており、同時にコンゴ民主共和国での進行中の大規模エボラ流行（1,000超疑い例、250死亡）の文脈で報告されている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダのマラリア症例は補足的であり、主要なエボラ流行地はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。対象国リストに基づき、Brazil と DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。5月31日時点で既に大規模な流行が進行中であり、国際的波及の初期段階。

article.articleHeadline: تفاقم تفشي إيبولا في أفريقيا.. 263 إصابة مؤكدة وتحذيرات من أزمة صحية دولية متصاعدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worsening Ebola outbreak in Africa: 263 confirmed cases and warnings of an escalating international health crisis.
article.articleSummary: Escalating Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 263 confirmed cases and over 1,100 suspected, with 43 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant raising concerns for rapid spread. This outbreak is the seventeenth in the DRC and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery. Health workers warn of critical shortages of basic supplies, including masks and personal protective equipment, hindering containment. Field reports indicate the virus circulated for weeks before detection in some areas, allowing wider transmission. Urgent calls exist to activate national emergency systems and increase outbreak preparedness, with international partnerships most effective when aligned with national strategies. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola in DRC and Uganda, underscoring a need for a coordinated global response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の悪化：263例の確定症例と国際的保健危機の拡大に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡散リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern を宣言済み。
triage.notes: Uganda（226074）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生地であり、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれないため除外。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。エボラ Bundibugyo 株（稀な系統）の検出、43 死亡例、1,100 以上の疑い例があり、WHO が PHEIC 宣言済みの重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Chefe da Organização Mundial da Saúde diz que 5 pacientes se recuperaram de tipo raro de ebola no Congo - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization says that five patients have recovered from a rare form of the Ebola virus in the Congo - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Five patients diagnosed with a rare Ebola form recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, the outbreak’s eastern epicenter. Four were discharged today and a fifth left two days earlier; on Friday, the first recovery of a confirmed Bundibugyo-virus case was reported, the strain driving the current outbreak. There is no vaccine or specific treatment approved for this strain. Official data list about 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation in DRC; Uganda reports nine cases and one death linked to the outbreak. MSF warns the virus is spreading faster than response; attacks on health centers occur as armed groups operate in the region. Tedros urged community involvement and early care at health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関事務局長、コンゴで稀なエボラウイルスから5人の患者が回復したと述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の集団発生で、DRCで906疑い例・223死亡、ウガンダでも9例・1死亡が報告。稀な株、ワクチン・治療法なし、医療施設への攻撃、蔓延速度が対応を上回るとのMSF警告により、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo-virus型エボラの集団発生。DRCが主たる発生地で、ウガンダでも確認された二国間事象。医療施設への攻撃、武装勢力の活動による対応阻害、稀な株による治療オプション不足が重大な管理上の課題。WHOが公式に言及し高い社会的・政治的関心がある。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda to continue anti-ADF operations despite DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda's military says it will continue joint operations against the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) despite the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The Uganda Peoples' Defence Forces (UPDF) will persist against ADF remnants while observing Ebola prevention measures and standard operating procedures. The decision comes as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appealed for a ceasefire to allow health workers safe access to affected communities. The ADF, originated in Uganda and now based in eastern DRC, has been linked to attacks on civilians in the region, and joint Ugandan-Congolese operations have continued since November 2021. Tedros described the outbreak as very complex, noting insecurity, armed conflict, displacement, food shortages and community mistrust complicating response. Health officials warn cross-border movement and ongoing conflict could raise transmission risk if response efforts are disrupted.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、DRCエボラ流行にも関わらずADF対策作戦を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（DRC）とウガンダの軍事作戦継続による複雑な危機状況。国際的な懸念（WHO事務局長による停戦呼びかけ）、国境を越えた感染リスク、および管理可能性の懸念から、IHR基準複数該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの軍事作戦がDRC領内で継続されることを述べているが、エボラ発生地はDRC（東部）であり、ウガンダで症例が報告されている訳ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただし国境を越えた感染リスク（ウガンダからの人員移動、逃避民など）について健康当局が明示的に警告しており、地域的な懸念は高い。複雑な人道危機（武力紛争、人道的アクセスの制限、コミュニティ不信）がエボラ対応を著しく困難にしており、管理可能性の点で外部支援を必要とする状況である。

article.articleHeadline: Названо число подтвержденных смертей от Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola deaths in Africa has been announced.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 263 confirmed cases and 43 confirmed deaths. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya cited The Financial Times. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17—the 17th Ebola outbreak to date. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines, making management rely on pallia­tive care, isolation, fluid replacement, and pain relief. Health authorities and humanitarian workers report critical shortages of essentials such as masks and insufficient medical staff. Earlier, 18 patients with suspected Ebola disappeared after a fire at a medical center. The situation underscores ongoing transmission risks and the urgent need for medical supplies and personnel in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラによる確認された死亡者数が発表される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者263名、死亡43名の大規模発生。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、異常・予想外性が認められ、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で、承認済みの治療法やワクチンがないBundibugyo株の流行。医療資源の深刻な不足、感染リスク継続中。WHO による国際的緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the outbreak of a rare kind of Ebola
article.articleSummary: 134 confirmed Ebola cases across Congo and Uganda as of May 29, including 9 in Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola virus strain and is described as outpacing the response in both countries. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, elevating global attention and cross-border coordination. The report highlights Congo and Uganda as affected locations with ongoing transmission, but provides no further details on symptoms, exposure sources, or laboratory confirmation in the text. The international status aims to mobilize resources and guide containment and monitoring efforts across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラウイルス株の流行について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）として既に正式宣言されている。稀なウイルス株による多国間での活発な伝播と国際的対応の必要性が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの両国が影響を受けていると記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、すでに国際的な感染症危機管理体制が発動されている。稀なウイルス株の特性に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil identifies 2 possible Ebola patients, as WHO reports some recoveries in Congo
article.articleSummary: Two possible Ebola cases under monitoring in Brazil: in Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever, suspected Ebola; initial tests negative, isolated in an infectious-disease facility. In Rio de Janeiro, a Ugandan man with viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) is under investigation after malaria testing; case under review. Sao Paulo officials say the risk of introduction into Brazil or South America remains very low. In Africa, WHO reports five recoveries from Bundibugyo virus in eastern Congo’s Bunia, Ituri Province, noting this rare strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Outbreak totals: 906 suspected, 223 deaths; 134 confirmed, 18 deaths in Congo/Uganda; Uganda reports 9 cases, 1 death. MSF calls for expanded testing and faster aid; response hindered by attacks on health centers in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu amid rebel activity.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ患者の可能性を2件確認、コンゴでのWHO回復報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（南米への持ち込み可能性）と、アフリカでの深刻な流行（906疑い例、223死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。複数国での同時多発的な確認症例と国際的関心の高さからシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルでの可能例2件とコンゴ(DRC)での流行及びウガンダでの確認を報告。対象国リストではDRCとブラジルのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。南米への初期侵入懸念と、アフリカでの継続的な流行拡大が同時に報告されている点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Bangka Tengah perkuat pengendalian vektor untuk cegah malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Bangka strengthens vector control to prevent malaria.
article.articleSummary: Central Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands Province, Indonesia, is strengthening malaria surveillance and vector control to prevent resurgence. Bangka Tengah Health Office, led by Zaitun, says the intensification through the Preventive and Control of Diseases program (P2P) engages all community health centers, hospitals, and related agencies, aiming to sustain malaria elimination via early case detection, laboratory testing, tracing transmission history, and monitoring movement from endemic areas. The program applies a 1-2-5 rapid response: report within one day, investigate within two days, and respond within five days after case discovery. Vector control includes mapping receptive areas, monitoring Anopheles habitats, distributing bed nets, and environmental hygiene education. Heightened vigilance followed a May 2026 outbreak in Bangka Regency; 2025 had three imported malaria cases. Mining activity and stagnant water may create breeding sites; emphasis on cross-sector coordination and electronic surveillance to maintain elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 中央バンカ県がマラリア予防のためベクター制御を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで既に排除宣言済みの地域での再発シグナルであり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、管理可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、詳細な症例数・重症度情報が記事に記載されておらず、現在の制御状況が明確でないため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: インドネシアは1977年にマラリア排除を宣言していた地域での再発（2026年5月にバンカ県で集団発生）。鉱業活動による止水池がベクター繁殖地となっており、地域的な管理課題を示唆。死亡数、入院数、症例数の具体的な数字が記事に記載されていないため重症度評価が困難。続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga un posible caso de ébola - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento |Noticias de ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates a possible case of Ebola - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento | News from ....
article.articleSummary: Brazil's São Paulo health authorities are investigating a possible Ebola case in a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo and is now hospitalized in grave condition at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology in São Paulo. The patient is isolated while doctors perform laboratory tests and genetic sequencing to confirm or rule out infection. The case is described as suspicious and under investigation, with isolation, immediate notification, laboratory analysis, and follow-up actions being implemented per current protocols. Authorities note the Ebola outbreak’s background factors—including Africa’s absence of endemic transmission, no direct flights between affected regions and South America, and the virus’s transmission through direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues after symptoms begin. The incubation period is two to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの可能性のある症例を調査 - ブラジルの保健当局が調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性、異常・予想外のイベント、国際的な拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの疑い例であり、確定診断待ちの状態だが、対象国（DRC、Brazil）での発生確認であり、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからの帰国者でSão Pauloで隔離治療中。検査・遺伝子配列解析により確認待ち。エボラはIHR対象疾患であり、確定診断まで厳密なモニタリングが必要。São Paulo地域の複数の地理的IDはいずれも同一地点を指すため、Brazil国レベルでの verified_location に統一。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒 刚果疫情220死 专家疑与猎食野味有关 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus Congo outbreak leaves 220 dead; experts suspect it is linked to bushmeat hunting | China Press
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) has left at least 220 deaths with more than a thousand suspected cases confirmed since the government declared an outbreak on May 15; the World Health Organization says the true number of infections is likely higher. The flare-up is suspected to be linked to hunting and consumption of bushmeat. Kinshasa’s Masina Market, the country’s largest wildlife meat hub, sells a wide range of species—from giant swamp-dwelling rodents to antelope and snakes—often in ways that conceal products from customers. In the Congo Basin, hunting and eating bushmeat remains culturally important; CIFOR estimates annual bushmeat harvest and consumption reach about 4.5 million tonnes. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the Congo and what is now South Sudan, with fruit bats and other wildlife as natural reservoirs; cross-species transmission occurs during handling and processing of bushmeat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス コンゴ疫情220死 専門家は野生動物の狩猟・消費との関連を疑う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て満たし、社会的・政治的関心が高い。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）でのエボラ爆発的増加を主題としている。220人以上の死亡と1000人以上の疑い患者。スーダンも発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文ではコンゴが主要な焦点であり、スーダンは言及されていない。野生動物からの人畜共通感染という重要な感染経路の特定があり、市場での不衛生な処理が継続的な曝露源となっている。WHOが真の感染数がさらに高い可能性を指摘しており、管理可能性への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga caso sospechoso de ébola en São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Investigates Suspected Case of Ebola in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is suspected in São Paulo, Brazil, after a 37-year-old male patient from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, who recently traveled in Africa, was admitted in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology. The case is under evaluation by the Center for Epidemiological Surveillance, with laboratory confirmation not yet available. Brazilian health authorities activated biosafety protocols, including isolation, immediate notification, laboratory testing, and follow-up per established procedures. The risk of Ebola introduction or spread in Brazil and South America remains assessed as very low, grounded on no sustained transmission in the Americas, the absence of direct flight connections from affected African regions, and the non-airborne transmission requiring contact with blood or fluids from symptomatic individuals. Active surveillance is urged in hospitals, focusing on patients with recent travel to or contact with fluids from suspected cases within 21 days, as authorities monitor for an imported case.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロでエボラ疑い事例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者であり、アフリカでのエボラウイルス曝露を示唆。現時点で検査確認されていないが、疑い事例として各国の感染症監視に影響あり。ブラジルでの実際の発症例が確認された場合、WPRの地域における初の認定事例となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola deja ya 43 muertos y 263 casos confirmados en República Democrática del Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already left 43 dead and 263 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northern Democratic Republic of the Congo has extended to Uganda, with 43 deaths and 263 laboratory-confirmed cases, and over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Ituri province accounts for about 88% of confirmed cases; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases including 1 death. Ongoing conflict drives cross-border movement, stressing health systems; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this Ebola strain. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya warns regional spread is a reality. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is in Bunia to assess the situation, with Health Minister Roger Kamba aiming to defeat or contain the outbreak within four to six months. RDC’s prior outbreak experience is cited as a critical asset.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により既に43人が死亡、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで263人の確定患者が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確定患者263人、死亡43人、疑い患者1,100人超、国境を越えた拡大、複数国への波及が確認されている。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCで確認された流行の中心地はイトゥリ州ブニア市。ワクチン・特異的治療法がない株による流行。WHO事務局長が現地を視察、感染症危機管理の最優先事案。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Ponad 1100 podejrzewanych przypadków eboli jest wciąż badanych
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases are still under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in DRC and Uganda has reached 263 confirmed cases by May 30, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation, with no approved vaccines or targeted therapies. Forty-three deaths are confirmed from Ebola Bundibugyo; laboratory tests have confirmed 129 infections in DRC and eight in Uganda, linked to travel from DRC. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Africa CDC lists 11 countries at risk for further spread, including South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania and Somalia. The virus circulated undetected for about four weeks before confirmation; Ituri Province in eastern DRC is seeing attacks on medical centers and staff, hampering contact tracing. Health authorities report equipment shortages (masks, PPE) and delayed response due to funding cuts. Calls for activation of national crisis systems and pandemic preparedness; international partners urged to align with African strategies.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: 1,100以上のエボラ疑い患者が依然調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者263人、疑い患者1,100人以上、死亡43人を伴うアウトブレイク。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生を明記していますが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めています。WHOが PHEIC 宣言済みで、11カ国でさらなる拡大リスクが指摘されており、医療施設への攻撃や資金不足による対応の遅れなど深刻な管理上の課題があります。

article.articleHeadline: MoH urges travelers to Congo and Uganda to adhere to Ebola protocols
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts Oman’s Ministry of Health to urge travelers arriving from or departing to these countries to follow preventive health controls. The guidance calls for monitoring health for 21 days after departure; avoiding unnecessary travel to affected areas; staying updated via official health authorities and the WHO; and ensuring valid health and evacuation insurance. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals and with blood or bodily fluids, washing hands regularly, using alcohol-based sanitizers, avoiding visits to healthcare facilities in affected zones, and not handling wild animals or consuming undercooked meat. Do not attend funerals or gatherings with direct contact with infected individuals. Ebola is not airborne but spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces and materials. Early detection and rapid reporting are emphasized to reduce spread. No case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省はコンゴとウガンダへの旅行者にエボラプロトコルの遵守を促促す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生がDRCとウガンダで報告されており、IHR基準（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。オマーンが公式に旅行ガイダンスを発出していることから社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてUgandaが記載されているが、記事サマリーは『DRCとウガンダでのエボラウイルス発生』と述べており、ウガンダはIHR対象国リストに含まれていない。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。オマーンはGeoNamesリストに含まれていないため除外される。エボラは高致命率で国際的懸念が極めて高いが、フルRRAでは具体的な患者数・死亡数などの詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Stray dog on biting spree injures nearly 60 in MP's Shivpuri; caught
article.articleSummary: Black stray dog in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, attacked pedestrians across several neighbourhoods, with the worst injuries reported in Laxmibai Colony where a two-year-old girl sustained critical facial wounds before bystanders intervened. By evening, nearly 60 people sought care at district hospital and local health centres for dog-bite injuries and were given anti-rabies vaccines and other treatment. The animal was tracked down and captured by Shivpuri Municipal Council officials. Health authorities have intensified surveillance in the affected areas and urged citizens to report aggressive or suspicious animals. The incident follows a Supreme Court ruling allowing euthanasia for rabid, incurably ill, or demonstrably dangerous stray dogs to curb risks to humans, while relocation and sterilisation orders were not recalled. Locals demand a permanent solution to stray-dog issues, highlighting public-safety concerns.

triage.headline_ja: インド・シブプリで野良犬が咬傷事件を起こし約60人が負傷、犬は捕獲される
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の接触事例（約60名が咬傷）であり重症度基準に合致するが、単一地域の限定的な事例で国際的拡大のリスクは低い。情報は比較的明確だが、死亡や重症化の詳細が不明であるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: インド・シブプリで野良犬による咬傷事例（60名が被害）。全員が狂犬病ワクチンと治療を受けた。犬は捕獲済み。単一地域の突発的な動物由来感染症事例で、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく国際的拡大リスクは極めて低い。ただし公衆衛生上の懸念と地域警戒が高まっているため、重症度と社会的関心に基づきWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades brasileiras investigam dois casos suspeitos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian authorities investigate two suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil, in the states of São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, as of 31 May 2026. One case concerns a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country that has declared a new Ebola outbreak, who presented fever and met the clinical definition of an Ebola suspected case. The São Paulo state government announced the case on Saturday. The report provides no laboratory confirmation and offers no further details about the second suspected case beyond its location in Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル当局がエボラの疑い例2件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。さらにWPRO基準5つすべて該当。コンゴでの発症者がブラジルに渡航し疑い症例が検出されており、リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのアウトブレイク宣言を背景としつつ、調査の主題はブラジル国内での疑い症例2件（São Paulo州およびRio de Janeiro州）。1例はコンゴ発症者がブラジルへ渡航。いずれも検査確認なしだが、エボラの国際的拡大リスク、著明な社会的関心、公式発表による高い信頼性からPICKUPに値する。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de Ebola testa positivo para meningite em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis in São Paulo
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo was initially classified as a suspected Ebola case and is isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas while Ebola testing continues. Laboratory confirmation by the Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified Neisseria meningitidis, causing meningococcal meningitis. The diagnosis was reached within a differential-diagnosis framework, acknowledging meningitis symptoms and epidemiological risk while Ebola-specific analyses are pending. Despite meningococcal meningitis confirmation, the Ebola investigation remains active until targeted tests are completed. The patient remains under isolation with ongoing clinical monitoring and biosafety measures at Emílio Ribas, a reference center for high-complexity infectious diseases. Public health authorities monitor the case due to Congo travel history; no death information is provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑い患者がサンパウロで髄膜炎検査陽性
triage.triage_reason: 確認されたコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航歴を持つ患者からのメニンゴコッカス性髄膜炎の確認診断、及びエボラの検査継続中という状況は、国際的な拡大リスクと複数国間の感染症の懸念を示唆するもので、IHR基準及びWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からサンパウロに渡航した37歳男性。メニンゴコッカス性髄膜炎が確認されたが、エボラの検査は継続中。高度な感染症対応施設での隔離管理が実施されている。国境を越えた渡航とエボラの検査継続の状況から、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στη Βραζιλία: Εξετάζονται δύο ύποπτα κρούσματα Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Brazil: Two suspected Ebola cases are being examined.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola Virus Disease cases are under investigation in Brazil, with no confirmed case and ongoing close surveillance. Rio de Janeiro state health authorities activated safety protocols; the two patients are isolated in specialized facilities and closely monitored as laboratory tests proceed to confirm or exclude Ebola. A man from Uganda reportedly developed Ebola-like symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea), but the Sao Paulo city government later said he tested positive for malaria and the case remains under investigation. Since the May 15 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, there have been over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and about 250 deaths, according to Africa CDC; Uganda has confirmed several infections and one death. WHO warns the true scale in DRC may be larger than detected. Sao Paulo officials say the risk of importation into Brazil and South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでの警戒：エボラウイルス病の疑い例2件が調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラウイルス病疑い例報告は異常かつ予想外であり、国際的な拡大リスク（DRC発生との関連）がある。IHR基準2項目以上とWPRO基準複数項目に該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでのエボラ疑い例。DRC・ウガンダの情報は背景・文脈として記載されているが、実際の疑い例発生地はブラジルのリオデジャネイロ州とサンパウロ市。対象国リストではBrazil(3469034)のみ該当。マラリア陽性例も報告されているが、主要な懸念はエボラ疑い例。確定例はまだなく確認待ち段階だが、異常性と国際的影響の大きさからPICKUPとした。

article.articleHeadline: 263 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو وأوغندا و43 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths, as of last Saturday, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain and is the seventh in the DRC and the third largest since Ebola was first identified, with responses surpassing current international capacity. Health officials report critical shortages of basic supplies such as masks amid weeks of undetected spread. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Calls have been made to rapidly activate national emergency systems and sustain investments in outbreak preparedness, with international partners playing a crucial but appropriately aligned role with African strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラウイルスの確認感染者263人、死者43人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、国際的対応能力を超える規模であり、明らかに国際的懸念事象として認識される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRC のみ verified_locations に列挙。Bundibugyo株によるDRC第7回目の大規模流行であり、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。国際対応能力を超える規模との報告により、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente suspeito de Ebola em SP testa positivo para meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola Patient in São Paulo Tests Positive for Meningitis
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil – As of May 31, 2026, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, hospitalized in São Paulo with suspected Ebola, tested positive for meningococcal meningitis. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat announced laboratory confirmation of the meningitis-causing bacterium by the Adolfo Lutz Institute as part of differential diagnosis. Nevertheless, the investigation for Ebola remains ongoing until disease-specific analyses are completed. The patient’s origin from the DRC, a country currently experiencing an Ebola outbreak, along with recent travel to an outbreak country, prompted the initial case classification. Health officials emphasize that the meningitis result does not confirm Ebola, and further testing is underway to assess any potential Ebola infection. No Ebola case counts or deaths are reported in relation to this incident.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロのエボラ疑い患者が髄膜炎で陽性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCからのエボラ疑い患者がブラジルで検出された事案は、異国感染症の国際移動を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行国からの患者がブラジル（対象国）で検出された事案。エボラの確定診断はまだだが、髄膜炎陽性は確認済み。国際渡航に伴う感染症移動リスク、および複数疾患の鑑別診断が必要な状況として重要。公式発表と継続検査結果に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS en alerte maximale, le Sahel sous menace invisible - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO on high alert, the Sahel under an invisible threat - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province as the epicenter amid insecurity, mass displacement, and fragile health systems. MSF faces access barriers posed by armed groups as populations flee, potentially carrying the virus. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to supervise the response, while suspected cases in some foci reportedly rise about 15% weekly. Containment hinges on ring vaccination, strict isolation of confirmed cases, and intensive contact tracing, but field reach may take days, allowing transmission. Ebola mortality can reach 90% without rapid care. Although currently confined to eastern DRC, experts warn of regional spillover into francophone Africa via porous borders and cross-Saharan movements. In Mali and the Sahel, only two laboratories diagnose Ebola and medicine stocks are limited, prompting concerns over imported cases and questions of regional health sovereignty.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱：WHOが最高警戒レベル、サハラ以南アフリカは見えない脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべてで満たす（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準を満たし、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのIturi州（Bunia）でのエボラ集団発生が主題。サハルや隣国マリへの地域的波及リスクが明記されているが、現在確認されている実際の発生地はDRCのみ。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、毎週15%の疑い例増加、90%の致死率、武装勢力による医療アクセス阻害、大量の人口移動により、国際的拡大リスクおよび管理困難性が極めて高い。マリやサハル地域での実験室診断能力が極めて限定的であることから、輸入症例検出の遅延が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Aggasztó az ebola gyors terjedése
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly, with a suspected case under investigation in São Paulo state, Brazil, after a man recently returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo was placed in isolation. A laboratory in Bunia, Ituri Province, can now deliver results within 24 hours, avoiding sample transport 1,500 kilometers to Kinshasa. Authorities emphasize community engagement and adherence to science-based measures, including ending unsafe burial practices, to curb transmission. International donors pledged about $500 million, but aid is slow to reach the field. In Ituri's refugee camps, where nearly one million people live in crowded conditions, fear is pervasive that an Ebola breach could threaten everyone. The situation underlines the need for rapid testing, swift isolation, and robust public health responses to prevent a wider outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの急速な拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが顕著。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。シグナルとして確実に識別される。
triage.notes: DRC内でのイツリ州における急速な感染拡大とブニアでの検査体制整備が述べられており、またブラジル・サンパウロでの疑い症例が国際的拡大リスクを示唆している。難民キャンプでの100万人近い過密居住環境は流行しやすさを極度に高める。国際的な資金支援（5億ドル）が言及されているも現地への到達が遅延しており、公衆衛生対応能力の課題が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco pacientes se recuperam de variante rara do ebola no Congo, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients are recovering from a rare Ebola variant in Congo, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: Five patients diagnosed with a rare Ebola variant have recovered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros in Bunia, Ituri Province, the outbreak’s epicenter. Four were discharged on Sunday, with one previously leaving the hospital two days earlier, as a new treatment centre opens. On Friday, WHO confirmed a recovery of a patient with the Bundibugyo variant—the first documented recovery of this strain during the current outbreak; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo yet. Official data show 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. MSF warns transmission is outpacing response and urges expanded testing, rapid deployment of personnel, and sustained medical supplies. Security challenges persist, with rebel attacks including seven killed in Beni; cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu (Goma, Bukavu).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのまれなエボラ変異株から5人の患者が回復、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準で4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス感染症は高優先度疾患であり、新変異株（Bundibugyo）の確認、複数国への拡大、死亡例、セキュリティ上の課題を伴うことからフルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクを主題とし、Bundibugyo変異株の初回回復事例を報告。ウガンダでの9症例1死亡が言及されているが、記事の主焦点はDRC（特にイトゥリ州ブニア）であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。MSFによる警告、セキュリティ課題（ベニでの反政府勢力による攻撃7人死亡）、ワクチン・治療法なしという管理困難性が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda o que é o ebola: sintomas, origem e casos em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand what Ebola is: symptoms, origin, and cases under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro) are under investigation after travelers arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, amid a renewed African outbreak that prompted WHO alerts. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic disease identified in 1976 near the Ebola River; it causes fever, headache, muscle pain, weakness, sore throat, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, with a 2–21 day incubation. Transmission is not airborne; it occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects. The outbreak is centered in the DRC’s Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with Africa CDC reporting 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths. Brazil’s Health Ministry regards national risk as low and has activated the National Contingency Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers, boosting traveler surveillance and recommending a second blood test 48 hours after the first if needed. The Brazil cases remain unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスについて理解する：症状、起源、および調査中のケース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の国際的事例、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、アフリカでの大規模流行に伴う国際的ケース報告であるため。
triage.notes: ブラジルの疑い例は未確認だが、アフリカ大陸での大規模流行（DRC Ituri/North Kivu地域で1,077疑い例、246死亡）と関連しており、WHO警告後の国際事例報告として高い警戒値。記事の主題は DRC での流行とブラジルへの輸入ケースリスク。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事本体では DRC のみが明確な流行地として記述されているため verified_locations に含めない（推測防止）。

article.articleHeadline: Com SRAG em alta no Acre, médica explica impacto do El Niño em novos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SARS on the rise in Acre, a doctor explains the impact of El Niño on new cases.
article.articleSummary: In Acre, Brazil, four sentinel units recorded 7,048 influenza-like illness consultations in 2026 (Sesacre Bulletin 17/2026). The respiratory infection profile has shifted, with Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) now the leading cause of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) hospitalizations, followed by rhinovirus, and low detection of SARS-CoV-2. The 2026 scenario is described as atypical and possibly shaped by climate variations and El Niño, fueling viral evolution and transmission after the pandemic. RSV remains a major cause of hospitalization in young children, while hospital wards are predominantly filled by babies and children; outpatient visits are led by young adults aged 20–29. Pneumologist Célia Rocha links climate change, deforestation, and nutrition transitions to increased vulnerability and rapid viral mutations. Preventive measures urged include up-to-date immunization (influenza, COVID-19, and other respiratory pathogens), mask use in crowded indoor settings, regular physical activity, and adequate hydration.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州でSRAGが増加、医師がエルニーニョの新規症例への影響を説明
triage.triage_reason: RSVが重症急性呼吸器症候群(SARS)入院の主要原因として検出され、異常な季節パターンが報告されているが、死亡事例や国際的拡大の具体的な兆候は記述されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジル・アクレ州でRSVが季節外れに増加している異常なパターンが報告されている。2026年のシナリオは非定型的とされ、エルニーニョおよび気候変動との関連が指摘されている。しかし死亡数、疾患の全国規模での拡大、国際的拡大リスクについての具体的情報は記事中に含まれていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では4項目が該当するが、IHR基準では1項目のみの該当であり、またブラジルは当該対象国リストに含まれていない点も注意。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente em SP com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, in São Paulo, Brazil, a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (an Ebola outbreak area) was admitted with suspected Ebola. Blood PCR confirmed meningococcal meningitis. The São Paulo State Health Department noted that the Ebola suspicion remains under investigation as of May 30, with additional laboratory and genomic analyses planned. The patient arrived with high fever and is in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, São Paulo. This is an imported case; findings underscore the need to differentiate Ebola from meningitis in travelers from outbreak regions. No further clinical details or outcomes were provided.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者がエボラ疑い症例でメニンジェコッカス髄膜炎に陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCからのエボラ疑い輸入症例であり、メニンジェコッカス髄膜炎確認とのダブルシグナル。公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的拡散可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行地域（DRC）からの帰国者がサンパウロで受け入れられた輸入症例。初期のエボラ疑い診断がメニンジェコッカス髄膜炎と確認されたが、エボラの最終的除外にはゲノム解析を含む追加検査が進行中。1814991=China対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCおよびBrazilのみを verified_locations に列挙。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief reports 5 Ebola recoveries as a new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Ebola in eastern Congo as a new treatment center opens in Bunia, Ituri Province. WHO Director‑General Tedros said four were discharged that day and one previously, noting ongoing vaccine and treatment development despite recoveries. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. As of May 29, Congo and neighboring Uganda report 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths. Recovered patient Baraka Bulambulu described fear and stigma in the community; nurse Ezo Étienne said it took seven tests to confirm Ebola, with symptomatic care only. MSF warned the outbreak spreads faster than the response, calling for expanded testing, rapid aid deployment, and sustained supplies. Attacks by militants and distrust around burial practices hinder response, though officials express hope and urge early care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部でのエボラ患者5人の回復を報告、新しい治療センターが開設
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の発生で、IHR基準の4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・管理可能性で該当。複数国への波及とWHOによる公式報告により社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ東部（Bunia, Ituri Province）でのエボラ発生が主題。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、確認症例は「Congo and neighboring Uganda report 134 confirmed cases」と共同統計で、ウガンダが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo virus株は承認された治療法やワクチンがなく、MSFが警告する通り対応より感染拡大が速い状況。攻撃や埋葬慣行への不信など複雑な現地事情による対応の障害が指摘されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola deja ya 43 muertos y más de 263 casos confirmados en RDC y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already claimed 43 lives and more than 263 confirmed cases in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, centered in Ituri province with 245 confirmed infections, plus 15 in North Kivu and 3 in South Kivu; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases including 1 death. Since declaration, 43 deaths and over 263 confirmed cases in total; DRC records 42 deaths and 3,200 contacts identified with 967 under follow-up. On May 29, 70 samples were tested, 54 positive (77.1%). Cross-border movement from fighting between armed groups fuels regional spread; health systems are saturated and there is no authorized vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits Bunia to assess response; Uganda’s Health Minister Roger Kamba cites a four-to-six month window to defeat or contain the outbreak. Four Ebola patients recovered in Bunia; AU notes 246 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により既に43人が死亡し、DRCとウガンダで263人以上の確認感染者が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱という高致死性の感染症で、複数国における確認患者・死亡者、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに無いため verified_locations には含めない。ただし記事の内容からDRCとウガンダ両国での流行が確認されており、国際的拡大が既に進行している状況。WHO事務局長の訪問、健康相の声明など政治的関心も高い。243人の確認患者、43人の死亡者、3,200人の接触者追跡など、深刻な局面にある。

article.articleHeadline: Здравното министерство: Рискът от ебола за държавите в ЕС е много нисък, но не пътувайте към засегнатите държави
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health: The risk of Ebola for EU member states is very low, but do not travel to the affected countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for people in the EU/EEA is very low per the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control, according to Bulgaria's Ministry of Health. Nevertheless, travel to affected countries is discouraged and restricted for Bulgarian citizens. The warning relates to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as of May 17, 2026, when WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. For travelers and residents in affected areas, infection risk remains very low if precautions are followed; higher risk exists for healthcare and humanitarian workers caring for patients, though infection control keeps the risk low. Returnees should seek medical care within 21 days of symptom onset and inform health authorities of travel exposure. Ebola transmits through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; not via airborne spread. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with patients, fluids, corpses, wild animals, and practicing hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省声明：EU加盟国でのエボラリスク は極めて低いが、影響を受けた国への渡航は避けるべき
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言した多国間エボラアウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ブルガリアは対象国外であり含めない。2026年5月17日にWHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言した重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Além de São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro também registra caso suspeito de ebola - Ser Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In addition to São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro also reports a suspected case of Ebola - Ser Saúde.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-31, Rio de Janeiro health authorities monitor a Belgian man with suspected Ebola who recently visited Uganda; he has viral symptoms such as cough, chills and diarrhea but no fever or severe headache, and malaria has been diagnosed. He is isolating while the Ebola test results are awaited. The case marks Brazil’s second suspected Ebola case, after one in São Paulo. The protocol involves transferring the patient to the Evandro Chagas Institute (INI/Fiocruz) for isolation until Ebola is ruled out. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals in the acute phase. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo presented with fever; malaria tests were inconclusive, and he developed intense diarrhea and disorientation, requiring intubation. He was diagnosed with meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis; Ebola testing is pending, with results due in 48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロに加えてリオデジャネイロもエボラ疑い症例を報告 - Ser Saúde
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例が2つの主要都市（サンパウロとリオデジャネイロ）で同時に報告されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ブラジルは対象国であり、国内検査体制の確立と国際的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）の2つの疑い症例を主題としている。DRC訪問者とウガンダ訪問者が検出されたが、実際の疾病発生地はブラジルである。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはDRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、これらは患者の訪問国であり、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つため、複数地域での同時報告は極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: Homem no Emílio Ribas com suspeita de ebola tem meningite - 31/05/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man at Emílio Ribas with suspected Ebola has meningitis - 31/05/2026.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, a 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, with suspected Ebola remains in grave condition in isolation at Emílio Ribas Institute after presenting fever, diarrhea and disorientation, with rapid deterioration requiring intubation. He is from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and had recently traveled to Brazil. Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirmed Neisseria meningitidis by qPCR, diagnosing meningococcal meningitis; symptoms include severe headache, fever, nausea, vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, confusion, and skin rash. Ebola investigations continue; no local transmission has been reported. The risk of introduction is very low, and there are no direct flights from Africa. Ebola incubation is 2-21 days, with exposed asymptomatic individuals monitored for 21 days. Vaccines/therapies exist for the Zaire strain but are not proven for the Bundibugyo lineage involved in the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エミリオ・リバス病院のエボラ疑い患者は髄膜炎 - 31/05/2026
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の複合感染、国際的な移動リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラと髄膜炎の複合疑い、国際移動による導入リスク、複数国への波及可能性がある。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC出身でブラジル到着後に発症。エボラ疑い患者から髄膜球菌性髄膜炎が確認された複合感染ケース。2026年のBundibugyo系統アウトブレイク関連。公式検査結果によりNe.meningitidis確認済み。Ebolaについては調査継続中だが、発症状況と渡航歴から導入リスクあり。国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports five recoveries from rare Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak centered in Congo and Uganda. As of 2026-05-31, Congo reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; more than 130 confirmed cases and at least 18 deaths among confirmed infections in Congo and Uganda. Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death, including several infections linked to cross-border transmission from Congo. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. Recovery updates include four people to be discharged today, one discharged the day before yesterday, and an additional recovery announced on Friday—the first documented recovery from the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak was confirmed in mid-May and worsens in a region with armed conflict, displacement, and weak health infrastructure. Infections continue to outpace response; Doctors Without Borders urges expanded testing, faster deployment of personnel, and improved humanitarian access. Tedros emphasizes community involvement; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが稀なエボラ株からの5例の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域として列挙されているが、サマリーでは康復事例の情報が主で、感染症イベントの実質的な発生地はコンゴが中心。コンゴはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれないため、確認された対象国はなし。ただしエボラ・ウイルス病は WHO PHEIC 宣言済みの重大事象であり、地域検証対象外でも PICKUP 判定は維持される。

article.articleHeadline: تعافي 5 حالات من إيبولا شرقي الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients recover in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola virus disease patients have recovered in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, the outbreak’s epicenter. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited an Ebola treatment center in Bunia and announced four discharges on the day of his visit and one discharge on the prior Saturday, all from a rare Ebola strain. The visit underscores ongoing response efforts and the push for vaccines and treatments. WHO reports 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths in the area. The report does not specify lab-confirmed totals or transmission sources, nor details on imported or exported cases. Emphasis remains on patient recovery alongside continued public health measures to curb transmission in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 5例のエボラ患者がコンゴ東部で回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い重症度と国際的拡大リスクを持つ疾患であり、IHR基準で2つ以上該当。DRCにおける906疑い例と223疑い死亡の報告は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、シグナルピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Ebola）は WHO PHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）の対象疾患。記事では DRC Ituri州 Bunia地域における906疑い例と223疑い死亡が報告されており、WHOが治療センター訪問を行うなど国際的な対応が進行中。ただし記事は回復例に焦点を当てた速報性の高い報道であり、検査確認例数や感染源の詳細は記載されていない。継続的な監視と詳細情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un Belge isolé au Brésil après des symptômes compatibles avec Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Belgian isolated in Brazil after symptoms compatible with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Belgian man isolated in Brazil after Ebola-like symptoms. He was admitted to a Rio de Janeiro hospital (Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas) with cough, chills and diarrhea after arriving from a region with Ebola outbreaks, Uganda. Infection control protocols were activated at Fiocruz's Ebola reference center in Rio de Janeiro. While Ebola diagnostic tests are underway, preliminary findings revealed the patient has malaria, with fever, headaches and muscle pains typical of malaria. The patient was initially treated at home before transport in a specially equipped ambulance, with medical staff in protective gear. Health authorities launched contact tracing to identify anyone exposed, who are urged to report symptoms such as high fever, headaches, or joint pains. If Ebola is confirmed, it would mark the first case in the state of Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで隔離されたベルギー人、エボラに相応する症状
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例の国際的な移動（ウガンダ→ブラジル）であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ブラジルでのエボラ確定事例となれば新規流入事象として重大。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの感染地域滞在後のブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）での隔離を述べている。暫定検査でマラリア陽性だが、エボラ検査が進行中。確定前の段階だが、国際的な感染症移動として高リスク。ベルギー（Belgium）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加していない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief reports 5 Ebola recoveries as a new treatment center opens in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola in Bunia, Ituri, Congo, as a new Ebola treatment center opens. Four were discharged today and one yesterday, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The current outbreak strain, Bundibugyo virus, has no approved treatment or vaccine. Authorities report 134 confirmed cases in Congo and neighboring Uganda, with 18 deaths as of May 29. Recovered patients described fear and stigma; one patient required seven tests before Ebola was confirmed. Treatment is supportive (fluids, antiemetics, pain relief) rather than disease-specific. MSF warns the virus spreads faster than the response and calls for expanded testing, quicker aid deployment, and sustained medical supplies. Attacks on health centers and burial-practice tensions hinder response; community involvement is emphasized. The outbreak affects Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部での新しい治療センター開設に伴い、エボラ5例の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の既知感染例、越境例、治療困難性、医療システムへの負荷、国際的支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載されたウガンダは越境確認例の言及にとどまり、記事の主題はコンゴ東部（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）の発生である。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola virus（承認治療法なし、致死率18/152=約11.8%）の急速な拡大、医療施設への攻撃、埋葬慣行との相克など複合的課題が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil monitors two patients for Ebola amid fears of spread from Africa
article.articleSummary: Two patients in Brazil are being monitored for Ebola amid fears the central-African outbreak could spread. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, presenting fever and Ebola-defining symptoms, was isolated in a São Paulo infectious disease facility after initial tests were negative. A second potential case in Rio de Janeiro state involves a Ugandan man with cough, chills and diarrhoea; malaria testing returned positive and the case remains under investigation. Since the north-eastern DRC outbreak was confirmed about two weeks ago, the WHO reports 1,028 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; limited testing kits for the Bundibugyo strain mean many suspected cases lack confirmation, suggesting the true toll is higher. MSF describes rapid spread and uncertain scale. Uganda and Rwanda have closed borders with DRC; the United States has banned entry for non-U.S. travelers who recently visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan; Kenya's quarantine-centre plan was blocked.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アフリカからの感染拡大の懸念のなかエボラ熱の患者2名を監視中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的な地理的拡大リスクが具体的に示されており、IHR基準で「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当。複数国での対応措置と確定例の国際移動パターンがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、DRC発のエボラ熱アウトブレイク（1,028疑い例、223疑い死亡）がブラジルへの患者移動を示す具体的事例を記述。対象国リスト内ではBrazilとDRCのみが実際の発生地として言及されている。Uganda、Rwanda、Kenya、Sudan、USは対応や制限措置の実施国として登場するが、サマリー上での疾病イベント発生地ではない。マラリアは第2症例で併存検査陽性だが、主要懸念はエボラ熱の国際移動リスク。

article.articleHeadline: O que sabemos até agora sobre os dois casos de suspeita de Ebola no Brasil | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What we know so far about the two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil under investigation as of 31 May 2026. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old traveler who recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo—the site of an Ebola outbreak with about 220 deaths under investigation—arrived gravely ill and was initially treated for malaria. Meningococcal meningitis was later confirmed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz, but Ebola diagnostics continue at Instituto Emílio Ribas under biosafety protocols. In Rio de Janeiro, a patient who traveled from Uganda—near the DRC border—presented with diarrhea, chills and cough and remains isolated at Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas while clinicians rule out Ebola; malaria is diagnosed, with contact tracing by SES-RJ and state health authorities ongoing. Ebola transmits via body fluids, not airborne, with a 2–21 day incubation; no vaccine exists, so prevention centers on avoiding contact with ill individuals or animals and strict infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで疑わしいエボラ2例についてこれまでに分かっていることは何か | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例（南米での稀な輸入例）、DRCでのアウトブレイク関連、複数国での接触履歴、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）でのエボラ疑い例が主題。DRCおよびウガンダは患者の渡航歴の文脈で言及されているが、イベント発生地はブラジルである。複数の疾患（Ebola、Meningococcal Meningitis、Malaria、Chagas）が列挙されているが、記事の焦点はエボラの疑い例。生物安全防護プロトコル下での診断継続中で、感染制御対策が実施されている。南米でのエボラ疑い例は極めて稀であり、国際的な懸念の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil investigates two possible Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Two possible Ebola virus disease cases under monitoring in Brazil: a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever who met the suspected case definition; initial Ebola testing was negative and he is isolated at a specialized infectious disease facility in Sao Paulo. In Rio de Janeiro, a man from Uganda with cough, chills, and diarrhea triggered safety protocols; officials later said malaria testing was positive and the case remains under investigation. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, has generated over 1,000 suspected cases and around 250 deaths, with confirmed infections and one death in Uganda; WHO warns the outbreak may be broader than detected. Sao Paulo officials say the risk of introduction into Brazil/South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの可能性のある2症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体の国際的な疑い症例であり、DRC発生地域からの流入が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）でエボラ疑い症例が調査中であり、DRC発生地域からの患者流入が確認されている。DRC発生地域は対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントは国際的な感染症危機（DRC大規模エボラ流行）の新地域への流入である点で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Over 40 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda
