article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving a growing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) and neighboring Uganda. As of May 30, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 43 confirmed deaths (42 in Congo, 1 in Uganda) and 349 suspected deaths, with 272 confirmed cases (263 in Congo, 9 in Uganda). Africa CDC lists 263 confirmed cases across both countries and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. Reservoir likely fruit bat; human infection follows contact with infected wildlife secretions and spreads via person-to-person transmission, with burial practices heightening risk. WHO DG Tedros visited Bunia, urged against unsafe burials and cautioned against travel bans and border closures; five patients in Bunia recovered as a new Ebola treatment center opened. Congo has faced multiple Ebola outbreaks; this marks its 17th.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱で40人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に懸念される重篤な感染症であり、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、承認済み治療法・ワクチンの欠如により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)への拡大言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内の具体的な発生地は Ituri州の Bunia。272確認症例、43確認死亡、349疑い死亡との報告。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、埋葬慣行についての公開警告などから政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja 43 muertos y más de 260 contagios confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves 43 dead and more than 260 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has caused at least 43 deaths and 263 confirmed cases, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as regional risk rises due to population movement. In the DRC, Ituri Province reports the highest burden (245 confirmed), followed by North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases, including 1 death. The circulating Bundibugyo variant has no authorized vaccine and no approved specific treatments, hampering containment efforts. Ongoing armed conflict in northern and northeastern DRC has driven mass displacement and highly permeable borders, aiding spread. About 3,200 contacts have been identified, with around 1,000 under epidemiological surveillance. On May 29, labs processed 70 samples, 54 positive (positivity >77%). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to coordinate responses; containment could take 4–6 months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が43人の死亡と260人以上の確認患者を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo variant）は最高レベルの公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダは9確認患者、1死亡」と二次的な位置づけ。主要なイベント発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo variant、高い死亡率（43/263≈16.3%）、武装紛争による人口移動、接触者3,200人以上、WHO事務局長による現地訪問など、最高度の対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Ponad 1100 podejrzewanych przypadków eboli jest wciąż badanych
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: Over 1,100 suspected cases of Ebola are still under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda persists. Africa CDC chief Dr. Jean Kaseya reported 1,077 suspected infections and 246 probable deaths since the official outbreak start. By May 30, 2026, 263 cases had been laboratory-confirmed in DRC and Uganda. Within the confirmed group, laboratory tests verified 129 infections in the DRC and 8 in Uganda, linked to travel from the DRC. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC and the third-largest by size, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain. Over 1,100 suspected cases remain under investigation, with 43 deaths confirmed in this lineage. Ituri province in eastern DRC has seen attacks on medical centers and staff, hampering contact tracing. Eleven countries at risk include South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, and Somalia. The virus circulated asymptomatically for about four weeks before confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: 1,100件以上のエボラ疑い事例が現在も調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCおよびウガンダで263確定例、246名の死亡が報告されており、11カ国でリスクがある。国際的な拡大リスクが高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確にある。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo株によるエボラ発生をDRCを中心に報道しており、ウガンダとの国境を越えた伝播も言及。対象国リストではDRCのみが確認される。医療施設への攻撃により接触者追跡が阻害されており、管理可能性に課題がある。11カ国でリスク評価されているが、具体的な確定例はDRCとウガンダで報告。

article.articleHeadline: Symptômes compatibles: Ebola suspecté: deux hommes à l'isolement au Brésil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms compatible with suspected Ebola: two men in isolation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Two men in Brazil are in isolation with symptoms compatible with Ebola. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), in Sao Paulo, presented fever and is under isolation while tests are pending. A second man from Uganda, who arrived in Brazil on May 22 and is in Rio de Janeiro, showed viral symptoms including cough, chills and diarrhea; he was tested positive for malaria, and his Ebola status remains under investigation. Brazilian authorities say the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil and South America remains very low. The Ebola outbreak has been declared in eastern DRC since May 15, with the virus detected in three Congolese provinces; Uganda also reports cases, with two new confirmed on Friday, bringing Uganda’s confirmed total to nine. Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths in DRC; the WHO has issued an international health alert.

triage.headline_ja: 症状一致：エボラ疑い：ブラジルで2人が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い例が複数国から入国者に検出され、DRCでの発生宣言と連動した国際的な懸念事象。
triage.notes: DRCからの渡航者および隣国からの渡航者がブラジルで検出。DRCでのエボラ発生宣言（5月15日）と時間的に関連。WHOからの国際保健警報が発出されている。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Resumen: La madre de Agostina internada, encontraron los restos de Agostina en Córdoba, brote de ebola y más...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summary: Agostina's mother hospitalized, Agostina's remains found in Córdoba, Ebola outbreak and more...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains active as of May 31, 2026, with the World Health Organization reporting rapid transmission that outpaces containment efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the hardest-hit region to assess the situation and called for accelerated resource mobilization, enhanced epidemiological surveillance, and stronger infection control measures. The briefing provides no updated case or death counts, no laboratory confirmation details, and does not specify the exact districts affected. The report highlights concern that the pace of spread may undermine current containment strategies, underscoring the need for rapid international support to stop transmission and prevent cross-border spread. No further clinical or transmission-source details are provided in this brief.

triage.headline_ja: 要約：アゴスティーナの母が入院、アゴスティーナの遺骨がコルドバで発見、エボラ感染症アウトブレイクなど...
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクは、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのすべてを満たす。WHO事務局長による現地視察と国際支援の呼びかけが認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには具体的な症例数や死亡数、検査確認の詳細が記載されていないが、WHO事務局長による現地視察と国際支援の緊急呼びかけが記述されており、アウトブレイクの深刻性が確認できる。コンゴ民主共和国での発生が明確に述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO calls for community cooperation to contain DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri province (Bunia) caused by Bundibugyo virus continues; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. As of 31 May 2026 WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in DRC; five patients recovered and four more were to be discharged on Sunday. Uganda confirms nine cases and one death. Brazil monitors two potential infections in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro - one 37-year-old man from DRC with fever (suspected case) and a Ugandan visitor with viral symptoms. Protests over body-burial protocols accompany the outbreak; call for community involvement and a ceasefire to protect health workers; Tedros says it's everybody's business. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern; MSF warns rapid spread with hundreds of samples untested. International aid includes EU supplies; US adds US$80 million, bringing total to US$112 million. Africa CDC urges rapid activation of national incident systems and lasting pandemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCエボラアウトブレイク封じ込めのためのコミュニティ協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）によるDRC Ituri州での大規模アウトブレイク（906疑い例、223死亡）で、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言を発令。ウガンダでの確認例、ブラジルでの疑い例と、複数国への拡大が示唆される。IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラ・ウイルス（Bundibugyo型）はワクチンが存在しない。DRC Ituri州（Bunia）での900例超の疑い例、ウガンダでの確認例9例1死亡、ブラジルでの疑い例（DRCからの帰国者）が報告されている。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。複数国の政府支援（米国$80M追加、EU供給）と国際機関（MSF、Africa CDC）が関与。発生地域にはウガンダも含まれるが、記事の主題は DRC（Ituri州 Bunia）でのアウトブレイクであり、3国すべてが verified_locations に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Scenariu de coșmar. Cupa Mondială riscă să devină un focar global de Ebola: mii de persoane ar putea fi infectate fără să știe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nightmare scenario. The World Cup risks becoming a global Ebola outbreak: thousands of people could be infected without knowing.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, ahead of the 48-team FIFA World Cup in North America, Ebola risk rises as millions of fans travel to the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant, has been identified in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, where it has caused over 220 deaths. Authorities warn that over 2,000 potential virus carriers remain unidentified, and the outbreak continues to grow. Experts caution that asymptomatic travelers could reach North America; a single infected spectator could trigger panic and prompt swift public-health actions. Measures are being implemented at major airports; host nations may tighten screening before matches involving high-risk teams, with a view to preventing an epidemic. Dr. Katherine O'Reilly notes the overall risk is low but cannot be ignored; comparisons to the 2014 West Africa outbreak are cited. DRC is participating in this World Cup, the tournament's largest format to date.

triage.headline_ja: 悪夢のシナリオ。ワールドカップがエボラのグローバルアウトブレイクになるリスク：数千人が知らないうちに感染する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラの国際的なスポーツイベント関連での拡大シナリオは高い社会政治的関心を持つシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは仮想シナリオ（2026年のワールドカップを想定）として読まれるが、実際の発生地域はウガンダとDRC（Bundibugyo株）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。北米（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）への国際的拡大リスクはシナリオベースだが、実在するBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク（DRC/ウガンダ）の報道に基づくシグナル。本質的に高リスクイベント関連のシグナルであり、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil monitors two patients for Ebola amid fears of spread from Africa
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026: Brazil is monitoring two patients for Ebola amid fears of spread from Africa. The Telegraph reports Brazilian health authorities are evaluating two individuals for possible Ebola infection, with no laboratory confirmation disclosed in the excerpt. The piece highlights heightened concern about Ebola transmission from African outbreak regions into Brazil and notes official vigilance without detailing symptoms, dates of exposure, or infection source. No case counts beyond the two monitored individuals are stated, and there is no information on where in Brazil the patients are receiving care or the outcome of testing. The report attributes the information to Africa Correspondent Ben Farmer and The Telegraph’s Global Health Security team; additional specifics are not provided in the available text.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アフリカからの感染拡大への懸念の中でエボラ患者2名を監視
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がブラジルで報告されており、国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準3該当）が存在するが、ラボ確認がなく、症例の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラの疑い患者がブラジルで報告されていることが明確であり、Brazilを verified_locations に含める。Africaは大陸名のため具体的国家ではなく除外。ラボ確認がないこと、患者の詳細情報が不明であること、症例数が2名のみで限定的であることから、確定的な判定を控え WATCH とした。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente monitorado por suspeita de ebola no Rio testa positivo para malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient monitored for suspected Ebola in Rio tests positive for malaria.
article.articleSummary: Belgian traveler arriving in Rio de Janeiro from Uganda tested positive for malaria, quashing initial suspicion of Ebola. The patient remains hospitalized at Fiocruz’s Instituto Nacional de Infectologia under observation. The illness presented with a mild clinical picture compatible with various infections, prompting precautionary monitoring. The malaria diagnosis was confirmed late on May 30, 2026. The case is not considered a confirmed Ebola infection; authorities continue a broader investigation for possible viral hemorrhagic fever, a group that includes Ebola, until all required tests and evaluations are completed. The investigation is led by the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) in collaboration with the State Health Secretariat and Fiocruz. Contacts who had contact with the patient are under preventive monitoring while health surveillance reviews the epidemiological scenario and ongoing outbreak considerations in Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでエボラ疑い患者がマラリア陽性を判定
triage.triage_reason: マラリア確定診断で当初のエボラ疑いが解消されたが、当局が広範なウイルス性出血熱の調査を継続しており、情報が進行中である。未確定の段階でのシグナル拾い上げ基準は部分的に満たすが、最終診断により懸念が低減した。
triage.notes: 記事主題はリオデジャネイロ（ブラジル）での確定診断事例。ウガンダからの旅行者だが、発症地はブラジル。当初エボラ疑いで注視されたが、マラリア確定により懸念が低減。ただし当局が広範なウイルス性出血熱の調査を継続中のため、追加の検査結果待機が必要。ベルギーは旅行者の出発地で発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 1100 sumnjivih slučajeva ebole, WHO proglasio izvanredno stanje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases, WHO declared a state of emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda comprises 263 confirmed cases and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation, with 43 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The epidemic—the 17th in the DRC and the third largest since the virus’s discovery—has expanded in recent weeks with undetected transmission. Health authorities warn of critical shortages of basic supplies, including protective masks, as outbreak response lags behind transmission. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for Ebola in the DRC and Uganda, signaling international focus and the need for heightened action and sustained preparedness. Uncertainty persists regarding transmission dynamics and containment, underscoring the urgency of rapid national crisis response and long-term pandemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の疑い例が1,100件以上、WHOが緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国への拡大、PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、国際的関心が明確。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Uganda（共和国ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国(203312)に該当し、記事サマリーに明記されているため含める。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、43死亡、263確認例、1,100以上の疑い例という重大な状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Reports 5 Ebola Recoveries
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare Ebola virus strain in Bunia, eastern Congo, during a 2026-05-31 visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus to inaugurate a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province. Four recoveries were discharged on 2026-05-31 and one on 2026-05-29. The remarks emphasize ongoing vaccine and treatment development while noting that recovery from Ebola remains possible. Bunia sits at the heart of the outbreak. The report does not provide total case counts, fatalities, transmission details, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources, nor any information on imported or exported cases. The update highlights progress in patient outcomes within the ongoing outbreak response led by the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ感染症から5人の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生は深刻で異常だが、5件の回復報告という限定的な情報のみで、全体的な疫学情報（総症例数、死亡数、感染源、伝播詳細）が不足している。さらなる続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は回復事例という肯定的なニュースに焦点を当てているが、エボラ感染症という疾患の性質上、深刻度は高い。ただし、総症例数、死亡数、伝播様式、検査確認、感染源など重要な疫学情報が欠落しており、完全なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Sospetto caso di Ebola a Cagliari: paziente in ospedale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: a patient was transported to Santissima Trinità hospital’s infectious diseases unit after being picked up at home with symptoms compatible with Ebola. Authorities activated containment protocols; police, fire service and local agents attended, and medical staff wearing PPE conducted the initial assessment. The patient had reportedly arrived from abroad, nationality not disclosed. Italy is pushing for tighter border controls and has dispatched Spallanzani Institute experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni proposed placing border-management on the European Council agenda (June 18–19, 2026) and coordinating with health ministers via videoconference next week ahead of EPSCO on June 16 to define priorities. Africa CDC data as of May 30 cite 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases, indicating ongoing regional outbreak risk and international support efforts.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑わしいエボラ出血熱の症例：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、イタリアでの疑い患者発生は異常・予想外。DRC/ウガンダでの既知の流行がある中での国際的な事例であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準4つ以上該当。欧州レベルでの政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: イタリア（Cagliari）での疑い患者報告は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、既知の流行地であるDRCとウガンダからの国際的移動に関連する事例として、DRCのみを記載。Africa CDC データで DRC/ウガンダでの確認症例263例、死亡43例、疑い症例1,100例以上という大規模な流行背景がある。イタリア首相やEU当局が国境管理を欧州評議会の議題に挙げるなど、高い政治的関心が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Подозрение на Эболу в Кальяри: пациент доставлен в больницу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Cagliari: Patient Transported to Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia: a patient was hospitalized at Santissima Trinità Infectious Diseases Unit after being picked up from home with fever and symptoms compatible with Ebola; the individual recently returned from abroad, and nationality was not disclosed. Italian authorities activated border controls and prepared a coordinated response; Rome has dispatched Spallanzani Institute experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and Prime Minister Meloni proposed including border management in EU discussions, with health ministers’ videoconference and the EPSCO Council meeting on June 16–19, 2026 to set operational priorities. Africa CDC updates as of May 30 report 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases. Officials warn the outbreak region is under strain and that regional spread is possible, while international partners bolster the African response.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリにおけるエボラ疑い患者：患者が病院に搬送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の疑い患者がイタリアで検出され、DRCとウガンダでの流行との関連性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア（対象国リストに含まれていない）での疑い患者について述べているが、同時にDRCおよびウガンダでの確認された流行ケース（263確認例、43死亡）が詳述されている。verified_locationsには実際の感染症発生が確認されている対象国であるDRCのみを列挙した。イタリアでの疑い患者は検査待機中であり未確認のため対象国外として除外。国際的なシグナルの重要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ‏43 وفاة و263 حالة إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو ‏وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 43 deaths and 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Africa CDC reports 43 deaths and 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, amid an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. Uganda has recorded 7 confirmed Bundibugyo infections since the outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province, northeast DRC near the Ugandan border, and has temporarily closed its borders with DRC. The outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the third largest since discovery, with counts surpassing many international responses. Healthcare workers warn of severe resource shortages, including masks, undermining containment. Africa CDC Director-General John Kasia urged rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investment in outbreak preparedness, stressing that international partners’ support must align with African strategies. The agency also warned that 10 African countries face Ebola threats beyond DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラウイルス病の死亡者43人と確定症例263人を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の複数国での確認されたアウトブレイク、重大な死亡率と症例数、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境を越えた発生）、国境閉鎖と国際支援要請が明確である。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしサマリーではウガンダのエボラ確定症例（7件）が明示されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。重症度（死亡43人、確定症例263人、疑い症例1,100以上）、国際的拡大（ウガンダでの確認）、資源不足による管理課題、Africa CDC による国際支援要請が複合的に存在し、迅速なRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Minta Negara Tak Gegabah Tutup Perbatasan Saat Ebola Merebak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Urges Countries Not to Rush to Close Borders as Ebola Spreads.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the WHO urges countries not to rush border closures as Ebola spreads from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In Bunia, Ituri Province, the outbreak has reported more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases. Uganda has nine confirmed cases, with two new infections detected in Kampala. The DRC aims to contain transmission in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and has strengthened laboratory capacity: about 900 samples tested, roughly 260 positives; daily testing capacity now 200–300 samples. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that travel bans can hinder health teams and transparent reporting, even though no vaccine or specific therapy is approved. He emphasized rapid, quality medical care and community trust as key. Authorities estimate 4–6 months to end the outbreak in best-case scenarios.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ感染拡大時に国境封鎖を急がないよう求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。DRC・ウガンダでの複数地域での1,000件超の疑い患者と複数の確定例、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）も地理的に関連し確定例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（1,000件超の疑い患者）であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。エボラウイルス疾患は高致死率、急速な人獲得感染性、国際的懸念の特性から、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة "إيبولا" في الكونغو وأوغندا لأكثر من 300 وفاة وإصابة - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda rises to more than 300 deaths and infections - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan and the world.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have reached 263 laboratory-confirmed infections and 43 deaths, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation through May 30, 2026. The cases are attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare lineage. The current outbreak is the seventeenth in the DRC and the third largest since the virus’s discovery, and it surpasses the capacity of the global response. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Health authorities report shortages of basic supplies such as masks, hampering containment efforts. Officials are urging rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investments in outbreak preparedness, stressing that international support is most effective when aligned with African strategies and institutions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の患者数が300人以上に：コンゴとウガンダでの感染者数と死亡数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み。フルリスク評価（RRA）進行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は Bluedot API の発生地域に含まれているが、評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため記載。PHEIC 宣言済みで国際的関心は極めて高く、緊急の対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite: sintomas podem ser confundidos com Ebola? | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis: can symptoms be confused with Ebola? | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil: a 37-year-old man with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo—an Ebola-affected country—is hospitalized with suspected Ebola. He has a laboratory-confirmed meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis. Ebola laboratory confirmation has not been obtained; investigations continue. The patient is in isolation after fever, diarrhea, and disorientation requiring intubation, and officials caution that Ebola cannot be ruled out, as dual infection remains possible with similar symptoms. The case highlights the challenge of differential diagnosis between Ebola and meningitis. Ebola incubation is 2–21 days, with transmission via contact with bodily fluids. Meningococcal meningitis presents with fever, headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, photophobia, confusion, and poor responsiveness, and spreads through respiratory droplets. The patient remains under care at Instituto Emílio Ribas after initial testing at Instituto Adolfo Lutz.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎：症状はエボラウイルス病と混同される可能性があるか？ | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国での検査確認事例・診断困難性により公衆衛生上の懸念がある。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・異常性・流行リスク等複数該当。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国（エボラ流行地）への渡航歴を持つブラジル在住者で、髄膜炎確定診断だがエボラ検査陰性未確定。重症度（挿管要）と診断困難性により国境を越えた公衆衛生懸念あり。メディア関心も高い（CNN）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Neues Behandlungszentrum und erste Überlebende
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: New treatment center and first survivors.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) reports five recoveries from Bundibugyo Ebola virus as a new treatment center opens; four more patients to be discharged the same day, with one already released two days earlier. Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Africa CDC tallies 263 confirmed cases in Congo and Uganda as of May 30, with 43 deaths and over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The WHO confirms the first documented recovery of a Bundibugyo patient in this outbreak. MSF notes faster spread despite better facilities, due to PPE and testing shortages, urging more tests, faster deployment, and reliable supplies. Survivors describe delays in confirmation and symptomatic treatment only. Tedros appeals for international funding; WHO has received about one-third of required funds; Congo has allocated $20 million. Africa CDC expects a vaccine by year-end; containment is challenged by IS-linked ADF and Rwanda-backed M23 rebel attacks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行：新しい治療センターと最初の生存者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。高い死亡率、確定症例263件、疑い例1,100件以上、複数国への拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDB)の流行。DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアが主要な発生地。ウガンダへの国際的拡大も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ワクチン未承認、特異的治療法なし、反政府勢力（ADF、M23）による紛争が対策を阻害している。WHO資金確保率が3分の1程度で、国際的支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades brasileiras investigam dois casos suspeitos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian authorities investigate two suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil, in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo presented with fever and met the case definition for suspected Ebola and is in isolation at a specialized infectious-disease institute, but laboratory tests did not confirm the illness. In Rio de Janeiro, authorities activated safety measures for a man arriving from Uganda with viral symptoms such as cough, chills, and diarrhea; the city later said malaria testing was positive and the case remains under investigation. The DR Congo declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, with Africa CDC reporting more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; the virus has also been detected in Uganda. The WHO activated an international health alert. São Paulo’s health secretariat says the risk of entry into Brazil/South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル当局がエボラの2つの疑い例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当、WHO国際保健警報発動、対象国（ブラジル）での疑い例が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行拡大に伴い、対象国ブラジルで疑い例が報告された重要なシグナル。記事サマリーに基づき、DRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルのリスク評価は「低い」とされているが、国際的なエボラ流行の拡大局面における輸入症例の報告として警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolagyanús eset Cagliariban: beteg kórházban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-suspected case in Cagliari: patient hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: On 31 May 2026, in Cagliari, Sardinia, a person was hospitalized at Santissima Trinità hospital’s infectious diseases center after Ebola-like symptoms; the patient, who had recently traveled abroad, was placed under hospital observation and transported in PPE. Authorities initiated Ebola protocols; nationality not disclosed. Italy is pushing tighter border controls and has dispatched experts from the Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo; Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni proposed discussing border management at the 18–19 June European Council, with a health ministers’ video conference planned next week and EPSCO on June 16 to set priorities. Africa CDC reports Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda: 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of May 30, with over 1,100 suspected cases, signaling ongoing regional spillover risk and need for international support.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでのエボラ疑い症例：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また WPRO スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア（カリアリ）での疑い症例を報じているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし DRC および Uganda でのエボラ活動（263 確定症例、43 死亡、1,100+ 疑い症例）が明記されており、DRC は対象国に該当するため含める。イタリアの患者は DRC との関連が示唆され、EU レベルでの対応強化（国境管理、ヨーロッパ評議会での討議予定）が記されており、国際的懸念が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола удари и Бразилия? Разследват два предполагаеми случая
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did Ebola hit Brazil too? Two suspected cases under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus disease cases are under surveillance in Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro). The first is a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo with fever who meets the suspected-case definition; initial tests did not confirm Ebola, and he remains isolated with continuous medical monitoring as a precaution. The second case involves a man from Uganda with cough, chills and diarrhea; subsequent testing returned positive for malaria, but the Ebola status is not yet confirmed. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and about 250 suspected deaths since the outbreak began in May; Uganda has several confirmed infections and one death. Brazilian authorities say there is no current basis for panic, and risk of spread in Brazil or South America remains very low, with enhanced surveillance and readiness to respond if needed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがブラジルにも？2つの疑い例が調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク、公衆衛生への影響）。エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な拡大事例であり、複数国での患者発生により公開衛生上の重大な関心事項。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い例がブラジル（新興地域）で検出され、DRCおよびウガンダでの既知の大規模流行との関連性がある。ブラジル当局は現在のリスク評価は低いと述べているが、国際的な疾病拡大の可能性がある。ウガンダも記事中に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: World Health Organization hails recovery of five Ebola patients
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus disease have recovered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with four discharged on May 31, 2026 and one discharged on May 29, after the outbreak was declared about two weeks earlier. The latest Ebola outbreak in DRC is the 17th and has caused more than 220 suspected deaths. The responders operate from a newly opened Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province. Unlike Ebola Zaire, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or treatment, and authorities report scarce medical supplies. The outbreak’s response is further challenged by anger over body-management protocols and the ongoing presence of armed groups in eastern Congo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged armed factions to declare a ceasefire to aid control efforts; MSF called the situation deeply alarming.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ患者5人の回復を称賛
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、社会的関心あり。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（17回目、220人以上の死亡疑い）はシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラウイルス疾患が報告されており、承認されたワクチンや治療法がない。武装勢力の存在、医療物資の不足、遺体処理プロトコルに対する不満など、対応に複数の課題がある。WHOとMSFが国際的な懸念を表明している。

article.articleHeadline: Over 40 Dead In Ebola Outbreak In Dr Congo And Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, described by WHO as a severe, often fatal form. As of Saturday, 43 confirmed deaths (42 in Congo, 1 in Uganda) and 349 suspected deaths; 272 confirmed cases (263 Congo, 9 Uganda). Africa CDC reports 263 confirmed cases across Congo and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected under investigation. Root source believed to be bats, with spillover to humans via wildlife contact; ongoing human-to-human transmission and elevated risk from unsafe funeral practices. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia in Ituri province, urging against unsafe funeral practices and asking countries to reconsider recreation bans and separator closures, which he said discourage transparency. Five patients in Bunia recovered; vaccination and treatment efforts continue. This is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, and authorities aim to contain it.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ感染症流行で40人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。高い致死率の出血熱で複数国に拡大し、WHO事務局長も現地訪問しており、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に除外。ただしサマリー上ではウガンダでも確認されており、越境感染の危機的状況を示している。Bundibugyo エボラ型、致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染＋葬儀習慣による感染リスク有。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的関心の高さを示すシグナル。コンゴの17番目の流行。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 43 morti e 263 casi confermati in Congo e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, 43 deaths and 263 confirmed cases in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northern Democratic Republic of the Congo and adjacent Uganda has caused 43 deaths and 263 laboratory-confirmed cases, with more than 1,100 suspected. The majority of confirmed infections are in the DRC, particularly Ituri province, which accounts for about 88% of cases; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases, including 1 death. Ongoing fighting and cross-border population movement are driving transmission, while health systems are overwhelmed and there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this Ebola strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, Ituri, to assess the situation and support containment, as Kinshasa aims to curb the outbreak within four to six months, leveraging its prior outbreak experience. Italy issued an ordinance requiring declaration and reporting for travelers from DRC and Uganda or those who were in the affected areas within 21 days; the Bundibugyo strain risk is deemed low, but precautionary measures apply.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴとウガンダで43人の死亡と263人の確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されたウガンダでの9確認症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。DRCのIturi州が症例の約88%を占める。Bundibugyo株で治療法・ワクチンがない状況。イタリアが既に渡航者報告措置を実施。WHO事務局長が現地入りし、対応に当たっている。

article.articleHeadline: حالة إيبولا مشتبه بها في كالياري: إدخال المريض إلى المستشفى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient admitted to hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy, after a traveler returning from abroad was admitted to the Santissima Trinità Hospital's infectious diseases unit. Health protocols were activated; police, fire services, and local officers attended while clinicians in protective gear treated and transported the patient. The patient's nationality was not disclosed. Italy is tightening border controls, sending experts from Rome's Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni proposed adding border-management to the EU Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026. To prepare, a video conference of health ministers is planned next week, and the ISPCO Council will meet on 16 June to set priorities. Africa CDC Director Jan Kasia told the Financial Times that by 30 May there were 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases, signaling ongoing regional transmission risk and Africa-led international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑わしいエボラの症例: 患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例が報告され、IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。DRC/ウガンダでの確認症例263例・死亡43例という実際の流行背景とイタリアでの輸入症例の報告により、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: イタリアで報告されたカリアリの疑い症例は対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーの主題は DRC・ウガンダにおける確認されたエボラ流行（263確認症例、43死亡）とその国際的波及リスク。イタリアの症例は DRC からの輸入に関連しており、DRC が対象国リストに含まれるため DRC のみを列挙。Africa CDC による regional transmission risk の指摘とイタリア政府による国境管理強化提案により、国際的な関心と対応が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil suma un nuevo caso sospechoso de ébola y refuerza la vigilancia sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records a new suspected case of Ebola and strengthens public health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Brazil investigates a new suspected Ebola case in Rio de Janeiro state, a man from Uganda with viral symptoms; isolation and epidemiological surveillance are activated, with initial malaria-positive tests while Ebola is still under evaluation. A second suspected case in São Paulo involves a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fever-compatible and in isolation at the Emilio Ribas Institute of Infectology, awaiting laboratory confirmation. Health authorities maintain monitoring in both states, but the risk of Ebola introduction is considered low due to no local transmission and limited direct air links with Africa. The Congo outbreak, along with cases in Uganda, has triggered a WHO alert; Africa CDC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths in the current epidemic. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted via contact with bodily fluids; strict containment measures remain in place.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラウイルスの新たな疑似患者を記録し、公衆衛生監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的拡大の初期段階を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症（致死率が高い病原体）の国際的な拡大事例。ウガンダ及びコンゴでの流行がブラジルに波及。現地での二次感染は限定的と報告されているが、WHO警告が発令されており国際的監視対象。Bluedot発生地域にはアフリカ大陸全体が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はブラジル・コンゴの事例に限定されるため、verified_locationsはこれら2国のみに絞定した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola response: US helps Kenya with specialised health facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya, in partnership with the United States, is developing a specialised health facility in Laikipia to bolster monitoring, isolation, and emergency response against Ebola and other infectious threats. The move follows the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, highlighting that infectious diseases cross borders. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said Kenya should remain vigilant as a regional hub for trade, travel and commerce. The Laikipia facility will enhance disease surveillance, diagnostic capacity, emergency preparedness exercises, critical medical supplies, and rapid response systems, complementing existing isolation and treatment facilities at Kenyatta National Hospital, Kenya National Police Hospital, and Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital. The investment aims to strengthen Kenya's health security architecture—laboratory systems, healthcare infrastructure, disease surveillance, emergency response, supply chains, and workforce readiness—and improve Kenya's ability to respond swiftly to potential outbreaks, beyond entry-point screening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：米国がケニアの専門保健施設を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な疾患であり、DRCでの流行が記事の背景にあるが、当該記事の主題はケニアの予防的施設整備である。ケニアでの実際の患者発生は記載されていない。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行が背景にあるが、記事の主題はケニアの予防的施設整備であり、ケニアでの実患者発生は報告されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するが、当該記事はDRCのイベント発生を直接報告しておらず、DRCでの流行への対応としてのケニアの施設開発に焦点を当てている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil probes two suspected Ebola cases as patients test positive for other diseases
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases being investigated in Brazil on May 31, 2026. In Sao Paulo state, a man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently visited the DRC presented with fever and is intubated in serious condition. Lab tests returned positive for meningitis, but authorities say this does not rule out Ebola; the case remains under investigation. In Rio de Janeiro state, another suspected Ebola case involves a patient who had recently traveled to Uganda and tested positive for malaria; Ebola remains a possibility and is under investigation. Both DRC and Uganda are experiencing Ebola outbreaks. The Health Ministry confirmed the Sao Paulo patient’s condition is serious, highlighting ongoing concerns about imported Ebola cases in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが疑わしい2件のエボラ症例を調査中、患者が他の疾患で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。高病原性ウイルス（エボラ）の国際移動ケースであり、DRCとウガンダの流行地域からの輸入症例のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは極度に高病原性で国際的懸念が高い。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの流行言及があるが、実際の調査・患者確認はブラジルで発生。検査結果は髄膜炎マラリアだが、エボラ除外されていない状態での継続調査。DRCとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外し、Brazilのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, un caso sospetto a Cagliari: paziente prelevato da casa e trasferito in ospedale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a suspected case in Cagliari: patient picked up from home and transferred to hospital.
article.articleSummary: May 31, 2026 — A suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Italy involves a person who had returned from abroad and developed symptoms compatible with Ebola. Health authorities activated containment protocols, retrieved the individual from home with police and emergency services, and transported them to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases unit for all necessary investigations. Separately, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak, where Bunia airport remains closed to commercial traffic. Ghebreyesus expressed solidarity, stating WHO is beside the community and will listen to residents to address the situation. The article ties the local suspected case to ongoing global Ebola responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、カリアリで疑い例が判明：患者が自宅から搬送され病院に転送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（重大な公衆衛生上の脅威）の国際的な懸念事例。イタリアでの疑い例報告と並行してDRCでの流行進行中。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、国境を越えた感染リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア（Cagliari）での疑い例とDRC（Bunia, Ituri）での進行中の流行を並行報告。対象国リストに基づき、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする（イタリアは対象国外）。ただし、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は高く、トランスナショナルな監視が必要。WHOトップの現地訪問により国際的関心も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil investigates two possible Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Two possible Ebola cases under investigation in Brazil: a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever and suspected Ebola, initially testing negative and isolated at a São Paulo infectious-disease facility; and a man from Uganda in Rio de Janeiro state who showed viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) and had safety protocols activated after Rio officials said malaria was detected, with the case under investigation. The Ugandan patient reportedly tested positive for malaria; investigation continues. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, has produced more than 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths, with Uganda reporting several infections and one death. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak’s true reach is likely wider. Sao Paulo authorities say the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil/South America remains very low. Date: 2026-06-01.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ出血熱の2つの可能性のある症例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、DRCにおける既知の大規模流行（1,000件以上の疑い患者、250人以上の死亡）の存在、および複数国（ブラジル、DRC、ウガンダ）への波及の可能性がIHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの患者が言及されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRC流行の規模（1,000件以上の疑い患者、250人以上の死亡）とブラジルへの波及の可能性が判定の主要因。ブラジル当局は導入リスクが低いと評価しているが、国際的な懸念の高さは明確。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) and neighboring Uganda. As of May 31, 2026, Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya reported 263 laboratory-confirmed cases across DRC and Uganda with 43 confirmed deaths; more than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, and 246 suspected deaths had been reported by Thursday. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri, a northeastern DRC province, and has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment; containment relies on preventative measures. The World Health Organization has issued an international health alert, with authorities warning that official counts likely underestimate the true scale. A $319-million regional response plan was adopted by health ministers of DRC, Uganda and South Sudan. WHO chief Tedros visited Ituri and pledged support, as Africa CDC urged accelerating continent-wide efforts to meet this serious test of preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ疑似患者が1,100人を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。263確認症例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑似患者。WHOアラート発行、国際支援計画実施中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。スーダンも同様に対象国外のため除外。エボラ感染確認（Bundibugyo strain）、クロスボーダー伝播（DRC→ウガンダ）、WHO国際アラート発行、$319百万地域対応計画採択など、極めて重大な多国間公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia: a symptomatic patient was picked up from home and transported to the Santissima Trinità Hospital infectious diseases unit, with police and emergency services on scene. The patient is believed to have recently returned from abroad; nationality is unknown. Italy has dispatched Spallanzani hospital experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo and urged tighter border controls. Prime Minister Meloni proposed placing border-management on the European Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026, with a videoconference of health ministers next week and an EPSCO Council on 16 June to define priorities. Ebola outbreaks persist in the DRC and Uganda, with 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of 30 May and more than 1,100 suspected cases. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya warns the region remains under pressure and that regional spread is real.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラ疑い例：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の輸入例、国際的拡大リスク、国境管理強化の政治的反応）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。EUレベルの政治的対応と国際支援が活発化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認できる実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。Cagliari（イタリア）の患者は疑い例で、DRCからの輸入例である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Ugandaも実際の流行地であるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアからの報告だが、Italyは対象国リストにないため除外。EU・イタリア政府レベルでの高い関心と、Africa CDC警告に基づく国際的な懸念が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Itália: suspeita de caso de Ébola em Cagliari, doente no hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy: suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia: a patient was transported to Santissima Trinità hospital’s infectious diseases center after being removed from home with Ebola-compatible symptoms; the individual, who had recently returned from abroad, is admitted as protocols are activated. Police, firefighters, and municipal officers joined the response, while medical staff in protective gear entered the residence. The patient’s nationality was not disclosed. Italy has activated border-control measures and dispatched Spallanzani Institute specialists to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Prime Minister Meloni proposed adding border management to the European Council agenda for June 18–19, 2026, and Rome sought coordination through a health-ministers videoconference next week and the EPSCO Council on June 16. Africa CDC reported, as of May 30, 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DR Congo and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases, signaling regional risk and ongoing response.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア：カリアリで疑わしいエボラ患者、患者は入院中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの疑い例がイタリアで検出され、既にDRC/ウガンダでは263確定例と1,100以上の疑い例が報告されている。欧州レベルでの対応が開始された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、イタリア（Cagliari、Rome、Lazio等）での疑わしい症例が報告されているが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。一方、DRC（ID 203312）では263確定例と多数の疑い例が確認されており、これが対象国に該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはAPACマニトアリングスコープ外のため除外。Bluedot APIが付与した位置情報にはイタリアの複数地域が含まれているが、記事の実質的な感染症イベント発生地はDRCおよび周辺地域である。

article.articleHeadline: USA, screening all'aeroporto JFK per i voli dai Paesi colpiti dall'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA, screening at JFK Airport for flights from Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York will begin screening travelers arriving from Ebola-affected countries—Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda—as part of a broader U.S. public health response that already screens passengers at Dulles, Atlanta, and Houston. Travelers who have been in these countries in the past 21 days will be routed to a screening area for health questionnaires and possible further evaluation, forming part of a multi-layer approach including outbound screening and post-arrival monitoring. The outbreak centers on Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the DRC, with 225 confirmed cases, 906 suspected cases, and 223 suspected deaths reported by WHO. There is no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Bunia in the east, urging community-centered responses; MSF warns the response lags behind the outbreak’s rapid spread. The U.S. added $80 million in aid, totaling over $112 million; one American surgeon in Congo is the only confirmed case, evacuated to Germany for care.

triage.headline_ja: USA、エボラ感染国からのフライトに対するJFK空港でのスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的通知対象疾患であり、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク、米国での症例確認、複数国での国際的検疫体制の構築など、重大な感染症危機の要素を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス、確定症例225例、疑い症例906例、疑い死亡223例）に対する米国の検疫対応を報道。記事では南スーダン、ウガンダも影響国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。米国内での症例確認（アメリカ人外科医1名、ドイツに搬送治療中）、複数の米国空港での検疫体制構築、WHOとMSFの関与など、国際的な感染症危機管理の最中である。

article.articleHeadline: 43 وفاة و263 إصابة بفيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 43 deaths and 263 infections from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola virus infections have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. This outbreak in the DRC is the seventh recorded there and the third largest since the disease’s discovery, with health workers reporting delays in detection and shortages of basic supplies such as masks. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concerns. Uganda has temporarily closed its border with the DRC amid the outbreak. Africa CDC Director Jan Kasia urged rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investments in outbreak preparedness, stressing that international partners must align with African strategies. WHO teams are responding to the Ituri province outbreak epicenter in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 43人の死亡と263人のエボラウイルス感染がコンゴとウガンダで報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言を行っている。国境閉鎖、多数の死傷者、国際的な対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認症例数の具体的記載がなく、主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州と記述されているためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、ウガンダが国境を閉鎖し対応しており、国際的拡大の可能性が高い。WHOはPHEIC宣言済み、Africa CDCも警告を発出している。

article.articleHeadline: Cas suspect d'Ebola à Cagliari : patient hospitalisé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, with patient hospitalized at Santissima Trinità Infectious Diseases Department after home care; police, firefighters and municipal police coordinated entry; medical staff in sterile suits and masks admitted the patient; local newspaper La Nuova Sardegna says the individual is a traveler returning from abroad; authorities have triggered Ebola protocols. Italy has dispatched experts from the Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo; Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called to raise border-control discussions at the European Council meeting on 18-19 June 2026. In parallel, coordination with health ministers is planned via videoconference next week and at the EPSCO Council on June 16, to set operational priorities. Africa CDC said as of May 30, there were 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in DRC and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases; authorities warn of real risk of regional spread and underscore African and international response.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでのエボラ疑似患者：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: イタリア国内でのエボラ疑似症例報告であり、DRCおよびウガンダでのアクティブな流行背景で国際的拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・流行易易性・管理可能性）。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な関心は、DRC・ウガンダでの積極的エボラ流行（確認患者263名、死亡43名、疑似患者1,100名以上）であり、イタリアの症例は境界線例である。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしIHR基準は国際的な懸念に基づいて評価。EUレベルでの調整と境界対策強化の政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de ebola coloca autoridades de saúde em alerta em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola Case Puts Health Authorities on Alert in São Paulo
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo with suspected Ebola virus disease. He exhibited fever and hemorrhagic-fever–consistent symptoms, including diarrhea and rapid clinical deterioration with disorientation, prompting transfer from a local urgent care to the reference infectious disease unit. Laboratory tests are underway to confirm or rule out Ebola; the case remains under investigation. Brazil’s Ministry of Health and the State Health Secretariat have activated the National Contingency Plan, enforcing patient isolation, immediate notification, and epidemiological investigation. Officials say the risk of introducing Ebola to Brazil remains very low, given no sustained transmission in South America and the need for direct contact with infectious bodily fluids. Ebola can cause fever, muscle pain, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in severe cases, hemorrhage and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス疑い患者がサンパウロの保健当局を警戒态勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な健康被害の可能性、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の疑い患者が確認され、ブラジルの国家緊急計画が発動されており、シグナル認識のレベルに達している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジル・サンパウロで確認されたエボラ疑い患者。DRC（203312）はこの患者の渡航元として言及されているが、記事本体ではDRCでの新規発症は記述されていないため、発生地域としてはBrazilのみを verified_locations に含める。ブラジル保健省による国家緊急計画の発動、患者の隔離実施、検査実施中という対応が確認される。南米での持続的感染リスクは低いと報告されているが、国際的関心と社会政治的関心は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente em SP com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis | abc+
article.articleSummary: In São Paulo, Brazil, a 37-year-old man hospitalized with suspected Ebola tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR. As of 2026-05-31, Ebola suspicion remains under investigation, with further laboratory and genomic analyses planned to confirm or rule out infection. The patient had recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country experiencing an Ebola outbreak, and arrived in Brazil with high fever, currently in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, São Paulo. Protocol requires suspected cases to be reported immediately to municipal epidemiological surveillance and the CVE-SP. The Emílio Ribas institute serves as the state reference center for suspected or confirmed cases, while the Instituto Adolfo Lutz conducts laboratory investigations and differential diagnosis. Ongoing monitoring will determine whether the suspected Ebola diagnosis is confirmed and guide public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者がエボラ疑い症状でメニンジコッカス髄膜炎陽性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性（ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者の初期報告）と国際拡大リスク（DRC渡航歴、両国での進行中の流行）を満たし、さらにWPRO基準では重症度（入院症例）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染可能な髄膜炎、検査確定待ち）、管理可能性（州の参考センター対応）が該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからブラジル（サンパウロ）へ入国し、メニンジコッカス髄膜炎確定、エボラ感染の可能性は調査中。州の指定参考機関（Emílio Ribas研究所）で隔離管理中。後続ゲノム解析によるエボラ確認待ち。DRCは現在進行形のエボラ流行地。両国が該当する対象国である。

article.articleHeadline: Posible caso de ébola en Cagliari, paciente ingresado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Ebola case in Cagliari, patient admitted.
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: A person hospitalized at Santissima Trinità’s infectious diseases unit after being picked up at home with symptoms compatible with Ebola; they had recently returned from abroad. Police, firefighters, and local officers helped evacuate the patient to testing; healthcare workers wore PPE. National protocols activated; case treated as suspected imported Ebola infection. Italy has dispatched Spallanzani experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Prime Minister Meloni seeks to include border management in the European Council agenda (June 18–19, 2026), with a health ministers videoconference planned and EPSCO meeting on June 16 to set priorities. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya said May 30 there were 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected, underscoring a region under pressure and the real risk of regional spread; international partners remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでのエボラ疑い事例、患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: イタリア国内での輸入疑い例であり、DRC・ウガンダでの流行中の状況下での国際拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーはイタリア（カリアリ）での疑い事例を扱っているが、対象国リストにはイタリアが含まれていない。一方、DRCでの継続的流行（263確診例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例）が記事の主要背景であり、アフリカCDC所長の発言により東アフリカ地域の深刻な状況が強調されている。verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただし、この輸入事例とDRC流行の関連性から、全体的なリスク評価はPICKUPに相当する。

article.articleHeadline: Cagliari'de olası Ebola vakası: Hasta hastanede
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, prompts infection-control protocols as a patient who recently returned from abroad was admitted to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious-disease center after developing symptoms. Emergency crews in protective gear transported the patient; nationality undisclosed. Italy has intensified border controls and recently dispatched experts from the Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Rome seeking to elevate border-management discussions at EU forums. Health ministers are slated for a videoconference ahead of the EPSCO Council on June 16 and a June 18–19 European Council meeting. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya reported as of May 30, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases. Officials warn the outbreak remains under pressure with real regional spread risk, underscoring ongoing international response and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑わしいエボラ症例：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い例がイタリアで確認され、DRC・ウガンダでの大規模流行（263確定例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例）との関連。国際的な対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イタリア（カリアリ）での疑い例は報告されているが、実際の確定的なエボラ発生地域はDRCとウガンダである。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。Africa CDC公式報告による確定例・死亡例・疑い例の大規模流行が記録されており、国際的な健康危機として高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Cas suspect d'Ebola à Cagliari : un patient à l'hôpital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: a patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, triggered infection-control protocols at Santissima Trinità hospital after a patient with Ebola-like symptoms was transported from home to the infectious diseases unit. Authorities secured the residence as clinicians in protective gear treated and moved the patient to hospital care. Local media says the individual is a traveler returning from abroad; nationality not disclosed. Italy has strengthened border controls, with Spallanzani Institute experts deployed to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urging EU border-management discussions for 18–19 June 2026; a ministerial coordination call is planned ahead of EPSCO on 16 June. Africa CDC reports, as of May 30, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases, indicating the region under pressure and a real risk of regional spread, supported by international partners.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラ疑い患者：患者が病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が該当し、エボラウイルスという高リスク病原体の疑い患者が国際的な移動経路で報告されたもの。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからは、イタリア（カリアリ）での疑い患者が報告されており、患者は海外からの帰国者。しかし、対象国リストに照合すると、実際に確認されたエボラ流行はDRCとウガンダで発生しており、本評価ではDRC（203312）のみを verified_locations に含める。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事では DRC での263確認患者と43死亡が報告されており、地域的な拡大リスクが明確。イタリアでの疑い患者は国際的な感染拡大の早期警戒信号として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Cagliari, sospetto caso di Ebola: portato in ospedale un uomo rientrato dall'estero. Cosa sappiamo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cagliari, suspected Ebola case: a man who had returned from abroad was taken to hospital. What do we know.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Italy: a man who had recently returned from abroad was taken from his home to the Santissima Trinità hospital and admitted to the infectious diseases unit for diagnostic work-up. Emergency teams, supported by police and emergency services, entered the residence in protective gear and transferred the patient to isolation for testing. The case remains under laboratory confirmation to either confirm or exclude Ebola. Protocols were activated amid heightened international attention to the disease. As of May 30, 263 Ebola cases were confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, per Africa CDC. Separately, Brazil is also assessing another suspected case in São Paulo involving a man who had returned from the DRC and is in precautionary isolation at the Emilio Ribas Institute of Infectious Diseases. Cagliari investigations aim to clarify the case and assess population risk.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリ、エボラ疑い症例：海外から帰国した男性が病院に搬送。現在判明していることは？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患が複数国（イタリア、ブラジル）で疑い症例として報告されており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク、およびWPRO基準の異常性・流行しやすさが該当。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: イタリアおよびウガンダで報告されているエボラ症例は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。ただし記事サマリーではDRCとブラジルの疑い症例が主題であり、これら対象国でのシグナルとして評価した。イタリアの症例は帰国者由来で、DRCでの流行（263確認症例）に関連していると考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo and...
article.articleSummary: By May 31, 2026, Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (Ituri) and neighboring Uganda comprises 263 confirmed cases with 43 deaths, and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, northeast DR Congo, and has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment, so containment relies on preventive measures. WHO has triggered an international health alert, while authorities warn the true scale is likely underestimated. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya urged action at the speed of the epidemic and called for expanded funding beyond external sources. A $319 million outbreak response plan was adopted by DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. WHO Director-General Tedros visited an Ebola treatment center in DR Congo, pledging support to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが報告：コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでエボラ疑似症例1,100例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。確認症例263例、死亡43例、疑似症例1,100例以上という大規模なエボラ流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として対応すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでも検出が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC（対象国ID: 203312）が主要な発生地域。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認治療なしの極めて危険な状況。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し国際的な注視が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brésil: placement à l'isolement de deux hommes présentant des symptômes possibles d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: Two men placed in isolation after presenting with possible Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Two men, one from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and one from Uganda, were placed in isolation in Brazil on 31 May 2026 after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola as Brazil monitors an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and rising cases in Uganda. A 37-year-old from the DRC, with fever, is treated as a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo; tests have not confirmed Ebola, investigations continue. In Rio de Janeiro, a Ugandan national who arrived on 22 May showed viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea); malaria testing was positive, but the case remains under investigation for Ebola risk. Officials say the risk of introduction to Brazil/South America remains very low. Background: the DRC declared a new outbreak on 15 May in the eastern region; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases; Africa CDC notes over 1,000 suspected DRC cases with 246 deaths; WHO has issued an international health alert.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：エボラの可能性のある症状を呈した2人の男性が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダで進行中のエボラ流行を背景に、ブラジルで疑い症例が検出され、国際的拡大リスク、貿易・渡航制限リスクが存在する。WHOが国際保健警報を発出済みであり、シグナル対象。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでの2例の疑い症例（DRC・ウガンダからの渡航者）を報道。DRCで宣言された新規流行（5月15日、東部地域）とウガンダの確定症例9例を背景としている。WHOが国際保健警報を発出済み。ウガンダはBluedotが付与したが、記事サマリーでは具体的な流行地としてのウガンダの記述は背景情報のみで、実際のイベント発生地はブラジルとDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Ύποπτο κρούσμα Έμπολα στο Κάλιαρι: ασθενής στο νοσοκομείο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia: a traveler who returned from abroad was admitted to Santissima Trinità hospital’s infectious diseases unit with Ebola-like symptoms; active protocols and responders dispatched to the residence. The patient’s nationality is not disclosed. Italy has pushed for stricter border controls, with Spallanzani Institute experts sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Prime Minister Meloni urging border-management discussions at the European Council on June 18–19, 2026. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya reported by May 30 that confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC and Uganda total 263 with 43 deaths, while suspected cases exceed 1,100, signaling ongoing transmission in a strained region and a real risk of regional spread; international partners continue to coordinate the response.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラウイルスの疑い症例：患者が病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: イタリアで帰国旅行者にエボラの疑い症例が報告され、DRCとウガンダでの確認症例263例・死亡43例という背景がある。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性、異常性が高く、IHR基準3つ以上該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: イタリア・サルデーニャ州での疑い症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCとウガンダでの確認・疑い症例が東アフリカ地域での流行の背景となっており、イタリアでの症例は輸入例としての位置付けである。アフリカCDCが報告した263確認例・1,100超の疑い症例、およびイタリアが欧州理事会で国境管理強化を要求している点から、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: مورد مشکوک ابولا در کالیاری؛ بیمار در بیمارستان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A suspected case of Ebola in Cagliari; patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: a person with Ebola-like symptoms was transported to the Santissima Trinità Infectious Diseases Center; authorities conducted testing and containment with staff in protective gear. La Nuova Sardegna reports the individual appears to be a resident who recently returned from abroad; nationality not disclosed. Italy called for tighter border controls, sending experts from the Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni proposed addressing border management at the European Council on June 18–19, 2026, and coordinating via a video conference of health ministers next week and an OSCE Council meeting on June 16 to set priorities. Ebola in the DRC and Uganda totals 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of May 30, with over 1,100 suspected cases; Africa CDC notes a regional outbreak under pressure and stresses an African-led response with international partners still essential.

triage.headline_ja: カグリアーリで疑似エボラ患者が発症；患者は入院中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に重大な感染症であり、イタリアでの疑似症例報告は異常・予想外、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクをすべて含む。DRCとウガンダでの流行拡大も同時に確認され、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリアのカグリアーリでの疑似症例を報道しているが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリスト対象国であり、記事で流行拡大が述べられているため含める。ウガンダでの流行についても言及されているが、ウガンダはリスト対象国に含まれていないため除外。エボラは極めて重大な病原体であり、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。イタリアでの疑似症例発生により国際的警戒度が高まっていることが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Bericht aus der Demokratischen Republik Kongo zum Ebola-Ausbruch im Ostkongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has intensified amid long-standing health-system shortages. On May 15, 2026, Ituri province officially reported the 17th Ebola outbreak, arising with the Bundibugyo strain and spreading quickly to North Kivu and South Kivu. Unlike past Zaire-strain episodes, there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Widespread rumors, mysticism, and distrust of humanitarian actors hinder access to care. Overcrowded refugee camps housing millions of displaced people create extreme hygienic conditions that facilitate transmission. The government, led by the Ministry of Health and INSP in collaboration with the WHO, coordinates response, with international acknowledgment from WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Primary obstacles remain vaccine availability and operationally securing remote rural areas for contact tracing. The security situation—armed groups in eastern Congo—limits access and renders parts of Ituri largely unreachable. No case or death counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からの報告：東コンゴのエボラ発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の新規アウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、国際的拡大リスク、および複数のIHR基準を満たすため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの新規アウトブレイク（第17例）で、従来のZaire株と異なり、利用可能なワクチンや特異的治療法がない。難民キャンプの過密状態、セキュリティリスク、保健システムの脆弱性により対応が困難。WHO事務局長による国際的認識あり。ケース数・死亡数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Nairobi, May 31, 2026 (AFP) - Africa CDC says over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC reports over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as of May 31, 2026, signaling a continuing regional outbreak. The article only provides suspected infection counts; laboratory-confirmed totals and deaths are not disclosed. No information is given on patient symptoms, transmission routes, infection sources, or whether cases are imported or exported between countries. Details on public health actions, vaccination campaigns, timelines for confirmation, or containment measures are not included. The lack of confirmed data and clinical details limits assessment of outbreak severity from the article alone. The date reference indicates the count reflects the situation up to 31 May 2026, with no further updates provided in the text.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが報告：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラの疑い例1,100件以上
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極度に重篤な感染症であり、1,100件以上の疑い例が複数国で報告されていることはIHR基準（深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）を明確に満たし、シグナルとしての検知価値が高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではUgandaが発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リスト（1269750=India等）にUgandaは含まれていない。ただしDRC（203312）は対象国に含まれるため、DRCのみ verified_locations に記載。エボラの地域拡大を示唆する情報であり、確認された症例数や死亡者数は未公開とのことだが、疑い例1,100件以上という規模と複数国での報告により、IHR全4基準及びWPRO全5基準に該当する高リスクシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: EAC ministers to meet over Ebola outbreak - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda triggers East African Community (EAC) extraordinary virtual meeting for June 1–2, 2026, to coordinate regional response. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 26, DR Congo: 121 confirmed cases, 17 deaths among confirmed, 1,077 suspected cases, 246 suspected deaths; Uganda: seven confirmed cases, one death as of May 25, with first two cases traveling from DR Congo. The outbreak mainly affects Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu in eastern DR Congo, with Ituri as the epicentre. EAC mobilises nine mobile laboratories at border points and high-risk locations, including Gisenyi and Gihundwe in Rwanda; additional labs planned across DR Congo, Kenya, South Sudan, Burundi, Tanzania and Uganda. Uganda Virus Research Institute supports lab diagnosis and training; TEACH program strengthens health workers’ capacity; Rapidly Deployable Expert Pool (>180 responders); 500 PPE sets procured for DR Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: EAC大臣会合 エボラ発症について - KMA Updates
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの東アフリカ地域での発症で、confirmed cases（DR Congo 121例、Uganda 7例）と死亡例を伴い、地域的な国際会議が開催される等、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の重大な影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDR Congo（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で121例確認、死亡17例）とUganda（7例確認、死亡1例）でのBundibugyo Ebola virusの確認を報告。East African Community (EAC)が地域対応調整のための緊急仮想会合を2026年6月1-2日に召集。他の周辺国（Rwanda、Kenya、Sudan、Burundi、Tanzania）は検査体制や支援活動の面で関与しているが、サマリー上の主要な発症地は対象国リストではDRC とUgandaのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, patient taken to hospital
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, prompted hospital protocols after a patient with Ebola-like symptoms, who had recently returned from abroad, was taken to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases unit. Authorities described a scene with police and responders; medical staff wore protective suits as the individual was transported for testing. Italy has deployed Spallanzani hospital experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo and is pushing tighter border controls, with Health Ministers’ videoconferences planned ahead of the EPSCO Council. Across the region, Ebola remains active in the DRC and Uganda: as of 30 May, 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, with over 1,100 suspected cases. An African CDC official cautioned the epidemic’s regional spread risk and highlighted ongoing international support.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア・カリャリで疑い例のエボラ患者が病院に搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、および実際の感染症流行地域（DRC、ウガンダ）での活動が確認されるため、シグナルとして拾い上げる必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア（カリャリ）での疑い例に関するものだが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、記事の主眼はDRCおよびウガンダでの活動的なエボラ流行（263確定例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例）にあり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれている。イタリアでの疑い例がDRC出発者であり、国際的な懸念を示している点を踏まえてPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Sospetto caso di ebola nell'isola, inviati allo Spallanzani i campioni ematici del paziente: chi è e cosa sappiamo La Nuova Sardegna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case on the island of Sardinia, the patient's blood samples sent to Spallanzani Institute: who he is and what we know.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Sardinia, Italy. An Italian citizen who was born in the Congo developed symptoms compatible with Ebola and was admitted around 2 a.m. to Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari. Hospital authorities implemented ministerial infection-control protocols to protect healthcare workers and other patients. Blood samples were immediately sent by special transport to the National Institute for Infectious Diseases Lazzaro Spallanzani in Rome for laboratory confirmation. Officials await tests to determine whether this is an Ebola infection. The report notes the patient’s origin from Congo, and underscores the ongoing vigilance in Italy while awaiting diagnostic results; no confirmed case has been announced at this time. The article focuses on containment measures and the process for confirming the diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア・サルデーニャ島でエボラ疑い患者、スパッランツァーニ研究所に血液検体を送付：患者は誰か、何が分かっているか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者が報告され、IHR基準で2項目以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）が該当。確認待ちながら公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア・サルデーニャ島での疑い患者を報告しているが、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）に該当する。患者はコンゴ出身だがイタリアでの発症報告であり、イタリアは対象国に含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ただしDRCが発生地域に含まれているため、コンゴでの発生が確認されている場合はDRC(203312)を追加検討すべき。記事サマリーでは患者がコンゴ生まれだが、実際の発症・診断はイタリアでの報告に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Estado confirma meningite em paciente com suspeita de Ebola na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State confirms meningitis in a patient with suspected Ebola in the capital.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat confirmed a 37-year-old man in isolation at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in the West Zone of São Paulo city with meningococcal meningitis, after an initial suspicion of Ebola. The patient reported fever and recent travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, a country with areas of transmission. Diagnostic confirmation of meningococcal meningitis was provided by Instituto Adolfo Lutz as part of a differential diagnosis process. Samples are still being analyzed to rule out Ebola and other viral etiologies. Investigations were initiated preventively following clinical and epidemiological criteria in line with national and state protocols, and management remains clinical and epidemiological until final results. Regiane de Paula, coordinator of the Disease Control program, stated that the meningitis-causing bacterium has been lab-confirmed, while the Ebola investigation continues.

triage.headline_ja: State confirms meningitis in a patient with suspected Ebola in the capital.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎とエボラ疑い患者（DRC渡航歴）は公衆衛生上重大な懸念。確定診断待機中で国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC渡航歴あり。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎は確定（Instituto Adolfo Lutz）だがエボラ除外検査継続中。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク（髄膜炎菌）と輸入リスク（エボラ）の両面で懸念。州保健局が予防的対策実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Ministero della Salute "Accertamenti su un caso sospetto in Sardegna"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Ministry of Health: "Investigations into a suspected case in Sardinia."
article.articleSummary: Ebola investigations are underway for a suspected case in Sardinia. A patient who recently returned from the Congo is in Cagliari and symptomatic. The individual has been tested for Ebola, with the sample to be analyzed by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome in the evening. The patient remains isolated in a hospital setting. The Italian Ministry of Health says it is in contact with local Sardinia health authorities and Spallanzani to follow the evolution of the case and to coordinate the response. Officials emphasize that the risk to Italy remains very low. The outcome will depend on laboratory confirmation from the evening analysis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、保健省「サルデーニャの疑い事例について調査中」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（致死率が高い一類感染症）の疑い事例が報告され、コンゴからの渡航者が関連。異常・予想外性が高く、重症度が高い疾患であり、国際的な関心と対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから判断すると、実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴ（Democratic Republic of the Congo）であり、イタリアはコンゴからの渡航者による疑い事例への対応国である。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし、この事例がコンゴでの流行拡大と関連している可能性があり、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Verdacht in Cagliari: Patient im Krankenhaus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected in Cagliari: Patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola in Cagliari, Sardinia: A person who recently returned from abroad is admitted to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s Infectious Diseases unit after developing symptoms.
