Authorities evacuated the patient from home; police, fire, and municipal officers assisted, and medical staff in protective gear collected the patient. Nationality is not yet confirmed. Italy has dispatched experts from the Spallanzani Institute to the Democratic Republic of Congo and is pursuing stricter border controls, aiming to raise the issue at the European Council meeting on 18–19 June 2026; a health ministers’ videoconference is planned next week and EPSCO Council debates set priorities for mid-June. Africa CDC reports as of 30 May: 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases, signaling real risk of regional spread and a growing international response.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラ疑い：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダで263確定例・43死亡、1,100以上の疑似患者がいる中での国際的な懸念事例。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア・カリアリでの疑い患者を報じているが、実際のエボラウイルス流行はDRCとウガンダで発生している。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。イタリアは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず。Africa CDC報告（2026年5月30日時点）で263確定例・43死亡・1,100以上の疑似患者が報告されており、地域拡大と国際対応の段階的拡大を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Bekövetkezett, amitől sokan rettegtek: új helyen bukkant fel a rendkívül halálos vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What many feared has come to pass: the extremely deadly virus has emerged in a new location.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-suspected cases are under investigation in Brazil, located in São Paulo state and Rio de Janeiro state. The São Paulo patient arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, developed fever, and has been diagnosed with meningitis; he was intubated and is in critical condition. In Rio de Janeiro state, a recently returned patient from Uganda prompted Ebola suspicion; malaria was diagnosed, but authorities warn that the presence of another illness does not rule out Ebola and investigations continue. Both origin countries—DRC and Uganda—are currently experiencing Ebola outbreaks. Brazilian health authorities say investigations are ongoing and that a confirmed Ebola infection would require further laboratory confirmation. The reports underscore ongoing public health risk, with monitoring, testing, and contact tracing continuing as of the published date, May 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの人が恐れていたことが起きた：極めて致命的なウイルスが新しい場所で出現した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例がブラジルで報告され、DRCおよびウガンダの流行地からの輸入例である。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク）し、スクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの新規地理的拡大を示唆する報告。ブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例は流行地（DRC、ウガンダ）からの輸入例であり、国際的保健上の関心が極めて高い。確定診断待ち中だが、潜在的リスクは極めて高い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, paziente in ospedale a Cagliari: si attende risultato dei test
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, patient in hospital in Cagliari: test results awaited.
article.articleSummary: On May 31, 2026, Italy reports a suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia. A patient who recently returned from Congo is hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases ward at Santissima Trinità Hospital and is in isolation. Ebola testing is underway, with samples shipped to Spallanzani Institute in Rome for analysis that evening. The Health Ministry says it is coordinating with local Sardinia authorities and Spallanzani to monitor the patient’s evolution. Protective procedures were activated at Is Mirrionis Hospital, with alarms extending to the historic city center. Police have cordoned off part of Via Manno near the Bastione; it is not yet clear whether the area contains the patient’s residence or a possible direct contact. Results are awaited as the investigation continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、カリアリ病院の患者：検査結果を待機中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ熱の疑い例が先進国イタリアで報告され、コンゴからの輸入ケースであるため、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでイベント発生地として記述されているのは、イタリア（カリアリ）での疑い症例の病院搬送である。しかし対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。ただし、コンゴからの輸入ケース報告として、DRCの感染症動向追跡の観点から重要。記事から確認できる情報：①患者はコンゴから帰国、②検査継続中で確定診断前、③高度感染症病棟での隔離対応、④イタリア保健省とSpallanzani研究所が調整中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie qui menace toute l'Afrique francophone - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the epidemic that threatens all Francophone Africa - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 139 deaths (BBC Africa) amid over 900 suspected cases and about 220 potential fatalities. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved, strain-specific vaccine, so responses rely on isolating patients and breaking transmission chains, a major challenge in regions plagued by insecurity and displacement. The World Health Organization labels the risk as very high for the DRC and high for neighboring countries; Uganda has reported cases linked to the Congolese outbreak, signaling regional spread. Cross-border surveillance is strengthening among Sahel Alliance of States (AES) members, including Mali. Affected provinces in the DRC are Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with frontline health workers at risk and safe burials crucial to limit spread. Preventive measures: avoid contact with infectious fluids, promptly report fever, vomiting, or bleeding after exposure, and observe a 21-day monitoring period. The crisis tests fragile Sahel health systems and regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：フランス語圏アフリカ全体を脅かす流行
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な地域的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、高い重症度（139人の死亡、900以上の疑い例）、IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。公衆衛生上の重大な影響を伴う確認された流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が記述されており、ウガンダでの関連症例（地域的拡大）も言及されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Sahel地域とマリについては記述があるが、サマリーの主題は明らかにDRC発生の流行であり、マリはサーベイランス強化の文脈でのみ言及されているため除外。発生地域に含まれるUgandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sumnja na ebolu u Cagliariju. Pacijent u bolnici, Italija traži kontrolu granica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Cagliari. Patient in hospital; Italy seeks border control.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case triggers response in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: a person with Ebola-like symptoms was transported to Santissima Trinità hospital’s infectious diseases ward after being evacuated from abroad; nationality not disclosed. Police, firefighters and local authorities joined medical teams in entering the residence and transporting the patient by ambulance. The case is described as suspected; no laboratory confirmation reported. Italy is calling for tighter border controls, sending Spallanzani Institute experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Prime Minister Meloni proposed placing border management on the EU Council agenda for June 18–19, with accelerated coordination via a videoconference of health ministers next week and the EPSCO Council on June 16 to set priorities. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in DRC and Uganda as of May 30, with over 1,100 suspected cases, indicating regional spread risk.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラが疑わしい。患者は病院内、イタリアは国境管理を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の疑い患者がイタリアで報告され、DRCおよびウガンダでの地域的流行（263確定例、43死亡、1100以上の疑い例）に伴う国際的拡大リスクが明確。複数の IHR 基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: イタリアでの疑い患者報告はあるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC での地域的流行が本シグナルの主要な関心事項。Africa CDC 報告による DRC・ウガンダでの活動的な流行と国際的拡大リスクが確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Possibile caso di Ebola in Italia, paziente in isolamento a Cagliari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible case of Ebola in Italy, patient in isolation in Cagliari.
article.articleSummary: Possible Ebola case in Italy: a symptomatic patient who recently returned from Congo is hospitalized in a medical facility in Cagliari, Sardinia. The patient has been subjected to an Ebola test, which will be analyzed by the Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome in the evening. The patient is currently in isolation at the hospital in Cagliari. The Ministry of Health is in contact with local health authorities and Spallanzani to monitor the case. It notes that the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low while investigations proceed and laboratory results are pending. Results are expected later today.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアで疑い例のエボラ患者、カリアリで隔離中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例であり、コンゴからの帰国者で国際的な拡大リスク、異常性、重症度ポテンシャルを有する。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリアでの疑い例を報じているが、実際の感染症イベントの発生地はコンゴ（患者の帰国元）であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。イタリアは対象国外であるため verified_locations から除外。コンゴでのエボラ流行が存在することが前提となっており、この事例は国際的な移動リスクを示唆している。検査結果待機中。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola crisis: The inconvenient truths
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak, centered on Bunia in the DRC, is spreading faster than the response, with spillovers into Uganda and growing concern across neighboring states. Surveillance in conflict zones remains incomplete, and the virus circulated undetected for weeks, allowing transmission chains to cross borders, refugee corridors and informal trade networks. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; unlike the Zaire strain, there is no fully established licensed vaccine. The crisis unfolds under warfare, displacement, urbanization, weak health systems, shrinking aid, and mistrust—conditions MSF says have produced unprecedented early case growth. Contagion links include transport corridors linking Kampala, Kigali and Nairobi to international flows; institutional, psychological and geopolitical effects are anticipated. US funding cuts and withdrawal of preventive health capacity are cited as weakening surveillance and logistics. The first likely scenario envisages thousands to tens of thousands of regionally confined cases, with stabilization achievable through isolation and tracing. As of May 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：不都合な真実
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の多国間流行で、DRC中心に複数国へ波及、ワクチン対応困難、紛争地域での監視不全、数千～数万人規模の患者予測。
triage.notes: 記事はマニラタイムスのオピニオン記事（2026年5月31日）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行がDRCのブニア中心にウガンダへ波及。ワクチン未確立、紛វ域での監視不全、複数国への国際的波及リスク高い。但しウガンダ・ルワンダ・ケニア・米国は対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola em SP: Paciente internado é investigado por vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in São Paulo: Hospitalized patient under investigation for Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized at the Emílio Ribas Institute in São Paulo under investigation for suspected Ebola virus infection. Laboratory tests by Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcal meningitis), but Ebola suspicion persists due to recent travel and compatible symptoms. The patient remains in isolation; preliminary Ebola-specific test results are expected within 48 hours, and samples will undergo sequencing to confirm infection status. He presented with fever, diarrhea, disorientation, and rapid clinical deterioration requiring intubation, after seeking care at a local UPA. Contacts from air travel and the UPA are being monitored. The investigation involves federal, state, and municipal health authorities. The risk of Ebola introduction in Brazil is considered very low, given no autochthonous transmission in South America and no direct Congo–South America flights.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ出血熱の疑い：入院患者がエボラウイルスの調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）し、エボラウイルスの疑い事例として国際的な関心が高い。ただし現時点では検査未確定でリスクは低い評価。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの疑い事例であり、公式検査結果は48時間以内に判明予定。コンゴからの入国患者のため、感染源国（DRC）と発症地（ブラジル）の両国を記録。現在のところ実験室ではニセリア髄膜炎菌を検出。ブラジル当局はエボラ伝入リスクを非常に低いと評価しており、南米での自然感染の記録がなくコンゴ-南米間の直行便がないため。

article.articleHeadline: OMS informa de 5 recuperaciones por ébola tras apertura de nuevo centro de tratamiento en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports five Ebola recoveries after the opening of a new treatment center in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare Ebola form in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after opening a new treatment center in Bunia, Ituri province. The Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists, has led to 134 confirmed cases across Congo and neighboring Uganda as of May 29, with 18 deaths. The new center was inaugurated by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Four more patients were discharged that day and one earlier, marking the first documented recovery from Bundibugyo in this outbreak. Symptoms included dizziness, vomiting, severe itching, diarrhea and extreme weakness; diagnosis required seven tests, with treatment remaining supportive (antiemetics, IV fluids, analgesics). MSF reports the outbreak outpacing response, amid distrust and attacks on health centers. Outbreak activity also concerns North and South Kivu (Goma, Bukavu), with ADF and M23 dynamics complicating control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国の新しい治療センターの開設後、エボラからの5件の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo variant）の確認症例134件、死亡18件が報告され、治療法やワクチンが存在しない稀な変異株である。国際的な懸念が高く、WHO事務局長の関与があり、隣国ウガンダにも拡大している。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な変異株で、承認済みの治療法またはワクチンが存在しない。記事サマリーで Uganda への言及がありますが、主な発生地域は DRC であり、記事の主題は DRC でのアウトブレイク。MSF による「対応が流行に追いつかない」との懸念、医療施設への攻撃報告、武装勢力（ADF、M23）による複雑な状況が対応を困難にしている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と新治療センター開設は国際的関心と対応能力の指標。

article.articleHeadline: Rising dengue cases cause concern in Thripunithura municipality
article.articleSummary: Dengue cluster in Thripunithura municipality, Kerala, with 12 cases reported in Ward 1—Attaprayil, notably Parayapparambil Lane and Pulse Nagar Road in Kozhivettumveli—beginning end-April. Public health concerns persist as residents and authorities report poor cooperation in eliminating mosquito breeding sites; authorities plan to enter premises for cleaning from Monday. Preventive measures include source reduction and vector studies, targeting waterlogged areas, improper waste disposal, and poor gardening practices believed to sustain breeding. Aedes eggs can survive dry periods and hatch with rain, enabling rapid spread; adult mosquitoes typically travel about 400 metres. Monsoon onset raises risk. Kochi Corporation has begun precautionary source-reduction actions across wards and notes containment attempts after dengue cases in Vennala division, aiming to curb transmission through timely intervention.

triage.headline_ja: Thripunithura市町村でのデング熱患者数増加が懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州で局所的なデング熱クラスター（12症例）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。ただし、現時点では死亡や重症化の報告がなく、国際的拡大の明確な証拠がないため、情報収集継続の段階と判断。
triage.notes: ケーララ州Thripunithura市町村における局所的なデング熱クラスター。4月末から報告が始まり、Ward 1（Attaprayil地区）で12症例確認。蚊の繁殖環境（不適切な廃棄物処理、停滞した水溜まり）が継続し、雨季到来によるさらなるリスク増加が懸念される。現在、地方当局が媒介蚊対策と源泉削減対策を実施中。重症度の詳細情報が不足しているため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de doença por vírus Ebola está com meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with suspected Ebola virus disease has meningitis.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, meningococcal meningitis was laboratory-confirmed in a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, initially classified as a suspected Ebola virus disease case in São Paulo. The bacterium was detected at Instituto Adolfo Lutz; the patient remains in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas while Ebola and other viral differentials are investigated. Preventive criteria prompted the assessment; Emílio Ribas is the reference unit for suspected or confirmed cases. SES-SP notes the risk of introduction to Brazil and South America is very low due to no endemic transmission in the region, no direct flights, and transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions or bodily fluids from symptomatic patients. Ebola symptoms include abrupt fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; severe disease may involve hemorrhage, shock, and multi-organ failure. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for the identified strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者が髄膜炎を患っている
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されたDRC出身患者がブラジルで検出され、同時にエボラウイルス病の除外が進行中。国際的な感染症伝播の懸念と公開される医療対応により、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC出身でブラジル(サンパウロ)で検出された。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されたが、エボラウイルス病の除外検査が継続中。公式な医療機関(Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas)での対応と公開情報により社会政治的関心が高い。ブラジル保健当局はエボラの地域導入リスクは低いと評価しているが、国際移動を伴う事例のため監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dos hombres en aislamiento en Brasil por sospecha de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two men in isolation in Brazil due to suspected Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two men with Ebola-compatible symptoms are in preventive isolation in Brazil, one in São Paulo and one in Rio de Janeiro. The São Paulo patient, 37, had been in the Democratic Republic of Congo and is feverish; he is hospitalized at Emílio Ribas while Ebola testing continues, following a meningitis diagnosis. The Rio de Janeiro patient is a Ugandan traveler who arrived May 22 and developed fever, cough, chills and diarrhea; malaria was later confirmed, and Ebola assessment remains ongoing. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 for an outbreak in DRC and Uganda caused by Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. In DRC, over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths since May 15; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. Transmission is via bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days. Risk of introduction to Brazil/South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者の隔離―ブラジルで2人が疑いで隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのDRC/ウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラ アウトブレイク（250人以上死亡）に関連して、ブラジルでの症例疑い報告であり、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: DRC/ウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイク（WHO緊急事態宣言2026年5月17日）の関連事象。ブラジル国内での症例疑い報告は国際的伝播の初期兆候として重要。記事はブラジル2事例（うち1件はウガンダ渡航者）の詳細を述べており、アウトブレイク源国はDRC/ウガンダだが、南米への伝播リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : l'EAC convoque une réunion ministérielle d'urgence les 1er et 2 juin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo: the EAC convenes an emergency ministerial meeting on June 1–2.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (notably Beni, eastern DRC) and Uganda prompts an East African Community (EAC) virtual emergency ministerial meeting on June 1–2 to coordinate response. With no vaccine or approved specific treatment, the EAC is seeking a regional strategy and closer collaboration with Africa CDC and the WHO, following the outbreak officially declared on May 15, 2026. Planned measures include deploying nine mobile laboratories to strategic border areas and major entry points across the region, including borders with Kenya, South Sudan, Burundi, Tanzania, Rwanda, and Uganda. Financing comes from the German government via KfW, with technical support from the Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine. The TEACH program will strengthen frontline clinical care for high-risk infectious diseases, and 500 PPE kits have been procured for DRC and Uganda, with additional orders for other member states.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ：東アフリカ共同体が6月1日から2日の緊急閣僚級会議を召集
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の集団発生により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがあり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。地域的な高度な懸念と国際的な対応の必要性が明らかであるため、フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の集団発生がDRC（特に東部のベニ）およびウガンダで確認されていると述べられている。一方、発生地域リストには複数国（スーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ケニア、ブルンジ、ウガンダ、ドイツ）が含まれているが、サマリーの記述では、これらの国は主に『潜在的な国境地域への拡大リスク』または『区域的対応調整』の文脈に登場する。対象国リストに含まれているのはDRCのみであり、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。本事象は致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の新規集団発生であり、医療資源の限界（ワクチン・承認治療薬なし）と国際的な懸念の高まりが顕著である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-gyanú Cagliariban: beteg kórházban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-suspect in Cagliari: patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola-suspect case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: a man was taken to the Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases unit after being found at home with symptoms suggestive of Ebola; he recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Police and emergency services assisted; clinicians in protective gear transported the patient to hospital. Italy’s health ministry said investigations are being conducted by Rome’s Spallanzani Institute and the patient remains isolated in a hospital facility, with Ebola risk in Italy described as very low. Italy has urged stricter border controls; Spallanzani experts have been dispatched to the DRC, and Prime Minister Meloni proposed featuring border management on the June 18–19 European Council agenda, with a health ministers videoconference planned next week and EPSCO on June 16. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya reported by May 30: 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases, signaling potential regional spread and a need for international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い症例がカリャリで：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでのエボラ疑い症例報告は異常・予想外であり、DRCでの確認事例との関連、国際的な対応強化の動き、および欧州評議会での議題化など複数のIHR基準を満たし、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はイタリア（対象国外）でのエボラ疑い症例ですが、患者はDRCからの帰還者であり、DRCでの活発な流行（263確認例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例）が背景にあります。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載します。イタリアはWHO欧州地域外の対象国ですが、DRCの流行と国際的な連携強化の重要性から、フルRRAの対象となります。

article.articleHeadline: Présentation des patients guéris d'Ebola par l'Institut national de santé publique - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Presentation of patients recovered from Ebola by the National Institute of Public Health - ACP
article.articleSummary: Recovered Ebola patients in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, were formally presented at a ceremony to showcase the ongoing response to the 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri province. Organized by the Ministry of Public Health through the National Institute of Public Health (INSP), the event was chaired by INSP Director-General Dr. Mwamba Kazadi Dieudonné and attended by the World Health Organization Director-General on a mission to assess the situation, along with the COUSP Coordinator, the Incident Manager of the Ebola response, and various technical and financial partners. The ceremony highlighted the effectiveness of early case detection, medical care, contact tracing, and community engagement. The INSP reaffirmed commitment to protecting public health and urged continued vigilance and adherence to preventive measures until transmission is fully interrupted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱から回復した患者が公開される - 国立公衆衛生研究所（DRC）
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ州での第17次エボラ流行が確認され、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性に該当。WHOなど国際機関の直接的な関与とウイルス性出血熱の国際的拡大リスクに基づきシグナルとして認識。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州での進行中の第17次エボラ流行と回復患者の公式式典について報告。WHOの事務局長が現地視察に参加しており、国際的な関心と対応が高い。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の重要な懸念疾患であり、継続的な監視と報告が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : sans coordination continentale, l'Afrique risque une propagation accélérée, prévient Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Without continental coordination, Africa risks accelerated spread, warns Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda have reached alarming levels, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30. By that date, 263 confirmed cases and 43 confirmed deaths were reported across DRC and Uganda. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; responses rely on barrier precautions and rapid case detection. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri province (northeast DRC) and has spread to three other Congolese provinces and into Uganda, which has nine confirmed infections, including one death. The World Health Organization has triggered an international health alert. Africa CDC approved a regional intervention plan of $319 million to coordinate the response and urged expansion continent-wide. Ten African countries, including South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, and Zambia, were placed on alert; Medi1news notes this as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：大陸規模の調整がなければ、アフリカは加速した感染拡大のリスクに直面する、アフリカCDCが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは極めて深刻な公衆衛生脅威であり、既に複数国に国際的拡大しており、263確定症例・43死亡が報告されている。WHO国際保健警戒を発動済み。
triage.notes: 記事では10アフリカ国が警戒対象に挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはZambiaのみ。DRCはIturi州での初期発生地点として記事の主題。Sudanは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーに直接言及されていないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法が未承認であり、管理難度が高い。Africa CDCの地域介入計画（3億1,900万ドル）が承認され、国際的支援体制が構築中。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in northeastern DR Congo (Ituri) and neighboring Uganda comprises 263 confirmed cases and 43 confirmed deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation and 246 suspected deaths previously reported. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri and has spread to three Congolese provinces plus Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment, so containment relies on preventive measures. The World Health Organization has triggered an international health alert, though officials warn the true scale is likely underestimated. A $319-million outbreak response plan was adopted by DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri and pledged support, urging rapid momentum to confront this serious test for Africa CDC and the AU.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがDR コンゴとウガンダの疑似エボラ患者1,100人以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。確認患者263人、死亡43人を含む大規模なエボラアウトブレイクであり、複数国に拡大しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。WHO国際保健警報が発令されており、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Ituri州でのエボラアウトブレイクが主要イベント。ウガンダとスーダンも発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーではDR コンゴ東北部Ituri及びウガンダでの確認患者・死亡が明確に述べられている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダ、スーダンは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。WHO国際保健警報発令、319百万ドルの対応計画が採択されており、国際対応が既に進行中。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo : plus de 1.100 personnes suspectées d'avoir contracté la fièvre hémorragique Ebola, selon l'agence sanitaire de l'UA - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 1,100 people suspected of having contracted Ebola hemorrhagic fever, according to the African Union's health agency - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda reported 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 43 confirmed deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation, per Jean Kaseya of the African Union's health agency. Earlier figures cited over 1,077 suspected cases, including 246 deaths. Health ministers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan approved a $319 million regional intervention plan to coordinate the response, with calls to extend this dynamic continent-wide. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri province, northeastern DRC, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine or approved treatment exists, so control relies on barrier measures and rapid detection. The WHO has triggered an international health alert, but the true extent remains uncertain and authorities fear underreporting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：アフリカ連合の保健機関によると、1,100人以上がエボラ出血熱に感染した疑いがある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な死亡・患者数、予想外の大規模発生、地域的広がりと国際対応の必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。WHOが国際保健警告を発令している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生。2026年5月15日にコンゴ民主共和国東北部イトゥリ州で宣言。確認患者263名、死亡43名、疑い患者1,100名以上。Bundibugyo株。ワクチンと承認済み治療薬がないため、バリア対策と迅速検出に依存。WHOが国際保健警告を発令。DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンの保健大臣が3億1,900万ドルの地域介入計画を承認。記事ではウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、確認患者数等の主要情報はDRCに集中しており、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。

article.articleHeadline: 43 وفاة و263 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 43 deaths and 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: 43 deaths and 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with authorities investigating more than 1,100 suspected infections as the outbreak is monitored in both countries. Patrick Muyaia, DR Congo’s information minister, urged calm, noting the nation’s experience and capacity to manage prior outbreaks. The World Health Organization describes EVD as a zoonotic disease that spills over from wildlife to humans and then spreads through human-to-human contact; the case fatality rate averages around 50 percent, with past outbreaks ranging from 25 to 90 percent. Patients typically present with high fever and, in severe cases, uncontrolled bleeding. Transmission occurs via body fluids, placing household members and caregivers at highest risk. The report notes three Ebola virus types: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, and Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: 43名の死亡と263件の確定エボラ症例がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで報告 - ショルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い病原性（致死率50%前後）と国際的拡大リスク、複数国での同時発生報告が存在し、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Uganda（1562822）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国として含める。エボラウイルス病は致死率50%前後、人間-人間感染の高い伝播性、複数国での同時発生報告があり、IHRおよびWPRO双方の全基準に該当するシグナル。直ちにフルRRA及び緊急通知が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sorcellerie, choc social, interventions de la police... En RDC, la difficile lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Witchcraft, social upheaval, police interventions... In the DRC, the difficult fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak is unfolding in three eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu. Since May 15, 2026, authorities report 1,028 suspected cases and 246 deaths over two weeks, with the broader national wave having infected about 3,500 people during 2018–2020. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa on May 29, expressing support for affected communities and urging a faster response, citing shortcomings in Congo’s alert system that allowed the outbreak to spread for months before action. The piece frames healthcare workers and aid responders as battling difficult conditions, while noting the ongoing transmission in the three provinces. No specific infection source or laboratory confirmations are provided in the report. The situation underscores the urgent need for rapid containment measures and robust surveillance to halt further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 魔術、社会的混乱、警察介入…コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス病との困難な闘い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行性・長期曝露リスク全て該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問など高い社会的・政治的関心も確認。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の多発地域型アウトブレイク（東部3州：イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）。短期間（5月15日～31日）で1,028疑い例、246死亡。WHO事務局長の現地出動等、国際的対応が開始されている。サーベイランス遅延による感染拡大が指摘されており、管理面での懸念も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, guariti 4 infermieri in Congo. Oms: "Vostro coraggio dimostra che l'epidemia può essere fermata"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: four nurses have recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO: "Your courage shows that the epidemic can be stopped."
article.articleSummary: Four nurses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have recovered from Ebola virus disease, with WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus presenting recovery certificates to them in Bunia, eastern Congo. He stated their courage offers hope and demonstrates that the outbreak can be stopped. Nurse Etienne Ezo described his experience, noting dizziness, hypotension, and vomiting as initial symptoms before recovery. As of May 31, 2026, Congo reports 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths probably linked to the outbreak, according to WHO. Neighboring Uganda has nine cases and one death, per its Health Ministry. The report highlights ongoing Ebola activity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で4人の看護師が回復 WHO事務局長「皆さんの勇気は流行を止められることを示している」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生への影響（906の疑似患者、223死亡）、国際的拡大のリスク（ウガンダでの確認症例）が明確であり、2つ以上の基準に該当。また、WPRO基準でも重症度、流行性、管理可能性の複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ民主共和国での確認されたエボラ流行は対象国であり、シグナルのピックアップ基準を明確に満たす。WHO指導部による関与と地域的な懸念の高まりも確認。

article.articleHeadline: OMS faz apelo após avanço de surto de Ebola; veja vídeo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO appeals after an Ebola outbreak advances; watch video.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as WHO appeals for community involvement. During a visit to Bunia, the epicenter in Ituri Province, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged residents to mobilize in the response to the new Ebola epidemic. Congolese authorities report 1,028 suspected cases to date. The agency says it is expanding its operations in partnership with the DRC government to curb the outbreak, with health teams continuing case monitoring and strengthening prevention measures in Bunia and nearby areas, alongside intensified community outreach campaigns. Tedros, during a stop in Kinshasa, warned that international financial support is urgently needed and noted that only about one-third of the funds required to sustain the response has been received. Additional resources are deemed essential to control transmission and protect at-risk populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ感染拡大後に訴え；ビデオを視聴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当し、また重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性において複数のWPRO基準に該当。WHO事務局長の直接的な訴えにより社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)Annex2の規定疾患であり、1,028疑い例の報告、複数州での流行、WHO事務局長による直接的な訴え、国際的資金支援の緊急要請など、複数の重大シグナルを示唆。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）は対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーの主題である。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 250 cas confirmés d' Ebola enregistrés dans trois provinces en RDC - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 250 confirmed Ebola cases recorded in three provinces in the DRC - ACP.
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been recorded across Ituri (245), North Kivu (15), and South Kivu (3) in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of May 29, 2026 (report published May 30). Cumulative deaths total 42. Approximately 60 new suspected cases are reported daily; 3,200 cases have been listed and 967 contacts followed. Of the affected, 95 patients are admitted for care and 39 are in isolation. Public awareness efforts have reached 17,968 travelers (98.5%). To strengthen the response, the government provides logistical support, including three vehicles for field teams; a further 15 vehicles and 1,800 motorcycles are expected to be deployed to the affected provinces to aid surveillance, case management, and outreach.

triage.headline_ja: RDCの3州で250件以上のエボラ確定症例を記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。進行中の大規模エボラ流行で、確定症例263例、死亡42例、日次新規疑い症例60例、3,200例の接触者追跡中。DRCはシグナル対応能力が限定的であり国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月30日時点の情報。DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州での多地域流行。政府による物流支援と国際的な追加支援の必要性が明記されている。エボラウイルス病は高致死性でヒト-ヒト感染が容易であり、管理困難なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: "Ebola fuori controllo nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo", l'OMS lancia l'allarme e chiede l'aiuto della popolazione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the WHO issues a warning and asks for the public's help
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province (Bunia), is out of control. The current outbreak is the seventeenth since 1976. More than 900 suspected cases and over 220 suspected deaths have been reported in the DRC. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no vaccine; early diagnosis and prompt care are critical for patient survival. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged broad community involvement, warning that containment cannot be left to health authorities alone amid local protests over control measures. Uganda has confirmed several infections and at least one death; Brazil is monitoring two travelers from affected areas with compatible symptoms. Ongoing armed conflict in Ituri complicates response and resource mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で制御不能。WHOが警告を発出し、国民の協力を求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国家発生で、WHO事務局長による警告、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ確認、ブラジル監視中）が存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダおよびブラジルも言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダ・ブラジルは接触者追跡・監視段階。武装紛争による対応の複雑化が対応可能性を低下させている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株にはワクチンが存在せず、重症度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: נגיף האבולה מאיים על המונדיאל 2026: "אירוע הדבקה המוני"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus threatens the 2026 World Cup: "a mass infection event".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists, with 906 cases and 223 deaths officially recorded, not all deaths confirmed as Ebola. Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Four patients have recovered from the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, and the first documented recovery of a patient infected during the current outbreak was announced recently during the WHO director-general’s visit to a DRC treatment center. Authorities warn that the upcoming 2026 World Cup could become a mass infection event due to intense international travel and large crowds, though risk remains low; early Ebola symptoms can resemble other viral illnesses, complicating early detection. Canada and the Bahamas imposed temporary entry bans on residents from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. MSF urges expanded testing, faster medical staffing, and uninterrupted supply chains, while security threats and armed-group attacks in eastern DRC hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが2026年ワールドカップを脅かす：「大量感染事象」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限発動）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、感染拡大性、管理可能性）。複数国での確定症例と死亡が報告され、国際的な渡航制限も発動されている。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ感染が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。カナダとバハマも渡航禁止を発動しているが、これは対象国ではなく対応国として記載。2026年ワールドカップに関連した国際的な懸念が強調されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。セキュリティ上の課題と武装勢力による攻撃がDRC東部での対応を妨害している点も注記。

article.articleHeadline: The World Health Organization praises the recovery of 5 Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo recovered and were discharged after completing care at a newly opened specialized treatment center, according to the World Health Organization on 2026-05-31. The center strengthens rapid response by providing specialized care, medical isolation, and diagnostic services to manage the outbreak and support local health authorities. Contact tracing for confirmed cases is ongoing, with intensified community awareness campaigns on prevention and early symptom reporting. Field response teams remain coordinated with national authorities and international partners to rapidly detect new cases and prevent transmission. While the recovery of these patients is encouraging, health measures must continue to prevent further outbreaks. Ebola is a serious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person. The DRC has experienced several outbreaks in recent years, underlining its experience in containment.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者5人の回復を称賛
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは極めて重篤な感染症であり、DRCでの発生は国際的関心事項であるが、現在の記事は患者の回復と治療体制の整備を報告しており、拡大の急迫的リスクは低い。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: DRCでの継続的なエボラ発生は公衆衛生上の懸念事項だが、現在の記事は患者回復と対応体制強化に焦点を当てており、急速な国際拡大の兆候は見られない。今後の感染者数増加や地域外への拡大情報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dois casos suspeitos de ebola no Brasil seguem em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil remain under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil are under investigation, in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, involving an Ebola strain with no vaccine. Both patients recently traveled to Africa. On 30 May, other diagnoses were ruled out: a 37-year-old man who had been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for meningitis and developed fever and diarrhea, requiring intubation before transfer to Instituto Emílio Ribas. In Rio, a Belgian traveler in Fiocruz isolation tested positive for malaria; Ebola remains not ruled out. The Rio case is linked to Uganda; Ebola testing in saliva and urine was negative on 30 May, with blood testing pending. Health authorities say Brazil’s outbreak risk is low due to no South American transmission history, no direct Congo-to-South America flights, and transmission requiring contact with infected fluids. WHO notes 906 suspected Congo cases and 223 suspected deaths; 134 confirmed, nine in Uganda, 18 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで疑い例のエボラ2例が調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで報告されたエボラ疑い例は国際的に予想外の拡大事例であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。コンゴでの進行中の流行（906疑い例、223死亡）との関連性があり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事主体はブラジルの疑い例報告であるが、背景のコンゴ流行の現況も述べられている。ウガンダは地理的言及のみで疑い例の発生地として記載されていないため除外。2026年の日付は将来の架空情報である可能性が高いが、内容的にはエボラの国際拡大リスクを示す重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Riposte contre Ebola : Tshisekedi ordonne un renforcement immédiat des mesures sanitaires | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola response: Tshisekedi orders immediate strengthening of health measures | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, the 17th outbreak, is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On May 27, 2026, a high-level meeting chaired by President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo addressed the Ebola resurgence and evaluated the ongoing response. The Bundibugyo strain is the focus of intervention, with directives to accelerate health interventions and limit transmission. Key measures include rapid deployment of medical and logistical teams to affected zones and strengthening patient-care infrastructure. President Tshisekedi also ordered intensified epidemiological surveillance in households within outbreak zones and mandated barrier precautions in high-risk areas, notably systemic handwashing and temperature checks at strategic points. The article provides no specific case or death counts or laboratory confirmation details, but underscores government leadership and expanded infection-control efforts to curb spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | エボラ対応：チセケディ大統領が保健措置の即時強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の第17回アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当。大統領による直接的な対応指示があり、社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（第17回アウトブレイク）。大統領級の対応会議開催、感染制御強化・疫学監視の強化が指示されている。具体的な患者数・死亡数は記事では未掲載だが、政府の高レベル対応と感染抑制の継続的な努力が確認できる。DRC内での発生に限定し、国際拡大リスク評価は潜在的脅威に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Kodaikanal anti-rabies vaccination drive reaches 3,400 dogs in six days
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Kodaikanal, Kodai Hills, Tamil Nadu, vaccinated 3,430 dogs over six days, with 55 dogs sterilised under the Animal Birth Control (ABC) program; all sterilised dogs implanted with microchips for identification. The campaign was organized by the Kodaikanal Society for Protection and Care for Animals (KSPCA) in partnership with Kodaikanal municipality, Dindigul district administration, Kodaikanal Wildlife Sanctuary, Mission Rabies India and WVS Veterinary Task Force, targeting Kodaikanal and surrounding hamlets. Although the six-day drive officially concluded on May 31, 2026, vaccination and ABC activities continue through June 5, with a daily goal of about 110–120 sterilisations to reach roughly 4,000 total vaccinations. Officials note that regular vaccination and inspections have kept dog rabies cases at a minimum, near zero for several years, underscoring the public health benefits of sustained vaccination and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コダイカナルの狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーン、6日間で3,400頭の犬に到達
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンは予防的な公衆衛生対策であり、異常な疾患発生イベントではない。複数年にわたり犬の狂犬病ケースがほぼゼロに抑制されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは狂犬病の予防接種キャンペーンであり、感染症の異常発生（アウトブレイク）ではない。むしろ動物衛生当局による継続的な予防対策の一環である。記事は複数年にわたり犬の狂犬病ケースが抑制されていることを述べており、疾患圧力の上昇を示す証拠がない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in Congo is serious threat, but not 'the next COVID'
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in the northeast near Uganda and South Sudan, poses a serious regional threat but is not deemed 'the next COVID'. The Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO assesses global risk as low, with very high national risk in Congo and high regional risk. Transmission requires close contact with infected bodily fluids; casual contact is unlikely. Factors fueling spread include dense population, cross-border movement, mining activity, and ongoing armed conflict. WHO recommends airport screenings, temperature checks, and rapid isolation of symptomatic individuals; broad travel bans are not advised. No case counts are provided. In parallel, WHO notes worsening humanitarian conditions in Gaza and calls for broader international journalist access. Public trust issues and an 'infodemic' complicate risk communication, but WHO emphasizes evidence-based response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ感染症アウトブレイクは深刻な脅威だが『次のCOVID』ではないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の問題）、かつDRCは対象国で確認された。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているエボラアウトブレイク発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の北東部。ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境近く。WHO評価では全世界リスク「低」だが、コンゴでの国内リスク「非常に高い」、地域リスク「高い」と分類。ワクチンと治療法がないエボラ株。Gaza Stripは記事内で人道的状況言及があるが、感染症アウトブレイク発生地ではなく、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo e Uganda registram 263 casos confirmados de Ebola, com 43 mortes, diz CDC da África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo and Uganda report 263 confirmed Ebola cases, with 43 deaths, Africa CDC says.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, per Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, with 43 deaths attributed to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain. The outbreak represents the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third largest since the virus’s discovery. Health authorities and humanitarian workers report shortages of basic supplies, including masks, after the outbreak went undetected for weeks. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Kaseya calls for rapid activation of national incident-management systems and sustained investment in pandemic preparedness, noting international partners are most effective when aligned with strategies developed by African institutions and governments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダが263件の確認されたエボラ症例を報告、43人の死亡、アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスのPHEIC宣言、複数国での急速な感染拡大、死亡者を含む重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な対応とWHO関与が確認される。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外だが、DRCでのエボラ発生は明確。Bundibugyo株によるまれな株の流行、PHEIC宣言、医療用品不足による管理困難が報告されており、国際的支援要件が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case triggers protocols in Cagliari, Sardinia, after a patient was taken to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases unit from home with Ebola-compatible symptoms. Police and emergency services supported the transfer, and healthcare workers in protective gear isolated and admitted the patient. The Italian Ministry of Health said the person is symptomatic and recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo; tests will be performed by Rome’s Spallanzani Institute. The patient remains in isolation, and officials reiterate that Ebola risk in Italy remains low. Italy has called for tighter border controls, with Spallanzani experts dispatched to the DRC and a health-ministers videoconference planned before the 18–19 June 2026 European Council, plus an EPSCO Council on 16 June to set priorities. Africa CDC reports 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in the DRC and Uganda as of 30 May, with over 1,100 suspected cases; regional spread risk is real.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑い症例のエボラ患者：患者が病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目中3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。対象国DRCでの活発な流行と国際的な懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者はDRCから帰国し、イタリア（カリアリ）で疑い症例として報告された。発生地域にはイタリアも含まれているが、記事の主題となる活動的なエボラ流行地はDRCであり、イタリアは輸入症例の報告地点。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCでの263確認症例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い症例という数字から、リージョナルスプレッドリスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Says Over 1,100 Suspected Ebola Cases In DR Congo And Uganda
article.articleSummary: More than 1,100 people were suspected of having contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, according to the head of Africa CDC in a Financial Times commentary. The figure refers to suspected cases rather than laboratory-confirmed infections, and the article provides no confirmed case counts or deaths. Published May 31, 2026, the piece notes the ongoing concern over Ebola in the region. An accompanying image shows medical staff carrying an Ebola patient on a stretcher at Rwampara hospital. The report underscores the need for continued surveillance and timely laboratory confirmation to clarify the outbreak's scope across DR Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ疑い患者1,100人以上と発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを有し、1,100人以上の疑い患者という大規模イベントは公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのイベントを言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（id: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。1,100人以上の疑い患者数は確認された感染例ではなく、ラボ確認の必要性が指摘されている点に注意。エボラは極めて高いスクリーニング優先度を持つ病原体。

article.articleHeadline: Cagliari, paura per un sospetto caso di ebola: "È sintomatico"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cagliari, fear over a suspected Ebola case: "The patient is symptomatic."
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy triggers formal public health protocols. A patient who recently returned from the Congo exhibited Ebola-like symptoms and was removed from a residence by medical teams in protective PPE, then transported to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases center in Cagliari. Emergency response involved police, fire brigade, and local authorities. The Health Ministry confirmed the patient is symptomatic and will undergo Ebola laboratory testing. Tests will be conducted by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome later today. No additional details on identity or travel history beyond Congo are provided. If confirmed, this would activate imported-disease management procedures and require cross-regional coordination between Sardinia and the national reference center in Rome.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラ疑い症例による恐怖：「患者は症状あり」
triage.triage_reason: イタリアで報告されたエボラ疑い症例は、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡リスク）、異常性（高所得国での輸入症例）、国際的拡大の懸念を備えており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア（ローマ、ラツィオ、サルデーニャ、カリアリ）が含まれているが、サマリーの主題は『コンゴから帰国した患者がカリアリで症状を呈示』であり、実際の感染源はDRC。対象国リストにはイタリアは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし、イタリアでの輸入症例確認は高い関心事項であり、PICKUP判定に変わりなし。

article.articleHeadline: Dobre vijesti: Pet pacijenata oporavilo se od rijetkog soja ebole u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Good news: Five patients have recovered from a rare strain of Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in eastern Congo, with four to be discharged today and one discharged two days earlier, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, Ituri Province, epicenter of the current outbreak. Although there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo virus, recoveries are possible with supportive care. As of May 29, 134 confirmed cases have been reported in Congo and neighboring Uganda, including 18 deaths. Recovered patient Baraka Bulambulu described community fears and distancing. Medical worker Ezo Étienne reported rapid symptom progression—dizziness, vomiting, severe itching, diarrhea, and exhaustion—and seven tests before confirmation; treatment was supportive (antiemetics, IV fluids, analgesics). MSF warned the virus spreads faster than response and urged expanded testing and quicker aid mobilization. Burial protocols have fueled tensions, with attacks on at least three health centers; Tedros urged local community involvement.

article.articleHeadline: Rio: belga testa positivo para malária, mas Fiocruz não descarta ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro: Belgian tests positive for malaria, but Fiocruz does not rule out Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Belgian traveler from Uganda arrives in Rio de Janeiro with cough, chills and diarrhea; Fiocruz's Evandro Chagas Institute isolates him while evaluating whether Ebola infection could be present, given Uganda's Ebola activity. Initial analyses of saliva and urine on Saturday showed malaria infection and were negative for Ebola; blood test results are still pending. The patient will remain isolated until a conclusive diagnosis. Contacts are being traced with municipal and state health department support. Fiocruz notes that Ebola is not airborne and transmits via direct contact with blood, tissues or fluids; Brazil's risk is assessed as low. An ongoing Ebola outbreak exists in Central Africa, with Congo as the epicenter and cases reported in Uganda. The case underscores precaution due to travel history; Fiocruz remains the Brazilian reference for suspected Ebola testing and care.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ：ベルギー人がマラリア陽性と判定、フィオクルーズはエボラも除外しない
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからのエボラ活動地からの渡航者がブラジルに到着し、エボラの除外診断が進行中。IHR基準では異常性・予想外性が高く、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスク評価の対象となる。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラの確定診断はまだ保留中だが、ウガンダのエボラ活動地からの入国者であり、症状がエボラと一致する可能性があるため初期段階のシグナルとしてピックアップ。DRC及びUgandaはBluedot APIにより識別されたが、記事の主要な感染症イベント発生地はブラジル（患者到着地）のため、verified_locationsに含めるのはBrazilのみ。現在のところマラリア陽性で初期分析ではエボラ陰性だが、最終診断は血液検査結果待ち。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾ ಸೋಂಕು ಕಳವಳಕಾರಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡುತ್ತಿದೆ : ಎಂಎಸ್‌ಎಫ್ | Ebola infection spreading at alarming rate in Congo: MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection spreading at alarming rate in Congo: MSF
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, faces an Ebola outbreak spreading at an alarming rate, per Doctors Without Borders (MSF). Two weeks after the WHO declared Ebola activity in Ituri, MSF reports rapidly rising case numbers and a highly concerning situation. MSF Director Dr. Alain Gonçalves states the outbreak has deteriorated since cases were first acknowledged. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri on Saturday to assess containment efforts and affirmed international support for Congo’s response. As of May 31, 2026, Congo has reported more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 9 Ebola cases. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The international community continues to monitor and assist efforts to curb transmission in the region."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染がコンゴで警告的な速度で拡大：国境なき医師団(MSF)
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスによる大規模集団発生であり、1,000件超の疑い例と246人以上の死亡が報告されている。国際的な懸念と支援が高い。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州におけるエボラアウトビレイクの報告。ウガンダへの越境例（9例）も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの発生状況である。WHOとMSFによる公式確認、WHO事務局長の現地視察、国際支援体制が既に構築されている。2026年5月31日時点でDRCは1,000例超の疑い例と246人以上の死亡を報告。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Ungkap 5 Pasien Ebola Sembuh, Pertama Kalinya pada Varian Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Reveals 5 Ebola Patients Recovered, First Time in the Bundibugyo Variant
article.articleSummary: Five patients with the Bundibugyo Ebola variant have recovered in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the first documented recoveries of this variant. The World Health Organization confirmed the dispositions as Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened an Ebola treatment center in Bunia on May 31, 2026. Four patients are slated for discharge today, with one released two days earlier; another recovery was reported on May 29. No approved vaccine or treatment exists specifically for Bundibugyo, and authorities continue to pursue vaccines and therapeutics. As of May 29, 2026, 134 confirmed cases have been reported across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda, with 18 confirmed deaths. Baraka Bulambulu, one recovered patient, said communities feared the disease and faced uncertainty, underscoring the emotional toll despite recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ患者5名の回復を発表、ブンディブギョ株では初めて
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。ブンディブギョ株としての初の回復事例は医学的に重要であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認症例と死亡が継続中であることから、継続的な監視と詳細RRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダが言及されているが、確認症例数の詳細がDRCに集中しており、主要発生地はDRC（特にイトゥリ州ブニア）。ウガンダは隣接国として「neighboring Uganda」と記載されているのみで、実際の発生地確認の記述が不明確なため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ブンディブギョ株は致死率が高く、特定の治療法がないため、医学的・公衆衛生的関心が高い。WHOの治療センター開設とDG声明も社会的・政治的関心の証拠。

article.articleHeadline: WHO tells GT Ebola outbreak 'evolves rapidly'; Chinese health expert defuses concerns
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), an Ebola strain, continues to surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of May 30; over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, amid ongoing cross-border transmission between DRC and Uganda. One confirmed case, a U.S. national who treated patients in DRC, is receiving care in Germany. WHO director-general Tedros visited Bunia in Ituri province to assess the outbreak; BVD lacks an approved vaccine and definitive therapy. Experimental options prioritized include MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), Regeneron's maftivimab, and Gilead's remdesivir; WHO urged clinical trials to generate efficacy data. Transmission remains by direct contact with bodily fluids; there is no evidence of airborne spread. Despite the spike, Chinese experts say risk to China is low; China CDC reports zero infections. China has 21-day post-travel health monitoring for returnees, and mass vaccination is unlikely; targeted protection for high-risk groups is planned.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがGTに「エボラアウトブレイクは急速に進化している」と語る。中国の健康専門家は懸念を払拭
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）の国際的な拡大が進行中であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクが確認される。確認済み症例263件、死亡43件、1,100件以上の疑い例を含む急速に進化する状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョウイルス病）は主としてDRC（イトゥリ州）およびウガンダで発生しており、確認済み症例1件がドイツで治療されている米国国民である。対象国リストとしてはDRCと中国（中国の準備態勢と予防措置が記述されているため）を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツ、米国も対象外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO calls for community cooperation to contain Ebola outbreak in DRC - The Herald ghana
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia, faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus; no vaccine exists, but patients can recover with care. WHO Director-General Tedros urged community involvement, calling it 'everybody’s business,' as protests over body-burial rules accompany attacks on health facilities. The outbreak has 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths in DRC; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. Five patients have recovered and four more were due for discharge; another patient had been discharged earlier. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern, making it the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC. Cross-border alerts: two suspected cases in Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro) linked to exposure in Africa, and a Ugandan-man with Ebola-like symptoms in Rio. International aid—US$80 million additional (total US$112m) plus EU donations—supports relief; Africa CDC urges rapid activation of national systems and sustained preparedness. MSF warns the spread is outpacing response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため地域社会の協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認症例、死亡事例あり。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアを中心とするエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の流行。906疑い患者、223疑い死亡報告。ウガンダでも9例1死亡確認。ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）で2疑い症例報告。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（DRC第17次流行）。国際支援実施中だが、MSFは流行が対応を上回るペースで拡大しているとの警告。対象国外（ウガンダ、ガーナメディア）からの報道だが、記事サマリーは明確にDRC主要発生地とブラジルの2次感染事例を述べており、両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: مسؤول بالاتحاد الإفريقي: وفاة 43 شخصا وتسجيل 263 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا بالكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union official: 43 dead and 263 confirmed Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, an African Union official reported 43 Ebola deaths and 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected infections under investigation, including a rare Bundibugyo strain. The statement calls for rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investments in epidemic preparedness, noting that international partners are crucial but most effective when their support aligns with strategies of African institutions and governments. Medical and relief workers in Congo have warned of shortages of basic supplies, such as masks, as the virus has circulated for weeks without detection. The World Health Organization previously designated the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring the global health risk and need for coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合高官：コンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルスによる43人の死亡と263人の確認患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間発生であり、IHR基準の4項目全てに該当。WHOが既にPHEIC指定しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが全て明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。記事ではコンゴとウガンダの両国での発生が報告されているが、対象国はDRCのみ。WHOのPHEIC指定により国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak claims 43 lives in Congo and Uganda - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq and the world
article.articleSummary: As of 31 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has 263 confirmed infections and 43 deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The infections are linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak and the third-largest since the disease was first identified nearly 50 years ago. The World Health Organization has classified the outbreak as a public health emergency of international emergency. Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya urged rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investment in epidemic preparedness across Africa, stressing the essential role of international partners when aligned with African strategies. The comments came in an opinion piece published by the Financial Times.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴとウガンダで43人の死亡者を出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。確認感染263例、死亡43例、疑い例1,100例以上。WHO公式に「国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態」に分類。エボラ出血熱の流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを全て満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHO地域東南アジア地域(SEARO)に分類される対象外国のため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。エボラ出血熱はBundibugyo株と同定。DRC17番目のアウトブレイク。Africa CDC Director等からの国際的対応呼びかけあり。WHO公式分類により確実なシグナル案件。

article.articleHeadline: Sospetto caso di Ebola a Cagliari, paziente ricoverato in isolamento: test inviato allo Spallanzani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, patient hospitalized in isolation: test sent to Spallanzani.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy; patient hospitalized in isolation after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola. A biological sample has been sent to the Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome for confirmatory testing; results will confirm or exclude infection. The Italian Ministry of Health confirms the patient is isolated and under monitoring, with constant coordination with Sardinia’s health authorities. Population risk is described as very low, with precautionary measures implemented per international protocols. Context: ongoing Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda reporting over 250 confirmed cases and 43 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Italy has introduced a health-declaration requirement for travelers arriving from or through affected areas up to 21 days prior to entry. Final confirmation awaits Spallanzani analyses.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラ疑い患者、隔離入院：検査をスパッランツァーニに送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例がイタリアで報告され、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。中央アフリカでの進行中の流行状況と関連し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるイタリアはWPRO対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。ただし、DRCで進行中のエボラ流行との関連性があり、中央アフリカの流行状況が背景情報として記載されている。患者の検査確認待機中だが、疑い症例の報告自体が国際的シグナルとなる。

article.articleHeadline: Confermati 263 casi di Ebola in Congo e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 Ebola cases confirmed in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 Ebola cases have been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, according to Jean Kaseya, director-general of Africa CDC, cited by Reuters. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation, and 43 deaths have been reported, attributed to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain. Kaseya disclosed these figures in an editorial published today in the Financial Times. The update signals an active cross-border outbreak across two countries with ongoing laboratory confirmation and surveillance efforts. The article does not provide details on the infection source, transmission chains, or whether any cases are imported or exported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルス病263件が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例263件、死亡43件、国際越境流行で重篤な公衆衛生影響が明確。レアな Bundibugyo 株による複数国同時発生は異常で、国際的拡大リスクが高く、国際支援必要。
triage.notes: Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーは DRC とウガンダの越境流行を述べるが、対象国リストでは DRC のみ該当。Africa CDC による公式発表で信頼性高い。Bundibugyo 株は稀で、1,100件以上の疑い症例が調査中という点で懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga 2 casos sospechosos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates 2 suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health authorities investigate two suspected Ebola cases in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where a new Ebola outbreak has been declared, presented fever and is in isolation at a specialized infectious-disease institute; laboratory results are not yet confirmed. In Rio de Janeiro state, a man from Uganda showed viral symptoms including cough, chills, and diarrhea; the Rio municipality reported malaria, and the case remains under investigation. The DRC has reported over 1,000 suspected cases with at least 246 deaths since the May 15 outbreak; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. The WHO has issued an international alert; authorities in Sao Paulo say the risk of introducing Ebola to Brazil and South America remains very low. Five recoveries have been reported in DRC, including recent discharges; Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ出血熱の疑い例2件を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC及びウガンダでの確定的な流行、ブラジルへの輸入例疑い、WHOの国際警告発出により、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの流行（1,000件以上の疑い例、246死亡）が確定的であり、ブラジルへの輸入例が疑われている。WHOの国際警告と複数国での拡大がシグナルの強度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Un caso sospetto di Ebola a Cagliari, il paziente è isolato in ospedale: era da poco tornato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A suspected case of Ebola in Cagliari, the patient is isolated in the hospital: he had recently returned from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Italy: a man who had recently returned from Congo has been transferred to the Santissima Trinità Hospital’s infectious diseases ward and placed in isolation. He reportedly exhibited symptoms compatible with Ebola, triggering the full protocol as health workers in protective suits entered his home to collect samples. All diagnostic tests will be carried out in Rome by the Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases, with results expected in the evening. The Ministry of Health notes that the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low. In response to the alert, Via Manno in central Cagliari was closed to pedestrians for several hours; the street was cordoned off and shop shutters were temporarily lowered before normal activity resumed.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア・カリアリでエボラ疑い患者が発生、最近コンゴから帰国した患者が病院に隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラの疑い患者がイタリアで報告されており異常・予想外だが、確定診断前であり、イタリアは対象国外。DRC からの輸入症例の可能性があるが、IHR基準の完全評価には確定診断と詳細な接触者情報が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴからイタリアに帰国後の疑い患者であり、発症地がDRCであると示唆される。イタリア（カリアリ、ラツィオ州、ローマ）は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。確定診断前のため、フルRRA実施まで経過観察が必要。DRCでのエボラ確定症例の報告がない場合は、今後の情報更新を注視。

article.articleHeadline: EAC to hold emergency health ministers' meeting over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, the East African Community (EAC) announced an extraordinary virtual health ministers meeting (June 1–2) to coordinate a regional response to an ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak centers in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, notably Ituri Province, with Uganda also affected, raising cross-border transmission concerns in a high-mobility region. EAC Secretary General Stephen Mbundi said preparations include strengthened surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention, and risk communication, in collaboration with Africa CDC and the WHO. Key interventions: nine mobile laboratories at strategic border points, a pool of over 180 rapid-response experts, and expanded health worker training. The bloc also aims to improve PPE supply and develop a regional framework to accelerate vaccine and diagnostics approvals; member states include Burundi, DRC, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: EACエボラ発生への対応で保健大臣緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な多国間爆発であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。東アフリカ共同体が緊急対応を発動する重大事態。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは高リスク病原体。DRC（Ituri Province）が主要発生地。記事はウガンダも影響を受けていると述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。EAC加盟国のうち対象国はDRCのみ。東アフリカ地域での急速な感染拡大懸念が高く、ワクチン・治療法の不在が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Во ДР Конго и Уганда се потврдени 263 случаи на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo and Uganda, 263 cases of Ebola have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Among the infections, 43 deaths have occurred among those infected with the rare Bundibugyo strain. Health authorities stress urgent activation of national incident-management systems and sustained investment in pandemic preparedness. International partners are crucial, but support should align with strategies developed by African institutions and governments. Frontline health and humanitarian workers in affected areas report shortages of basic supplies, including masks. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The article provides no specific details on infection sources or import/export of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドルコンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルス病263例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、複数国での確認、死亡例あり、国際的懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみ対象国に該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、1,100件以上の疑い例、死亡43例、Bundibugyo株（稀有株）であることなど、極めて高リスク。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sospetto caso di Ebola a Cagliari, ma il rischio resta molto basso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, but the risk remains very low.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Italy, elicited an intensive emergency response, with 118 transporting the patient and responders sealing the street while staff in PPE entered the home. Epidemiological work by ASL traced the person’s movements to early May, when he visited relatives in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo. The decisive finding: the man never traveled outside Kinshasa during the trip, while the Ebola outbreak declared two weeks earlier is currently active in Ituri province, in the far northeast of the DRC, more than 1,500 kilometers from Kinshasa. Fever and mild cough were reported, symptoms compatible with many seasonal infections and not specific to Ebola. No laboratory confirmation or case counts are provided; overall risk to the public is described as very low.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑わしいエボラ患者が報告されたが、リスクは非常に低い
triage.triage_reason: 疑い患者はコンゴ民主共和国の首都キンシャサに滞在し、アウトブレイク地域（イトゥリ州）には接触せず、症状は非特異的で検査確認なし。イタリアでの公衆衛生的影響は極めて低いと評価される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は「イタリア・カリアリでの疑い患者」であるが、サマリーの分析により患者はDRCのキンシャサにのみ滞在し、現在のエボラアウトブレイク地域（イトゥリ州）から1,500km以上離れており、接触リスクがない。症状は発熱と軽い咳で非特異的であり、検査室確認なし。公開情報上のリスクは非常に低いと明記されている。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの実際のアウトブレイクは継続中だが、本記事の主題となる疑い患者とは疫学的に関連がない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: caso sospetto a Cagliari. Il paziente è ricoverato. In serata gli accertamenti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: suspected case in Cagliari. The patient is hospitalized. Tests to be carried out this evening.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Sardinia, Italy: a symptomatic Italian citizen who recently returned from Congo is hospitalized in Cagliari and placed in isolation. The Ministry of Health confirms the patient, initially taken to Santissima Trinità Hospital’s Infectious Diseases Center, was transported to Rome for testing. Blood samples were promptly sent to Rome’s Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases, with Ebola diagnostic tests scheduled for the evening of Sunday, May 31, 2026; laboratory confirmation is pending. Precautionary protocols led to the involvement of 118 emergency services, use of full protective gear, and an area cordoned off in the city. The Spallanzani specializes in infectious diseases. Officials say the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low. The patient is reported to be Italian, of Congolese origin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：カリャリで疑い例。患者は入院中。本日夜間に検査実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い例が対象国DRCからイタリアに帰国した患者で報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理に関する懸念が認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCから帰国したイタリア国民がイタリア（カリャリ・ローマ）で診療を受けているが、疑い例の実発生地はDRCである。イタリア領土内での確定例は現時点で報告されておらず、疑い例の段階。検査結果は未確認。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。イタリアは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga posible caso de ébola en São Paulo; activan protocolos de bioseguridad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates possible Ebola case in São Paulo; biosecurity protocols activated.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is isolated at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology in São Paulo after developing fever, triggering a precautionary Ebola investigation linked to the outbreak in eastern Africa. Authorities are conducting laboratory tests to confirm whether the patient has Ebola virus disease or another feverish illness with similar symptoms. The investigation coincides with an ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC involving the Bundibugyo strain, which has caused hundreds of infections and deaths. Brazilian health officials say the risk of introduction and transmission in Brazil is very low, noting there is no local transmission and no direct flights between affected areas in Africa and South America. The results will determine if this is an imported Ebola case or another diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがサンパウロでの可能性あるエボラ症例を調査；生物安全保障プロトコルを発動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例がブラジルで報告され、DRCでの活動的な流行と関連。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性、予想外の国への導入リスク、国際的拡大の可能性）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはSão Paulo（ブラジル）とDRCが含まれている。患者はDRC出身だが、症状はブラジル（サンパウロ）で発症・隔離されている。DRCでのBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が背景。ブラジル当局は現在のところ導入および伝播リスクは低いと評価しているが、国際感染症検出システムの観点からはシグナルとしてピックアップが必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola progresse à une vitesse jamais observée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak is progressing at an unprecedented speed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu) is progressing at unprecedented speed two weeks after authorities declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026. In Bunia, MSF and WHO report rapid case reporting with suspected cases exceeding 1,000 and about 240 deaths potentially linked to Ebola-Bundibugyo, a strain first identified in Uganda in 2007. Testing capacity is strained; hundreds of samples remain unanalyzed, delaying laboratory confirmation and size estimation. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Border and transport restrictions hinder delivery of medicines, equipment, humanitarian aid, and staff. MSF calls for immediate expansion of testing capacity, strengthened medical and humanitarian support, and safer access to affected areas to accelerate outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ疫病が過去に類を見ないスピードで進行している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な速度、国境地域での拡大の国際的リスク、渡航・貿易制限），かつWPRO基準5項目すべて該当する高リスクシグナル。エボラ出血熱の大規模疫病は最優先対応対象。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株による大規模疫病。2026年5月15日の公式宣言から2週間で前例のない速度で進行中。疑い症例1,000例超、死亡240例。Ituri州が震源地で、North Kivu・South Kivu州へ拡大。国境制限により医療・人道支援物資の供給が阻害されている。ウガンダとの国境地域での発生のため、地域的な国際拡大リスクが高い。MSFおよびWHOが検査容量拡充と医療支援を強く要請。

article.articleHeadline: Brésil: placement à l'isolement de deux hommes présentant des symptômes possibles d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: Two men placed in isolation after displaying possible Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Two men, one from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one from Uganda, were placed in isolation in Brazil after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola. Brazilian health authorities said investigations are ongoing following initial examinations. The travelers reportedly arrived from Ebola-affected regions, prompting precautionary isolation while tests are pursued. No laboratory confirmation or case counts were provided in the report, and details on exposure or contact tracing were not disclosed. Authorities emphasized investigations to determine exposure risk and potential transmission, with no further details released. The incident underscores heightened vigilance for Ebola in international travel and the use of isolation pending confirmation as of May 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：エボラの可能性のある症状を示す2人の男性が隔離施設に収容
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的疑い例（DRC・ウガンダからの渡航者がブラジルで隔離）であり、IHR Annex2の4基準のうち「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、エボラという重大感染症のシグナルとしてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に除外。記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダからの渡航者がブラジルで隔離されたことが主題であり、DRC とブラジルの両国がシグナル対象。ただし現段階では検査未確認（疑い例）であるため、継続監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola | Plus de 1100 cas suspects, selon l'agence sanitaire de l'Union africaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | More than 1,100 suspected cases, according to the African Union's health agency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and neighboring Uganda: 263 laboratory-confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of May 30, 2026, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The epidemic began May 15 in northeastern DRC and has been detected in three Congolese provinces and in Uganda, which has nine confirmed infections including one death. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; containment relies on barrier precautions and rapid case detection. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned about slow, dependency-heavy funding and called for broader continental financing, while a $319 million regional intervention plan was endorsed by health ministers of DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The World Health Organization has issued an international health alert; the outbreak’s true scale remains uncertain and underestimation is likely.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | アフリカ連合保健機関によると1100件以上の疑い例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4項目すべてに該当。重篤な公衆衛生影響（263確定例、43死亡）、予想外の発生、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）、WHO国際保健警告発令により渡航・貿易制限リスク高。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）および南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。発生地域APIはアフリカ大陸とウガンダ・スーダンも返しているが、記事本文ではDRC（Ituri州）が主要発生地。DRC対象国のため PICKUP判定。ワクチン未承認、治療法なし、資金制約下での大規模アウトブレイクは重大な懸念。WHO国際保健警告発令済み。
